long: A mob required to be used for triggers. DO NOT DELETE.
description: It looks unfinished.

long: Puff the Fractal Dragon is here, contemplating a higher reality.
description:
Is that some type of differential curve involving some strange, and unknown
calculus that she seems to be made out of?

long: A healer in a white luminescent robe is tending to the wounded.
description:
This beautiful woman at one time used to piously offer her healing skills to
any in need.  But times are rough and now she can only afford to help those that
are just starting their adventures.  Type 'heal' to see what services she
offers.

long: The questmaster is waiting for a brave adventurer to step forth.
description:
Many adventurers come here to seek glory by attempting to solve the quests
given to them by this old man.  The quests are not easy, sometimes nearly
impossible.  But they will always be a challenge.  The questmaster looks at you
and says, 'Help autoquest should show you all you need to know'.

long: A healer in a white luminescent robe is tending to the wounded.
description:
This beautiful woman at one time used to piously offer her healing skills to
any in need.  But times are rough and now she can only afford to help those that
are just starting their adventures.  Type 'heal' to see what services she
offers.  Type 'heal <spell>' to buy one of her spells.

long: Jack Russell hunts with his dogs.
description:
The Jack Russell takes its name from the Reverend John Russell who bred one
of the finest strains of terriers for working fox in Devonshire, England in the
mid-to-late 1800's.  Rev.  Russell (1795-1883), apart from his church
activities, had a passion for fox hunting and the breeding of fox hunting dogs
he is also said to be a rather flamboyant character, probably accounting for his
strain of terrier's notability and the name of our terrier today.

long: John Russell seems to have lost his dog.
description:
John Russell maintained his strain of fox terriers bred strictly for working,
and the terrier we know of today as the Jack Russell is much the same as the
pre-1900's fox terrier.  The Jack Russell has survived the changes that have
occurred in the modern-day Fox Terrier because it has been preserved by working
terrier enthusiasts in England for more than 100 years.

long: A Jack Russell terrier is following a scent.
description:
Jack Russell Terriers are a type, or strain, of working terrier.  They are
not purebred in the sense that they have a broad genetic make-up, a broad
standard, and do not breed true to type.  You will see different "types" of
JRTs, from long-bodied, short, crooked legs to a more proportioned length of
body and longer legs.  This is a result of having been bred strictly for hunting
since their beginning in the early 1800's, and their preservation as a working
breed since.

long: Wishbone begins yet another adventure.
description:
Wishbone is a Jack Russell Terrier played by a dog named Soccer.  This
adorable little actor has his own series on PBS and gets credit for introducing
children to over 40 stories from classic literature.  Wishbone became so popular
after his series started in 1994 that he now has his own line of children's
books and plush toys.

long: A sick looking dog gags on something in its mouth.
description:
The dog is unkempt and unhealthy.  It does not look like it has been eating
very well.

long: A boring old clone is standing here.
description: This clone is nothing to look at.  No, really, it is quite boring.

long: A strange humanoid is here.  How odd, its flesh seems to be falling off!
description:
This strange humanoid is moving rather slowly, and appears to be a corpse, a
walking corpse!  It must be a zombie or something of the sort.

long: Moose is lounging about enjoying his fame.
description:
Moose is the name of the cute little Jack Russell Terrier who became famous
when he landed the role of Eddie in the TV show Frasier.  Moose is also a
leading star in the movie My Dog Skip and is known for his performances
throughout the U.  S.  Currently Moose lives in Los Angeles with two of his
sons, Enzo and Moosie.

long: A very kind and caring soul is here looking out for those who need it.
description:
She immediately reminds you of your mother.  Constantly worrying about
everyone and everything.  She is always around to help out those who have hit
hard times and need a little boost.

long: A questmaster is waiting for a brave adventurer to step forth.
description:
Many adventurers come here to seek glory by attempting to solve the quests
given to them by this old woman. The quests are not easy, sometimes nearly
impossible. But they will always be a challenge. The questmaster looks at you
and says, 'Are you up for a challenge? '

long: A quest mob wanders around aimlessly waiting to be slaughtered.
description: This mobile's sole purpose is to be hunted down and killed.

long: A huge quest ogre has a pair of wings attached to his back as if he could fly.
description:
Though large and intimidating, this ogre does not seem to realize that he
would strike fear into the hearts of most mortals.  Instead everything seems to
scare him to death.  It is as if he has seen the future and he knows he is going
to die.  A crude pair of small wings are attached to his back and he seems to be
trying to fly away.

long: Socrates patiently waits to help new builders.
description:
Socrates (469-399BC), Greek philosopher, who profoundly affected Western
philosophy through his influence on Plato. Born in Athens, the son of
Sophroniscus, a sculptor, and Phaenarete, a midwife, he received the regular
elementary education in literature.

long: Friedrich Nietzsche searches for those wishing to become Overmen.
description:
Nietzsche, Friedrich Wilhelm (1844-1900), German philosopher, poet, and
classical philologist, who was one of the most provocative and influential
thinkers of the 19th century. One of Nietzsche's fundamental contentions was
that traditional values had lost their power in the lives of individuals.
Nietzsche maintained that all human behavior is motivated by the will to power.

long: An amorphous shape is floating in the air.
description:
As you stare at this amorphous shape, it begins to appear to take the shape
of a cloud-like humanoid.

long: An elemental is standing patiently here.
description:
This creature is the essence of the elements, and appears to be waiting
patiently for something to occur.

long: Plato offers advice to any who are in need.
description:
Plato (circa 428-347 BC), Greek philosopher, one of the most creative and
influential thinkers in Western philosophy.

long: Aristotle wanders the hallways constantly in search of more knowledge.
description:
Aristotle (384-322 BC), Greek philosopher and scientist, who shares with
Plato and Socrates the distinction of being the most famous of ancient
philosophers.

long: Confucius is busy following the way.
description:
Confucianism, major system of thought in China, developed from the teachings
of Confucius and his disciples, and concerned with the principles of good
conduct, practical wisdom, and proper social relationships. Confucianism has
influenced the Chinese attitude toward life, set the patterns of living and
standards of social value, and provided the background for Chinese political
theories and institutions.

long: The gateguard watches the gate carefully swinging the key around on its chain.
description:
He stands his watch carefully eyeing anyone who approaches. Disdain for the
local government and the miserable wages has corrupted most of the gateguards.
A simple bribe of about 10 gold is all it takes to get past them.

long: The variable questmaster is waiting to set you.
description:
This questmaster will save a variable to your player file to remember whether
or not you have done his quest. This way you can only do this quest once.

short: the protector of the magic eight ball
long: The protector of the magic eight balls ensures everyone gets an eight ball before they leave.
description:
This strange humanoid lacks any distinguishing features. It is dressed in a
white robe cinched about the waist with a white rope. It seems to have a
strange power about it.

long: A man beaten to the brink of his life stares up at you with powerful eyes.
description:
James Stockdale was shot down by anti-aircraft fire during Vietnam.  He was
held as a POW for seven years.  He spent over half of this time in solitary
confinement in leg irons.  Even being incapacitated he was still able to lead
the POW underground resistance successfully.  For this he was routinely tortured
and beaten resulting in permanent disablement from a repeatedly broken leg,
broken back, and shoulders being wrenched from their sockets.  When his captors
attempted to use him as televised propaganda, he slit his scalp with a razor.
When they covered the cut with a hat he beat himself with a stool until his face
was swollen beyond recognition.  As a final attempt he slit his wrists rather
than allow himself to be used or let down his fellow POWs.  His captors found
him unconscious and near death.  The torture stopped after that and they no
longer attempted to use him.  He received the Medal of Honor for his actions.

long: Carl Von Clausewitz is hunkered down in a corner of the cell plotting an escape plan.
description:
Carl von Clausewitz was born in Burg bei Magdeburg, Prussia, in 1780.
Clausewitz's father was an officer in the Prussian Army.  Carl entered the
Prussian military service at the age of twelve years, eventually attaining the
rank of Major General.  He is most famous for his military treatise, Vom Kriege,
translated into English as On War.

long: A crippled man seems content with his life and abysmal surroundings.
description:
Epictetus spent his youth as a slave in Rome to Epaphroditos, a very wealthy
freedman of Nero. Even as a slave, Epictetus used his time productively,
studying Stoic Philosophy under Musonius Rufus. He was eventually freed and
lived a relatively hard life in ill health in Rome, during which time he became
a cripple due to a bad knee. He was exiled along with other philosophers by the
emperor Domitian sometime between 89 and 95.

long: A spy from the underground resistance is discreetly looking for some new recruits.
description:
The underground resistance has been blamed for most of the crime in the city
and it has been rumored that many new recruits often end up missing. The few
that do manage to come back are often damaged both physically and mentally.

long: The prison commissar walks with his back straight and his nose held high.
description:
The Commissar is the highest ranking official in the prison and is
responsible for all interrogation and the propaganda it produces.

long: Some hired muscle is willing to do just about anything for the right price.
description:
This grisly mercenary is covered in scars from numerous fights. His eyes
show an intense hatred and a blankness of intelligence that seems to convey the
truth about brawn without brains.

long: Homer Simpson is wandering around aimlessly in a dream like state.
description:
The infamous cartoon character has come to life and roams this World spouting
words of wisdom to fellow travellers. He is decked out in his usual blue pants
and food stained white t-shirt.

long: The one, the only, Chuck Norris dominates the World around him.
description:
Chuck is a martial arts star, winning numerous martial arts championships
including being a six-time undefeated World Professional MiddleWeight Karate
Champion with a record of 65-5. He is also a renowned teacher in the martial
arts and if you are lucky he may pass on some of his wisdom to you.

keywords: waitress jenny jennifer woman girl maiden
long: The waitress is waiting with a pot of coffee.
description:
Although she seems to be a mere maiden, Jennifer is a veteran of the greasy
spoon, and enjoys serving the builders who come here in their overalls after a
hard day laying bricks and writing triggers.

long: This saleswoman is laden with gadgets and gizmos that are outrageously priced.
description:
A combination of good business sense, charming personality, and good looks
has made her a success at pushing useless products on uneducated buyers.  Only
on a rare occasion does she sell anything useful.

long: Death the Grim Reaper is smoking a Hookah.
description:
The dark-robed skeletal figure radiates an unendurable coldness. It is
however, his day off, and he is using a water pipe that he picked up in
Istanbul. It smells like he is smoking strawberries.

long: A young man is here smoking a cigarette.
description:
Dressed in drab clothes he looks tired and over worked.  He is one of the
few men who did not sign up for military service.

long: Ian stands here ready to serve your needs.
description:
He watches you carefully, looking at everything you look at.  Sizing you up
as you peruse his wares.  He is a small man, by anyone's standards.  He has a
strange glint in his eyes which some men get when obsessed with money.

long: Liam waits impatiently while you shop.
description:
Liam is constantly checking and restocking all his shelves.  His shop is in
an ordered disarray that only he can fathom.  Just ask him for help and he can
probably find what you need.

long: Shiro waits with a smile while you browse his goods.
description:
Shiro is a large man, a good foot taller than you.  He enjoys his job and no
one can come close to his skill in designing and forging weapons.  He is still
very much in shape in spite of his years.  He looks very capable of using any
of his fine weapons.

long: Shiro's daughter, Rhian, stands here waiting to help you.
description:
She is clothed in a beautiful, and tight, dress.  Something tells you that
she sells more weapons when she wears that dress.  She is easily one of the
more stunning woman you have ever come across.

long: An old, balding man slowly walks past, leaning heavily on his cane.
description:
The life in Sanctus though protected is anything but peaceful.  The citizens
spend many a sleepless night wondering about their safety.  This old man seems
to have aged prematurely due to his worrying.

long: Captain Lugdach, a retired sailor, is steaming some white oak to make a canoe.
description:
Years at sea have hardened this already tough man.  He looks like he could
tear your arms out at the socket without an upwards glance.

long: Branwen, the leatherworker stands behind the counter.
description:
Using hides bought from the local farms this young man makes some of the
finest leather products in Sanctus.  His wares are guaranteed for life.

long: Sarge, the blacksmith is here, pounding on his anvil.
description:
So intent on his work he seems not to notice you.  It gives you small start
when he asks, "may I help you?  " without looking.  Not a man to be kept
waiting, Sarge begins to tap his foot impatiently.

long: Hazel, the Wellmaster is sealing a barrel of water.
description:
She looks tired, but in a good way.  It must be true when they say about
everyone worrying about the dome collapsing and chaos befalling the city.  She
looks competent in her work and enjoys it immensely.

long: Corwin, the head postmaster is waiting to help you with your mail.
description:
The Postmaster seems like a happy old man, though a bit sluggish.  He
worries about the reputation of the Time Warp Mail Service, as many people seem
to think that it is slow.  Perhaps if he were to brush the cobwebs from his
uniform it would help to make a better impression.

long: Rowin, the jeweler, stands behind his display case.
description:
The jeweler has an eyepiece shoved in one squinted eye, and looks as if he
may be a tough bargainer.  You won't have much luck swindling this swindler.

long: A young woman strolls by, smiling at you.
description:
She is wearing a very drab white dress with some sort of flowery print on it.
She keeps smiling at you, and she's not a bad looker, but I wouldn't get your
hopes up.  She looks at you with a sideways glance and puckers her lips as if
she wants to be kissed.

long: An old lady is taking a break, just sitting on the ground.
description:
She looks frail and withered.  The kind of lady you're supposed to help
cross the road.

long: A man pushes past you in a rush to get somewhere.
description:
The man gives a little smirk as you look at him.  He acknowledges you with a
simple nod and then moves on.

long: A fisherman stalks past, obviously he didn't catch anything.
description:
He looks very disgruntled, another long day of fishing with nothing to bring
home.  You feel sorry for the guy.

long: A old man is reminiscing about the old days.
description:
He rambles about how much better it was back in his day.  Mentioning strange
words like "the old school" and how he was so popular back then.  You pity him.

long: An annoying kid is taunting everyone that looks at him.
description:
What a pest.  This kid seems to enjoy other peoples misery.  He is nothing
more than a big bully stuck in a little body.  He seems to have learned to get
by with his big mouth rather than brawn or brain.  Someone should teach him a
lesson.

long: A woman is here gossipping with anyone that will listen.
description:
She rants and raves about everything from her boyfriend to the weather.
She would probably give all she owns for a good man, maybe you should find out.

long: The banker greets you as you enter, smiling.
description: A very rich man, one of the richest alive.  He loves money.

long: Your guildmaster is meditating here.
description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

long: Your guildmaster is praying here.
description:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to the Gods; he has
a peaceful, loving look.  You notice that he is surrounded by a white aura.

long: Your guildmaster is hiding here.
description:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief.  He is dressed in the finest clothing, having the
appearance of an ignorant fop.

long: Your guildmaster is sitting here sharpening a sword.
description:
This is your master.  Big and strong with bulging muscles.  Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born.  He has a
calm look on his face.

long: Fiona is stocking the shelves to overflowing with various foods.
description:
She is rather slim for someone running a grocery.  Remember that saying,
never trust a skinny cook, you would think it would also apply here.  She
smiles and looks friendly enough.  I guess if the rest of Sanctus trusts
her....

long: A young girl is playing with a little doll.
description:
She is enthralled with reenacting a little skit of some sort where her doll
is a powerful Magi and is fighting the evil Drakkar.  She is almost as filthy
and ragged as the doll that she plays with.

long: An man dressed all in black stalks past you.
description:
A hired sword, this guy specializes in the elimination of pests.  Of course
his price is high, but many think it is well worth it.  Have someone you would
rather see dead?  Just ask this guy for some help.

long: A warrior is guarding a set of stairs in the back.
description:
Years of training and experience have molded this middle-aged man into a
fighting machine, only a fool would ever try to kill someone with as much skill
as this man.  Then again, fools are born everyday.

long: A Red Magi watches you careful, as if you have done something wrong.
description:
This man is obviously very competent in the magical arts or he would not
stare at you so.  He is dressed in a long flowing red robe with the hood pulled
down.  Various pouches hang from a red belt.

long: The town thief is trying to hide from the authorities.
description:
Hard to believe, but even in Sanctus the underground activities of criminals
is always present.  This small man lives off of the fortune of others by
stealing whatever he needs.

long: A maid scurries about trying to finish up all her chores.
description:
She smiles kindly as you look her up and down.  She definitely enjoys her
work.  With a sigh of regret she moves on to finish her chores.

long: A hoodlum waits for an innocent victim.
description:
He starts to walk away slowly eyeing you carefully as he realizes he is
being stared at.

long: A butler bows says, 'good day sir' as he walks by with his nose in the air.
description:
Dressed in black and white finery this man lives a decent life by serving
others.  Not exactly the most prestigious job, but it seems to make him think
that he is important.

long: A member of the blue magi floats past you.
description:
He seems to be out practicing.  He floats a good six inches off the ground
and is slowly moving along.  What next?  Someone will probably fly past you.

long: A Master Magi is in deep contemplation of the universe.
description:
The red robe signifies his order.  He is one of the five Master Magi alive
today.  He holds himself with a dignity that astonishes even you.

long: A man in a blue robe is studying a book intently.
description:
The Master Magi before you is enthralled in the book he is reading.  He is
oblivious to the world around him.

long: The Master Magi of the green order dismisses you with a wave.
description:
A Master Magi is the highest ranking magi of each order.  Of the seven
orders of the Magi only 5 have Master Magi's.  The orders of the purple and
gray robe have yet to select a master magi as none of them are powerful enough.

long: A man in a black flowing robe is chanting something under his breath.
description:
The Master Magi of the black order.  This man should not be taken lightly.
He has mastered the arts of his order and can call down upon his foes the power
of the gods.

long: A Master Magi in a yellow robe strolls by.
description:
One of the seven orders of the Magi, This Master Magi is well known
throughout the city and is revered almost as much as the gods.

long: An ugly white cat with dirty matted hair is pawing through the garbage.
description:
The cat has been missing a few meals from the look of its tightly drawn skin
around its ribcage.  The cat is filthy and needs a good hosing down.  It is
extremely wary of you and shies away at your approach.

long: Hannibal, the bartender wipes down a spot at the bar for you to sit at.
description:
Hannibal loves his job more than anyone in the city.  He is always up to
date on all happenings within Sanctus.  If you need some information this is
the man to go to.  He shouts over the other customers to you, 'What can I
getcha?  '

long: A corporal is making his rounds.
description:
He looks very tired and sick of his low paid high hour job.  His aspirations
to become a war hero went down the drain when he signed up for the army of
Sanctus.  Now all he does is stand watch and clean latrines.

long: A member of the green magi flies past, literally.
description:
Another magi out for some spell testing it seems.  They constantly expand
their knowledge.  Seeking to invent some new spell to help restore the balance
that Drakkar ruined.

long: A scantily clad waitress waits to fulfill your every need.
description:
She expertly works her way in between the tables and people balancing three
pints of ale on a platter while skillfully avoiding the attempted slaps at her
fine ass.

long: A black magi walks past in a state of deep concentration.
description:
One of the seven orders of the magi the black are known for their delving
into the the more abstract forms of magic.  The other Magi will not even
associate with them sometimes because of this.

long: A yellow magi chants some arcane words and is suddenly standing behind you.
description:
The magi are known for their experience with magic.  Many study decades to
reach the title of Master Magi.  Very few actually make it.

long: A man in a flowing gray robe is resting here.
description:
He carries himself with a confidence that is almost frightening.  You
realize he must be a magi.

long: Logan looks up with a wry grin on his face.
description:
You are just another shopper to him, and he will squeeze every dollar out of
you that you carry if your not careful.  He runs the town pawnshop.  Though the
prices aren't great he carries a lot of equipment that cannot be found anywhere
else.

long: A magi in a purple robe is making a fashion statement.
description:
The robe just seems....  Loud.  That color purple can't be natural.  You dare
not laugh or even smirk since you know they take offense to such things.

long: A sergeant is trying to find his corporal so he can put him to work.
description:
The sergeant looks pissed that his corporal ran away.  Now he is going to
enjoy tearing the corporal a new one.  More latrine duty is in the corporals
future.

long: A mangy mutt is looking for some scraps to eat.
description:
This dog does not look very healthy.  It almost looks rabid, better keep
your distance.  It notices you looking at it and trots towards you hoping for
some handouts, its tail wagging.

long: A midwife is tidying up the house.
description:
She looks rather old, touches of gray sprinkle her dark brown hair.  She
must have once been very attractive, but not any longer.  She looks worn down
and tired from her daily chores.

long: A newborn baby is rocking peacefully in his crib.
description:
How cute, this little tyke can't be more than a few months old.  He is just
starting to get some hair.  He looks up at you and giggles softly, expecting
some attention.

long: A pickpocket brushes up against you.
description:
This lowly thief has resorted to what most thieves consider petty crimes.
Like taking candy from a baby.  Any thief can swipe gold, only the more
experienced thieves can swipe equipment.

long: A patrolman is making sure everyone behaves.
description:
The patrolman keeps a keen eye out for any trouble and is quick to respond.
Only the foolish mess with these trained and disciplined men.

long: The War Master is planning his next victory.
description:
This one man is responsible for the protection of the entire city.  He is
very old.  His hair a bright white and hanging below his shoulders.  Other than
his hair he shows no signs of his age.  He is still built like an ogre and just
about as evil tempered.

long: The Great Speaker of the Land greets all who enter the realm.
description:
Dressed in baggy blue velvet pants and a white silk shirt covered by a
glaring red vest this man's voice can be heard throughout the realm.  He waits
to greet new travellers and bestow upon them his sagely advice.

long: An old sage looks out over the city.
description:
Far older than anyone you have ever set eyes upon, this man holds himself as
if nothing could ever scare him again.  As if he had seen everything this life
can throw at him and already overcome every obstacle in his life.  He is
unafraid of death.

long: Carla stands here running her sewing machine at a blinding rate.
description:
Cloth flies into her homemade spindle at such an alarming rate that you
wonder how she could possibly keep up with it.  Maybe she uses some kind of
magic to weave those clothes?  Probably just years of experience.  She can make
almost anything out of cloth.

long: A lieutenant is cursing up a storm as he looks for his sergeant.
description:
He is used to giving orders, not babysitting and hunting down people.
Looks like a lot of heads are going to roll when he finds who he is looking for.
He looks very strong and wise.

long: A general is planning his next strategic victory.
description:
He mumbles to himself as the war plan is being picked apart in his head.
Trying to account for every possible outcome he carries a heavy responsibility
that few people never appreciate.  He orders men to their death.

long: A streetsweeper pushes a broom in front of him, picking up any trash he finds.
description:
He is out here, day and night, picking up the garbage people leave behind.
Do him a favor and don't litter.  He looks miserable from his job.

long: A statesman holds himself in very high regard.
description:
This rather rich fellow owns a fair amount of property so he was given the
title of statesman.  He is prized within the city because during a time of war
his land and property will help to protect the city.

long: A hired hand is waiting for a job here.
description:
This guy looks capable of many things, which he would do for the right
price.  Few people can afford him though.  So don't expect him to jump at your
first offer.

long: A pathetic drunk is staggering around intoxicated almost to unconsciousness.
description:
He probably won't last very long.  Some hoodlums or a thief will come along
and relieve him of his money and maybe his life.

long: A beggar looks up hopefully into your eyes.
description:
He has mastered a pathetic puppy dog look that would cause most people to
give in to his plead.  But you're not that weak, are you?

long: A lance corporal struts past, looking very tough and conceited.
description:
Another member of the Sanctus army, this man has worked his way up and has a
bright future in the army.  Too bad he will probably be dead before he can get
that far.

long: A staff sergeant walks by, keeping step to a cadence in his head.
description:
This guy has been around.  He could probably teach you a thing or two on
fighting styles.

long: A starving bum is trying to get to the good garbage before the streetsweeper.
description:
This guy must have run into some bad luck to end up where he is right now.
He is covered in a film of dirt and grime.  He smells even worse than you.

long: A loyal citizen of Sanctus wanders past.
description:
The man seems lost in his own thoughts.  He has a grin on his face and seems
to think something is funny.  He doesn't have a care in the world.

long: One of the many townsman of Sanctus wanders past.
description:
He seems content with his life.  He walks past briskly mumbling something to
himself.

long: A townswoman is heading out to buy some supplies.
description: Dressed in a simple floral print dress so looks nothing other than ordinary.

long: A farmer has come in off the fields to see something of the city.
description:
He looks lost in the hustle and bustle of the city.  It looks like he wants
to get back to his farm as soon as possible.

long: A magi stands in front of a set of stairs with his arms crossed.
description:
He doesn't seem to be happy just standing there, he seems to be protecting
or standing watch over something, but you can't tell what.

long: A cleric carefully watches a set of stairs leading up.
description: He looks intent on whatever purpose he has been given

long: A sentry is watching the gates, ensuring your protection.
description:
They stand their post with dedication and determination.  They seem very
competent and will warn of any attack upon the city.

long: Gunney stand here shouting orders.
description:
This guy looks mean.  He is stuck in charge of training new recruits to the
army.  He pretends to hate his job, but deep down you know he loves making the
recruits lives miserable.

long: A thief watches the entrance to the upstairs warily.
description:
He seems content twirling a dagger between his fingers and occasionally
glancing towards the stairs in the back.

long: The stateswoman walks by with her nose stuck up in the air.
description:
You wonder how she manages to see where she is going.  Her nose is stuck sow
far up in the air that it seems she must not be able to see where she is
placing her feet.  Yup, you were right.  She just stepped in a pile of dog
shit.

long: A miserable recruit is carrying out Gunney's orders.
description:
This guy is exhausted.  The typical over worked and under paid army recruit.
This guy needs a beer, a woman, and some time off.

long: Javier, the High Councillor looks at you peacefully.
description:
One of the seven high councilman he holds one of the most prestigious
positions within Sanctus.  Javier is known for his common sense and appeal to
those who live hard lives.  He was himself just a farmer before he his calling
to become a Cleric.

long: A lookout peers into the distance.
description:
Hour after hour he stands above the gates looking for any sign of danger.
It is up to him to warn the town in case of an attack.  The position has a lot
of responsibility and is only given to those who show promise within the army.

long: Ingrid stands over a boiling pot of foul smelling liquids.
description:
She has given up her life as a mage and turned to the more economical
approach to living.  She sells her potions and other concoctions for a fair
price to any who may be in need.

long: A Master Thief twirls a dagger between his fingers.
description:
He has probably killed more people than the number of days you have lived.
He looks hard, the kind of hardness that comes from watching people die and
seeing how fragile life can be.  He acknowledges you with a nod and seems to
wait patiently for something.  G

long: Morgan, the bartender, looks you over carefully.
description:
He serves his customers with ease and experience.  He wears a spotty apron
and has a dirty towel is over one shoulder.

long: Sareth flips through a book hardly paying any attention to you.
description:
He has become very good at putting things down in paper, including spells.
His powerful scrolls can be used by anyone and are a very valuable asset to any
adventurer.

long: A healer is bent over from old age.
description:
His fellow clerics forced this poor old man into retirement.  He didn't
listen and instead opened up his own shop.  For a small fee he can fix you
right up.

long: A baker, covered in flour, pounds relentlessly on some tough dough.
description:
She looks very rugged.  Years of baking has given her arms like a smithy.
Very scary, especially considering she is bigger than most smithies you've seen.
She smiles kindly and tells you to let her know when you see something you'd
like.

long: The butcher's assistant is learning the trade.
description:
He looks up to his father is in most young men.  The field their father
works in is almost always what they end up doing.  He seems resigned to his
fate of cutting meat for the rest of his life.

long: A commander of the army overseas the protection of the city.
description:
He ensures that all is well within the city and that everyone in the army
carries out their orders and makes a good job of it.  He has been fighting more
years than you've been living.

long: A cat rubs up against your leg hoping for some food or affection.
description:
A pure white long-haired pussycat.  The only color cat in the city since
they are considered good luck.  All other cats are either served up for dinner
or let loose outside the city.

long: A small puppy has lost his way and is whimpering pathetically.
description:
How cute, you feel pity for him as he tries to work his way between peoples
legs trying to find his way home.

long: A german shepherd perks up its ears and wags its tail as you approach.
description:
These dogs are kept for many reasons.  Some are used to herd livestock,
others for protection, and even a few simply as pets.  They are very smart and
have evolved beyond normal animal intelligence due to Drakkar's experiments with
animals.

long: A small delicate dove pecks at the ground.
description:
The dove is pure white, almost looks like an albino except it has black eyes
instead of pink.

long: A mouse scurries into the gutter, trying to avoid being stepped on.
description:
This little rodent looks more like someone's pet than a street rat.  It is
pure white with black eyes and seems unafraid.

long: A cute little kitten is ready to pounce, its tail twitching back and forth
description: The kitten seems intent on attacking your feet for some reason.

long: The newbie guide is here to answer any of your questions.
description:
This experienced adventurer has decided to devote her life to helping those
who are new to this dangerous realm.  She has travelled far and seen many
things.  For the right reasons she has been known to help those who request it
of her.  She always is willing to give advice to those in need.

long: The carpenter frowns at your intrusion.
description:
He is loaded down with a tool belt full of various items he uses in his
building of houses.  He looks very busy and should not be bothered.

long: A temple cleric tends to the sick and wounded.
description:
He looks like he enjoys his job very much.  Helping those who are in need
for nothing more than a warm smile.  He is very gentle and looks like he cares
deeply about all of his patients.  He smiles at you warmly.

long: The butcher is covered in blood and guts.
description:
He seems to enjoy his job a little too much, is that blood on his lips too?
He has a strange look in his eyes, a lust of some kind.  Some inner instinct
warns you to be careful around this guy.

long: A hermit is standing here, oblivious to you and the rest of the world.
description:
This recluse has been living outside of the city for too long.  He is
disheveled and in desperate need of a bath and clean clothes.  He must be strong
and determined to survive out here on his own.

long: A bobcat is crouching here, protectively guarding her young.
description:
Normally this animal would flee at the first sign of humans, but she has her
young close by and will not leave them.  You have heard about how ferocious
animals can become when protecting their young.  Now you are about to experience
it first hand.

long: A cute little chipmunk scurries around gathering nuts.
description:
Its cheeks are puffed out to the max and look like they are ready to explode.
It must be gathering food to stash away for emergencies.  It's a small brown
furry critter with black and white stripes running from the top of its head all
the way down to its tail.

long: A red fox sneaks slowly away from you, trying to go unnoticed.
description:
It looks more of a brown than red.  The fox is extremely alert with its ears
coming to fine points listening for any sound of danger.  Its big bushy tail is
a sure sign of its good health.  It saw you coming a mile away and does not seem
very scared.

long: A skinny gray coyote fades into the trees as you approach.
description:
Although the coyote looks a little too skinny, it is definitely still in very
good shape.  This scavenger has learned to live off the land and has become a
common nuisance to the farmers in the area.  Entire packs have been known to
take down a stray cow.

long: A graceful doe flicks her white tail at you.
description:
The doe stares at you carefully.  You see a flash of white from the underside
of her tail as she warns other deer of your presence.  She looks very frightened
of you and could run at any second.

long: A large buck with a full rack of antlers stares back at you.
description:
There must be at least 12 points on the impressive antlers this buck is
wielding.  You wonder what it would feel like to be butted with those things.
Maybe you're about to find out.

long: A merchant is here travelling between the capital and Dun Maura.
description:
This merchant looks like he has been travelling for some time between cities.
He is definitely gifted at the art of selling useless junk that no one really
needs.  He looks experienced and you wonder how many times he's had to defend
himself being out in the wilderness like this.

long: A peddler is bringing his wares to the city to sell.
description:
This peddler has a bunch of useless junk that he hopes to be able to sell at
a profit to the suckers in the city.  He looks very untrustworthy.  You hold
your purse a little tighter as you walk by.

long: A possum is hanging from a tree by its tail.
description:
This odd creature has eyes that look to be made for seeing in the dark.
It's about 2 feet long including a hairless tail.  It looks stupid and slow.

long: An alligator crawls slowly towards you.
description:
This large scaly creature has a set of jaws on it that make you take a few
steps back.  It looks extremely tough and you doubt many weapons could penetrate
that thick hide.

long: A raccoon is sitting in a tree just above you.
description:
This miniature bandit looks very interested in what you're doing.  It watches
you without any sign of fear.  It uses its human-like hands to climb around in
the trees.  It is gray and black with the unforgettable mask around its eyes.

long: A skunk waddles slowly past.
description:
You freeze in your footsteps as you see the familiar black feline with a
white stripe down its back and on its tail.  This animal is scared of no one
since only an idiot would attack it and chance being skunked.

long: A little baby bobcat is playing here.
description:
This cute little critter looks like a house pet.  Except for those sharp
claws and teeth that it must just be learning how to use.  It's tempting to go
ahead and pet the cute little fella.

long: A lynx hisses at you as you walk by.
description:
This small and stocky feline has definitely adapted to these forests.  Its
ears have small tufts of hair sticking out of the ends.  It is about two or
three times the size of any cat you've ever seen.  It walks with agility and
purpose.

long: A hunter roams these woods in pursuit of a big buck.
description:
Clad in hides from his latest kills, this veteran of the wilderness stalks
his prey silently, waiting for the opportunity to strike.

long: The huntress tracks her prey with skill and determination.
description:
Covered in hides and fur from her past killings, she looks very experienced
and adept.

long: Farmer Bob wanders about looking for his lost cow.
description:
He looks very old and tired.  A lifetime's worth of hard work on the farm has
aged him beyond his years.

long: A cow roams about aimlessly, munching on any grass it can find.
description:
The cow is large and brown, with a short fur coat.  It is extremely docile
and friendly, having been domesticated to life on a farm.  Strange for it to be
out roaming around.

long: A reddish brown weasel slinks along the road.
description:
The weasel is a rodent that can prey on animals larger than itself.  It is
very intelligent and resourceful.

long: A newborn cow calf looks for its mother.
description:
The calf can barely walk on its own four feet.  It stumbles awkwardly towards
you, looking for its mother.

long: A heifer looks up at you.
description: The heifer is a young cow that has not yet calved.

long: A fisherman walks between the cities to sell his latest catch.
description: He walks past with a long purposeful stride on his way to making some money.

long: A bandit pillages everything in sight.
description:
The bandit has a big grin on his face and greets you with a wave.  He must
have just made a killing.

long: A merchant is here crying at his recent losses.
description:
A shame to see a grown man cry, but he has lost a lot.  He relates to you how
his caravan was looted by bandits.  All his accumulated wealth taken away in an
instant.

long: A gypsy brags of her clairvoyant ability then stares at you, shocked by your future.
description:
She grasps your palm and stares in horror up into your eyes.  She says, 'For
a minimal fee I can tell you of yer future.'

long: A greedy trader has been mugged recently and has nothing of value.
description: He is upset at his loss, but knows how to get it all back.

long: A small brown furry groundhog runs towards its hole as you approach.
description:
It is a grizzled thickset marmot, built low to the ground and about the size
of a small dog.

long: The wanderer is out on one her missions.
description:
She is clad in only a burlap sack and roams the realm looking for something
or someone only known to her.

long: Bubba staggers by, a little tipsy from his moonshine.
description:
He reeks of homemade moonshine, most likely made from corn.  He is the
typical hillbilly, and fits his name to a tee.

long: Kami, the guardian of earth stands here.
A Namekian Priest stands here looking at you.
description:
It looks unfinished.  He looks just like the other people in this village,
his green skin, antenna, and namekian cloths.

long: Mr. Popo is kneeling here tending to his flowers whistling.
A large wolf stands here growling.
description: The wolf has a very dirty looking coat, she seems angry at something.

long: Matilda sits behind her desk writing something on a piece of paper.
description:
She is a very pretty woman, and is also very polite, she smile sweetly at you
and then goes back to writing on her paper.

long: A Newbie Fighter stands here looking at you.
description:
He seems to be not a lot to look at, he looks kind of weak, his health seems
to be good though.

long: Vegeta stands here, grinning evilly at you.
description:
@YVegeta has a huge golden aura, his hair is blond and his muscles are huge.
Occasionally bolts of electricity arc through his aura.  @n

long: Master Roshi sits here reading a magazine and making weird noises.
description:
He wears a large turtle shell, and large funny looking sunglasses, the sun
shines off of his head, and he wears an old Hawaiian shirt.

long: Truncks is here playing his game system paying you no mind.
description:
The purple haired boy wears nothing more then a capsule corp t-shirt, blue
jeans, and a pair of semi worn-out socks.

long: A beautiful woman is here tending to the garden.
description:
Here hair is purple and she wears no clothing you have seen, it seems to be
made completely of a red material, she has a very shaped figure, curves in all the
right places.

long: A Namek Townsmen is walking around here.
description: You see nothing special...

long: The Elder Namek sits in his large chair breathing heavily.
description:
This has to be the largest Namek ever, sitting at a height of about 8'7" and
weighing over 800lb, he could easily crush you.  But he won't because of his age
and he is a peace loving man that looks like any other Namek.

long: A Dragon Statue sits here.
description: It is a large statue of a dragon.

long: A large bird flies around here.
description: You see nothing special...

long: A brown rabbit hops around happily.
description: It looks like a brown fluffy rabbit.

long: A white rabbit hops around happily.
description: It looks like a small white fluffy rabbit.

long: A Gambler is here gambling away his money.
description:
He wears the usual biker outfit, all leather, and he swings a chain around
his head.

long: A Biker stands here swinging a chain around.
description: He has the usual gamblers dice, and holds a knife in his left hand.

long: Map maker Lena sits behind the desk selling and making maps.
description:
It looks unfinished.  She has beautiful fair skin, her clothing looks new, a
nice silk shirt, and a pair of silk pants.  Her long whit hair flows gently down
her back, and she wears a small pair of half-moon glasses.

long: Chwin stands behind his desk polishing a sword.
description:
Chwin has a rugged look about him, his cloths are torn in some places, and
his hair is all messed up.

long: Arwin Mic'Zell fiddles with some armor behind his desk.
description:
It looks unfinished.  Arwin Mic'Zell wears some of the finest cloths you have
ever seen, they seem to be custom made, and very expensive.  He has short blond
hair, and he stands rather tall.

long: An elven townsmen walks around the city.
description:
It looks unfinished.  It is hard to tell this townsmen from the others, they
all look almost exactly the same, his hair is blond, and shoulder length.  His
cloths look new and he has a peaceful aura about him.

long: An elven woman walks about the city.
description:
She has long flowing white hair, her body is well built, but still beautiful.
Her cloths are well crafted and she looks to be loving.

long: The Village Elder stands here watching you.
description:
This man seems to be the oldest elf in the village, he has short white hair,
his face is worn looking.  Even though he looks old, he still seems to be
beautiful.  His clothes look to be some of the best you have seen.

long: Ligern, the village warrior, sits watching the fire.
description:
Ligern looks to be young, but he has many scars all over his body, the fire
light illuminates his body, making him seem older then he actually is.
Although he has many scars, he looks to be strong, and more powerful then any
other in the village.

long: A small squirrel frolics around.
description:
A chestnut brown squirrel, the is about medium size moves around in the
woods.

long: An ugly troll stumbles around here.
description:
This has to be one of the ugliest things ever seen, it has large cuts on it's
body, and in some places it is missing skin.  He wears nothing but a loincloth,
and a small belt.

long: Jak the shop keeper sits behind his desk.
description:
He wears a long ratty trench coat, and his hair is all straggly.  He has
multiple cuts on his face, and a long beard.

long: An orc moves in the shadows.
description:
This creature almost matches a trolls ugliness, the stench that comes from
him smells like rotting flesh.  His armor looks weak, and he wears no weapon.
He looks to be a little strong.

long: A wood imp watches you carefully.
description:
This wood imp looks like a giant tree, he stands at 8'3" and has a moss
beard.  His branches are all messed up and he has no leaves.

long: A woman stands about the room, giving people there mail.
description:
She wears a pair of spectacles, and a long white coat.  Her hair is a bright
pink, and is in a pony tail.  She stands up straight looking at you sternly.

long: Jewel stands here smiling sweetly.
description:
Jewel looks rather pretty.  She has long brown hair, and she wears some odd
looking clothes.  She has a well built body and looks very nice.

long: A hell hound looks at you angrily.
description: This is a very large dog, his hair is messed up, and he glows a bit.

long: A pretty border collie sits by the chair.
description:
She is a medium sized black and white dog, she has a long fluffy tail, and a
small head.  Her head cocks sideways as you look at her, and she wears an
expression as if asking who you are.

long: A heavily armored Guard stands here.
description:
The guard looks to be unaffected by your presence. His large form is
completely covered by armor. His face expressionless, his body motionless. He
just looks to be one big living statue.

long: The Weatherman watches the sky.
description:
He seems to be a regular man, wearing large glasses, and other business
clothes.

long: An Elcardorian orthodox priest stands here with a stern look on his face.
description:
At first sight, he's not the kind of priest you want to leave your children
with.  Than again, with the aura of calmness oozing out of him.  Maybe taking a
rest next to him would not be such a big risk.

long: The Executioner stands here waiting for his next beheading.
description:
A black hood covers his entire face.  Three holes have been cut out of the
dark cloth.  The eyes peering out behind the mask look to be slightly crazed and
definitely blood thirsty.

long: A rebel from the Suncas clan looks at you, paranoia in his eyes.
description:
No more than a boy this teenager stands before you waiting for the overthrow
of the Elcardian Empire.  No more than a boy this teenager stands before you
waiting for the overthrow of the Elcardorian Empire.

long: An elite Suncas rebel soldier is standing here.
description:
This grizzled veteran looks more like a mercenary than a soldier.  Which in
fact may actually be the case.  The Suncas rebels have been known to hire help
when they need it.

long: A rebel commando from the Suncas clan stands here.
description:
Scars seem to cover this middle-aged man from head to toe.  He appears to be
missing a few fingers and he walks with a favoring to his left leg.

long: The rebel leader Sujin Suncas is sitting here.
description:
The mastermind behind the latest attempt at overthrowing the Mayor.  He is
young, but a brilliant fire burns in his eyes that some people would call
craziness, but he calls eccentricity.  He is the motivation behind all the
rebels.

long: An Elcardorian infantry man stands here.
description:
This grunt has no purpose other than to sacrifice his life for his army, and
maybe take a few enemies out in the pursuit of that end.  He is heavily muscled
and adequately trained.

long: An officer of the Elcardorian military guards his township here.
description:
He holds himself with an air of authority.  A hard look in his eyes shows his
years of experience and training.  He has probably led more men into battle than
you've ever met.

long: An Elcardorian military captain struts his sword around here.
description:
The Captain is in charge of keeping the peace by order of the Mayor.  It is
the Captain's responsibility that everyone within the city behaves.  More often
than not this includes crushing any rebel uprisings.

long: A man is slowly dying from loss of blood.
description:
Wounds cover his body.  Some from whips, others from jagged blades, and still
others from piercing weapons and hot brands.  This poor soul looks to have been
broken with pain to spill his guts and tell his story.

long: Grandfather sunshine is here tending the cash.
description:
His beaming smile seems to brighten everyone's day.  The typical elderly
grandfather he looks very trusting and kind.  White hair, beard, and mustache
give him a jovial look.

long: A member of the Elcardorian parliaments stands before you, now as a prisoner.
description:
At one time this guy used to stick his nose up in the air believing that he
was above the law because of his position he held within the government.  Now he
has been humbled by chains and torture.

long: The Suncas prison guard is here making sure that no one leaves the dungeons.
description:
He looks tired and inept.  The monotony of his job has caused him to become
bored and lax.  Of course so few of the prisoners stay long enough down here to
even attempt to escape so a guard is more for looks than need.

long: A panhandler broke off her ass, begging for your charity is sitting here.
description:
This poor lady has seen better days.  At least she is begging and not selling
her soul body.  That will probably come later.  She looks up at you with those
pitiful puppy-dog eyes trying to find a little sympathy.

long: Brack, the weaponsmith displays his creations with pride.
description:
The burly man resembles the anvil that he pounds upon.  Blunt is about the
only word to describe him.  He definitely knows his metal-working though.  He
holds his tools and works the forge with a love for the craft that only the
gifted can possess.

long: Penny, the bank teller is handling some money.
description:
A strange gleam flickers in her eyes as she counts out some coins behind the
counter.  She does not look like the kind of person you would want to trust your
fortune with.  She immediately puts on a facade when she realizes you are
staring.

long: Tring, the armorer pounds away at a stubborn cast.
description:
Elcardorian armor has been known for its strength and durability around the
realm.  It is just about as famous as its outrageous prices.  This stocky old
man makes some of the finest in the city, and he prices it that way too.

long: The mayor's wife is here hinting at you to leave.
description:
They say behind every great man there is a woman, and she is one of those
women.  She has long black here with green eyes and looks deceivingly frail.

long: Coughing in bed, the Elcadorian mayor really doesn't want to fight any more.
description:
This once powerful man has withered away into almost nothing.  His strength
and will has been drained from him.  Too bad it will soon be too late for you to
know what happened to him.

long: Grandmother sunshine is here baking goodies.
description:
Her mere presence brightens the room.  She treats everyone like a long lost
grandson and immediately makes you feel at home.  Her kindness and sincerity
puts you to ease immediately.  The cookies she is baking smell delicious.

long: The grocer of Elcardo smiles at you in hopes of a sale.
description:
His business continues to do well no matter who is fighting who, or who is
running what.  The grocer could care less about rebels.  As long as people need
food and supplies, he's happy.

long: Lara is here looking you up and down.
description:
Rumors state that Lara was an outcast from a far distant city of mages.  She
was caught up in some horrible feud and had no choice but to flee.  So she setup
shop in Elcardo and seems happy and successful with the change.

long: A dark hooded man roams the streets
description:
You can see almost nothing about this man because his black cloak covers him
fully.  Just between the opening of the coat, a glint of steel catches your
eyes.  Odds are this man would like to be left alone.  He is almost certainly a
rebel which is apparent by the symbol on the head hilt of the dagger.  Who is he
stalking?

long: A strongarm of Iuel is not willing to trade in business.
description:
This ghostly apparition uses benign forces to mold and shape various
instruments of death and destruction.

long: The wisdom of Iuel hangs over the atmosphere.
description:
The wisdom and experience of all time can be found from this spirit.  It has
always been, and forever will be.  Gaining knowledge and insight into
everything.

long: A brewing cauldron is in the middle of the room bubbling.
description:
Within the cauldron an ethereal spirit stands, slowly stirring the contents.
No longer a living presence in this world it has nothing to fear, but it still
dwells in the lost arts of the arcane.

long: A stoned drugkeeper stares at you with an empty eye.
description:
The shade of the drugkeeper is eternally doped.  His abuses in mortality seem
to have somehow transferred over to the other side.  It knows it's drugs.

long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description: The spirit floats towards you slowly, looking for anything of value.

long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description:
The spirit fades slowly in and out of existence, barely still part of the
real world.  It stares with dull lifeless eyes at everything around it, seeming
to be looking for something.

short: the fallen knight's spirit of Iuel
long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description:
The shadowy figure seems to blink in and out of existence, it's form never
really even discernible, besides the fact that it looks human in form and is
layered in armor.

long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description: An ephemeral form that almost seems to disappear when looked at directly.

short: the dark blessing spirit of Iuel
long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description:
This shade from another life is strangely dark, almost black and seems to
carry with it an ill boding.

long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description:
A lost soul of a long dead vampire, it's body has become lost with time and
only it's lifeless spirit can now seek fresh blood that it cannot consume.

long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description:
This hunched over spirit barely even looks human, or what was once a human,
grotesque features mark it as a ghoul that long since died.

short: the spell chanting spirit of Iuel
long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description:
The wandering spirit is the remains of a powerful mage that found
immortality.  But could not bring it's mortal body along for the ride.

short: the soul snatching spirit of Iuel
long: A spirit of Iuel haunting these grounds waves a shaky hand at you.
description:
This undead spirit has lost it's bodily form and now lusts for another's to
absorb and return to life.

long: A fat rat sits on a mat eating slabs of cat grinning like the mad hat-ter.
description: This tamed rat waddles awkwardly due to it's massive girth.

long: A wog dog chews on a log releasing gas, causing a fog is here.
description:
This trained dog can roll over like a log, go for a jog, fetch a cog, and
maybe kill a frog.

long: A small boy named Roy sits here playing with this toy, his face full of joy.
description:
The boy looks rather coy and begins to annoy everyone which he seems to
enjoy.

long: A wolverine sick with disease growls at you.
description:
This angry beasts fur is matted and brown from dirt.  It foams at the mouth
and snarls at anything that moves, even it's own shadow.

long: A red and black striped tiger crawls in the shadows hoping not to be seen.
description:
The large beast is the size of a small horse.  It's muscular body rippling as
it stalks back and forth waiting for some easy prey.

long: A huge crab skitters around in the muddy waters.
description:
The large crab has a set of deadly claws on two of it's eight long limbs.
Each limb measuring almost a span in length.  It's hard crustaceous shell and
casings give it better armor than most other animals.

long: Writing equipment floats around in the air, waiting to take a message.
description:
Leafs of paper and other parchment float about the room ominously.  Quills
and ink bottles also.  It is here where you may mail anyone within the mud.

long: A mournful wraith hovers in and out of existence.
description:
Faceless and featureless, the only that can be seen about this entity is the
vague outline of a humanoid figure.  Glowing faintly, it nonetheless appears the
darkest thing in the room.

short: a mob for making triggers work
long: A mob stands here, waiting to help out some triggers.
description:
There is no actual description as this is a trigger mob.  I only typed this
in because I didn't like seeing the error messages in zcheck la de la la de la
la de la

long: @CA gigantic ice dragon@c stands guard over the castle.@n
description:
Huge and intimidating, this dragon is covered in massive armor-plated
scales, shimmering all different hues of crystal and ice.  Large scaly limbs
stand firmly against the ground, tipped with razor-sharp claws and encrusted
with snow as if the dragon has almost become part of the architecture.  His
steely eyes are bright but cold, glimmering with a strange blue fire.

long: @CA pale queen@c gazes forlornly towards the east.@n
description:
Her smooth, delicate features were probably naturally pale, but now her skin
is tinged with an eerie blue hue.  Her sorrowful eyes linger on the eastern side
of the room as if she were longing for some place she can no longer reach.  Her
dress merges with the floor in a flowing train of ice, rooting her to the spot
for all eternity.

long: @CA white-haired king@c gazes thoughtfully toward the west.@n
description:
Old and sorrowful in appearance, this man's thick white hair is part his own
and part crystals of snow.  His face is haggard and morose, his eyes filled with
a silent longing as he gazes toward the western part of the room.  The lower
part of his body has turned almost completely into ice, rendering him a statue
in his own abode.

long: @CAn icy princess@c stands frozen to the spot.@n
description:
This young girl has smooth white skin like moon-cream, silver blonde hair
tumbling down her back, glittering with snow crystals.  Her eyes are large and
sorrowful, a deep azure blue paled and sparkling with a misty glaze of ice.  A
fine sheen of frozen droplets covers her gown, studding it with crystals as if
bejewelled.

long: A tester dealer stands here.
description: It looks unfinished.

long: A woodchuck runs for its hole.
description:
This small brown animal is covered in thick fur and is about the size of a
small dog.  It is built very low to the ground and is actually pretty quick.

long: A large dusty rat crawls around here.
description: This rat seems to be oblivious to all around it.

long: A goblin raider stands here with a really angry look on his face.
description:
The goblin charges around looking for anything valuable to loot.  He eyes you
up and down trying to determine what you might have of value.

long: A mon's goblin is walking around looking for more artifacts to steal.
description: He carries a sack of useless loot.  Loot only to him you guess.

long: A hulk goblin is here tearing the place down.
description: Larger than the typical goblin this beast relies on his brawn to win.

long: This is a small unfeathered vicious looking bat.
description:
It squeaks and flutters its wings in anticipation to flight, and possibly a
feast.

long: A goblin bomber is here setting up an explosive.
description:
He carries a flask of gunpowder, flint, and some wicks.  Hardly the type of
person you would trust with explosives.

long: A centaur archer looks for a point of elevation to fire his arrows from.
description:
This beast has the upper body of a troll.  Huge arms and a barrel chest gives
proof to his earned position within the military ranks of centaurs as an expert
archer.

long: A peaceful monk wanders the halls in thought.
description:
He looks peaceful until you notice what looks like troll armor hidden
underneath his robes.

long: A centaur warrior runs around the area looking for someone to kill
description:
The brown coat of this centaurs body is thick and matted with dirt and grime.
It looks like she has had a long battle.

long: An oversized rat with large fangs looks at you curiously.
description: This one looks weak.  Though those fangs look deadly.

long: A crazy monk stands her muttering gibberish.
description: It appears he saw some things that he really wished he hadn't.

long: A deranged monk screams in fear at your presence and cowers in the corner.
description:
His eyes have become unfocused and seem to be looking within.  No one is home
upstairs.

long: A centaur swordswoman stands here looking pretty.
description:
She simply stomps over any remaining monks that live.  Crushing skulls and
breaking bones as she passes.

long: A monk who was kneeling in prayer before you interrupted him.
description: The monk looks upset to have been interrupted from his daily ritual.

long: A centaur axeman is here waiting to pick a fight.
description: He looks crazed and in pursuit of more blood.

long: A centaur warpriest stands his ground, casting spells on all the enemies.
description: Some centaurs have taken up the arcane arts.  Before you stands one of them.

long: A centaur samite healer runs around trying to revive the wounded centaurs
description: He dwells in the arcane art of healing and looks to be very gifted at it.

long: The Doom Priest guildmaster assesses your abilities and prepares for your training.
description:
He is aged and weathered from a hard life.  But, a power emanates from him
and the cold stare from his green eyes shows a wisdom and intelligence
unparalleled.

long: A goblin horde rushes in, attacking you from all directions.
description: These goblins are short, fat, and smelly.

long: An obese goblin charges in, trying to run you over.
description:
She is damn ugly, and smells funny.  Hard to believe something as disgusting
as this creature can survive its own breath.

long: A white and tan centaur gallops in your direction.
description: This massive beast is half horse and half man.

long: A heavily armored centaur points an intimidating finger in your direction.
description:
This centaur has been equipped for battle with chainmail.  He stomps around
heavily from the added weight.

long: A dying monk sits here in agony.
description: This man looks as if he has been attacked by a pack of some wild beasts.

long: An ensign goblin straight out from military camp, leads the raid at the front lines.
description: He looks a little bit cleaner than the typical goblin, must be more educated.

long: A raging troll clenches his fist in anger pulling the surroundings down.
description:
This troll looks to be in a battle frenzy.  A glazed look covers his eyes as
he snorts and grunts in anger.

long: With skin of stone hardness, this troll runs up and down the monastery crashing into everything in his path.
description:
The skin of this troll looks like rock!  He uses his arms and legs as
bludgeoning weapons against anything he comes across.

long: An enormously huge troll stands his ground, ready to take on a whole party of warriors.
description:
This troll is in a blood rage looking for another innocent victim to
slaughter.  He looks your way.

long: A powerful Doom Priest guards the stairwell going down.
description:
He carries no weapons and wears no armor.  He needs no such thing to protect
himself.  A power and intelligence can be seen when looking at this priest.  He
acknowledges your presence and stands even closer to the Doom Priest guild
entrance.

long: A small lamb is here looking for little boo peek.
description: This poor lamb looks lost and lonely.

long: Little bow peek is here looking for her lost sheep
description: Nothing.

long: A very small white bird is perched here.
description: This bird looks very gentle and sweet.

long: A small black fish swims here.
description: This fish looks good.

long: A small piglet dashes around.
description: The small pig is covered in mud and is enjoying the mess it is making.

long: A small snake lurks here waiting for something to eat.
description: This snake looks as if it has been waiting for a while.

long: A goblin is sneaking around looking for some backup.
description:
This goblin seems to have lost his counterparts.  He is not quite so sure of
himself without friends to hide behind.

long: A large purple toad squats here.
description: This thing looks uninterested in everything.

long: A goblin soldier is finishing off a few of the remaining monks.
description:
This yellow-green beast is barely even humanoid in resemblance.  You can
smell him from here.

long: The ghost of a monk who died in an unfair game of politics haunts this room forever.
description: Nothing.

long: A small troll stomps around trying to look tough.
description:
This thing looks pretty weak Though it is a troll and shouldn't be
underestimated.

long: A heap of grass lies here.
description: The grass looks like some kind of weed.

long: A wounded monk is scrunched up here in the corner.
description: The monk looks as if he had been attacked.

long: A very large orc is here dead.
description: This orc looks as if it was torn apart by a pack of wolves.

long: Tower Guard Holden is here inspecting visitors.
description:
It looks unfinished.  A tall male guard in armor stands here inspecting each
visitor into the tower before they enter for security.  He is rather satisfied
with his duties now and carries an arrogant smirk.

long: Tower Guard Stradler cheerfully surveys the crowd.
description:
Stradler is a charming and attractive guard.  He inspects visitor's
inventories for security here.  The ladies (and a few men) seem to flock to him
for inspection.  He stands proud and tall for the safety of the people of Los
Torres.

long: A citizen stands here.
description:
The citizen of Los Torres stands here, minding her own business.  She does
not want to be bothered, she has many, many errands to run.  She looks in her
purse, counts her money and checks for her ID cards.

long: A governmentally hired assassin stalks around here.
description:
An assassin veiled in red lurks around in the forest to match the color of
the leaves and be unseen.  He crunches on the twigs making it a dead giveaway as
to where he is.  He has been ordered by the government to kidnap any people who
are planning to attack them.

long: Zulthan the Waiter takes orders from customers here.
description:
Zulthan the Waiter is here taking orders and retrieving food for people. He
seems very busy, but he is very happy doing what he does. He has brown hair and
is very short. He is also a bit on the pudgy side as well, though he doesn't
seem to care.

long: Cassandra Lacela kinda stands here, like, drunk, you know...
description:
Cassandra Lacela stands here, kind of.  She slurs her tongue and her hair is
all messed up.  She must be drunk.  She is wearing a white dress with some red
and purple stains on it.  She lazily will take her customer's orders and she
seems to have an obsession with lace, due to the decor in the room.

long: The Government Official Lesalie is here.
description:
The Government Official Lesalie is here in his brown suit.  He is wearing a
white tie and brown pants.  He has brown hair and seems to be very tall.  He has
a scar in his left cheek that looks like a slash from a weapon or a claw of
sorts.

long: Salesman Derresor Maosund stands here checking his inventory of armor.
description:
Salesman Derresor Maosund smiles at his customers as they browse his display
and ask him questions on 'What does this armor do' and 'How much are these
boots'.  He is wearing a black robe over what seems to be flowing black pants
and a black shirt.

long: A Sniper Assassin hides here spying on citizens.
description:
The assassin here looks through the wall patiently at the citizens walking
past.  She has long red hair that matches her red outfit.  She has very unique
sniping skills as well as some interesting close up combat technique to boot.
She is mumbling to herself as she carefully watches to anyone opposing the
government.

long: The Assassin Chieftain stands here guarding over her prisoner.
description:
The Chieftain of the Red Assassins stands here with her specially gold rimmed
red veil and her dull gold badge that reads 'Red Assassin Chieftain'.  She gives
orders to her assassins from the government and checks over her prisoner.  She
has long black hair that flies out from behind her veiled head.  She has a very
tall and skinny figure and she stands with her hand on her hip.

long: The Government Official Visconti crawls up in his own filth.
description:
The Government Official Visconti, famous now for the addition of the top floor
in the second tower, is covered in dirt, with ragged clothing and a bruised
face.  He has a stubbled beard growing from lack of grooming and he smells like
a skunk in an exhaust pipe!

long: Tower Guard Ackley stands here, slacking off.
description:
He stands short, and has a severe acne problem.  He often bites at his nails
and shivers uncontrollably.  He has a major temper problem, and can go off the
deep end easily when someone comments on one of his flaws.  He snorts loudly at
random people for a laugh, and makes lewd gestures at those who have
disrespected him before.

long: The Government Official Miranda stands here.
description:
Oh, busy, busy, busy!  That's how she wishes her life was.  Now she's been
stuck in this dark place for so long all she has left to do now is cry.  Her
brown overcoat and pink dress are all tattered, torn and wet.  Her face is
covered in dirt, though it is hard to tell through her bushy medium length hair.

long: The Government Official Phel is standing here.
description:
He grins, he manipulates, he's the sneaky official Phel.  Known for his
persuasive skills around the town, nobody is exactly sure if this guy's
trustworthy or not.  He wears a dark green suit as he works his busy day.  His
hair is blonde with a white streak of hair down the right.  His eyes are colored
differently, one being brown and one being hazel.

long: The Government Official Gertrude sneers wickedly as she works.
description:
The pink suited Gertrude always wears a sneer and does things for her own
interest instead of who she is supposed to represent.  She constantly sends off
any messages of complaint to her, and is blatantly corrupt.

long: The Government Official Cecille hums ignorantly to herself.
description:
Cecille looks pretty darn dumb to be an official.  She is wearing a light
pink buttoned shirt and a matching skirt.  She is humming a song that she made
up five seconds ago and its rather irritating.  She seems like she would be
easily persuaded to believe one way or the other even if its unjust.

long: The Government Official Thedoric grins fakely as he greets his clients.
description:
Thedoric is heavily biased toward certain beliefs in life and is not afraid
to go to extreme measures to ensure that his beliefs are reality.  He is wearing
a red suit and has medium length black hair.  He always wears a rather fake grin
as he meets with people.  He tends to favor those who agree with him, and maybe
he's a bit irrational when it comes to those who don't...

long: The Government Official Luther tries his best to keep the council in line.
description:
Luther is trying all he can do to keep the council in line as of now.  He is
wearing a blue trench coat over a blue dress shirt with white pants.  He has
very short brown hair with deep blue eyes.  He is scrambling to save the city
from the council, though he looks like he could use some help.  Maybe you should
say hello to him?

long: The Empress's bodyguard Verno blocks anyone from seeing the Empress.
description:
Verno, it would seem, stands very tall though he also has a very large
waistline.  He is wearing a standard black tuxedo and he has his arms folded,
stepping right in front of the path so that no one will go through.  He has a
bald head and is also wearing a pair of black sunglasses.

long: Empress Lerallia smiles warmly at you.
description:
Leraillia is very exquisitely dressed.  She is wearing an untied scarlet red
robe over a shirt that hangs down to her thighs at some parts.  The shirt is cut
so tat triangular flaps hang from the waste.  Her pants are very loose and have
several chains hanging from various spots.  The pants are flared a lot at the
bottom, so much that it totally covers her feet.  She has long blonde hair and
sky blue colored eyes.  Her lips are the scarlet of her robe.

long: The artist paints another picture.
description:
The artist wears a paint covered smock and a black beret.  He stands in
disgust trying to think of ideas for his next masterpiece.

long: A journalist wanders around asking people questions.
description:
The journalist is dressed nicely, and is carrying a notepad, a pen and a
sheet of questions to ask the citizens of Los Torres.  The questions mainly deal
with the government, though most people seem unwilling to answer them.

long: A really fat chef stands behind the counter chopping onions.
description:
The chef is extremely fat, I mean, totally huge.  He has a thick, black,
curly mustache.  He is wearing a big poofy hat that chefs normally wear and a
big white apron that somehow manages to fit around his grandiose waist.

long: A crying man mopes on one of the pews about how he lost his wedding ring.
description:
The man has totally wrinkled clothing and bangs his fist on the pew
repeatedly for some reason, making all the citizens nearby uncomfortable.

long: The Government Official Johanes works on his papers.
description: He looks busy and self important.

long: The maid stands here doing laundry.
description:
