assassins.  Every idea, concept, and belief that is instilled in every assassin
while training came straight from this man.

long: A knight is guarding the entrance.
description:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Swordsmen and his extreme
skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly opponent.

long:
The Magistrate sits behind his desk, eyeing you as if you have done
something wrong.
description:
This man is obviously used to the power he wields.  A man to be reckoned
with.

long: Rapas the Rat stands in this small shop, ready to serve your needs.
description: Obviously not only a skilled thief, but a trained killer.

long: A nurse waits here, syringe in hand.
description: A kind smile on her care worn face, this woman is perfect for her job.

long: A street tough stands here, looking angry at the world.
description: What the hell are you looking at, dickweed?

long:
A ranger leans against the inner trunk of the tree here, waiting to help
you to the next level.
description: Lean and wiry, this man almost blends into the wall he leans against.

long: A man tends shop here, a wry smile on face.
description: It is apparent that this man would much rather be out killing someone.

long:
The bartender gives you a quick once-over, decides you're okay, and asks
how he can help you.
description:
A young, quick-witted man, the bartender loves to meet new people and hear
their stories as they rest in his bar.

long: A nurse is here, making her rounds.
description: A tired looking nurse.

long: The bartender turns to you, folds his massive arms, and growls from under his thick beard, "What'll it be?"
description:
This man obviously will brook no argument in his place.  A real his way or
the highway kind of guy.

long: A scantily clad waitress hands you your menu with a more-than-friendly smile and tells you, "anything you need, ANYTHING, just let me know."
description: This woman may not be quite a goddess, but she sure comes close.

long: A waiter who knows where all his customers keep their money is standing here.
description: Hmmm...  Wonder where he got that coin he is playing with.

long: A waiter is here.
description:
This guy looks like he could easily kill you while still carrying quite a few
firebreathers.

long: Salazar is standing here, eager to serve you a special drink.
description:
Salazar looks like quite an entrepreneur.  He knows how to keep his customers
happy, but that doesn't mean he's a pushover!

long: A young, pert, beautiful, and dangerous woman sits behind the desk.
description:
She looks as if she would be afraid to break a nail, but if she works here,
then she probably could pull your nails out one by one without you even
noticing.

long: A man hurries by, head down, dressed all in black.
description:
This man, wearing a jet black cloak pulled high over his face and black
boots, looks like a rough customer.

long: A man hurries by, head down, dressed all in brown.
description: This man must be the most nondescript man you've ever seen.

long: A Peacekeeper is standing here, ready to jump in at the first sign of trouble.
description: He looks very strong and wise.  Looks like he doesn't answer to ANYONE.

short: a member of the city constable
long: A member of the City Constable stands here.
description: A large man with no expression whatsoever showing beneath his visored helm.

long: A sanitary engineer is walking around, cleaning up.
description: What a tough job he has.

short: a member of the city constable
long: A member of the city constable stands here.
description: A large man with no expression whatsoever showing beneath his visored helm.

long: A mercenary is waiting for a job here.
description: He looks pretty mean, and you imagine he'd do anything for money.

long: A sullen, sloppy drunk is here practically laying on the bar.
description:
A drunk who seems to not be able to handle his drink, and to carry too much
money.

long: A beggar is here, asking for a few coins.
description: The beggar looks up at you with pleading eyes.

long: A stableman is here, ready to take your steed.
description:
The stableman, or more aptly put, stableboy, is a young man earning extra
money to help support his family.

short: a member of the city constable
long: A member of the City Constable is here, guarding against trouble.
description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy constable.

long:
A pale, skinny street urchin is here looking for any handouts or
valuable garbage.
description:
Grubby from head to toe, this poor fella looks like he was born on the
streets.

long: A Jareth commoner walks by you.
description: The man looks at you, tips his hat, and say,"good day to you, my friend.  "

short: one of the town folk of Jareth
long: One of the town folk of Jareth is here.
description: Prosperous, this man walks by whistling a merry tune.

long: A sniveling fop of a courtier walks by you, his nose in the air.
description: Dressed in his finest, this little man must have been to see the Lord.

long: A woman wearing a bikini and a sash reading Miss Hawaii stands here proudly.
description:
Beautifully tanned, long shapely legs, and DEVOTED to Kaan.  Wait!  What's
that mark on her left boob?  Well, I'll be damned!  It's a tatoo!  It reads
"Rodger's a sex-machine!  "

long: The Guard for the Guild of Mages stands here.
description: Pretty mean looking for a mage, better be cool.

long: The Guard for the Guild of Clerics stands here.
description: He may be wearing a robe, but I bet he could still kick your ass.

long: The Guard for the Guild of Warriors stands here.
description: Now THIS is one mean motherfucker.

long: The Guard for the Guild of Rangers stands here.
description: Wiry, lean and ready to beat your ass.

long: The Guard for the Guild of Assassins stands here.
description: Do NOT mess with this man.

long: A woman wearing a thong and pasties wearing a bright sash reading Miss Florida stands here.
description:
Sorry, buddy.  No peeking this one is all Kaan's.  One feature seems to stand
out though...  What's that tatooed on her ass???  Ahh, it's some letters that
spell, "Djinn's MY pimp!  " hmm, how interesting.

long: Wayn stands here, smiling, waiting to help you.  You wonder how he could possibly be smiling in this stench.
description:
As you get in closer for a better look, you see that Wayn has a set of nose
plugs in, attached to a head strap.  So that's his trick!

long: The cartwright waits here, ready to answer any questions.
description: The cartwright looks to be owner, operator, and builder of these fine carts.

long: A small loyal puppy is here.
description: The puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

long: A small, quick, loyal beagle is here.
description: The beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

long: A large, loyal rottweiler is here.
description: The rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

long: A large, trained wolf is here.
description: The wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

long: The cryogenicist is here, playing with a canister of liquid nitrogen.
description:
You notice a tired look in her face.  She looks like she isn't paid well
enough to put up with any crap from mud players with attitudes.

long: The jeweler stands behind his display case.
description:
The jeweler has an eyepiece shoved in one squinted eye, and looks if he may
be a tough bargainer.

long: A man dressed in dusty clothes gives you a smile and a wave as he walks by.
description:
The glint in his eye as he watches you pass doesn't make you feel all that
comfortable.

long: A man wearing a blue and gray uniform reading 'XXXX POSTAL SERVICE' runs by.
description:
You barely get a look as this man keeps on going toward the next town, just
doing his job.

long: A small, white rabbit hops by you, making it's way into the woods.
description: Cute little guy - but he IS in your way.

long: A hiker trudges by, loaded down with his backpack.
description: This man looks as if he could walk you into the ground and then some.

long: A Fetch, dressed in black tattered robes which seem to float about its body, stands here.
description:
A Fetch can mean one thing and one thing only - someone is going to die.
The primary function of a Fetch is to foretell death.  The question is - is this
Fetch foretelling your death, or someone else's?

long: A womanish spectre floats through the manse, her eyes crying blood.
description:
Her sad eyes tell a story of loss and regret, an anguish as ancient as this
home, possibly even older.  She constantly wrings her hands, looking about as if
in search for someone or something.

long: A sticky spiderweb lunges out at you, trying to draw you into its web.
description:
It is a very intricate and thick pattern that has been woven here, you could
stare at it for hours and travel its full length.  Strange, it seems almost as
if it might have just moved...

short: the spectre of the master of the house
long: A spectre of a distinguished man floats a foot above the chair at the desk, intent on something there at the desk.
description:
The spectre notices your arrival and - with bared teeth - lunges at you,
obviously intent on your destruction.

long: A moaning churel floats through the house, weeping for all the lost children.
description:
Its feet seem a bit askew, almost as if they were turned backward on the
ankles, and the constant moaning is enough to drive a crazy man sane.

long: A large black spider crawls along the floor just ahead of you.
description: It has hair all over its small but grotesque body.

long: A howling Phantom floats through the halls, looking for others to join it in its eternal Hell.
description:
You can not distinguish any specific features of this terrible force of evil,
only a vague humanish shape, baleful glowing eyes, and what appears to a flowing
robe cloak all about it.

long: A Screeching Apparition comes flying at you, screaming its anger and hatred.
description:
Its insubstantial form gathers together into a blackish cloud, all mottled
and shot through with streaks of reddish-orange flames.

long: A rat scurries across the floor in front of you.
description:
With its short, stubby hairs all raised on its back and its tail ramrod
straight, you would almost think this rat meant to attack you!  Best not to find
out - better kill it.

long: A Rahn warrior suddenly lunges up out of the grass and attacks you!
description:
Dressed in the ancient Rahn war garb, wearing tufts of grass about his waist,
with his face painted in light brown hues, this man looks quite fearsome.

long: A Rahn warrior lunges at you, seemingly from nowhere!
description:
Dressed in the colors of the grasslands, this woman blends in with everything
around her, rendering her nearly invisible.

long: A Rahn hunter is startled from his place of concealment, turning his anger on you!
description:
The tales told of these fearsome grassland hunters keep children up at night,
for fear one may sneak into their room!

long: A Rahn huntress decides you are fair game since you have invaded her territory!
description: This fearsome woman can only be described as 'bestial'.

long: A Rahn hidesman comes running at you, teeth bared.
description: Man, this dude is crazy!

long: A Rahn Keeper lunges at you from his spot in the grass, watch out!
description: He looks mean.

long: A butler walks up to you and states, 'please follow me, sir.'
description: Dressed all in black, looking like a very capable and dependable man.

long: A huge five headed demon rises up up on its haunches and attacks!
description:
This demon has pure malevolence for anything living.  Oops!  You're living!
I guess that means you!

long: A man sits here, chatting happily with a handsome older woman.
description: Looks like he just might get lucky.

long: A woman sits here, chatting with a young man.
description: Looks like a socialite who has seen better days.

long: A balding man sits in a recliner, feet up, before the fire.
description: Man, that looks comfey!

long: A servant walks by, stiff backed and formal.
description: Black slacks, white shirt, black overcoat - you know, a servant.

long: A maid walks by, ignoring you and all others as she goes about her business.
description: Black dress, white smock.  She looks quite a bit like a maid.

long: The Cook bustles about, making a mess while making a meal.
description:
Dressed in what used to be white, the cook mostly wears her many stains upon
herself.  Strangely, she seems almost proud of those stains, almost as if they
were decorations from battles past.

long: A HUGE FAT maid stands here, cramming all the food she can in her mouth.
description:
This big 'ole porker must have won at least one all-you-can-eat contest in
her time.

long: A huge slimy green thing crawls across the table, sucking at the food.
description: Man, that's sick.  Sick and wrong.

long: The Face suddenly comes alive, out of the picture, and attacks you!
description: By the Gods, what IS it?

long: A HUGE bear rises up on its hind legs, looking as if it may attack!
description:
The image of this bear wavers in and out, flickering.  Could it be that this
thing isn't what it seems?

long: The man jumps up from the bed and although he has not a stitch on him, attacks!
description: This guy must've been a little, err, busy?  When you landed in his room.

long: The woman simply tries to cover herself under the blankets.
description: Poor girl, looks as if maybe she was one the servants...

long: A vampiress stands naked in the shower, mouth open wide, gleefully slurping the blood.
description: As beautiful as she may seem, she is ten times as dangerous.

long: Old Marty stands behind the bar, mixing drinks.
description: Good Old Marty, what a guy.

long: Ma sits here in her rockin' chair, knittin' away the time.
description: -Ma asks, 'Are you one of Inna's friends?  '

long: Pa sits with his whittlin' knife, whittlin' on some wood.
description: -'Looks like another one of them damn hippies, Ma', Pa says.

long: An Ancient Dragon is resting on it's haunches in the center of the floor, one eye cocked curiously upon you.
description:
Scarred, a bit withered, but definitely still in good enough condition to
whoop your ass.

long: Martin dangles about four feet off the floor from a rope.
description:
Poor fella, he always said he never had enough time to get anything done.
Always so busy...  Guess he got this one thing done, though.

long: A receptionist sits at her desk, filing her nails.
description: Undefined

long: Inna is here, busily brewing some kind of potion.
description: Dressed in a white alchemist's robe, she still looks stunning.

long: Igor is mixing a brew here.
description: Looking tall, regal and powerful, you have to respect this man.

long: A huge brown bear roars its defiance and opens its jaws in a snarl!
description:
It moves its head this way and that, as if looking for the best spot to bite
you.

long: A rattlesnake slithers up near you, raising head and tail in anticipation.
description:
Roughly 5 feet in length, this snake could very well give you a bit of
trouble if you mess with it too much.  Best to just sort of ease on past.

long: A wolf slinks past you, looking at you out of the corner of its eye.
description:
It looks sleek and swift, not very large at all, but large enough to give you
a few nips in the ass if you mess with it.

long: An enormous black bear rears up on two legs and roars!
description:
Its gaping jaws drip saliva, saliva that is probably the prep for the bear's
mouth where it intends to bodily put you!

long: A huge grizzly bear lumbers along, minding its own business.
description:
It doesn't even acknowledge the fact that you are near, it just moves right
along on its way.

long: A little fox runs past you, happily playing its day away.
description:
It jumps from leaf to leaf in huge bounds, trapping the leaf and biting the
hell out of it, the going onto its next 'victim'.

long: Ernie the farmer stands here, welcoming you to his home.
description:
Ernie looks like your typical country farmland hick, complete with cowhide
jacket and rubber boots.

long: Ernie's wife, Sandy, stands proudly with her husband.
description: She ain't much of a looker, but for a farmer's wife, she'll do.

long: Ernie's daughter, Patty, is here milking a cow.
description: Wow, they sure make farm girls just right.  Think she's eighteen?

long: A man is here, bedded down in the hay, obviously a tramp looking for a free day's rest.
description:
Patchwork clothes of every color and size, this man is your typical roaming
loser.

long: A cow patiently waits to be milked here.
description: Moo.

long: Girschwyn relaxes in his favorite chair near the fire.
description: He looks a bit old, but just the same, very fit.

long: A farmhand is here, busy at work.
description: Looks like this guy spends most of his day rolling in dirt and sweating.

long: A tractor sits in the middle of the field, looking quite unused.
description: Big, green and mean - that's this tractor's story.

long: A stableman works with the horses here.
description: Dusty and musty, grubby and nasty, this guy LIVES for his job.

long: Krandle is here, chewin' on a piece of straw.
description:
Krandle has that look of a man always squinting into the sun, even at night.
His face is leathered and wrinkly from the sun.

long: Erik sits here on the dock, doing a bit of fishing.
description:
No doubt Krandle, Erik's father, would throw a fit if he knew Erik was
fishing and not doing his chores.

long: A frog is here, relaxing in the sun and water.
description: Riddip.

long: A deer is standing here, frozen in fear by your presence.
description:
A beautiful doe, this beautiful creature nearly brings tears to your eyes by
it's stunning perfection.

long: Suzarre the Pig Woman stands here... she looks a LOT like Kathy Bates.
description: She's your number one fan....

long: A pig is here, stinking and dirty.
description: Oink.

long: A chicken struts around the yard, hoping for some seeds.
description: Cluck.

long: A man is here, sloppin' the pigs.
description: Grubby old man, looks like he really gets into his work.

long: A man is here, feeding the chickens.
description: With his long, beak-like nose and strange walk, this man has become his work.

long: The Father, Padrick lies in everlasting slumber next to his bride, Siobian.
description:
Although in a slumber, his eyes will not close.  Must be an enchanted
slumber.

long: The Mother, Siobian, lies in eternal rest next to her husband, Padrick.
description: Siobian lies at rest, but her eyes remain open - she must be enchanted.

long: The Goddess Cathari, in all her splendid wisdom, rests here in her golden throne.
description:
Her aura is such that it makes you squint looking at her.  What a sight to
beheld...  A true Goddess.  Maybe you should try killing her...

long: A Howler Banshee moves gracefully past you, ignoring the fact that you are here.
description:
Dressed in a fine evening gown, simple yet elegant, she moves with an
otherworldly grace.

long: A Wailer Banshee floats past you, her feet barely touching the ground.
description:
Her feet actually do touch the ground, but her grace and poise is such that
she seems to float.

long: A Firshee Banshee strolls past you, all elegance and formality.
description:
One of the few males you have seen thus far in the village, and a stunning
specimen he is.

long: A visiting Toreader cousin kneels in worship before the Mother and Father.
description:
Her head is bowed and her lips move, but she makes no sound, nor does she
acknowledge your presence.

long: A pelican is here, taking a break in the sun.
description: Looks like every other pelican you've seen....

long: A sea otter is here, basking in the warmth of the sun.
description: Cute little guy, even though he looks a bit slimy.

long: A seagull pokes about, looking for scraps.
description: Dirty little bird, you wish you had a wrist-rocket (more fun).

long: The Lighthouse Keeper is here, looking unsure of what he should do about you being here.
description:
"All I ever wanted was sexual fulfillment", the Lighthouse Keeper explains,
"I never intended to hurt anyone, it seems that this all;just got a bit out of
hand....  "

long: A strange looking.. thing(?) is standing here, no expression on it's face at all.
description:
It looks as if it may be a man, but then, being that it is naked, you can see
that it is just a bit of both.

long: A woman lies here on her cot, bruised, naked, and bleeding.
description:
It looks as if she may have been a very beautiful woman at one time, however
she is now so covered in dirt and grime, it is hard to tell.

long: A naked man stands, boasting a HUGE set of knockers.
description:
You're not sure what he is, how he came to be what he is now, and you're not
sure you want to know.

long: The Perfect Companion lies stretched out on the bed, waiting to give pleasure.
description: It is not describable, simply not describable.

long: The Lighthouse Keeper's wife is here, sewing and humming a happy song.
description:
Such a kind looking lady, I'm sure she'd let you stay to dinner if you had
the urge.

long: Max, the Lighthouse Keeper's dog rests before the fire.
description:
Mostly mutt, but very friendly, this black dog looks like the stereo- typical
house-dog.

long: The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter is here, playing house.
description:
Although she looks as if she must be at least fifteen or sixteen years old,
she still seems quite content with her dolls.  What a nice girl!

long: Old man Takker sits here, fishing away his life.
description:
It is said by many that Old Man Takker hasn't left this spot for over twenty.
His disciples bring him any food he needs, and they say he never sleeps - just
fishes.

long: A fisherman sits here, trying to imitate Takker as best he can.
description: Man this guy smells bad!

long: With a tremendous blast of force, the Kracken lunges up from the water!
description: This creature is larger than a city block and older than the Gods themselves.

long: A huge, black doglike thing blasts from behind trees, attacking you!
description: This demon dog is a Barghest, guardian of all things evil and cruel.

long: A corpse candle shimmers before you, trying to find it's way to Peace.
description:
This unlucky soul lost it's way to Heaven or Hell, wherever it was headed,
and wound up roaming this forest in search of the Way.

long: A strange, pale manlike thing ambles into view, slowly turning its head your way.
description:
This thing, half blood-sucker and half were-man, looks as if it has not fed
in some time.

long: Lord Ankou, King of the Dead, rides his ghostly cart through the forest.
description:
This awful spectre of death rides his cart through the forest searching for
dead souls that he may claim as his own.

long: A ghostly spectre follows alongside it's Lord, guarding the captured souls.
description:
With no distinct facial features it is hard to tell if this thing was once a
man or woman or if it ever was alive at all.

long: A man stands here, a wooden stake sticking out of a backpack he is wearing.
description:
He gives you a piercing look, one that seems to borrow down into your soul.
He raises one side of his upper lip in a snarl and attacks.

long: A buzzard spots you and heads your way, watch out!
description: This nasty, dirty bird looks hungry and mean and ready to bite your face off.

long: A woman wearing a pretty pink taffeta dress trudges along the beach.
description:
My, what beauty.  But she just gives you a long, doleful stare and without a
sound continues along.  How strange--her eyes are a very dull gray.  Doesn't
seem to work with her beautiful face.

long: A woman wearing a pretty blue silk dress trudges along the beach.
description:
My, what beauty.  But she just gives you a long, doleful stare and without a
sound continues along.  How strange--her eyes are a very dull gray.  Doesn't
seem to work with her beautiful face.

long: A woman wearing a pretty pristine white cotton dress trudges along the beach.
description:
My, what beauty.  But she just gives you a long, doleful stare and without a
sound continues along.  How strange--her eyes are a very dull gray.  Doesn't
seem to work with her beautiful face.

short: the woman in a drab beige dress
long: A woman wearing a drab beige burlap dress trudges along the beach.
description:
My, what beauty.  But she just gives you a long, doleful stare and without a
sound continues along.  How strange--her eyes are a very dull gray.  Doesn't
seem to work with her beautiful face.

short: the special slave of the master
long: A slave for the master works endlessly at his will.
description:
My, what beauty.  But she just gives you a long, doleful stare and without a
sound continues along.  How strange--her eyes are a very dull gray.  Doesn't
seem to work with her beautiful face.

long: A very fat harem master orders his concubines around.
description:
Gads.  This man must have some kind of magic to be able to keep all of these
women, because he certainly doesn't have the face for it.  He looks somewhat
like a cross between a pear and a potato, but without the good looks.

long: A small, red crab scuttles along the beach.
description:
This small creature has rather large pincers for its negligible size.  It
looks benign, but probably wouldn't appreciate being attacked.

long: A cute, cuddly little tar baby is here, ready to follow the first person it sees.
description:
Aww, this cute little thing is just COVERED in tar.  It latches on to the
first sign of human life.  And it's just so cute you can't want to kill it!

long: A seagull flies about the cliff.
description:
Hmm...  It's a bird, that much you can tell.  It doesn't appear to care
whether you look closely at it or not.

long: The Priest of Fear is walking around, looking rather pompous.
description:
This incredibly strong person doesn't look like the kind of man you'd want
to meet on the street every day.  He certainly inspires fear in your heart.
You'd most likely *NOT* want to attempt to kill this man!  He's one mean
fellow!

long: A wailing ghost floats about the halls.
description:
You look and look but all you can really see is the wall behind it, and a
faint outline of something making the wall shimmer.

long: A prisoner, locked up for crimes against Fear, is raving here.
description:
The prisoner looks at you bravely and shouts, "JUST KILL ME!  I DARE YOU!
" He looks totally emaciated, as if he hasn't been fed for weeks.  He is dirty
and almost naked--his rags barely cover him.  He is covered in his own filth.
Just looking at him makes you want to retch.

long: The butcher stands here, waiting for his next kill.
description: He's rather ordinary, except for the humongous knife he holds in his hand.

long: The High Priest of Terror stands before you in all her majesty.
description:
How shocking!  Out of all the types of people you would expect to see in
this kind of position, you didn't expect to see someone this beautiful and
kind- looking.  She stands about 2 meters tall, and while she is obviously very
strong, she is also quite voluptuous.  She looks at you with the most
sympathetic eyes--you just want to give yourself over to her.

short: the Keeper of the Shrine of Vice
long: The Keeper of the Shrine of Vice guards the alter from desecration.
description:
This man is covered in the blood of his former kills. He looks as if
he would like to make you his next. Keep clear of this guy.

long: The Grand Dragon of Terror rests, curled around a giant pillar in the temple.
description:
This dragon is just beautiful.  Its scales are mirror-like in polish.
Beautifully-colored wings protrude from the sides.  Unlike most dragons, this
actually resembles a snake--except that it's about one-hundred times larger,
and certainly is more dangerous.  Sharp teeth extend from the mouth, and wisps
of smoke curl from its nose.  It looks at you with infinite intelligence and a
little bit of resignation, as though it knows you will eventually get around to
attacking it.

long: The torturer stands here, brandishing a cat o' nine tails.
description:
The torturer looks stark raving mad, to be frank.  He waves his weapon in
the air with a mad cackle, and looks at you.  With an evil grin, he says, "ah,
my next victim!  Yessssss" and launches himself at you.

long: An interrogator sits here, ready to grill you for information.
description:
This man is small and frail-looking, but you can tell that he's quite
dangerous to attack.  He looks at you with steel-rimmed glasses and says,
"shall ve beegeen?  "

long: The Grand Inquisitor of Despair looks you up and down appraisingly.
description:
This man looks just like the others, except for an uncharacteristic gleam in
his eye.  He looks quite sinister, as though he expects to get information out
of you--whether you know it or not.

long: The Priest of Hopelessness stands here, waiting to remove all hope of leaving.
description:
The priest looks back at you indignantly and says, "how dare you attempt to
look at me!?  " and promptly attacks you.

long: A small rodent with armored scales slowly crosses the path.
description:
This wee armadillo looks fairly well-armored.  Doesn't look like he could do
much damage, but would still be difficult to kill.

long: An oversized, hairy spider scuttles away.
description: The tarantula loves its privacy, and hopes you will soon leave.

long: There is a strange looking cactus here.
description:
You have never seen anything like it.  This plant can actually change its
position over time!  Sharp spines stick out dangerously, threatening to prick
you.

long: A thin, mangy beast lurks about here.
description:
This dog looks like it has never been tamed.  Its fur stands on end, and it
is full of brambles.  You don't think you should pet it.

long: A lemming pauses here, looking for a cliff to leap off.
description:
This small but feisty rodent has absolutely no brains.  It is sitting here,
just waiting to follow a crowd.

long: A razorback boar stands here, looking angry as hell.
description:
This vicious-looking animal looks both angry and hungry.  Provocation would
surely bring him to a spastic frenzy!

long: A rattler is coiled up here, trying to be invisible.
description:
This snake is doing its best to blend in with its surroundings.  Most of its
victims usually bet attacked because they step on it.

long: An Indian scout sneaks about here, glaring at you with suspicious eyes.
description:
This man is sent out into the desert for one reason, to keep you away from
something.

long: A mad hermit is here, getting ready to mutilate you!
description:
You see an old man, covered with wrinkles and other deformities.  He is
obviously very displeased with your presence, and wants to kill you for your
knowledge of where he lives.

long: A massive Indian guard is here, ready to defend his post to the death!
description:
This large man has very dark skin, from standing at attention in the desert
sun for hours on end.  He eats cactus thorns for breakfast, and sleeps on
rocks.  You wish you were this tough.

long: The Indian ruler of the south is here, smoking a strange weed.
description:
Slashing Boar looks right back at you, and you can somehow sense that he
would just as soon kill you as look at you.

long: The Giant condor peers off into the south...
description:
You are amazed at this bird's size.  You are awed at its grand presence.
You really shouldn't kill it, it might be illegal.

long: A spiky-looking horny toad is here, taking an afternoon nap.
description: This little beast would be very frightening if it were larger.

long: A small creature digs here with a sad look in its eyes.
description:
This creature is one of the few left of the race of memlins.  Short and
gangly, it looks well suited to life in tunnels.  Its warty skin is the color
of sand and stone and two large pointed ears twitch at any sound.  Large yellow
eyes seem to fill its face with an expression of despair and helplessness.

long: A heavily-muscled guard stands here keeping an eye on the surroundings.
description:
This fierce looking guard has the large amber eyes and pointed ears of his
memlin kin, but appears unnaturally muscled and strong.  His face is stern and
grim as though he takes his duties seriously, but his wide eyes betray a sense
of concealed desperation.

long: A small squeaking bat dives in and out of the shadows.
description:
Flitting about quickly, this bat hardly stays still long enough to be
observed.  Its characteristic black furred body and webbed wings are somewhat
harmless looking until several sharp teeth glint in the subdued light.

long: A weary memlin supervises the handing out of supplies.
description:
His eyes are slightly glassed over and the natural creases of his face are
even more deeply furrowed into an almost constant frown.  Absent-mindedly
shuffling various items into some resemblance of order, he seems scarcely aware
of anyone else's presence.

long: A @Ctiny wish@y floats lazily through the air.@n
description:
It looks almost like a small wisp of cotton, delicate white strands drifting
out from a spherical body as it floats in the air.  Almost more like a seedling
than an animal, it is easy to forget it is alive, until it hums gently and
drifts deliberately closer.  This creature's mere presence seems to freshen the
air, as though it were somehow filtering and replenishing it.

long: An armored guardian stands here, blocking the gates to the north.
description:
Tall and menacing, his body is completely covered with black iridescent
armor that reveals none of his natural form.  Even his eyes are masked by the
metal visor over his face, though somehow he seems to perceive his surroundings
very well indeed.

long: A small child stands here.
description:
This small memlin child seems to have even larger eyes than her adult-kin.
Startlingly luminous and brimming slightly with tears, they are almost like the
amber eyes of a feline, only unsettlingly vacant.  She seems confused at the
workings of the world around her and draws shyly away on approach.

long: A colorful pheasant hides amongst the greenery.
description:
This beautiful bird is well-fattened and covered with bright plumage that
makes its efforts at hiding almost laughable.  Its cherry-red face blends into a
warm bespeckled brown that covers most of its body, a brilliant patch of
eggshell blue and light purple fanning out into its tail.

long: The Keeper of the Temple stands here.
description:
This memlin looks very wise as though the product of a lifetime of
contemplation.  Tranquil yellow eyes betray no hint of emotion or thought, and
only the faint swishing of robes can be heard as he moves about the room.

long: A @Rfire wrm@y scuttles about here, filling the air with smoke.@n
description:
This creature wanders about the place devouring anything it sees.
Shuffling along on spines that cover its entire body, its gigantic fiery mouth
gives it the ability to consume even metals and piles of rubble, making it
useful for excavation sites.  Black smoke rises from the creature, the product
of its constant digestion.

long: An emaciated memlin lies dying here.
description:
This pathetic looking creature could easily be mistaken for a decaying
skeleton were it not for the rasping sounds of breath that still escape his
mouth.  A single black chain secures his ankle to the wall, though he appears
far beyond any chance for escape or survival.  Paper-thin skin hangs loosely in
folds about his skeletal body, the eerie rattling sound as he struggles for
breath a sure sign of his imminent death.

long: @gA strange glassy stalagmite protrudes from the floor.@n
description:
On closer inspection, this spike doesn't appear to be a stalagmite at all.
In fact it seems almost gelatinous, quivering slightly with every vibration and
slowly waving as if by its own accord.  It looks as though there is more to it
than what can be seen protruding from the ice.

long: A newly-grown @Cwish@y wobbles uncertainly in the air.@n
description:
This little creature is still sticky from the sap of its parent vine.
Disentangling its delicate strands slowly, it seems to grow larger as the air
currents from its siblings dry it off, making it increasingly capable of
navigating its way through the slight breeze.

long: A skeletal creature crouches within the circle of light.
description:
The color of faded blue egg-shell, this creature makes a faint clacking
sound when it moves as though it is made entirely of bone...  or indeed
egg-shell.  Squinting black eyes peer calculatingly out from an elongated skull
and a hideous toothy smile splits across its face at the sight of you.  Two
gigantic spider-like hands curl protectively around a glowing object in its
lap.

long: A dying memlin leans against the wall, half turned to stone.
description:
Shuddering slightly, this half-dead creature clutches at the wall for support
as his skin seems slowly to darken and crack.  His entire lower body has turned
completely into stone, the petrification creeping higher like a black spreading
stain.

long: A @Rfire wrm@y is tethered here, billowing smoke around it.@n
description:
Large sharp spines protrude from all over this strange creature, twitching
slightly as peristaltic-like contractions ripple through its body.  Large
amounts of thick black smoke ooze from pores all over its body as it devours the
piles of rubble, ore and all with its massive fiery mouth, acting almost as
living waste disposal.

long: A dark, beady-eyed rat sniffs the air.
description:
This mangy rodent must be well-fed to have grown so large.  Pink scaly feet
and a long worm-like tail are all of the creature that is not covered in coarse,
matted dark fur.  Two predatory black eyes scan the surroundings as the animal
apparently continues its scavenges for anything edible.

long: A little iridescent beetle scurries along.
description:
This little glistening beetle has two rather large pincers that protrude
like horns from its head.  Tiny legs move almost too quickly to be seen, as the
creature scuttles nervously around, streaks of blue and green glinting in its
black armor.

long: A green serpent writhes along the floor, jewelled markings down its back.
description:
This long, undulating snake weaves its way cautiously along, green shimmering
scales glinting as it moves.  A tiny blood-red tongue flickers in and out of its
mouth like fire, highlighting the scarlet diamond markings all down the length
of its body.

long: A female memlin stands here, busily preparing food.
description:
This memlin appears intently focused on her activities, large yellow eyes
following the flurry-like movements of her hands as she washes, slices, and
kneads.  Traces of white powder and the scent of herbs and spices linger on her
clothes and skin.

long: A memlin child seems to daydream as he dangles his feet in the water.
description:
Smaller and scrawnier than a full-grown memlin, this appears to be a child of
about ten years old.  His large eyes are far too big for his head, which is
likewise out of proportion to his fragile build.  Kicking his feet lazily, his
expression is one of almost meditative calm.

long: A mighty, dragon-like creature watches perceptively with glowing eyes.
description:
This powerful creature is most similar in appearance and size to a dragon.
Massive scale plating cascades smoothly down its back and sides, reptilian skin
polished and gleaming as it moves.  An enormous tail waves slowly and
pendulously from side to side, its clawed feet indenting the almost solid
ground.  Its most unusual feature is its large faintly glowing eyes, uncannily
perceptive they seem to peer through things rather than at them.  The eyes are
of odd coloring too, one glowing bright ember red and the other gleaming
charcoal black.

long: A female humanoid with scaly skin stands here, her eyes faintly glowing.
description:
This young female is tall and well built, her lean body covered with pale
soft scales that shimmer gently in the light, barely noticeable they look more
like tattooed patterns on human skin.  Long fair hair cascades down her back,
and her features are strikingly prominent yet still smoothly feminine.  Her
large blue eyes seem almost eerily perceptive, shimmering just a little to
brightly to appear normal, vivid splashes of green fading and dying as though
some strange force pulses through them.

long: A Khan'li warrior stands proudly here.
description:
This tall warrior is strong and muscular, his whole body covered in very fine
smooth scale-like skin that glistens iridescent black, almost shimmering and
radiating intense heat.  His eyes are large and dark, flickering slightly with
red flashes as though a very fire dances within them.  Long clawed hands hang at
his sides and his black teeth are small and pointed.  Powerful and intimidating,
he gives an air of formidable confidence and proud fearlessness.

long: A Dynar youth wanders meditatively here.
description:
This delicate, agile humanoid is slender and elongated in body and limb.
His movements are unusually fast although smooth and graceful and his pale skin
glows like moonlight.  His soft, fair hair seems almost to float through the air
as he moves and his large violet eyes are almost childishly innocent.

long: A little memlin blinks curiously around.
description:
This small creature is slight and sinewy, his skin as tanned leather and
slightly rough in texture.  Large pointed ears stick up on either side of his
head and his huge amber eyes fill half his face.  Peaceful in expression, he
looks eager to learn and explore, peering easily and perceptively about in the
shadows.

long: The Revealer stands here, guarding the secrets of his people.
description:
This aged memlin is shrunken and wrinkled with time, his large eyes faded in
color as an ember about to die.  His expression is firm and troubled, as though
he has seen enough for many lifetimes.

long: A rabbit grazes peacefully here.
description:
This little animal is covered with soft brown fur, two long floppy ears
dangling down either side of its head.  Oblivious to everything, it chews
happily on the abundant grass, constantly sniffing as it hops about.

long: A young memlin stands eagerly here, as if waiting for something.
description:
This bright-eyed memlin has an expression of almost excited wonder and
curiosity on his face.  Fidgeting constantly, he wrings his hands as he
glances around at everything, flickers of emotion passing over his face like
wind-blown clouds.

long: A powerful Khan'li sorceress stands here, eyes blazing with anger.
description:
This intimidating Khan'li woman radiates an immense aura of power and rage,
her dark flowing hair billows restlessly around her as though caught in some
stormy force.  Her eyes are deep obsidian black, shifting with Khan'li flickers
of scarlet and the occasional flash of green, their expression one of vicious
calculating evil.  Cruel black teeth glint like coals amidst the fiery crimson
of her lips, so sharp and pointed as to appear almost feral, her smooth scaled
skin as dark and glossy as slick oil.

short: a dark crow with gleaming green eyes
long: A dark crow perches here, its green eyes gleaming.
description:
This jet-black crow is covered with sleek iridescent feathers, its
formidable beak sharply curved, obviously made for tearing flesh.  Two tiny
gleaming eyes peer suspiciously about, the color of deep emerald green.

long: A giant vulture is here.
description: It looks hungry.

long: A demon horse is here.
description: The demon horse widens its nostrils and fire burns in its eyes.

long: A rabid fox is here, drooling heavily.
description: The rabid fox seems almost putrid.

long: An earth demon lingers in the air.
description: It is brown and stocky.

long: An evil bird is here.
description: It is raven black with bright, gleaming, yellow eyes.

long: An Iodocentipedus crawls around here very slowly.
description:
It is a mixture of colors, blue, red and brown, totally lacking hair on its
plated body.

long: A fanged reindeer walks around here looking for food.
description: It is awesome, at least by reindeer standards!

long: An hill ghoul walks and walks and walks here.
description: It is large, white and looks MAD!!!

long: A stone ogre tramples around.
description: The ogre seems confused.

long: An ice troll mutters about.
description:
It is covered with a thick ice armor.  And it certainly looks ready for
battle.

long: A lithophiliac is here, burping his ass off.
description:
He is skinny but still a scary being, presumably because of his dreadful
smell.

long: The Wizard of ice-molding looks grimly at YOU!!
description:
He is of average height wearing a long silvery robe covered with small ice
crystals.  He seems very intelligent with his long frosty beard and sharp
looks.

long: The stormbringer sweeps around here.
description: The stormbringer is HUGE but still swift.

long: The Earl of Sundhaven is out for a stroll.
description:
A tall noble with sand-colored hair and goatee is strolling by with an
amiable but authoritative countenance.  Long out of knighthood, he nevertheless
looks quite confident in his abilities to defend himself, and has gone on to
wining, dining and governing the human population.

long: A guard of Sundhaven stands watchfully.
description:
His swarthy human face is framed by well-combed dark hair that gazes about
with a relaxed, alert air.  He wears in his uniform the dark gold and black
colors of the town banner, and the sword that hangs from his hip looks more
than idle decoration.

long: The town hangman is here, idly swinging a noose.
description:
This brawny, placid fellow is garbed in loose black garments and an
eye-patch, from his days as a pirate along the northern coast.  He has, of
course, since seen the light and sticks to legal murder.

long: A black-robed priest is here, tending a candelabra.
description:
The glow of candles half reveals a shadowy priest with dark features and a
somber but pleasant manner.  He carries a small kaleidoscope in one hand, with
which he watches the movements of his elusive deity.

long: A black-robed priestess is charting a stellar calendar on the wall.
description:
She looks entirely focused on her task of painting and numbering, yet pauses
to give you a nod as you pass in.  Her beauty, though great, is surpassed by
the swirl of etherous colors that she busies herself with.

long: A shadow passes along the ground something flies overhead.
description:
Regarded in local myth as a bird of prophecy, it regards you with one eye as
it passes over.

long: A smoke-colored rat sits in the shadows.
description: It slinks quickly from your vision, apparently nervous about eye contact.

long: You sense someone lurking about.
description:
Catching you spotting him, he gives you a quick grin and a friendly nudge.
Better check your pockets.

long: A blackberry picker is singing among the bushes.
description:
She is garbed in a peasant's frock and carries a basket of blackberries.
Black hair frames a gentle face and broad gray eyes accustomed to hardship.
She gives you a shy smile and feigns interest in a fray of her sleeve.

long: A halfling peddler is here calling his wares.
description:
A short, slender being with wary and mirthful eyes barely gives your
kneecaps a second glance.  He seems engaged in drawing the eyes of persons of
wealth.  He wears a tray of spices and other goods on a strap around his neck.

long: A mendicant in rags shoves a cup in your face.
description:
You are absorbed by the foul smell of his ragged body, but take pity; there
are worse odors among the wild regions of the vast world.

long: A knight in bright armor is telling tales in a roaring voice.
description:
His shining armor and sword of silver are so stainless that you wonder if he
merely has a master blacksmith, or an overactive imagination.

long: An eager squire stands attendant.
description:
He appears to be hanging on his lord's every word, but when watched closely
seems to pay more attention to his cold mug of ale.

long: A foreign princess is downing shots at the bar.
description:
She has a beauty that fascinates the eye, but she shows about as much
interest in you as an empty keg.

long: A gypsy minstrel bows a fiddle nearby.
description:
She is clad in the brightest colors; red, gold, purple and orange compete
for the attention of the eye.  She has thrown down his feathered cap and seems
ready for donations.

long: The village idiot is dancing about.
description:
He notices you checking him out, bounces up into your face, and begins
reciting bad poetry.  He looks suspiciously like someone you know.

long: The Priestess of the Ministry is here, garbed in black.
description:
She is tall, elderly and imposing, but willing to teach those new to her
priestly arts.  The black gown that she wears flows past her toes to the stone
floor.

long: The Mistress of Assassins comes half out of the shadow.
description:
You see but a blur in the shadow that is the keeper of the Black Naga
assassins guild.  She is willing to train newcomers to her roguish trade, after
that you must search elsewhere for learnings.

long: The Knightmaster fingers his beard and ponders you.
description:
A swarthy man clad in the padded armor standard for training newcomers.
Thick auburn hair and beard frame a face intelligent in battle.

long: The Archmage watches you through a crystal ball as you arrive.
description:
His violet robes have long frayed and faded, his beard is long and tapering,
but his powers have only grown throughout the years.  He is willing to teach
his mystical arts to newcomers.

long: The bartender is here doing his thing.
description:
This plump fellow leads a quiet life.  Nevertheless the odd creatures that
find their way to this bar from all lands have had an effect on him.  He
glances up and gives you a lopsided grin as he mumbles to the floor.

long: A retired thief cleans a shot glass behind the counter.
description:
Having retired from the bounty lists, this thief spends his days managing
the Nightbreak Cafe for the assassins guild.  So may you, if you become
addicted enough to caffeine.

long: The falconer stands proudly before several cages.
description:
His tall, noble bearing seems to go hand in hand with the alert postures of
his taloned birds.  A magnificent white kestrel stares at you from his left
shoulder.

long: The cartographer grins at you over wire-rimmed spectacles.
description:
Thin and wisp-haired, this old man regards you with a wily grin and looks
ready to cut some deals.  There is a rumor he was kicked out of the mages
guild for fraud.  Can you trust his goods?

long: The town treasurer sits happily on a huge pile of gold.
description: This little man has found his bliss.

long: The blacksmith stands in the glare of the fire.
description:
This ex-warrior is short and brawny, looks to have some dwarf ancestry.  He
is carrying a hot poker though, better not mess with him.

long: The jeweller stands behind a glass case of rubies.
description:
The jeweller is a dark-skinned woman in a silken frock.  She seems to be
doing very well for herself.  A black gem sparkles dimly round her neck.

long: Phadela is here grinning maniacally in a mirror.
description:
This local witch comes from desert lands and is making her fortune off the
superstitious.  Her dark eyes look sharply into yours in the mirror on the far
wall.  Her black hair and turban remind you of her exotic origins.

long: The hobbit pastry chef rolls some dough behind the counter.
description:
A round, short fellow covered in flour.  He looks content as a mouse in a
corn shed, snacking on his sticky creations perpetually.

long: The old alchemist stands here preparing bubbling vials.
description:
He is withered as a gnarled tree, but seems wise in a mad sort of way.
Glass vials of all colors surround him, attesting to his knowledge.

long: The wise magess flies about the shop.
description:
An old silver haired woman levitates and sings to herself as she reshelves
tomes and organizes scrolls and parchments.

long: Mekala tosses some pad thai in a pan nearby.
description:
This young, dark woman has traveled far from jungle lands to prepare her
spicy-hot dishes for this heavily traversed town.  She sings a foreign song in
a bizarre, guttural tongue.

long: The armorer is here buffing a suit of scale mail.
description:
The cousin of the warrior guildmaster is six foot five and perhaps three
hundred pounds..  Needless to say, he has many friends.  He stands rose-buffing
a beautiful suit of scale mail.

long: The weaponsmaster sharpens a kris at the back wall.
description:
He's a wiry little fellow, but agile as a squirrel.  He prefers to be left
alone in the world of blade artistry, and generally people grant him his wish
with pleasure.

long: A little old lady hovers around you.
description:
She looks a little bored, and pleased to see you, hoping for a big sale.
You cringe as she gives you a warm toothless smile.

long: A gray and white mockingbird mimics you from an oak branch.
description:
She cocks her head from side to side, studying you rapidly, then does an
impression that looks very familiar and makes your friends crack up laughing.

long: A paranoid adventurer hides within the town walls, afraid to leave.
description:
His bug eyes and electric hair show you he has perhaps seen to many beasts,
and they were too much for him.

long: A silk trader is strolling, looking for business.
description:
The fact that he has been about many lands shows on his weathered, scarred
face.  When he notes you looking him over he smiles cunningly and shows you a
variety of colored silk goods.

long: A mischievous boy is looking for something to set on fire.
description:
His small, darting eyes are set off by a mess of tousled black hair.  Ever
since his sling shot was taken away, he has been playing with torches.

long: A dark-haired girl is eyeing you curiously.
description:
This small girl has a fine dress and precocious look that makes you feel she
must be a wealthy citizen's daughter, perhaps a merchant or judge.

long: A tabby cat is stalking a mockingbird.
description:
She looks plump from plenty of good eating.  Her wide green eyes are fixated
on a fluttering mockingbird, the stripes of her thick black and brown fur
mingling with the lines of the grasses.

long: An old mage studies the chessboard in rapt contemplation.
description:
His white beard trails down to his withered toes.  His forehead is creased
in contemplation, but a wine-induced smile plays on his lips.

long: A young warrior is sparring with his shadow.
description:
This brawny fellow hops about, rather gracelessly, shadow-boxing.  He is too
absorbed to notice you watching him.

long: A thief is lounging, hiding out from the bounty hunters.
description:
He doesn't look too nervous about being found and brutally hung for his
crimes.  With his feet up and margarita in hand, he kicks back in an easy chair
and thumbs through a magazine.

long: A priestess is preparing a blindfolded animal for sacrifice.
description:
She is busy anointing a serrated dagger with a special balm, and sprinkling
a dark water over the animal.  She asks that you take a seat and keep quiet.

long: An iron chain rattles as something moves in the back of the room.
description:
Some black animal, its hard to tell exactly what in this darkness, is
chained to the back wall.  Even its eyes are darkened as a black fold of cloth
covers them until the moment of its departure from the world.

long: A gray cat pads around, sniffing things.
description:
He seems vaguely interested in something beyond the range of your five
senses, as cats often are.

long: A large white cat is sunning himself on a wall.
description:
He's a beautiful creature, with a long snow-colored coat tinged with gold in
the sunlight.  His eyes are closed as he lies in bliss in the heat.

long: The town butcher tosses meat cleavers about listlessly.
description:
This overweight fellow looks bloodthirsty and bored with life.  As you enter
he hurls several sharp meat cleavers around the edge of the door without
looking up.

long: The gate watchman stares glass-eyed at the horizon.
description:
He was apparently chosen for his inability to blink.  He is a brawny fellow,
but doesn't strike you as having the froth-mouthed drive to fight as seen in the
town guards.

long: A little sparrow pecks at the ground.
description:
The tiny metal clasp round a leg of this diminutive bird tells you it is
someone's pet.  It regards you with one eye then the other in a nervous
fashion, awaiting its first chance to fly to freedom.

long: A red-winged blackbird is preening nearby.
description:
The blackbird sports glossy dark feathers with wings tipped in crimson, and
a keen eye.  The small metal clasp round one leg tells you it is someone's
trained pet.

long: A giant white kestrel is perched near its master.
description:
The kestrel's plumage is pale as lamb's down, making it a beautiful animal,
but the sharp curved beak and arched talons remind you of its predatory habits.
A tiny metal ring is clasped round one leg..  It must be someone's pet.

long: Athos the great knight is somberly nursing a bottle of wine.
description:
Athos wears a face of sorrow on his noble countenance, displaying only a few
quiet words of philosophy when his tongue is loosened by drink.  His dress
depicts a man of learning and his voice one of some foul experience.
Something - or someone - still haunts him to this day.

long: A beautiful woman with fair hair flares angrily up at your intrusion.
description:
Milady de Winter is a slender form draped in white ermine and knowledgeable
in the ways of enchantment.  Golden hair falls to her waist, her eyes are cyan
blue and widened with anger, or perhaps a tinge of fear.  Long presumed dead,
she wears one of many guises and is accustomed to discarding lives.

long: The black naga guardian is coiled here.
description:
The guardian naga is a serpent-like creature, coal-black scales shield an
elongate body with the head of a woman, and make no sound with her curious
writhing.  It looks intelligent enough to judge whether you are worthy to pass
into the guild of rogues that is its keeping.

long: A large guardian gryphon sits immobile before you.
description:
It's a brawny beast, measuring six feet at the shoulder, and staring
passively at you with cold red eyes.  It watches faithfully over the guild of
physical battle that is its charge; only those worthy may enter.

long: A basilisk summoned from the ether guards a doorway.
description:
The guardian stands motionless with eyes of stone fixed on the far wall.
Nonetheless, this reptile, a figure born of a cold wisdom, knows well enough if
you are worthy to pass into the guild of priests.

long: A horned imp is crouched nearby, unfolding its wings.
description:
This is the familiar of the Archmage of the town, at present an ill- meaning
sort of ruler.  It is charged with the worthy task of defending the guild from
unwelcome intruders.  Its wickedly curving horns and innocuous teeth attest to
its ability to....  Well, dispose of you.

short: a warrior of the Black Watch
long: A warrior of the Black Watch maintains a alert vigilance here.
description:
A handsome, stalwart warrior of the famed elite guard of Sundhaven keeps a
tireless watch over the peace of the town.

short: the Lord of the Black Watch
long: The Lord of the Black Watch keeps the peace as he sips a scotch.
description:
The captain of the Black Watch, the well-known anti-rogue force of
Sundhaven, seems a fairly complacent noble confident in his own strength.  He
surveys his surroundings casually over the rim of a glass of strong drink.

long: A blind mage is sitting here, communing with nature.
description:
His blank eyes, the color long lost, leave the broad sky and seem to stare
right through you.  His sanity, also long lost, might have made him a fine
fellow once, but he would best be left alone now.

long: Something makes an eel-like motion under the water.
description:
A giant leech-like movement under the water marks the outline of a lamprey,
skin wet and oil-black.  The row of teeth that gapes for an instant above the
waterline gives a hint of its hunger for prey in this deserted place.

long: A small moth flits about nearby.
description:
The moth, pale downy white in color, beats its wings heavily above some
ferns nearby.  It seems quite harmless.

long: A disgruntled courier awaits your bidding.
description:
The gray and strained eyes of the courier look at you with ill-concealed
lack of interest.  The scars on his face are an indication that he has seen
foul weather of all sorts on the roads, and nothing you could request would
surprise him.

long: A Sundhaven noble stares past you with an aloof air.
description:
The noble is tall, of fair hair and complexion, and dressed in gold-bordered
finery.  He appears unaware of your presence, and preoccupied with his own
affairs.

long: Stu the Recruit is standing here.
description: Achhh!  Dont pay too much attention to him or you'll regret it.

long: A child playing obliviously on the floor is here.
description:
The child is like their parents with brown hair and eyes and they wear a
black pair of knit pants and and a white top.  They play with a wooden toy on

long: A facehugger stage alien sees you and springs!
description: A facehugger is trying to wrap it's tail around your throat!

long: A slime drooling alien is here waiting for lunch!
description: The alien 'smiles' back at you and extends its inner jaws!  SNAP SNAP SNAP!

long: The queen alien is here laying eggpods!
description: The queen alien is less than pleased at your presence.  You should die now!

long: A Predator alien is here scouting for trophies.
description:
The Predator is a huge bipedal monstrosity with vertically aligned jaws and
'hair' that reminds you of when you used to fight gorgons!  He is nearly twice
your size and already has a nice polished human skull hanging from his trophy
belt.  It looks like you are next!

keywords: Captain Vance Marshal captain vance marshal
long: Captain Vance Marshal is here in his exoskeleton armor!
description:
Captain Vance Marshal has obviously gone mad!  Then again you would too if
you had survived as long as he has on this cursed space station!

long: A four-legged panther alien is here waiting to rip your guts out!
description:
You thought the regular aliens had a lot of teeth?!  This man-eater has twice
as many at the bipedal aliens.  It also looks a lot nastier.  It moves with
such speed on all fours that there is just no way you can out run it.  You must
stand and fight this black monstrosity!

long: Lt. Miko Oshura is standing here in torn clothing.
description:
This tough young lady has been through hell and has managed to keep her wits
about her...  Not to mention her weapons!  Man is she ever glad to see a
smiling HUMAN face!

long: The Predator Captain is standing here looking angry!
description:
Uh oh...  Now you've done it!  There are some places you just shouldn't go
...  This is one of them!  The Captain of the Predators is very angry that you
have invaded his ship.  He will have to 'discuss' it with his crew-members after
he finishes polishing your skull!

long: A Space Station Alpha crewmember is here trying to stay alive!
description:
This poor haggard soul has been fleeing the onslaught of two different
species of alien aggressors.  How he has managed to stay alive this long is
anyone's guess.  He must be extremely resourceful!

long: Kay the Village Priest is here to tend you.
description:
Kay, the boyish lad, is the Cure of Saint Brigid.  He has short black hair,
dark eyes, rather scrawny in demeanor, but a very wise lad trained from the
north.

long: Broderick the Inn Keep is keeping his place.
description:
Broderick is from the north.  He is once a guard for Hypperex, then turned
pilgrim for a time he has found himself down here tending bar in his own place.
He has sandy blond hair, brown eyes, rather tall, muscular and a bit scarred
from all the battles he has seen while as a guard in Hypperex.  He wears a white
shirt and tan pants, with a green apron made of leather.  He smokes a cigar and
it protrudes from his narrow fleshy lips which he occasionally puffs while
wiping down the bar.

long: Francis the Blacksmith is here beating out a rod of metal.
description:
Francis is a big burley man with a ruddy complexion, dark black hair, dark
eyes and a thick full beard.  He had a huge upper body and arms from his work at
the forge.  He wears a white shirt, and black pants, and thick work boots on his
feet.  He looks like he is very formidable if you make him angry so best to
watch it.

long: Mick of Malvern is here to help you.
description:
Mick is the older son of Francis.  He looks like his father in many ways with
a huge demeanor, a large upper body and arms from working the forge.  He wears a
simple leather tunic and pants made of soft brown and helps in the Armory.  He
has the same dark black hair, dark eyes and a thick beard.

long: Charity of Malvern is here to help you.
description:
Charity is the adopted daughter to Elizabeth and Andrew of Saint Brigid.
She is very tall, lean and strikingly beautiful with long flowing blond hair to
almost the ground, blue eyes, and a fair complexion.  She wears a simple blue
gown adorned with flowers and hems sewn by her own hand and it fits the
flattering curves she has.  Her shoes are black made of calf skin.

long: Zino the Jeweler is standing here with an eye-loop examining a jewel.
description:
Zino is new to this realm, he is from the north, living in Hypperex mostly
and makes his living examining and appraising jewelry and jewels for the barons
of Hypperex.  He is a wiry man, who is very lean, with graying hair has a full
goatee, and dark eyes.  He wears a typical red tunic and pants with a golden
belt, and necklace that has the symbol of the Inquisition about his neck.  He is
not too welcome here in Saint Brigid by the folk here but he is known for being
a just and fair man when it comes to his skills to appraisal.

long: Hans is here to pawmp you up...
description:
Hans is German, very short, and clad in a gray sweat suit and boots with a
headband on his forehead.  He has brown hair, a burly face and he is really well
built from head to toe.

long: Floora the Grump is here to take your order.
description:
Floora is an old woman in about her nineties, but looks and acts like she is
still in her fifties.  She has dark hair, sprinkled ever slightly with gray
hair, green eyes and has a trim but heavyset figure.  She is no slouch when it
comes to hard work, being active a lot in her store, it is always so neat and
orderly.  She wears a simple green and brown jumper with a brown tunic and
boots.  For her age she still seems to shine brightly.

long: Elizabeth of Malvern is here selling her realm famous bread.
description:
Unlike Charity, Elizabeth is her adopted mother, and she had brown hair,
brown eyes, and a heavyset figure and is quite beautiful but not shockingly like
her daughter.  She wears a simple brown and white dress, adorned with the same
patterns and colors incorporated in Charity's gowns as she taught her the trade.
Her shoes are brown leather.

long: Miriam of Malvern is here to humble serve you.
description:
Miriam is a youthful girl of about twenty, she has long reddish-gold hair,
green eyes and a trim very voluptuous body.  She wears a simple black dress
adorned in blue and a necklace of a pentagram around her neck.  She has no shoes
on ad the slit in her dress goes up to her waist revealing a little more than
anyone would want to know that she is a witch.  There is a tattoo on her left
thigh.

long: Madam Gwen is here dressed sexy and ready for action.
description:
Madam Gwen is here dressed in a sexy low cut house dress with slits up the
sides made of silk and wears thigh hight boots and a leather collar with spikes
while brandishing a whip.  She is attractive despite she is in her mid-forties,
a bit plump but still an eye catcher with her trim body, blond hair, blue eyes
and fair complexion.

long: Alisha is sitting here on the bed reading.
description:
Alisha is here reading while she waits for her next customer.  She is rather
young, about nineteen and been doing this for a while now since her mother
abandoned her on the street in Hypperex when she was accused as being a witch.
She has dark brown hair, brown eyes, a medium complexion and a trim body.
Alisha is attractive but rather too much of a brain for this type of work.

long: Rebecca of Pine is in her bed alone naked.
description:
Rebecca is a fair young woman with ruddy features, she has long brown hair,
almond brown eyes, and she is heavy set.  She has a round face with a medium
complexion, and despite she is heavyset has a decent figure.

long: Doris is here naked on top of Sphen
description:
Doris is maiden in her late twenties, she has black hair, dark eyes and a
fantastic body to boot.  She is one of the few who has escaped the Inquisition
and torture and she has many scars on her back and legs where the torturer
burned, broke, and mutilated her body.

long: Jenny Of Alastar is here playing with herself.
description:
Jenny is a young woman with long brown hair streaked with black, a pale form
with green eyes, a very small pair of breasts and she wears a black skirt over
it.  She is quite attractive, despite she is Wiccian, a large tattoo on the left
butt cheek on her left side depicting a pentagram.

short: a male citizen of Saint Brigid
long: a male citizen of Saint Brigid is here walking to work.
description:
The man is a typical peasant, with a simple brown leather pants and tunic
that he wears about him.  He has short brown hair, a headband, and looks a bit
of a weakling when it comes to battle.  He is one of the many farmers of Saint
Brigid who works the fields.

long: Natasha rubs herself down pinching her own nipples
description:
Natasha stands about five feet and six inches.  Her long red hair encircles
her angelic face.  Her eyes are as blue as the sky, and her skin is a milky
white.

long: Dirken the mighty runs his hands all over Candy's body.
description:
Dirken is an young man about twenty-eight, with short blond hair, brown eyes,
a bean pole body, and a ruddy complexion.  He sits on the bed with his shirt off
as he waits for Candy to acknowledge him and to start mutually satisfying each
other.  He is not very handsome for a miner.

long: Sphen of Sweden is laying on the bed enjoying the ride.
description:
Sphen is a thirty year old from sweden, he has come a long way to this realm
for fortune and glory and has may scars to show it.  He is tall and heavyset
Inza.  /n with blond hair, a very light complexion and blue eyes.

long: Tarus the Traveller is here watching the action.
description:
Tarus is a short dwarf of a man, with a long beard, a small body and only
stands about 4'2" tall.  His hair is white, and his eyes a sinister deep red.
He wears a tunic, a pair of pants and his belt he has a dagger sheath at his
side made of leather.

long: Renah the Gnome is here waiting for his turn.
description:
Renah is a gnome, about 3'8" tall, and he has a single mohawk on top of his
head colored multiple colors, above his thinly black eyebrows on his almost
oriental features.  He has a yellowish skin, dark brown eyes, and a plump body.

long: a female citizen of Saint Brigid is here.
description:
She is atypical citizen of the village, mostly a farmer, so she is very ruddy
complected.  She has long brown hair, brown eyes and a narrow figure.  She wears
a brown tunic top and a loose skirt, and what appears to be soft shoes.

long: a male citizen is here with his family.
description:
The man is a typical peasant, with a simple brown leather pants and tunic
that he wears about him.  He has short brown hair, a headband, and looks a bit
of a weakling when it comes to battle.  He is one of the many farmers of Saint
Brigid who works the fields.

long: a child plays innocently on the floor.
description:
The child is like their parents with brown hair and eyes and they wear a
black pair of knit pants and and a white top.  They play with a wooden toy on
the floor oblivious to the carnage that is to come.

keywords: A female citizen of Saint Brigid
short: a female citizen of Saint Brigid
long: A female citizen of Saint Brigid is going about her daily chores
description:
The woman is a typical peasant with a simple leather brown skirt and tunic
that she wears about her.  She had long brown hair, and looks a bit rough for
wear when it comes for battle.  She is one of the many farmers of Saint Brigid
who works the fields.

long: a village militia-man is here on guard duty.
description:
The guard is clad in a green and white tunic with a dark green pair of
trousers.  IT has the ensign of Saint Brigid on the tunic front which marks him
as a soldier of the free town.  He is one of the citizens who has stepped up and
volunteered to take the post to protect the village.

long: A female farmer is working in the fields.
description:
She is a typical farmer with straw hat and a blue shirt, pants and work boots
in which she toils in the earth with her brawny arms and narrow frame.  She
has long blond hair, blue eyes and a delicate, angelic appearance.

long: Franz is here to pamp you up...
description:
Franz is German, very short, and clad in a gray sweat suit and boots with a
headband on his forehead.  He has brown hair, a burly face and he is really well
built from head to toe.

long: Molly the Barmaiden is here serving drinks.
description:
Molly is one of Broderick;s daughters.  She has long brown hair, brown eyes,
and a light complexion.  She is quite beautiful and trim, wearing a long gown
under the apron she wears over it.  Molly holds a tray in her hand as she cycles
through the adventurers who stand in the room.

long: Catherine the beggar is here.
description:
Catherine the beggar is a young woman who is a known witch from the north.
She is outcast, and makes a decent wage begging from the local populace for food
and clothing, perhaps anything she really needs.  She has dark hair, dark eyes
and a round pleasant face, She is dressed in a patched ruddy gown with a rope
belt and no shoes.  In her hand she carries a tambourine in which to catch the
coins given to her by the adventurers in the tavern.

long: a sleeping adventurer is passed out here on the floor.
description:
He is a typical ruffian who wanders this realm seeking fortune and glory.
The adventurer is male, short, with short hair, dwarf-like, with a beard and he
snoozes on the floor in a drunken stupor with a glass mug still in hand.

long: A midget named Bridget is here waiting for the next trick.
description:
Brigjet is a full framed young woman of eighteen but only stands about four
foot two in height, and weighs about eighty pounds, She has red hair and green
eyes, wearing that of a thin, sheer gown as she waits for the next trick to
come.

long: A female adventurer is here drinking silently with her friends.
description:
The young woman is very attractive, and wears a simple tunic and pants under
the heavy armor she wears over it.  She has long brown hair, green eyes and a
slender attractive, but muscular figure.

long: A male adventurer is here drinking.
description:
This man is a mercenary of his profession, wearing armor and brandishing a
sword at his side.  He is an adventurer seeking fortune and glory.  He has black
hair, dark eyes and a lean muscular body.  He looks dangerous to be around.

long: A hooker is here taking a break from her tricks to smoke a cigarette.
description:
The hooker is not bad looking and she wears a simple robe over her narrow
body.  Her face is made up still but her hair is a mess from all the activities in
the last few hours.

long: Goethe is here, staring blindly into space.
description: Goethe exudes an aura of verbosity.

long: Harry the Hare Krishna is busy burning incense and singing.
description:
Harry is a tall man with a shaven head and a long pony tail...  Gee I wonder
if he is a Hare Krishna.

long: Wally the Wizard is busy playing with his magical items.
description:
Wally is an old, long haired man with an obvious affection to strange and
unusual magic items.  When he looks at you, he doesn't seem to be completely
there.

long: A policeman is here, walking his beat.
description:
Specifically recruited by the upper class people of New Sparta, there is no
one more respectable and honest than the on-duty policeman.

long: A cop is wandering around looking for doughnuts.
description:
You can see that this guy does not concentrate very much on his job and
tends to look the other way.  He seems to be more interested in filling his
belly with doughnuts than in protecting the city.

long: A mugger is thinking about taking your money or your life.
description:
Driven to desperate measures, this leech of society is after one thing...
Your money.  He'll do anything to get it too.

long: A tourist is here, taking in the sights.
description:
Every metropolis has them, well so does New Sparta.  Be careful not to get
caught in their line of sight.

long: Norm is drinking another beer.
description:
You see Norm from Cheers, he is big, fat, drinks a lot and is an overall
jolly fellow.

long: Cliff is rattling off useless trivia.
description:
A postal worker who never seems to be doing his job, Cliff is out of touch
with reality and tends to be annoying--even to his friends.

long: Carla is waiting on tables.
description: Carla splashes a drink in your face.

long: Woody is waiting to serve you a drink.
description:
A farm boy from Indiana, he has not quite fit into the atmosphere of the big
city yet.

long: Mayor Abe is about, inspecting the city.
description:
This high official, like most other politicians, seems uninterested in
helping the community.  Not a man to be trifled with, the Mayor is reputed to
have ties with the mob kingpin -- Lucifer.

long: Rebecca Howe is hurrying about making sure Cheers is in order.
description:
A very harried but yet beautiful woman.  Most of her anguish stems from her
sexual frustrations and from attempting to keep Cheers in order.

long: Sam is here, hitting on the women.
description:
A very handsome, self-assured ex-baseball player who is very popular with
the ladies, but often finds himself in sticky situations.

long: Frasier is here psychoanalyzing patrons in the bar.
description:
Though very emotionally unstable for a psychiatrist, Dr.  Crane tries to aid
people with their problems while creating his own.

long: Lilith is sitting at the bar, keeping a watchful eye on Frasier.
description:
A calm, thoroughly rational and logical thinker on the outside -- a wild,
crazy, sexual goddess on the inside.

long: Paul is here, drinking a beer.
description:
Paul is a robust man, who tends to be a bit childish when around Norm and
Cliff.

long: An alley cat is looking for food.
description:
