This is an everyday unwanted alley cat who spends most of his day looking
for food.

long: Pee Wee is doing something you would rather not like to know.
description: Pee Wee is the owner of this peep show, so you'd better not piss him off.

long: A punk is here, deciding what color to spray paint your back.
description:
You see a punk who is more than willing to knock off an old lady for a few
bucks.

long: A skinhead is here, looking for a punk to kill.
description: Skinheads are mean and nasty...  Better not stare too long.

long: A prostitute is soliciting you.
description: When you look at her she says, 'Hey baby, wanna party?  '

long: Jonathan Hill is here, welcoming his costumers.
description: This is the evil bald-headed guy who runs Melville's.

long: The Bishop is here, looking for a crime to solve.
description: Da Da Deah (sorry for the bad sound effects)!  It's the Bishop!

long: A dockworker is busy moving crates.
description:
Dockworkers get very strong from lifting crates and the size of his muscles
make you think twice about attacking him.

long: A prostitute is here, looking for customers.
description:
When you take a closer look, you realize that this is not the lovely lady
you first laid eyes on, but is really just a female impersonator.

long: A pimp is busy counting his money to see if his women have been cheating him.
description:
You over hear the pimp reciting poetry...
        Bitch better have my money
        not some, not half
        but all my cash!

long: A Raiders' lineman is here hunting for the ball.
description:
This is one of Orcland's lineman.  He is a balanced player, but has no
outstanding abilities.

long: A Warriors' lineman is here hunting for the ball.
description:
This is one of New Sparta's lineman.  He is a balanced player, but has no
outstanding abilities.

long: A Raiders' receiver is here running a pattern.
description:
This is one of the Orcs' skilled receivers.  He is quick, but not very
powerful.

long: A Warriors' receiver is here running a pattern.
description:
This is one of the Warriors' skilled receiver.  He is quick, but not very
powerful.

long: A Raiders' blocker is trying to pave an open pathway.
description:
This is the slowest (both physically AND mentally) of the bloodbowl players.
However, he is also very large and powerful, so be careful when tangling with
him.

long: A Warriors' blocker is trying to pave an open pathway.
description:
This is the slowest (both physically AND mentally) of the bloodbowl players.
However, he is also very large and powerful, so be careful when tangling with
him.

long: A Raiders' thrower, attempting a pass.
description:
Similar to a quarterback, this is a player with both mobility and a cannon
for an arm.  He can also hold his own when hitting with the big boys.

long: A Warriors' thrower, attempting a pass.
description:
Similar to a quarterback, this is a player with both mobility and a cannon
for an arm.  He can also hold his own when hitting with the big boys.

long: A fierce Raiders' blitzer, waiting to tear someone limb from limb.
description:
An all-around fearsome athlete, the blitzer is the toughest most aggressive
player on the bloodbowl field.

long: A fierce Warriors' blitzer, waiting to tear someone limb from limb.
description:
An all-around fearsome athlete, the blitzer is the toughest most aggressive
player on the bloodbowl field.

long: A loyal fan is here enjoying the game.
description: Your average sports fan, who attends a game now and then.

long: A child is here, wandering around.
description: Awww, how cute!!!

long: A vendor is here peddling his goods.
description: A merchant with a variety of goods, with nothing you particularly need.

long: A construction worker is here on his break.
description: A strong, dirty, harsh-talking construction worker.

long: A drunk, rowdy fan is here, making an ass of himself.
description: Sit down, sit down, sit down, sit down -- sit down you're rocking the boat.

long: A Security Guard is here, attempting to maintain order.
description: Not as efficient as a police officer, but then not as expensive either.

long: Fire Marshall Bob is busy trying to extinguish the fire that is on his back.
description:
This is one poor excuse for a Fire Marshall.  He's obviously started more
fires in his day than he's actually extinguished.  Just another sad example of
nepotism in today's world!

long: A fireman is here, looking rather useless.
description:
Well, the less skilled relatives of the Sparta executives needed a job
somewhere, so they wound up here.  Obviously, it is a very cushy job because
there are no real fires in New Sparta.

long: A whore is looking for customers.
description:
The only good attribute of this beast is her low prices, which would explain
why she is always busy with punks and skinheads.

long: A minor throat is busy doing homework.
description:
This is one of the weakest of the evil inhabitants of the library.  They
will do anything for a good grade or to keep a good man down.

long: A throat is here, looking for someone's notes to steal.
description:
This is one of the most populated species of the library.  They are really
desperate for a good grade.

long: A major throat is busy hiding all the science reference books.
description:
You see a barely human creature that has absolutely no morals or sense of
dignity.

long: A senior throat is burning all the useful books.
description:
You see a devilish looking creature that would gladly sell its sister into
slavery for a good grade.

long: The master throat is here, trying to break into the school records.
description:
The master throat is the devilish and desperate creature that lacks any
morals or self dignity.  Watch out, its' eyeing your stuff right now!

long: A cheerleader is here rooting on the home team.
description:
Wow!  Don't you wish there were more girls like these around?  Almost
nothing rivals the beauty of the cheerleaders, unfortunately their looks are
not always matched by their brains (unfortunately for them, but lucky for YOU!!
), though you are positive you could forget about that fact for just a few
hours.

long: Ilsa the Head Cheerleader is here, looking totally gorgeous!
description:
You gaze at this beauty with long, flowing blonde hair, an angelic, calming
face, firm, ample...  And a body that just screams...!  You snap out of your
daydream and notice that she is frowning at you, as she does not appreciate
people undressing her with their eyes.

long: Chief O'Hara is sitting behind his desk.
description:
The Chief is a longtime law enforcement agent who has become overweight from
years of eating doughnuts.  He is a jolly Irishman, who for the first time will
have to do his job without the services of Batman.  Unfortunately for you, he
actually looks up to the job now!  Looks like he has finally gotten a clue.

long: The Warden is here guarding the jail.
description: A staunch proponent of the death penalty, and the keeper of the jail key.

long: A maid is here cleaning up after the guests.
description:
The maid is a lady weary from constant upkeep of the hotel who views most of
mankind as slobs.

long: Esprit is behind bars, where he belongs.
description:
The law finally caught up to this character killer, who is serving an
indefinite sentence.  May this be a lesson to you all.

long: A cashier is busy filing her nails.
description:
You see a student working at her part-time job.  She really would rather be
somewhere else, but needs the money for tuition.

long: The cop is sitting here eating doughnuts.
description:
You can see that this guy does not concentrate very much on his job and
tends to look the other way.  He seems to be more interested in filling his
belly with doughnuts than in protecting the city.

long: The cop is sitting here having a drink.
description:
You can see that this guy does not concentrate very much on his job and
tends to look the other way.  He seems to be more interested in filling his
belly with beer than in protecting the city.

long: A shoplifter is busy stuffing things into her pockets.
description:
From the size of her pockets, you can see that this is one busy
kleptomaniac.

long: A fisherman is waiting to serve you.
description:
This guy's been around fish so long that he is beginning to look and smell
like one.

long: An arms dealer is cleaning his guns.
description: Like most arms dealers, he has got greased back hair and a slimy moustache.

long: Raghuram the 7-11 Manager is here.
description:
Like most 7-11 managers, Raghuram is Indian, and speaks with a near
incomprehensible accent.

long: Launchpad McQuack is here following Darkwing.
description:
You see a tall humanoid duck who is quite confused and very dim-witted, but
definitely no duck to mess with.  You instinctively retch in reaction to
looking at this horrible thing!

long: A bleached blonde bimbo is bouncing around.
description:
You can almost feel the intelligence and wisdom points being reduced as you
feel the blood rush from your head to another part of your anatomy.

long: A stripper is here, undressing for your entertainment.
description:
Wow, you have never seen such large breasts before in your life, it really
makes you believe that there is a God!  (and he likes big butts too)

long: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
description:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat Magic.
He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge of offensive as
well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

long: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
description:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the
Faith.  His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel
attacks and his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a
deadly opponent.

long: An assassin is guarding the entrance.
description:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as
possible, using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and where
to use them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes him a deadly
opponent.

long: A knight is guarding the entrance.
description:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Swordsmen and his
extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly
opponent.

long: The Mages' Guildmaster is standing here.
description:
Even though your Guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

long: The Clerics' Guildmaster is standing here.
description:
You are in no doubt that this Guildmaster is truly close to your god; he has
a peaceful, loving look.  You notice that he is surrounded by a white aura.

long: The Thieves' Guildmaster is standing here.
description:
You realize that whenever your Guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief.  She is to be dressed in poor clothing, having the
appearance of a beggar.

long: The Warriors' Guildmaster is standing here.
description:
This is your master.  Big and strong with bulging muscles.  Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born.  He has a
calm look on his face.

long: A retired Captain stands here, selling boats.
description: This Captain has eaten more sharks than you have killed peas.

long: An Armorer stands here displaying his shiny new (and previously owned) armor.
description:
An old but very strong armorer.  He has made more armor in his life than
you have ever seen.

long: A receptionist stands in front of you, looking quite bored.
description:
You notice a tired look in her face.  She looks like she isn't paid well
enough to put up with any crap from mud players with attitudes.

long: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
description: A tired looking waiter.

long: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
description:
This man was a famous sorcerer in his young days but now leads a quiet,
peaceful life as a waiter.

long: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
description: This waiter seems to have reach contact with God.

long: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
description: This waiter knows where all his customers has their money.

long: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
description:
The waiter looks like he could easily kill you while still carrying quite a
few firebreathers.

long: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.
description: What is there to say?  He is cleaning stuff up.  Wow.  What a thrill.

long: A beastly fido is here.
description:
A fido is a small dog that has a foul smell and pieces of rotted meat
hanging around its teeth.

long: A singing, happy drunk.
description: A drunk who seems to be too happy, and to carry too much money.

long: A small loyal kitten is here.
description: The kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

long: A small loyal puppy is here.
description: The puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

long: A small, quick, loyal beagle is here.
description: The beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

long: A large, loyal rottweiler is here.
description: The rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

long: A large, trained wolf is here.
description: The wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

long: An Elven Wizard is here, creating fireworks for the festivities.
description:
The Elven Wizard looks at you in a solemn sort of way.  His gaze seems to
penetrate through your innermost being.  He is wearing a silvery cloak and
holding a multi-colored staff.  Although he appears to be older than the oldest
man, he seems to have an inner strength which most mortals cannot overcome.

long: The Keeper of the Ring is here, guarding his treasure jealously.
description:
The Ring Keeper is a rather big but short halfling.  His short stature and
bulbous nose belie his true nature.  An elven sword that glows with a blue light
hangs from his belt, and on his finger you see the One Ring.  Although usually a
halfling of peace, he will fight you to the death if you attempt to take away
that which belongs to him.

long: Farmer Gamgee sniffs the air, wondering if harvest time is near.
description:
Farmer Gamgee is a short, stout halfling of thirty years.  His skin has been
tanned from working the fields night and day.  He's quite a jolly chap, always
ready to befriend an injured bunny rabbit.

long: A toddler crawls about, looking for something to chew on.
description:
The toddler is dressed in nothing but his birthday suit.  He crawls about for
he hasn't learned to walk yet.  He peers up at you and asks "da da?  "

long: A nursemaid wanders about, trying to keep track of all the toddlers.
description:
The nursemaid looks rather tired and worn out.  Taking care of so many
toddlers for too long has evidently taken its toll.  She looks to you and in her
eyes you can see her longing for a better life.

long: A cow is here, chewing her cud.
description:
The cow looks like it hasn't been milked in quite some time.  Although she is
past her prime, you see that she still has a lot of years left, and that if
provoked, her rear kick can be quite deadly.

long: A pig wallows in the mud and oinks in contentment.
description:
The pig appears quite happy to be a pig.  He is oblivious to your presence
and cares only for the care-free life that he leads.  It is enormously fat and
consequently cannot move around very quickly.

long: A chicken sits on her nest.
description: The chicken is bright and healthy.  She has no weapons but her beak.

long: A bull scratches at the ground and lowers his head.
description:
The bull is in top condition.  He looks like quite a fighter, nothing to be
reckoned with.  With his horns and his hooves he can attack just about anything.

long: A horse becomes frightened by your presence.
description:
The horse looks at you and turns away.  You can tell that it is afraid of
you.

long: A sheriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
description:
The sheriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are ever
roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff-raff like you.  In his belt is a
thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.  This is one
halfling you don't want to mess with.

long: A sheriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
description:
The sheriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are ever
roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff raff like you.  In his belt is a
thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.  This is one
halfling you don't want to mess with.

long: The Thain commands respect from all Shire folk.
description:
A personable yet serious halfling, the Thain looks at you and yells a deep
'Hullo'.  He walks about comfortably, secure in the knowledge that as long as
he's in office, the Shire will always remain a safe haven for Shire folk.

long: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
description:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveller.

long: The Miller is here, overseeing his busy mill workers.
description:
The Miller is an impatient young halfling, always trying to command more
respect from his workers than he can get.  He looks like the type of person who
deserves a spanking but never got one.

long: The mill worker runs to and fro.
description:
The mill worker is in fine shape from the hard labor that he does at the
mill.  He doesn't notice your presence, but he looks like he could break you in
two without thinking about it.

long: The elven warrior watches you solemnly.
description:
The tall elven warrior is light and fair-skinned.  The expression that he
wears on his countenance is solemn and tragic.  He cares not for this world any
longer and wearies of it.

long: The dwarven prince waits here patiently for the return of his king.
description:
Grim and cold, the dwarven prince is quite strong and bulky, even for the
dwarves of his land.  His glowing eyes peer out of his bushy face and stare
beyond your gaze.

long: the shopkeeper smiles and patiently waits for you to buy something.
description:
The shopkeeper will fight like a madman to protect his store from riff-raff
like you.

long: The grocer offers you the finest breads in all the land.
description:
The grocer is a large, jovial halfling who knows how to enjoy his pipeweed.
However, he also knows that it's worth protecting and so will do everything in
his power to prevent riff-raff like you from stealing it.

long: The blacksmith bids you welcome to his humble store.
description:
The blacksmith is a lean and mean fighting machine.  His knowledge of weapons
and armor would certainly help him in any fight against riff-raff like you.

long: The battle master offers to train any aspiring fighters.
description: The battle master is a wizened fighter, with many scars to prove his worth.

long: A halfling youth stands here, waiting for nothing in particular.
description:
The halfling youth is not yet quite in the prime of his youth.  He's knee
high and you get the sudden urge to step on him.

long: A seasoned adventurer sits here, telling tales of fame and fortune.
description:
The seasoned adventurer has seen his share of glory days.  Although he is
past his prime, he still looks like he could put up more than his share of a
good fight.

long: A local gossip asks you, "Have you heard the latest?"
description:
The gossip is all talk and no action.  You're transfixed by her ability to
talk so much so quickly.

long: A halfling beauty stares dreamily into your eyes.
description:
She is the most beautiful creature you've seen in quite some time.  As you
stare at her, thoughts of all else vanish.  You get the sudden urge to grovel at
her feet, hoping she'll take you in like a lost puppy.  You wouldn't dare harm a
hair on her precious little head.

long: A trainee screams a death cry as he delivers the fatal blow to a dummy.
description:
The trainee smiles smugly, aware of your interest in him.  He's a little
fresh, but his enthusiasm and desire to please more than make up for what he
lacks in skill.

long: A chic urbanite sits here, enjoying his class status.
description:
The urbanite seems very much at home in his surroundings.  His clothes are
all of the latest fashions and his manners impeccable.  He offers you some coins
if you'd be so good as to order a drink for him.

long: A country bumpkin dreams of pipeweed and its many uses.
description: The country bumpkin snores noisily.

long: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
description:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveller.

long: The receptionist sits here, signing forms.
description: He is a very professional looking type.

long: A sheriff of the Shire looks for the lost halfling youth.
description:
The sheriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  He looks at you,
smiles and asks you if you have seen a halfling youth somewhere outside the
shire.

long: A young hobbit waitress is taking orders for food.
description:
Bright eyed and rosy-cheeked, her small face is surrounded with an abundance
of dark curls.  Busily writing down orders, she scurries from one customer to
another, grabbing plates and setting them down on tables.

long: An elderly tailor stands here, folding fabric.
description:
Obviously elderly, even by hobbit's reckoning, this little tailor is somewhat
bent and frail looking.  Wrinkled, calloused hands caress the fabric in his
hands expertly, as though this is a trade he has held his whole life.

long: The crusty old Captain is here, fishing in the ocean.
description:
The old captain has skin like leather, and a mottled complexion.  He looks
positively ancient; yet his muscles and his countenance show that he is a
capable warrior.  He glares at you menacingly, suggesting you go away unless
you want to <Buy ship>

long: The huge, green Sea Serpent is swimming in the ocean, hunting for food.
description:
You see a huge monster before you.  Its glowing green eyes and sharp teeth
terrify you.  Green scales provide a spectacular defense armor.  They would
probably make great armor on you too.

long: A mean barracuda is flopping around in the sea.
description:
This horrid-looking fish looks very unhappy that you've infested his sea.
His sharp, huge teeth show just how unhappy he is as they clamp into you.

long: Leviathan is here, looking at you with a quizzical expression.
description:
Leviathan, the guardian of the seas--an eternal power guaranteed by the gods
to keep an eye on all those travelers that enter Oceania.  He is totally green
and has seaweed as his garb.  His ancient eyes belie his youthful countenance.

long: A gray bat hangs from the shadows here.
description:
This furry creature looks just like a giant gray rat, only with large
pointed ears and webbed wings that it curls around itself whilst hanging.
Glistening fangs and keen beady eyes seem ever ready for a chance to attack
fresh prey.

long: A poor citizen of France is sitting here.
description:
This unfortunate man is obviously from the lower classes of France,
unashamedly begging, the state of his appearance and the lingering smell around
him leaves no doubt that he is in the very desperate depths of poverty.

long: A priest is standing here.
description:
This elderly man is silver-haired and his aged face is lined with years of
concentration and devout prayer. His eyes look far away, as though he has
already half passed from this world into the next.

long: A believer man is standing here.
description:
This average looking man is probably in his late thirties or early forties.
Clean-shaven and reasonably neat, he is most likely of French middle class. His
dark eyes look humble and repentant, as though he seeks atonement for his sins
here.

long: A choirboy is singing here.
description:
This young lad has an innocent cherubic face, flushed with the effort of
recent singing. Pale and solemn, it looks as though he must have spent most of
his life within stone walls, his slight build made even frailer through lack of
work or play.

long: A believer woman is praying here.
description:
This woman is obviously a very devout believer in Christ, her expression
fervent and concentrated as she prays. Apparently she is also one of the many
who value their riches, her garb wealthy and well-adorned with gold.

long: The cardinal Richelieu is standing here, shouting to the people.
description:
This man has a darkly-lined face that is red from bellowing, and a peculiar
mustache, identifying him to most as Richelieu, the cardinal of France and
minister of Louis XIV. He appears completely absorbed in what he is saying, his
eyes bright and fierce with righteous fervor.

long: A white pigeon is here.
A man with a strangely shaped body is here wandering amongst the bells.
description:
This unusual looking man looks half-crazed, his face flushed as he screams
for someone named Esmerelda. His back is strangely bent, a large hump rising
from between his shoulders, but he looks incredibly muscular and strong, his
strength no doubt more powerful because of his anger.

long: Jean the monk is wandering here, cleaning the floors.
description:
This round-faced monk does not look very happy at all, frowning deeply, he
mumbles unhappily to himself as he goes about the menial chore of floor-
cleaning.  Short and stout, his beady eyes look more like those of a
troublemaker than a man of God.

long: A horrible monster made of stone is here collecting dust.
description:
This stone monster has been here for years and years judging by the layers
of dust. It seems to have become the home of several pigeons and insects,
layers of grime and dried on feathers making it truly grotesque, quite apart
from the evil and leering face.

long: An apprentice of the Musketeers is standing here.
description:
This youth looks fresh faced and eager, his keen piercing eyes showing an
unusual power and certainty as though he has great potential for leadership.
Still scrawny and small built, he is nonetheless quick and agile in movement,
his demeanor almost too confident for one so young.

long: A citizen of Lyon is standing here.
description:
This common citizen looks like one of many farmers and merchants of this
town, his expression seems humble and worn as though he has worked long and
hard, no energy left for protest or conflict.

long: A white poodle is tied to a tree here.
description:
This little dog is covered in fluffy white fur, carefully groomed and
sculpted from head to foot. Its smooth gray face has been clean shaven, two
large black eyes blinking at the surroundings as it waits for its owner.

long: Pierre is standing here mixing something very special.
description:
Dark haired and pale skinned, his piercing green eyes are fixed keenly on
what he is doing, aged hands steadily pouring colorful potions into glass
vials. His expression is stern and wise, as though he has learned much of the
world in his years.

long: A French merchant is here, trying to make a deal.
description:
This elderly man of lower class looks as though he has been at his craft
all his life. Honest faced and smiling, he nonetheless looks haggard, as though
it is a daily struggle just to bring money in for basic living.

long: A French woman is sitting here waiting for a carriage to pass.
description:
This young lady is very pretty and well-groomed, a hint of expensive
perfume lingering about her presence, indicating her upper class status.
Waiting patiently, she watches the surroundings dreamily with large chocolate-
brown eyes.

long: A black rat is here sniffing through trash.
description:
This vile creature is covered with matted dark fur, one of the disease-
ridden rodents so prevalent in the filthier places of France. Sharp yellowed
teeth glint menacingly beneath its twitching whiskers, piercing black eyes on
the look out for prey.

long: Renoir the thief lingers here, sharpening his dagger.
description:
Dark garbed, and covered with a layer of grime, he blends easily and
dangerously into the shadows, his squinting gray eyes watching everything
suspiciously. His constant sharpening of his dagger is an indication that he
must use it often.

long: Degas the hermit is collecting some fruit here.
description:
Degas is well known throughout these parts for his hermit way of living and
revolutionary standing, both these lifestyles well-funded by his less well-
known occupation as a thief. Busying himself picking, he nonetheless can be
seen glancing furtively at the pockets of passing citizens.

long: A brown squirrel scurries about collecting nuts.
description:
This furry little creature looks decidedly like a rat with a bushy tail
albeit a little cuter. Bright black eyes scavenge the surroundings for food,
its little whiskers twitching nervously as it stands up and peers around.

long: A mysterious woman is dancing here.
description:
This young woman has smooth olive-colored skin, her jet black hair
cascading down her back in loose curls as she dances. Smiling flirtatiously,
her emerald green eyes flicker with fiery personality and an almost devilish
enjoyment of life.

long: A citizen of Paris is standing here.
description:
This simple citizen looks a little nervous and furtive, perhaps because of
all the insecurity within France around this time. Plain-faced and wide-eyed he
glances around as though expecting trouble at any moment.

long: A revolutionary is here.
description:
His face is firm and set as though he has utter conviction in his beliefs,
stone-gray eyes look ready to take on almost anyone who would disagree with
him. He does not look strong enough to be a fighter although his movements are
fast and decisive.

long: A Musketeer in service is stationed here.
description:
This guard does not look as though he takes his post very seriously, in
fact he seems more inclined to sleep than to do much of anything else. His face
is carefree and bland in expression as though there is little in life he would
fight for.

long: Monet the chef is cooking delicious-smelling food.
description:
Known as one of the best chefs of all France, Monet has the privilege of
catering for the royal guards of king Louis XIV. Jovial in expression, his dark
twinkling eyes seem to indicate that he loves his job, his hands moving in a
flurry of busy preparation.

long: Porthos the Musketeer is here, looking for trouble.
description:
Large built and muscular, Porthos is known as one of the strongest of the
Musketeers. His wide frame and intimidating height make him slower in movement
and reaction, but he is nevertheless one of the best fighters in all France.

long: Athos the Musketeer is standing here.
description:
Not particularly intelligent or strong in appearance, Athos nonetheless is
a man of conviction, demanding respect for his sheer loyalty and sense of duty.
Neatly groomed, he is mostly sombre in expression, lines of time and hardship
creasing his face.

long: Aramis the Musketeer is standing here.
description:
Sharp eyed and highly perceptive, Aramis has a strong reputation for his
quick wit and intelligence. A gleam catches in his eye as he glances around,
always on the ready for a good scuffle in the name of duty.

long: A well-trained horse is eating some grass here.
description:
This beautiful black horse is sleek and glossy, its dark coat and mane well
groomed, already saddled and prepared for the guards of the French king. Large,
impossibly dark eyes blink at any visitors as the horse chews slowly, shuffling
the grass with its hooves.

long: A French receptionist is here, waiting to help.
description:
This young woman is very pretty and kind-faced, her gentle dark eyes
smiling welcomingly at all who pass. Sleek brown hair is pulled back into a
shiny ponytail, her smooth face powdered subtly and a hint of red gloss
flushing her lips.

long: A royal Musketeer is here protecting the king.
description:
This Musketeer must be well trusted and competent to have achieved such a
place of honor, that of personally guarding the life of the King. Stern in
expression, his countenance is one of unyielding loyalty and determination, his
keen eyes on the lookout for any danger.

short: a man in an iron mask
long: A man in an iron mask languishes here.
description:
This scrawny looking man is in pitiable shape, his limbs wasted away from
lack of use. His face is completely obscured from view but his presence is
somewhat powerful despite his state, as though he once held a position of great
importance.

long: A tiny flea is jumping around.
description:
This ugly little insect is dark and covered with tiny barbed hairs, its
little legs allowing it to jump higher and further than would have been thought
possible, allowing it to attach itself to almost any warm-blooded creature for
a feed.

long: Paulo the murderer is standing here.
description:
This man looks very dangerous, his cruel eyes malicious and calculating as
though he has betrayed many and would not hesitate to do it again. Agile and
muscular, he seems a formidable enough warrior, almost looking for an excuse to
kill.

long: A Musketeer is here on duty as sentinel.
description:
This young man looks bored out of his wits, swaying lazily as he stands,
almost fighting to keep his eyelids open. Humming gently to himself, it seems
almost as if the forlorn tune is more to keep him awake than offer any source
of amusement.

short: the guardian of time and space
long: The guardian of time and space stands here.
description:
This tall person is slightly strange in appearance, though it is not
immediately obvious why. His face is deeply lined and creased with age, his
deep-set gray eyes filled with a wisdom rarely seen. Although he does not look
particularly strong, something about his presence gives the impression that he
is a force to be reckoned with.

long: Toulouse waits quietly here, ready to help.
description:
Bright faced and mild in expression, he looks eager to assist. One of the
many merchants to be found here, he does not appear to be wealthy although he
seems more than content with his lifestyle and trade.

long: Louis XIV is sitting here.
description:
Proud and grim, his features are sharp and striking, dark confident eyes
betray no hint of uncertainty though this is the man held responsible for all
of the problems in France. He looks completely sure of himself, and this
despite the circulating rumors that he is not even really the king.

long: A teacher of skills and spells sits here, waiting for someone to teach.
description:
He looks skinny and has heavy glasses.  Also he looks rather intelligent.
To be taught what you can, type <prac> now.

long: A small piglet is sleeping here.
description:
It's a small piglet, sleeping, unaware that soon it will be pork chops.
Type <consider piglet> first and read what you're told.  Then <kill piglet> to
start fighting it.

long: The shopkeeper for Mudschool is ready to sell newbie-items.
description:
He looks like any other merchant, only his clothes are ragged.  He must have
too low prices.  To see what he sells type <list>, then <buy> to buy it.

long: An electron is here, doing electron things.
description:
This electron is a few hundred thousand times larger than your typical
electron.  It glows a bright yellow, and it crackles with energy.

long: There is a large Pentium-166Mhz processor here.
description:
This is a *huge* processor.  It dwarfs everything you've seen so far.  The
pins are huge, the cooling fan could probably chop a human in two.  The heat
given off by something of that size is ungodly, you are sweating heavily under
your armor.

long: There is a massive floating point processor here.
description: This is basically a really $#@%!  Big calculator.

long: There is a 16MB EDO SIMM chip here, running programs.
description:
This looks like your typical 16MB SIMM, black chips fused to a silicon
board, only this one's a lot larger, and oddly enough, looks mean.

long: There is a 28.8kbps modem here, emitting a hideous noise.
description:
This is your typical modem, except the fact that it's alive, and a hundred
times bigger.

long: There is a massive video card here.
description:
This video card is massive.  The chips are the size of small horses, and the
metal connectors are the size of your fist.

long: There is a gargantuan sound card here.
description:
This sound is huge, the ram chips are huge, and the connector for the CD-ROM
drive is huge.

long: There is a huge SCSI controller here.
description:
This is your typical SCSI controller.  Ports for hard drives, CD-ROM drives
and the like.

long: A pretty female sits on the edge of a table, talking with someone.
description:
She is dressed in some loose clothes and wears a short, dark cloak.  Brown
curly hair lines her face which looks very pleasant, as if smile and joy used
to house it.  Judging by that short sword on her side, she is something else
than just a normal housewife.

long: A herdsman sits here, concentrating on his beer.
description:
Dressed in a bunch of worn-out clothes, this man does not seem to own much
of wealth.

long: You barely notice a hooded man, sitting at the corner.
description:
As you star he turns away.  But you were quick enough to notice a tattooed
symbol on his wrist - like a small, reddish eye.

long: A taciturn dwarf is standing here, fingering his great beard.
description:
His great beard is reddish and it has been plaited carefully.  Even as a
dwarf he looks very robust, and a huge rucksack and a bunch of utilities, such
as hammers and dark chisels, seem to be carried as though they weighted
nothing.

long: Barumafir, the keeper of this tavern is standing here.
description:
Barumafir is a middle-aged, short-like man with a bad sciatica.  But he does
well with his tavern.

long: A pale man is lying on the bed, moaning faintly.
description: This guy had too much money - most of it is gone now.  Not too enviable.

long: A fierce ragamuffin rushes from the shadows.
description:
Dressed in dirty, tattered clothes, this being looks extremely poor.  With a
sick glow in his eyes he attacks you, intending to rob every- thing you
possess.

long: A brown pinemarten stars at you.
description: The animal looks considerably meager.

long: A short, long-bearded man is standing here.
description:
What a jolly being.  His face is reddish and he looks very kind.  The
clothes he wears are of cheerfully woven and brown leather, some of them simply
patterned.  As he were ascertaining something, he utters odd words and beckons
his companier.

long: You barely see a short man with a greenish beard.
description:
He seems to have some peculiar abilities.  Perhaps these brownies are not as
harmless as they look like.

long: A greenish creature with many tentacles rises from the pond!
description:
These strange monsters are slimy and their skin is covered in the shaking
rings of meat and vesicles.  They have several ugly heads with an eye standing
in the each.  The land of Gwyte is where they come from.  It is rumored that
they serve the Evil and therefore were sent around as messengers of horror.

long: A tall hunter stands here, glancing over the edge of the forest.
description:
Galeaufir looks like a man who is always sure of himself and his doings.
He is hardened in his work and keeps his carriage through the years.  Though
today's hunt does not seem a success at all.

long: A large steinbock is here.
description: Eating in peace, it does not pay any attention to you.

long: A hobgoblin stands here, grinning at you broadly.
description:
The hobgoblin resembles much of those brownies you encountered before,
although being a bit shorter.  But somehow you feel their personality might be
entirely unlike, and include sides which are dark and strange.

long: A beautiful centaur rests on the dais.
description:
She is tall and well-proportioned.  The dark hair descends on the light
brown skin, making no curls.  Her big eyes radiate wisdom and pleasant heat,
making it difficult to leave this fabulous being.  No doubt she enjoys high
esteem amidst the small folk of this forest.

long: An impressive brownie sits here, talking with the centaur.
description:
Taller than others, this brownie looks very authoritative.  His beard is as
white as snow and almost reaches his feet.  The jacket he uses is decorative,
and his hat is high and very fine in its own manner.

long: A small winged balrog is here gazing at you with demonic red eyes
description:
The Balrog is a winged creature with eyes which seem to pervade your being
and tear your soul apart.

long: The Elder Balrog is here...gnawing happily on your body.
description: Well hes trying to consume you, bones and all.  Yuck.

long: The Grand High Balrog is here, kicking your ass.
description: Hes umm, killing you

long: A human slave is chained to the wall here.
description: He looks pretty pathetic, maybe you should end his misery

long: Kerjim, lord of the balrogs sits here on his throne.
description:
His wings spread throughout the room blocking some exits, his demonic red
eyes glow as red as blood.  He looks very angry.

long: Lileth stands here in all her magnificence.
description:
She is extremely beautiful, with glowing gold hair cascading down her
shoulders, adorned with precious jewelry from all over the cosmos.

long: The Undead Corpse is here, attempting to persuade you to join the living dead
description: Hes just a rotted corpse, with gangly ripped arms and a detachable head

long: The dungeon ruler sits here in his chair.
description: This guy looks mean!  You had better run while you still have time!

long: An old woman sits here waiting to attack you, the intruder.
description:
She looks really nasty.  You don't want to find out how the deep scratches
and blood marks got on those walls....  Or do you?

long: A spooky ghost is floating in mid-air here.
description:
His eyes glow yellow, and then you practically feel them penetrate yours.
He reveals long, razor-sharp, 6 inch long claws and then takes a swipe at you!

long: Darkness reigns over the entire room.
description:
It is a huge shadowy figure with no eyes or anything.  Just total darkness.
How weird.  But when he hits you, it will HURT!!

long: A harmless spider sits in his web here.
description: This spider couldn't be dangerous....  But could it?

long: A dragon is here waiting for you to move closer...
description:
This thing doesn't like you.  It breaths fire out of its nostrils, and then
comes in for the kill.  If I were you, I'd get out of here and fast!

long: A small box lays in the corner, torn somehow.
description: It's a plain old box with nothing inside of it but dust.

long: A rock lays on the ground here.
description: It's just a plain old rock.

long: A little spider sits here.
description: It's a cute little spider.

long: A ghost is here, carrying his head with him.
description:
His head was somehow cut off and now he must carry it wherever he goes.
It's is a very bloody picture.  Sick.  Actually, it makes you want to puke.

long: A large bat flies around up here.
description: It's a bat!  Eeeeek!  Run!!

long: A bat is flying around.
description: It's a bat!  Eeeeek!!!  Run!!!!

long: A rat crawls around in a skull here.
description:
This little guy is having loads of fun playing inside of a skull on the
ground here.  It sits in the eye-hole and starts watching you now...

long: A rat is wandering around the entire area looking lost.
description:
This little guy looks so cute....  Don't let the looks fool you, though.
Be on your guard at every moment.

long: A roach crawls around here.
description: It's a bug!  Squash it!

long: A beetle crawls around here.
description: Yuck!  A beetle!  How sick!

long: Someone is acting like an idiot.
description: It's simple: he's LUNEY!!

long: A very evil prisoner stands here plotting his revenge.
description:
This guy is really evil.  He walks around with a file trying to get out of
this dungeon.  It looks like he's been in here for years!

long: Someone who looks very sad is here.
description:
All he does is weep all day long.  He does not belong here.  He cries and
balls, and then starts screaming of how he's here for no reason.

long: A slave sits here working for his master.
description:
This is really sad.  He gets whipped and whipped by the dungeon ruler, who
makes him work all day long for nothing.  He has marks all over his body from a
whip.

long: A wizard is wandering around here.
description:
This guy is bout half of your size and carries around a magic wand.  He
keeps mumbling to himself, and he probably is very lost.

long: A monster from your nightmares stands here.
description: It's the boogie monster!  Run and hide under your bed!

long: A crow stands here.
description: There's nothing really special about this bird.

long: The walls are strangely made of stone...
description: It's just a wall made of hard stone...

long: Shamus, the wandering liege, wants to protect you from the evil here.
description:
You see a human male, bald of head and thick of frame, wearing a white robe.
He has heard tales of this city of evil, and has come here as a missionary.

long: A twisted pile of cloth and bones lies here.
description:
You see an undead being whose sole purpose is to protect its barrow mound.
Flesh hangs from its wretched body, and it looks more dead than alive.

long: The groaning spirit of a long-dead woman floats here.
description:
This is the spirit of an evil female elf, a very rare thing indeed.  Her
hair is wild and unkempt, and she is dressed in tattered rags.

long: A multi-mouthed pseudopod of great girth is standing here.
description:
This is a large, amoeba-like being with one central eye which has a
tripartite pupil, and a hundred lashless inhuman eyes set above many
sharp-toothed mouths..

long: A tall Bugbear stands here, poised for action.
description:
Large and very muscular, this guy is covered in brick red fur.  Though
vaguely humanoid in appearance, he seems to contain the blood of some large
carnivore.

long: A Broken One stands here looking gruesome.
description:
This guy sure is ugly!  He has the head of an ogre, one webbed foot, one
human foot, and various other body parts that don't match.

long: A Bullywug is standing here, ready to defend his master's lair.
description: This guy looks kinda like a ninja turtle, except he's a frog.

long: A large plant that reeks of carrion stands here stinking up the place.
description: You see a giant, venus fly trap with 6 inch fangs.

long: A Gorgimera roars at your entrance, and ATTACKS!!!
description:
This monster has three heads, those of a gorgon, a lion, and a fierce
dragon.  It has the hindquarters of a large, black gorgon and the forequarters
of a huge, tawny lion, with brownish-black wings like those of a dragon.

long: A Death Knight stands here, lowering at you.
description:
A hulking skeleton, its face a blackened skull covered with shards of
shriveled rotting flesh, chillingly returns your gaze.

long: A large snake sits here, munching on a human body.
description:
The Deep dragon is an iridescent maroon colored beast about 25 feet long.
Known for assuming various shapes, this animal is highly dangerous and you
would do best to exit its lair immediately.

long: The Derro is standing here, barking orders.
description:
You see a dwarf with glowing white eyes which have no pupils.  His skin is
pasty white, but he looks stout enough.

long: An errant Elf is here, looking for denizens of evil.
description:
You see an attractive young man, about 5 feet tall, with gleaming eyes and a
pale complexion.  Though small, he appears to be very lithe and agile.

long: A Genie is levitating here with an evil grin on his face.
description:
You see a powerful mage naked to the waist, wearing only a pair of slippers,
some baggy purple pants, and a bracelet which sparkles with a multi-hued color.

long: A woman sits here on the bed, with her back to you.
description:
Well, you probably shouldn't have looked at this chick, cause she sure is
ugly.  But I guess you are about to see HOW ugly.

long: A big, stupid Orc is lumbering through here.
description: He's just ugly as sin...  Lets leave it at that.

long: There is a barkeep standing here, waiting to take your order.
description:
The barkeep is a waifish little guy, with safety pins piercing the flesh all
over his face...  He even has safety pins through his eyelids.

long: A citizen of Ghenna stands here.
description:
You see a grungy human, long since gone insane at the fall of his once proud
city.

long:
An old lady (who is obviously lost) is trying to sell you some makeup
here.
description:
You see a little old lady, dressed all in pink chiffon.  On her arm she
carries a heart shaped box made of crepe paper.

long: A broad shouldered man lies prostrate here, apparently praying.
description:
A huge man with a long black beard, the Ghenna Swordmaster is tatooed with
rune-like scars from head to toe.  Shrouded in vermillion, he wields a sword of
stunning beauty, which sings through the air as he attacks you.

short: a claw toed foot protruding from the wall
description: It looks just like a foot sticking out of the wall.

short: a claw fingered arm protruding from the wall
long: A claw fingered arm protrudes out of the wall.
description: It looks just like an arm sticking out of the wall.

long: A large statue of a humanoid male has been cut out of the granite here.
description:
It looks like a stone sculpture of Frankenstein's monster.  It stands twelve
feet tall, casting a long shadow over you.

long: An ugly woman clad in studded black leather turns toward you and shouts, "Down on your knees, maggot!!"
description:
This ugly wench is clad in studded black leather from head to toe.  Her
nipples protrude conspicuously from a leather push-up bra.  A thong around her
waist disappears into her crotch, which hasn't been waxed in a millenia.

long: A doll sits here leaning against the wall, forgotten by the child who owns it.
description:
This looks like your typical child's doll.  Its about one foot tall, and
looks like it is made of plastic.

long: A young, innocent looking woman is sitting here reading a magazine.
description:
She is so cute that you wonder how she ever fell into a lifestyle such as
this.  She notices your gaze, and gives you a cloying look.

long: Lester the molester is here with a pair of womens panties on his head.
description:
You see a sicko with bulging eyes, and a tiny bit of white spittle in the
corners of his mouth.

long: A toothless whore is sitting here on the bed, inviting you to join her.
description:
One eye, no teeth and pasty white skin, this chick looks like your worst
nightmare.

long: A dwarf is lying here, stunned.
description: You see nothing special.

long: A Maedar stands here in the darkness smacking his lips.
description: You see a muscular, hairless humanoid male dressed in a tunic.

long: A Maedar stands here in the darkness smacking his lips.
description: You see a muscular, hairless humanoid male dressed in a tunic.

long: Roger, the elven apostle is looking for evil guys to kill here.
description:
You see a young elf, only about 130 years old, who acts as though he is on a
crusade.  Dressed in light armor, he seeks out evil doers in order to eradicate
them from the face of the planet.

long: A wimpy little dragon is standing here, looking at you with deep blue eyes.
description:
You see what appears to be a tiny dragon, about the size of a chihuahua.
What a pansy he is too!

long: The biggest cockroach you have ever seen is standing here, looking down at you.
description: You see a cockroach about 8 feet tall - apparently a mutant breed.

long: The Deepspawn is standing here, ready to kill you.
description:
It looks like a large, rubbery sphere of mottled gray and brown.  Six arms
project from its body; three are tentacle-arms, and three are jaw-arms, ending
in mouths of many teeth.  It also has about 40 long, retractable, flexible eye
stalks that wave at you menacingly.

long: A Guardian of Hell stands here keeping you the hell out.
description:
The guardian is a stone devil, a hideous creation from the dark laboratories
of Hell.  Its black eyes stare into your soul with a hunger that makes you
shiver.  The guardian stands motionless before you.  Its rough gray skin looks
impervious to normal weapons.

long: A pile of gold coins lies on the ground.
description: A large sparkly pile of gold coins.

long: The male demon Dee lies on the bed here waiting to please you.
description:
This is the most handsome male you have ever seen.  His naked body makes
your mouth water.

long: The female demon Dee lies on the bed here waiting to please you.
description:
This is the most beautiful female you have ever seen.  The curves of her
naked body make you sweat, and babble uncontrollably.

long: A shiny gold bar lies on the ground.
description: This gold bar must be worth bucks!

long: A yummy looking chicken pot pie is here on the ground.
description: You see a golden crusted pot pie filled with chicken and vegetables.

long: A yummy looking beef pot pie is here on the ground.
description: You see a golden crusted pot pie filled with beef and vegetables.

long: A yummy looking vegetable pot pie is here on the ground.
description: You see a golden crusted pot pie filled with vegetables.

long: A damned soul wanders aimlessly here.
description:
You see a faint silhouette of a person.  Looking closely at it you can
barely make out features that would identify it as the person it was in life.

long: A tortured soul screams out in pain.
description:
You see a unrecognizable person going through unheard of and indescribable
torture.  It screams out at you in pain and terror.

long: A half-eaten person lies here writhing in agony.
description:
This poor soul looks as if he has been chewed on and been spit out.  It
writhes in agony and pain as it gasps frantically for Death to answer its
desperate plea...

long: A wall stands here. Its surface seems to move and come to life...
description:
The wall consist of graying and sinewy flesh - faces, hands, broken bones,
feet, and toes jutting from the surface.  You hear low moans of horror, pain,
and sorrow issuing from the walls.

long: A skeletal warrior wanders the planes of hell.
description:
Rotting flesh and gore drops from the bones of this creature.  Its decaying
eyes stare at you intently as it sees only you delicious and juicy brain.

long: A bloody severed arm lies here.
description:
The blood arm of some poor luckless individual.  The stench of the gore
covered limb makes you want to retch.

long: A bloody severed foot lies here.
description: This bloody foot definitely wasn't a lucky one.

long: A bloody severed nose lies here.
description:
I wonder how the person that lost this smells...  Hopefully not as bad as
this nose does...

long: The blood in the fountain gurgles merrily.
description: You see gallons and gallons of thick red blood gurgling in the fountain.

long: A lost soul stands here looking lost.
description:
This soul is definitely clueless to where it is.  He holds a ticket that
reads #14349023402342039840293481234900049.

long: A crispy critter is here being burned to death.
description:
This once used to be a person.  Now it is only a charred and smoking hulk
that is being burned for eternity...  I screams out as the flames lick at its
body and devour its flesh...

long: A decaying pile of bones lies here on the ground.
description:
Stringy bits of flesh blow gently in the breeze.  The bones rattle as you
walk by them.

long: A manes is here wandering the planes of hell looking for something to kill.
description:
A gruesome sub-demon who used to be a mortal.  It is a semi-intelligent
creature who attacks anyone they encounter with nails and teeth.  They are
often fed upon by Demon lords and princes.  Their green and red blotched skin
gives them a diseased and decaying look.  They somewhat resemble shadows or
ghasts.

long: The prisoner of hell, Raiden sits here for eternity.
description:
This is a sad individual.  He smells strongly of the rotten food that has
been thrown at him.  He sits here chained to the wall; banished to hell forever
by the God.

long: A sad looking individual sits here awaiting torture.
description:
She is sad looking indeed.  Cuts and scraps all over her.  Many scars and
burns cover her face and arms.

long: A sad looking individual sits here awaiting torture.
description:
He is sad looking indeed.  Cuts and scraps all over him.  Many scars and
burns cover her face and arms.  One of his arms is broken at the forearm and
hangs limply by his side.

long: A demonguard patrols the planes of hell.
description:
This very large demon stands before you licking its daggerlike teeth.
Yellow spittle runs down the scales of his blackened skin.

long: A burning fool is here, crisping away.
description:
You can barely make out anything on it.  All you can make out is the flames
of hell consuming it and the smell of burning flesh.

long: A construction worker is here welding pipework.
description:
He is the typical construction worker.  T-shirt, jeans, yellow hard hat.  As
you look closer at the hard hat you notice it says, '4th DEMONsion Construction
Co.  '

long: A construction worker is here working riveting framework.
description:
She is the typical construction worker.  T-shirt, jeans, yellow hard hat.
As you look closer at the hard hat you notice it says, '4th DEMONsion
Construction Co.  '

long: A construction worker is here working cutting structural steel.
description:
She is the typical construction worker.  T-shirt, jeans, yellow hard hat.
As you look closer at the hard hat you notice it says, '4th DEMONsion
Construction Co.  '

long: A fire devil stands here with a box of matches lighting up poor souls.
description:
It is an indescribably grotesque creature.  Its pale green-yellow skin erupts
with blisters and puss.  As you look at it, it smiles at you with sharp blood
covered teeth.  This is definitely a face only a mother could love.

long: A wall of fire is here, creeping slowly across the room.
description:
It is simply a large door sized wall of fire.  It slowly inches across the
room burning everything in its path; Including the poor souls that are chained
to various posts around the room.

long: A hell hound runs free through the halls of hell.
description:
This freak of a canine is rusty red to red brown in color.  Its eyes glow an
ghastly red.  Its sooty black teeth and tongue are covered with green spittle
that runs down its dung covered coat.

long: A frozen body lies here on the ground.
description:
As you look at the corpse you recoil as you notice its eyes still move.
They stare intently from its bluish face as if pleading for your help.

long: A Greater Ice Devil stands here cheerfully freezing souls..
description:
This devil is a mix of bug, bird, humanoid, and who knows what else.  Its
multifaceted eyes stare everywhere.  It goes about its business of slowly and
painfully freezing the damned souls, quickly thawing them and then starting
over.  Every couple of minutes it takes time out to break an appendage off of a
nearby soul and beat the soul with it.

long: A soul trapped under the ice gasps desperately for air.
description:
This poor soul has been encased in ice; almost as if it is caught under an
ice-flow.  It desperately gasps for air for a few minutes and then seems to die
for a second before it is restored and begins thrashing about again.

long: A half frozen body hangs here on a meat hook.
description:
A large meat hook is imbedded deep within the back of the body.  You see
small white maggots eating away at the body.  The flesh seems to move and
wriggle with a life of its own...

long: A small penguin waddles around here on the ice.
description:
What a cute little penguin....  Wait why is it looking at you that way...
HEY!  Penguins don't have teeth!

long: An I-scream worker runs from machine to machine.
description:
It moves about so frantically you can't really get a chance to look at it.
It runs about screaming, 'I SCREAM, YOU SCREAM!  WE ALL SCREAM FOR I SCREAM!!!
'

long: An Ice Screamer is here yelling into empty cartons.
description:
He is dressing in a white jumpsuit with the words, 'Eye Splean I Screamery'
written on it in large yellow letters.

long: A Demonic Foreman sits here looking at blueprints.
description:
This huge demon has somehow managed to fit himself into a oversized orange
jumpsuit.  The words, '4th DEMONsion Construction Co.  ' are written on the
back in large black letters.  He seems none to happy to see you.

long: The Secretary of Hell sits here watching the phones ring.
description:
This very sexy secretary seems to be just sitting here amusing herself by
watching the little lights on the telephone blink.  She is oblivious to your
presence and seems fascinated by the phones.

long: An office worker from hell is here looking for a boss to piss off.
description:
Just looking at them makes your blood boil.
AAAAAAAAAAaaaaaaaaaaaarrrrrrrrgggggghhhhh!!!!!!!!!!!

long: A records worker is here filing bad reports.
description:
You see a rather plain looking office person here filing a file on
someone.

long: Santa Claus is here checking who has been naughty...
description:
He's a jolly old man with red cheeks and a roly-poly belly and a laugh as
jolly as you can get.

long: The High Priest of Hell is here eating 'I Scream'.
description:
The dark black robes hide most of his features, but you can barely make out
his emaciated face beneath his hood.

long: A bowl of blood sits here on the altar.
description: Its is a wooden bowl filled with blood and bits of flesh.

long: A jury member sits here with a guilty sign, waiting for a trial to begin.
description:
It seems to be a lesser demon disguised as mortal.  Fair trial...  Not
likely.

long: Judge Whopper sits here trying to think of a painful sentence.
description:
This is the High Judge of Hell.  He has never found anyone innocent, and is
notorious for his painful and harsh punishments.

long: The Lawyer from Hell sits here playing games on his laptop computer.
description: Slimy, sleazy and has very sharp teeth...  A lawyer all right...

long: The Complaints Officer is here watching her favorite soap opera.
description:
She seems not to notice you; But is absorbed in her favorite soap, 'As The
Hell Burns'

long: The Bastard Hiramoto stands here trying to learn Kung Fu from a book.
description:
He looks at you and says, 'I think my Kung Fu is no good' and then goes back
to practicing.  He is known to buy anything....  And sell anything people sell
him.

long: A maintenance worker is here fixing stuff.
description: He is in a yellow jumpsuit with a large nuclear warning symbol on the back.

long: A weed is growing out of the cement here.
description: You see a nasty yellow and purple weed.

long: Stanley stands here waiting to sell you one of his wonderful figurines.
description:
He is a crafty old fart who looks about 1000 years old.  But his figurines
are pretty well known.  He was rumored to disappear around Solace 100 years
ago.

long: A half eaten horse carcass is here being digested.
description:
This is what used to be a horse....  Maybe...  Its hard to tell; half of it
has been digested already.

long: A stomach dragon is here digesting Big Mouth's food.
description:
A large brown and green slime covered reptile.  It seems to move around to
each food item and proceed to barf acid all over it.

long: A rancid turkey leg sits in a pool of slime here.
description:
Its one of those really nasty pieces of food in the refrigerator that
disappears and you wonder if it just walked away....

long: A reactor specialist sits here checking on the reactor core.
description:
He is dressed in a black jumpsuit with a large nuclear warning symbol on the
back.

long: A reactor worker sits here monitoring various screens.
description:
He is dressed in a black jumpsuit with a large lighting bolt symbol on the
back.

long: Homer Simpson sits here eating donuts.
description:
A balding fat man with jelly stains on his uniform.  He suddenly spills his
coffee and shouts out, 'DOH!  ' Warning lights blink rapidly as the coffee
shorts out the control panel.  Homer calmly stands up and unplugs the control
panel and sits down for a nap.

long: A nice slice of devils food cake is here waiting to be eaten.
description: Mmmmmm...  Don't you just want to take a bite?

long: A mad cook is here cooking up a storm.
description: You spots you and screams, 'Git awa froom mi food!  ' 'I'll kill you!  '

long: A frantic lady is here tearing her hair out looking for a sale.
description: Ugly!

long: A nuclear technician is here fiddling with his rad suit.
description: Wau, dont get too close, he seems to be glowing!

long: A stray proton is here whizzing about.
description: I can't see it.  Can you?

long: Radiation is here doing unknown things to you.
description: Eagle eyes?

long: The Chief Engineer of Hell is here playing with the panic button.
description:
He kinda reminds you of an old Bart Simpson.  He seems to be enjoying the
panic button at the moment; Chuckling happily as workers below on the reactor
floor frantically check dials and gauges while flashing lights and sirens sound.

long: A Greater Fire Demon stands here laughing at each scream he hears..
description:
This large black scaled demon laughs merrily as he watches poor souls scream
out in pain.  He pokes and picks at the flesh of the damned who were unlucky
enough to be tortured close to him.  His black taloned nails rip slowly through
their flesh, as he cackles with glee at the sounds of their unending pain...

long: A frozen side of beef hangs here on a hook.
description:
This enormous carcass looks as if it came from a small dragon or a very
large cow.

long: A guard dog sits here guarding the break room.
description: A vicious looking pit bull / demon dog mix is here slobbering on the donuts.

long: A mouth watering juicy steak is here steaming.
description: Mmmmmmm.....  Steak....  Mmmmmm...  You feel your mouth start to water.

long: The innkeeper watches for customers and drinks imported Scotch.
description:
Reilly doesn't keep this inn open by sitting and watching the goblins invade!
He looks more like a hobo than an innkeeper but you can at least see that he is
wearing a huge Scotch sword at his side.  He is also drinking from a huge bottle
of Scotch whiskey, probably not the single-malt variety.

long: Pater Vinci greets you as you pass by.
description:
Pater Vinci did not bear a weapon in the good old days, but now the goblins
ought to avoid him, because the good priest fought for King Korbor before he
took holy orders, and still carries a sturdy club.

long: Zeb Rykalp, sheriff of Ofingia, watches you closely.
description:
You had better keep on Zeb's good side.  He has few qualms about roughing up
the Midgaarders, and is ever-vigilant for evil.

long: Dorig the dwarf welds bars together with a 10 pound hammer.
description:
He is too strong for you to beat easily in a fight, and if he had a beer or
two in him Dorig would be invincible.  At least, he would think himself
invincible.

long: Joel Kreb, the village carpenter, rests with an axe close at hand.
description:
That axe he has has a long spike opposite its blade, and you do not think it
is intended for wood, but for flesh and bone, particularly of goblin-kind.

long: A stout halfling shopkeeper eyes your moneybag with a glinting eye.
description:
Guard your wallet carefully!  Rumor has it that Maxtrum rarely runs out of
money, which would be wonderful, if only his customers didn't so often find
their pockets lighter after leaving his store, though they bought nothing.

long: An elven alchemist inhales the fumes deeply and sighs happily.
description:
Churt notices you gagging as you enter his shop and peers at you with some
surprise.  He is a powerful wizard, having practiced such great spells as
`Churt's Irresistible Retch' and `Word of Command: Go away, I...  ' Well, never
mind that one.

long: A retired elven ranger works here as a leatherworker.
description:
Dek Shattershock- the name inspires fear in goblin and githyanki warrior
alike!  You ought to be scared, too, you shrimp.

long: A young Ofintine woman kneads dough here.
description:
She is not a noblewoman, but is a lady all the same.  After all, lady means
`loaf-kneader' just as lord means `loaf-ward' in the old Anglo- Saxon tongue.
She has bashed more goblins with her rolling pin than Jewish rye has caraway
seeds.

long: A priestess watches you carefully.
description:
This priestess is an old friend of Dek, Dorig, Churt, and Maxtrum.  They
saved the world from destruction, but there isn't much need for heroes in
peacetime.  You can see Sara's long spear hung on the wall where she can
instantly reach it.

long: Passing guards raise their visors in salute to Sir Kelek, their captain.
description: He did not reach this rank by staying close by the Newbie Zone.

long: Clad in bright mail and girt with a sword, King Korbor goes to war.
description:
Once King Korbor sat in his lofty hall, but now he marches with his army to
drive off the goblins which threaten his realm.

long: A small boy sneaks silently through the shadows.
description: Guard your money!  It is that dratted Tim!

long: Sir Mischa guards his town from evil creatures.
description: This knight could easily kill Curley GreenLeaf.

long: A guard of Ofintinia patrolls his town.
description: A sturdy guardsman, loyal to King Korbor.

long: An Ofintine guard watches the gate.
description: A sturdy guardsman, ever vigilant for evil.

long: An Ofintine volunteer patrolls his town.
description: He has taken up arms to fight the goblins.

long: A citizen of Ofinitine looks fierce and determined.
description: She has taken up arms to fight the goblins.

long: A man of Ofingia stands here.
description: He won't desert his town for a million goblins, all waving axes.

long: An Lonoyan woman walks through town.
description: Though the goblins poured in through every gate, she would stay here.

long: A small boy runs around shouting at unseen foes.
description: He is ready for the goblins when they come!

long: A Lonoyan girl stands here.
description: You are sure she has killed many trolls and more goblins.

long: A huge dog runs about, tongue lolling out of his mouth in a silly way.
description: A big goofy retriever, with a rough, coarse black coat.

long: You cringe in fear when a small black dog growls menacingly.
description: Reilly's miniature schnauzer looks tougher than a small dragon.

long: A farmer strolls about town in his Sunday clothes.
description:
As he walks past you, you see him stop and stare with an expression of
recognition, changing to anger.  Perhaps you left his gate open on the way here.

long: A drunken Dwarf rests here, singing loud enough to wake the dead.
description:
It takes more than a beer or two to intoxicate the sturdy mountain folk; he
must have had enough to stun a giant.

long: A fine fat gentlehobbit swaggers around, whistling merrily.
description:
There aren't too many hobbits living in Lonoya, and he is most likely a
visitor from the Shire.

long: A lovely Lonoyan woman serves mead to Reilly's customers.
description:
No one bothers her as she serves drinks, because they know that she has a
dagger ready for anyone who gets `fresh'.

long: An old Lonoyan man sweeps the road clean.
description:
Too old to wield a glaive, this man has taken upon himself the task of
picking up the litter that passerby drop in Lonoyan gutters.  Ofingia, the
"Jewel of Lonoya", would not sparkle as it does in Korbor's crown if he was not
so busy.  The old man really hates adventurers who don't clean up after
themselves.

long: A forest goblin roams Lonoya, arguing with himself.
description:
He doesn't seem to notice you right away, but I wouldn't wait for him to stop
talking and see you.  Goblins hate strangers, especially if they are armed.

long: A goblin raider prowls Lonoya, looking for travellers to rob.
description: Stumpy-short but thick, green-skinned and great-headed.  Ugly, ain't he?

long: A goblin crouches in ambush here.
description: Another goblin, another battle, another notch in your newbie dagger.

long: A goblin stands watch here.
description: Goblins, it seems, are not trusty watchmen.  You'd expect no more.

long: A great serpent slithers through the caverns, ignoring you.
description:
For a little while you fear poison, but this snake looks about as harmless as
any forty-five-foot reptile can.  Perhaps this serpent lives off the carcasses
of those killed by these goblins.

long: A stone-gnome is far from home.
description: He is wandering, as you are, through these tunnels to find an exit.

long: A goblin stands here alert, vigilant for intruders.
description: No one will pass by him unnoticed.

long: A green-skinned goblin warrior stands here, clutching a bloody scimitar.
description: He looks tougher than the average goblin.

long: A goblin warrior glares at you, angry at having been awakened.
description: He looks tougher than the average goblin.

long: A large goblin clad in stinking hides glares at you.
description:
You would NEVER wear his armor; untanned cowhide is not your style.  He
doesn't seem to mind it, however, and in any case this fellow is a dangerous foe
for any knight.

long: Toadstool, chief of the forest goblins, shouts and throws things at you.
description:
What does he throw?  Rocks, mostly.  Toadstool is taller than a dwarf, and
ugly as a toad.  He is larger than any goblin you have seen, in fact; maybe
Toadstool is orcish or half-orcish.

long: A goblin gnaws a bone here.
description: That bone looks very tasty, but he probably won't share it.

long: A huge hairy troll stirs a bubbling pot.
description:
As you watch, safely hidden, he picks up a dead goblin and throws it into his
pot, followed by a few spotted mushrooms and a halfling.  Then he catches sight
of you, and wonders what flavor you'd add to his concoction.  Oops!  Should have
stayed still, you idiot.

long: A sturdy oaken barrel bound with iron hoops stands in the corner.
description:
This barrel has no tap, but perhaps you could borrow one from the goblins.
No, I doubt it.  Besides, there is something queer about that cask.  Did it just
move?

long: A cabinet marked `Magical Items Only' stands in the corner.
description:
You nearly open the cabinet when you realize goblins don't write in the
Common Speech.  Perhaps it's a trap.

long: A strange hybrid of stone and centipede prowls the caves.
description: Half-crawler, half-concrete; it could only be the legendary Cementipede!

long: A drunken goblin staggers around.
description: You don't want to THINK about what he's been drinking.

long: A hungry warg stands here, growling at you.
description:
The goblins sometimes ride wargs, and maybe this one is trained as a mount.
You only know that the white fangs it now shows as it sees you approaching look
very sharp.

long: A peculiar green mold looks at you from the wall.
description: Looks at you?  Molds don't usually have EYES!  But this one does.

long: An Orc guards the caves here.
description: He is not as large as the usual Orc, probably half a goblin.

long: A goblin miner chips away at the mountains' stony innards.
description: He doesn't seem to be in the best of spirits.  It's been a long day.

long: The invisible stalker is, fortunately, not after you.
description: You can't see him.

long: A kobold slave hauls rubble for the goblins.
description: He is always looking for a way to escape.

long: A goblin miner rests here, out of his master's sight.
description: He is not too tired to kill you with that big nasty pick.

long: A great boulder nearly blocks the tunnel.
description: Where did that thing come from?  It didn't just MOVE, did it?  Hmmm...

long: A goblin slave driver supervises the miners and cracks his whip!
description:
He lashes fiercely at you with that great whip when he sees you in his mine
tunnels.

long: An Ofintine works as a goblin slave, with no hope of escape.
description:
The goblins captured him in a raid and now work him to death in their huge
mines.

long: An Ofintine works as a goblin slave, with no hope of escape.
description:
The goblins captured her in a raid and now work her to death in their huge
mines.

long: Wielding two great hammers, the goblin smith toils at his forge.
description: His knotted, iron-hard muscles attest to long hours at the anvil.

long: A goblin pumps the great forge-bellows here.
description:
He works at a furious pace as the overseer cracks his whip, to keep the
goblins' iron furnace white-hot.

long: A kobold shuffles quickly about, carrying iron ore and lime.
description: He avoids the whip nimbly as he feeds the roaring furnace.

long: A hill giant `encourages' the slaves with a huge flint-studded whip.
description:
He is not very bright, as few giants are, and might think you work here if
you stay much longer.  Like any evil giant, he loves causing pain.

long: A glowing iron pig cools in the sand, away from the others.
description: This iron pig seems to be chuckling softly.  Odd.

long: A large ogre trudges about, pushing boulders that must weigh tons.
description: He looks very strong.

long: An Elven hunter stalks goblins here.
description:
He, like you, has crept into Goblin-Town to hunt goblins.  Seems as though he
is doing a good job of it, so why not let him continue?

long: A large red dragon stands here, angry that you disturbed his rest.
description: He can't see you when he's sleeping, and you had best let him stay that way.

long: A huge troll of the Olog-Hai stands guard here.
description: Oh dear!  Time to leave the way you came in!

long: A large Orc stands here, looking for dinner.
description:
Offering him a waybread was a BAD idea, you now think.  Orcs don't like elves
very much.  Well, they do like elves dead.  In fact, they like almost any meat.
You probably look like a tasty meal.

long: A section of stone wall has many treasures embedded in it.
description:
You have heard of walls that came alive by wicked sorcery and absorb great
treasures within their magical masonry.

long: A fine iron-bound chest would catch any cabinetmaker's eye.
description: The chest was truly the work of a master carpenter.

long: Moragd the Goblin stands here.
description: Moragd is a great goblin warrior, son of Gorgh the Knob-headed.

long: Gorgh the Knob-Headed stands here.
description:
Gorgh, father of Moragd , is the greatest goblin warrior yet to taint this
world.

long: Khos the Greatnosed stands here.
description: Khos, Gorgh, and Moragd are the three best soldiers of the Great Goblin.

long: A goblin warrior stands here.
description: Ugly, slime-green, and bull-strong.

long: Thrash the Ogre Mercenary guards the Great Goblin.
description:
