You are sure you have seen Thrash before, somewhere.  Maybe he was in the
Grunting Boar the other day with Pippin.  Anyway, the Great Goblin has hired him
as a bodyguard.

long: Throm the Giant guards the Great Goblin.
description:
You are sure you have seen Throm before, somewhere.  Maybe he was at the
weapon shop the other day?  Anyway, the Great Goblin has hired this renowned
giant to guard his person.

long: Tarus the Swordpupil guards the Great Goblin.
description:
You are sure you have seen Tarus before, perhaps on BluemageMUD.  This sturdy
human is one of the Great Goblin's bodyguards.

long: The Great Goblin sees you and calls his guards!
description:
His head is bigger than any goblin's you have seen, and he is quite proud of
it.  This goblin is quite strong, and quite ugly, and has quite a few guards
around him.  Kill him, and King Korbor will repay you handsomely.

long: A poor mudder wanders, lost in this place.
description: You will become him if you are not careful.

long: A beautiful white star smiles at you.
description: You can't tell what the star looks like, she is too bright!

long: A young nebula is waiting to become a star.
description: It hasn't got a definite shape, it is just a cloud of mist.

long: A speedy comet is waiting to crush your head in.
description: You see the offspring of Halley's comet, here just to wipe everything out.

long: An enormous, red supergiant is forced to protect the galaxy.
description:
You notice the giant is not as tough as his name sounds ...  Still he can be
very powerful.

long: A tiny white dwarf is trying to sneak away from duty.
description:
Like the red giant, he is also appointed to stand guard for the galaxy.
But somehow he manages to escape.  Though tiny, it can take a lot of hits!

long: A huge nebula is here, resembling a horsehead.
description:
You can only make out its shape from the darkness.  He was cursed to stay in
here and his face may never be seen by anyone again.

long: The poor Andromeda is chained to the wall, suffering ...
description:
She was once a princess of beauty.  However, her beauty has led to a
Goddess's jealousy and she has to suffer here endlessly until Perseus comes.

long: The Mighty Hercules is working hard on his extra Labors for the Gods.
description:
He has been put to do the Ten Labors -- ten impossible tasks, by Hera, the
queen goddess, who disliked him.  But he finished them all and at the end was
granted immortality.  He is a very brave and strong fighter.

long: The wild pegasus is grazing peacefully.
description: It is the legendary horse with wings on its back.

long: Orion is still hunting for Scorpio.
description:
He is the legendary hunter who almost defeated Taurus the bull, but got
killed by Scorpio.  The gods put them both up as constellations but one appears
on one side of the sky and the other the other side so they will never meet.

long: The Pleiades are here, weeping for the loss of their sisters.
description:
These are the seven sisters of the Myths, and as for why they are here, no
one knows; even the Gods themselves have forgotten.

long: The gigantic Head of Draco lurks out from beneath and prepares to roast you.
description:
This evil-looking head is even larger than a giant.  He is the last guardian
before entering the inner galaxy.  His neck is flexing in a random fashion so
hitting the head is certainly not easy.

long: A baby draco is crawling on the Draco's body.
description:
You see a tiny creature which looks like a dragon except that its body
resembles a snake.  Gosh, is this a draco, you wonder, is this the thing we are
on now?

long: Aries is sitting here, welcoming you.
description:
You see a white goat here, the first guardian of the Zodiac, also the ruler
of Spring.  He looks as if he is expecting you.

long: Taurus wants to leave, but has been forced to stay as a guardian here.
description:
You see a wild-looking bull with a bad temper.  He is well-built and looks
like he can fight well ...  Indeed he has fought with Orion before and
survived.

long: Gemini is looking for his brother; have you seen him?
description:
As soon as you see him you know that he is the most perfect man you have
seen.  You can't find any imperfections on him.

long: Gemini is hiding from his brother, grinning evilly at you.
description:
As soon as you see him you see the most imperfect man you have ever seen.
How can there be such a contrast?  You wonder ...

long: Cancer the crab is here, hoarding the treasure away from you.
description:
You see a gigantic crab (YES, it is bigger than you!  ) with a crushed
shell.  Legend is that he was crushed by Hercules when he was sent by Hera to
kill him.  So Hera made Cancer a constellation for his work.

long: Leo the lion is roaring at you, ready for a strike!
description:
His metallic skin means that he could be the one which was killed by
Hercules during his first Labor.  His skin is so weapon-proof that Hercules
had to use his bare hands to tear the lion into two from its mouth!

long: Virgo is sitting here, winking at you suggestively ... you are alarmed!
description:
From what you have seen, you now realize that legends are legends, and Virgo
may not be the maid of chastity and purity at all!  But still she looks
gorgeous and is waiting for your first move, whatever it is ...

long: Libra, the fair and just, is staring at you, weighing up the sins of your past.
description:
He is a wise old man and can see people's thoughts through their eyes....
Now all he can see from you is greed and bloodshed.

long: Scorpio is moving his tail towards you, waiting to put an end to some mortals.
description:
Ever since he killed Orion in the myths, he has been punished by having
Sagittarius' arrow aimed at his heart forever.

long: Sagittarius the centaur is waiting to let go of his well aimed arrow ...
description: He is a centaur and a well trained archer.  No one can escape his arrows.

long: Capricorn is here, feeling bored ... he wants a fight!
description:
You see a mean-looking ram here.  He used to be a fierce fighter in the
ancient war but now the gods have decided to put him here, to live out the rest
of his days in peace.

long: The beautiful Aquarius is standing here, holding THE vessel.
description:
The pretty Water Bearer is smiling at you, you think you'd better give her a
hand with holding the vessel.

long: Pisces the mermaid is sitting here, waiting for your help.
description:
She has been forced to serve her husband, who had been cursed to turn into a
fish and she deserves your pity.

long: Pisces the fish, is jealous of your approach...
description:
He was once a very handsome man but now has turned into an ugly big fish.
So he becomes jealous of any living thing which is more handsome than him.

long: Ursa Major the bear is the last defense against any intruders.
description:
The Huge Bear which resides in the northern skies is here.  You think you'd
better turn back.  At least you have got a chance of survival.

long: Cassiopeia, the queen of the Universe, is sitting on her throne.
description: She is the Queen of Dignity; facing her you feel all your dignity has gone.

long: Cepheus, the king of the Universe, is sitting on his throne.
description:
He is the King of Might as well as of the Universe.  You suddenly feel very
weak and useless in front of him.

long: Polaris, the polar star, who commands the whole Universe, stands before you!
description:
He is the Master of the Universe, (NOT He-Man!  ), the most powerful!  Even
the King and the Queen obey him.  As you look at him you notice he is actually
a STAR, with dazzling bright light ...  Maybe you shouldn't have come here at
all?

long: Farlenian the soldier stands and watches quietly.
description:
Farlenian is a dark-haired, blue-eyed man with an extremely grave expression
drawn upon his face.  He wears a bright blue set of overalls, with some
protective layers of leather over top and a white cloak to round it out.  His
crossbow looks well-used and cared for.  You think he knows how to use it.

long: A small gerbil is eating some peanuts on a table here.
description:
It's a small, well-groomed and well-cared for brown gerbil.  Its sniffing
around some peanuts quietly, and then promptly shoves the lot of them in its
mouth!

long: Alerka Bardbane is resting here.
description:
Alerka sneers at you rudely, and ignores you.  He looks rather nondescript
and plain, just an ordinary man taking a break.  His knives do not look
ordinary at all, however.

long: Drogo the Dwarf is polishing his axe here.
description:
Drogo Bloodstain, dwarf at large.  He polishes his battle axe with a fervor,
more than once licking the blade to put a shine on it.  He seems to be having
fun...  To each his own.

long: A dark elf stands against the wall, watching.
description:
You feel his eyes bore through you for a moment, and then whisk away.  He
stands motionless, quietly...  Awaiting a proper moment perhaps?

long: A dog sits here, protecting his master.
description:
The dog growls at you as you approach, and his hackles raise menacingly.
You carefully stand back and consider your next move.

long: Airden the Wanderer is taking a break from wandering here.
description:
Airden is a tall, skinny human, dressed in simple clothes.  He smiles at you
and nods hello.  The dust on his clothes tells tales of many strange lands and
stranger adventures, and for a moment you consider asking him to tell you a
story.

long: A young kid stands out of the way here.
description:
On a second look, this twelve-year old kid seems completely drunk!  Hey!
Who gave the kid a drink?

long: A young woman sits here, a confused expression upon her face.
description:
Eshiay seems somewhat pretty, but very confused.  She moves a little
awkwardly, as if her body doesn't fit her very well.  She smiles at you
uncertainly, and then ignores you.

long: Jordo the Engineer is just hanging out here.
description:
Jordo's eyes glint viciously as he looks across the room.  From the way his
hands tighten on his weapon, you can tell that he isn't quite as at ease as he
would like you to believe.

long: A horse stands in its stall here, munching on some grain.
description:
It's a fairly plain, nondescript horse.  Brown hair, brown eyes, quiet and
pretty well-mannered.

long: A waiter rushes by, intent on his business.
description:
He looks harried from the way he hastily takes orders and rushes in the back
to get food, and to the bar for drinks.  He doesn't even spare you a glance as
he passes by.

long: A waitress rushes by, intent on her business.
description:
She looks harried from the way she hastily takes orders and rushes in the
back to get food, and to the bar for drinks.  She doesn't even spare you a
glance as she passes by.

long: A tired farmer relaxes here, for awhile.
description:
The dust and dirt of the land cover this man head to toe.  His eyes look
weary, his hands calloused, and those big work-boots he's wearing just can't be
comfortable.  This man is one of the citizenry elite; he feeds the people
through his own hard work.  Maybe you should buy him a beer.

long: Werith tends bar here, listening but not talking very much.
description:
From the size of those arms, this man must've once been a blacksmith.  You
bet he can more than take on anyone who wants to knock over his wayhouse for a
little cash...  This man is truly immense.  His movements sure, his eyes
keen...  You don't think messing with him would be a good idea.

long: A bartender pours a drink while advising his patrons.
description:
He nods, smiles, and asks you what you would like to drink.  As you decide,
he mixes a Franjie Deluxe for the guy down the ways a bit, his hands quickly
and surely spinning the lemon over the sides of the glass.

long: A chef struggles to get the food out quickly.
description:
With one hand he fries, with the other he flips the meat over, and with the
other hand he sprinkles some salt into the other hand which is holding...
Hey!  Isn't that too many hands?  This guy is good.

long: An adventurer babbles about some monster she killed.
description:
Her tales are pretty much full of it, and her equipment sucks.  Cannon
fodder.

long: An adventurer babbles about some monster he killed.
description:
His tales are pretty much full of it, and his equipment sucks.  Cannon
fodder.

long: A young woman watches the crowd go by.
description: She seems rather secretive.  You wonder what she's hiding.

long: A bartender pours a drink while advising his patrons.
description:
He nods, smiles, and asks you what you would like to drink.  As you decide,
he mixes a Franjie Deluxe for the guy down the ways a bit, his hands quickly
and surely spinning the lemon over the sides of the glass.

long: A bartender pours a drink while advising his patrons.
description:
He nods, smiles, and asks you what you would like to drink.  As you decide,
he mixes a Franjie Deluxe for the guy down the ways a bit, his hands quickly
and surely spinning the lemon over the sides of the glass.

long: A sea serpent swims around here.
description:
Looking closely at this creature reveals its large teeth...  Heading your
way.

long: A lizardman sentry sentries here.
description: He seems to be doing a good job sentrying.

long: A lizardman wizard is conjuring here.
description:
This wizard is deeply involved in his conjuring and hasn't noticed you...
Yet.

long: A large water elemental is swimming about here.
description: It seems to be part of the conjuring spell the wizard is casting.

long: A lizardman guard is guarding this area from people like you.
description:
This Guard is guarding.  Obviously he is not doing a good job.  This is
proven by the simple fact that you are still here.

long: The lizardman prince glares at you.
description: His glare is very unnerving.  Maybe you should attack him...

long: From behind the counter, Mr. Hooper smiles at you.
description:
Mr.  Hooper is the kind old man that runs this small general store.  He tips
his head forward and looks over his glasses at you.  'Is there something that
you would like to buy?  ', he asks politely.

long: The Headless Horseman, riding his nightmare, comes charging down on you.
description:
The horseman eternally looks for his missing head.  In an ancient military
uniform he sits on top of a powerful nightmare.  He turns toward you and levels
his sword at your neck, just before he charges.

long: An Elvis Impersonator is hiding behind a potted ficus here.
description:
This jumpsuitted throwback likes strutting his stuff.  The jumpsuit is
absolutely covered with flashy sequins.  As you look at him, he snaps his
fingers and points at you as he says, "Thank you.  Thank you very much!  "

long: A Rabid Potted Ficus sits here, grooving to the music.
description: It is a rabid Potted plant.

long: A gibbering lesser ghoul is savaging for his next meal here.
description:
It is a little thing, three feet tall at the most.  Its warped, green little
body twitches almost uncontrollably as he scans you deciding if it is worth the
risk to try to make you his next meal.

long: A gray-skinned goblin is prowling around here.
description:
The gray skinned creature is prowling here.  He carries a crude club and a
nasty expression

long: A monster made of crystal lurks here,
description:
Almost invisible against the rocky backdrop, the rock monster went
unnoticed until it struck.  Made of crystals and minerals it is slow but
powerful.

long: a red scorpion scuttles over a rocky patch of ground here.
description:
An arachnid about the the size of your two hands put together, the red
carapace of this creature provides it with a protective shells while its
stinger drips with a nasty venom.

long: One of the citadel's doomguard is patrolling the area here.
description:
A lumbering, clanking suit of animated platemail is all that makes up the
doomguard.  Like an invisible man in visible armor it forever walks the halls
of the citadel protecting it from outside threats.

long: A Clock Guardian lurks here waiting to get the drop on you.
description:
You didn't see it until it was almost on top of you.  The Clockwork
nightmare is in a vaguely humanoid shape.  It jerks and quirks as if it is not
totally in control of its own movements.

long: The Grim Reaper himself stands here waiting for those who would challenge him
description:
This is death himself.  The reaper stands as a grim figure.  His skeletal
hands clutch at his scythe.  His bony skull only partially concealed by his
black robe.  He looks at you a moment before he attacks.

long: A shambling zombie patrols the area here
description:
A walking, rotting corpse.  This is one of the mistresses countless thralls.
What they lack in individual strength, they make up for in numbers.

long: A Gigantic Suit of Armor stands here contesting your right to proceed further
description:
This monstrous suit of armor stands over ten feet tall and five feet wide.
Four inches thick as its thinnest point, the armor is covered with all form of
arcane runes that glow with power, burnishing the dark metal with an unholy
green glow that flows from deep within the Doomguard.  Who can guess what foul
dwenomers have been placed on this armor to give it its vital force.

long: A Greater ghoul stands on the balcony gnawing on the leg bone of his last victim
description:
A Humanoid mass of massive gray-green muscle and yellowed teeth.  Always and
eternally hungry.  He likes to take his victims here to eat in peace.  Will you
be his next victim.

long: A short, squat, purple child sits at the foot of Ilian's throne.
description:
A Gibbering little delinquent.  This child sits amused with childish toys.
Playing with rattles or slingshots or tops and the like.  It seems content with
its lot in life.

long: A helpless prisoner is chained to the wall here.
description:
This pathetic individual has not been fed in weeks.  He is lean and gaunt
from starvation.  He looks at you, pleading for mercy.

short: Ilian, the Mistress of the Void
long: Ilian, the mistress of the Void sits on her throne here glaring at you.
description:
The mistress of the void stands a full ten feet tall.  She personifies the
beauty of the night sky.  It is a cold, distant beauty, yet awesome in its
vastness and power.  Her smooth bone white skin is like flawless porcelain.
Her face has a haunting beauty ensculped in her evil.  The flowing purple robes
she wears are woven with the vastness of space.  She sits on her throne,
glaring at you while her children scuttle about her.

long: a flawed doomguard in on assignment, patrolling outside the citadel walls here.
description:
Like an invisible man in visible armor, the animated suit of plate was
relegated to outerpatrol due to its inferior quality.

long: One of the citadel's doomguard is patrolling the area here.
description:
A lumbering, clanking suit of platemail is all that makes up the doomguard.
Like an invisible man in visible armor, it forever walks the halls of the
citadel.

long: Scarlet Fever stands here with her hand on her saber
description: She looks diseased.

long: A dark-skinned elf is stalking through the forest.
description:
It is a dark skinned creature, with all the usual fine refinements
associated with their race.  His hair is a pale, bone white.  He stalks his
prey with a long curved knife.

long: A bug, one of a swarm flies around here, pestering you.
description: Its a mosquito, what else do you want.

long: A Large venus flytrap pokes itself out of the vines here.
description: It is a venus flytrap.  What more do you people want?

long: The Band stands here.
description: The band is playing a local favorite.

long: MouseRider sits on his throne here, his head in his hands.
description:
MouseRider is the greatest mortal sage ever.  He is also a most troubled
man, knowing things you couldn't even guess at.  You wonder how he could have
all that knowledge and not want power.

long: The Sentinel Beast's eyes glow chaotically as it attacks!
description:
The Sentinel Beast is somewhat reminiscent of a wolf if you ignore the
multi-colored glowing eyes, the horns, the six inch long claws...

long: Leonna, guildmaster of the Mages' Guild of Kerofk, greets you.
description:
Leonna seems to be a nice, fun-loving woman.  Obviously she became
guildmaster due more to her personality than her wizardly power.  Her powers
are no small matter, however; she is still one of the best mages in the city.

long: The Bookstore Owner looks up from a paperback as you come in.
description:
The Bookstore Owner looks very bored in his job here.  From the way his
fingers twitch and his eyes dart, you wonder if he really is what he appears...

long: The Thieves' Guildmaster, Seobagn, watches you with narrowed eyes.
description:
Seobagn snickers at you while he spins a coin around his fingers with
practised ease.  You wonder if its your coin.

long: The Bartender pours drinks several at a time to keep up with the rush.
description:
The Bartender looks harried as he tries to keep up with several different
orders at the same time.  Maybe you should bother him later...

long: The barmaids rush about delivering drinks and taking orders.
description:
The barmaid looks at you with a tired glance as she struggles to keep up
with the thirsty populace.  'What do you want?  ' she asks while pulling out an
order pad.

long: A drunk person is here, babbling about something incessantly.
description: The drunk person looks at you and slurs, 'Whatre you lookin' at, bozo?  '

long: A lucky gambler is here, striking it rich!
description: The lucky gambler looks at you and snickers.  Poor Boy!

long: The dealer sets out a new hand for all to play.
description:
The dealer looks at you flatly and says, 'Are you in or out?  ' He really
doesn't seem to care one way or another.

long: Ben counts his money, ignoring you completely.
description:
Benzaldehyde is a big man, reminding you of some elephants you've seen.
His eyes light up while he counts his money--a man possessed by his greed.

long: The shopkeeper smiles at you as you enter her store.
description:
The shopkeeper here is the legendary Bob's wife Ginger.  She welcomes you to
her establishment and invites you to browse as long as you wish.

long: An unlucky gambler struggles to hold back tears as his money disappears.
description:
The unlucky gambler just doesn't say a word, he just keeps putting the money
down, hoping to at least break even.  It doesn't even look like he's got a
chance.

long: A citizen is here, debating politics with anyone who will listen.
description:
The citizen seems very upset about something.  You're not sure exactly what,
but he seems anxious to tell you.  The more he talks, the more your attention
wanders until you're ready to go.

long: The receptionist smiles and offers you a room.
description:
Myrama is all smiles as you look at her.  She is bright, witty, and the only
reason why Kell is so successful.  Myrama is truly marvelous!

long: The herbalist is here, reading to her plants.
description:
The herbalist is an ancient woman, but she still seems spry and sharp-minded
when it comes to plants.  You've no doubt this woman is an expert in her field.

long: The lawyer is here, ready to lie his tongue out.
description:
The lawyer looks at you, ready to spot anything he can sue you for.  This
has got to be one of the most loathsome mobs in the whole mud!

long: The secretary pops his gum and asks you what you want.
description:
The secretary is a bored, out-of-place looking man, until you spot the
hidden daggers in his sleeve, boot, shirt, down his back, etc.  (not too good
at hiding them, is he?  ).  Obviously, this man is here more to protect the
mayor than to do office work.

long: Mayor Kell greets you into his office with a welcoming hand.
description:
The mayor seems happy to see you, even though you interrupted his putting
practice.  He sits you down, offers you a drink, and asks what he can do for
you.

long: The Council Guards look ready to rip you apart if you disturb the meeting.
description:
The Council Guards are impressive.  As you look upon their pikes and plate
armor, a little part of your brain start screaming about how you'd be crazy to
mess with them.

long: The council member looks quite upset as you interrupt them!
description: The council member is not just another politician...  He can fight, too!

long: The jailer reads his newspaper while sitting in his chair.
description:
The jailer looks bored, as if he was in a Fortran class.  That bored...
Really!

long: A prisoner here has given up all hopes of escape.
description:
The prisoner looks up at you weakly and mumbles, 'I am not a number!  ' He
gasps and looks dejected again.

long: A innguard is here, ready to fight off some marauding hordes.
description:
The innguard looks fearless and ready to defend the patrons of the Fortress
at a moments notice.

long: Jenk is here, ready to sell you anything!
description:
Jenk is a lowdown no good shopkeeper who'll sell anything to make a gold!
He's corrupt, greedy, and you're kind of man!

long: The black marketeer is here ready to sell you anything you want.
description:
The black marketeer has set up shop in Jenk's place to sell just what you
need...  Now what is it that you need?

long: A priest is here, performing his absolutions.
description:
The priest looks like a kindly man who has seen too much suffering for one
life.  He now devotes his life to XXXX, hoping to one day ascend to
immortality.

long: The High Priest is here, glowing with the benevolence of AO.
description:
The High Priest will be ascending to XXXX soon, and now his entire body
glows with the same light as his soul.

long: The recruiting sergeant tries to make you sign his forms.
description:
The recruiting sergeant has seen the world.  Now he's trying to make you do
the same.  ARGH!!!  Resist!  Resist!!

long: The Captain of the Guard salutes you with his epee.
description:
The Captain has a true love of civilized fighting.  He raises his eyebrow to
you...  Shall we have a go at it?

long: A beggar sits here, waiting for handouts.
description:
The beggar looks up at you with sad eyes.  However, you notice something
shiny clenched in his hand...  What is he hiding?

long: A citizen is here, waiting in line.
description:
The citizen looks at you with a flat stare.  You can see he's wondering if
you'll butt in line.

long: A citizen of Kerofk is here, going about his business.
description:
This citizen really doesn't have time to fool around with adventurers; he
has too much to do.

long: A militia guard is here keeping the peace.
description: The militia guardsman looks very well trained, for a citizen.

long: Kervin the wandering mage is well, ...wandering here.
description:
Kervin is very odd looking....  He has a big unkempt shock of white hair
that stick straight up and wears an electric blue robe to hide the rest of his
features.

long: The gateguard is here, guarding the gate.
description:
The guard guard looks at you and enunciates very clearly, 'Guard guard guard
guard guard guard guard guard guard.  ' (looks like he got the right job!  )

long: A bright shining light here nearly blinds you!
description:
You try to look closer at the light and nearly burn your retinas clear off.
That wasn't too bright now, was it?

long: Some guardian wisps here attack!
description: The wisp is made up of clammy, misty air, and a bad attitude.

long: The orb glows with a pure white light.
description:
The orb is pure crystal and shines with a bright aura.  This is surely the
object of your quest!

long: The liche that was MouseRider curses you horribly!
description:
This liche was once the troubled MouseRider.  Now he has finally lunged for
power and achieved it, making him immortal.  Will you be able to stop him?

long: The storm demons attack on the Liche's order!
description:
The demons are spindly with great bats wings and glowing blue eyes.  They
are twisted things not of nature.  They attack!

long: Tiersten looks at you with angry eyes and bared fangs!
description:
Tiersten, the patriarch of this odd, odd, family, turns out to be a vampire.
And a demonologist to boot!  He growls incoherently at you as he attacks!

long: A mist-like being stabs at you with a tendril!
description:
There doesn't seem to be much to look at, besides the coiling mist attacking
you!

long: Sosivia stands here, lost in daydreams.
description:
Sosivia struggles to hold onto her artist's soul, in spite of her family.
She is a beautiful woman that you wish you could take away from all this.

long: Celia sneers at you...Sneer!  Sneer!
description:
Celia is Talbot and Korino's sister, and Sosivia's mother.  She is the head
of the household as far as you can tell, and leeches onto the power with a
death-grip.  What a horrible woman!

long: Talbot spars with his brother Korino here.
description:
Talbot has a permanent sneer on his face.  He barely glances at you as he
beats his brother's sword back to take a vicious swipe...

long: Korino spars with his brother Talbot here.
description:
Korino looks at you with barely disguised contempt as he parries Talbot's
blow and ripostes around...

long: Bungle Fleecem, esquire, looks at you expectantly.
description:
He smiles, leans back, and tries to look bored to cover that vulturous
attitude.  He doesn't quite succeed; he IS a lawyer, after all.

long: A gravedigger works away the night shift here.
description:
He looks tired and dirty.  A glare out of the corner of his eye, and he
dismisses you easily.  He doesn't seem to care one whit about you.

long: A citizen of Kerofk is here, going about her business.
description:
This citizen really doesn't have time to fool around with adventurers; she
has far too much to do.

long: A hellhound looks at you with hunger.
description:
It's hide is a deep brownish-red hue, but its eyes are the most noticeable
about this magnificent beast.  Red within red eyes, with tiny pupils of black
in the center.

long: A goblin launches into a frenzied attack!
description:
You see the bloodlust in its eyes, and know there's no reasoning with this
creature...

long: The farmer sells her lackluster with all the excitement it warrants.
description: She looks wearied, but keeps hanging in there!

long: A receptionist stands in front of you, waiting to help you.
description: She looks at you happily, and pushes a ledger at you.

long: The Bartender pours drinks several at a time to keep up with the rush.
description:
The Bartender looks harried as he tries to keep up with several different
orders at the same time.  Maybe you should bother him later...

long: A madman has tea with his mortally challenged friends.
description:
He looks up at you with misted eyes and clenches his knife convulsively.
Spluttering and shaking, he begins to rise to his feet, cradling the cold steel
of his knife in his hands.  A tiny voice in your head says very clearly,
'Uh-oh.  ' You feel chilled...  Distant.

long: A rat scurries near the wall.
description: Its black, furry, and seems to have a serious problem with fleas.

long: A Leatherworker is here...working with leather.
description:
He smiles at your attention, and then turns back to his work.  His hands are
rough and scarred from frequent accidents with needles and leather-knives...
A hazard of the trade.

long: The Jeweller smiles at you briefly and motions you in.
description:
You can't guess what age she is; she's one of those few women that seem to
be almost timeless in their looks.  Her eyes glint with laughter as she notices
your scrutiny and slowly examines you.  You squirm under her penetrating gaze.

long: The butcher glances at you briefly and SLAMS down his cleaver.
description:
His apron is covered with bloodstains, as are his large, thick python-arms.
He holds a cleaver loosely and easily, almost as if he were born gripping that
thing.  His hair seems greasy and useless on his balding pate.  He sneers at
you and motions for you to take a number.

long: Sakifan the librarian looks up from his book as you enter.
description:
Sakifan sits on a small pile of books, idly caressing the cover of one while
he reads.  He puts his book down with a sigh as you come in.  Sakifan says,
'May I help you?  '

long: The Brewermaster oversees the work and marks upon a clipboard.
description:
The Brewermaster looks you up and down, nods approvingly, and says, 'Would
you like to chip in with the work?  Pays well...  '

long: Ceran the Contractor waves for you to sit down in a chair.
description:
Ceran plots a final line on his sketch and sighs in gratification.  He holds
the finished architectural drawing up to you; a plan to rebuild the ruined
temple to the north!  He examines it again, and then slaps it down onto a sheaf
of similar papers on his desk.

long: Grebe tends bar here between the drunkards.
description:
Grebe is an old, weatherbeaten scarred hulk of a man who looks as if he
survived the holocaust with only a few minor bruises to show for it.  You're
not sure if you want to mess with him or not.

long: A Sailor-Merchant points out his wares.
description:
This retired weather-beaten sailor man has quite a booming trade going on
here.  He grins snaggle-toothedly at you and tries to sell you an anchor.  You
don't think you need it.

long: The Landlord asks you how long you'll be staying.
description:
The landlord of this boarding house sneers at you and sticks out his hand.
Payment in advance.

long: A cityguard is keeping the peace.
description:
Just another law abiding citizen that decided to do more than just work the
mines or fields.  He has devoted his life to ensuring the protection of others.

long: A Brewery Worker rolls a barrel right on by you.
description: He waves at you and keeps going on by...

long: A Boarder sighs and tromps back to his room.
description:
Sad, poor, and depressed.  Obviously not one of the citizenry elite of
XXXX.

long: A Citizen of XXXX passes you without a glance.
description:
You make eye contact with the average looking man for a moment, and he
quickly looks away.  You notice his pace has sped up slightly; in a hurry to
get away from you?  Why would he...  Oh.  You've still got your weapon out.

long: A Citizen of XXXX passes you without a glance.
description:
You make eye contact with the average looking woman for a moment, and she
quickly looks away.  You notice her pace has sped up slightly; in a hurry to
get away from you?  Why would she...  Oh.  You've still got your weapon out.

long: A Merchant Trader is doing inventory in his head.
description:
His clothes are silken, and eyes hands soft, but his movement belie combat
training.  You don't think he would have gotten so successful by letting just
anyone knock over his operation here.

long: An Old Woman sits here, remembering better times...
description: Looking closer, you see that she isn't remembering; she's asleep!

long: A young boy plays quietly here.
description:
He looks up at you with watery eyes and asks for a drink.  He looks rather
sickly.

long: An aging housewife is waiting for her husband to return.
description:
You see worry in her eyes; is her husband overdue?  Possibly dead?  You know
with all those marauding bands of adventurers out there...  You never know!

long: An utter slob of a man is curled up in his chair.
description:
He hasn't bathed in, what?  One, two...  You stand away quickly; the smell
got to you.

long: An Old Man stares at the checkerboard intently.
description: He's playing checkers.  Leave him alone!

long: A man sits in his bachelor pad, just hanging out.
description:
He's cool, he's slick, he's got a job, and no woman will come near him.
That's life...

long: A nasty looking lion stands here!
description:
All teeth and fur, it could rip you apart in a few seconds!  Just hope it is
not really hungry!

long: A gate guard stands here.
description:
Dressed in animal furs, and smelling like he has not washed in a month, you
can tell that you have stumbled on a rather uncivilized person!

long: A cannibal stands here looking hungry!
description:
Looks a little like the guards that were on the gate, but with one
difference.  This guy has bits of meat and blood all over him.  Guess where it
came from!

long: A happy cannibal stands here.
description:
This cannibal is real happy because he has just got the last bit of meat
from a sweet young girl who stumbled into the camp!

long: The next meal cowers on the floor.
description:
She looks like she has been in here for days just waiting to be eaten!  You
could put her out of her misery!

long: A cannibal woman looks at you lustfully!
description:
Eeew!  How gross!  You can see little insects running all over her body.
She looks worse than the male cannibal's do, and that is saying something!

long: The cannibal chief looks very annoyed at your intrusion!
description:
This guy looks really mean!  Maybe you have walked in on the middle of a
meal.  Just hope that you don't end up as the next course!

long: A greater climbing tree snake slithers here!
description: This snake looks mean, no doubt about it.  Watch out for the fangs!

long: A small monkey plays with himself!
description: Awwww how cute!  It's scratching it balls!  KILL IT!!!!!

long: A large ape stands here.
description: Hairy, smell, and not nice to look at.  Maybe you should leave it alone?

long: A female ape jumps about wildly!
description: She looks the same as the large apes really.  Smelly dirty, and horrible.

long: The ape chief looks at you and roars!!
description: Like the other apes, but bigger, meaner, and a whole lot smellier!

long: A foreman stands here, cracking his whip evilly!
description:
He looks mean, brawny, and ready to bite you!  His clothes are rumpled, and
splattered with the blood of innocent citizens of Midgaard!  Cliche practically
oozes off him.  Get him!

long: An odd spirit guards an expensive-looking wagon here.
description:
This spirit looks kind of like the banshees that Mother always told you
about.  It seems pretty serious about guarding this wagon...

long: A Factory Worker works hard for minimum wage here.
description:
The worker is poor and wears ragged clothes.  Down- trodden by the system,
forced to work to exhaustion, he still holds his head high.  You can have his
life, but not his dignity.

long: A turtle trombles about, carrying wands for assembly.
description:
This turtle doesn't look too healthy for a good 4 foot high reptile.  Its
skin is going gray and patchy in areas, and its eyes are white and misty.
Poor thing!

long: A Vending Machine fixes orders for people with mechanical arms.
description:
This machine is a marvel of magic and engineering.  After recognizing the
order, and receiving the money, it quickly fetches and fixes the food,
delivering it with a tinny 'Thank You!  '

long: A Secretary sits here, answering the phone and looking busy.
description:
This secretary looks busy, but confident.  Even though she has a lot to do
greeting visitors and answering the phone, she never bats an eye as she says to
you, 'May I help you?  '

long: An office worker is pushing paper here.
description:
This office worker is trying to make it to the top, rung by rung.
Unfortunately, there isn't much room for advancement in this corporation, so
now is as good a time as any to goof off.

long: A secretary runs around here, busier than anyone should be.
description:
This secretary has SCADS of work to do, from her boss, friends of her boss,
other workers, etc.  You wonder why she puts up with this at all...

long: The Big Boss is waiting to give someone the AXE!
description:
You look at him, and accidentally catches his eye.  He begins yelling at
you!  For a second you get angry, before you realize that this is his _job_...
To yell at people.

long: A Giant Machine twists and whirls, hitting you by accident!
description:
It looks like a giant twisted creation of a blind engineer on acid.  Its
extruding parts look so hazardous that just thinking about entering the same
room might get you extremely hurt!

long: A frightened looking ghost flits about looking for escape.
description:
This ghost escaped the nets of the workers and now desperately seeks escape.
You feel for it, probably because of the fate that was intended for it...

long: A Dock Worker moves big crates about here.
description: He's big, he's brawny, he's busy.  Leave him alone.

long: A maintenance worker looks bored here.
description:
He looks at you with half-lidded eyes and rubs his hands on his jumpsuit
absently.  Not a real rocket scientist here.

long: The big, ugly lag beast is standing here sizing you up.
description:
Ick...  What a disgusting creature!  It is black and green and slimy and it
is drooling everywhere...  Looks mean too.

long: The lag monster stands here looking confused.  Kill him!  Kill him!
description:
What an odd looking little beast.  He looks harmless, but you never can
tell.  He is only about 4 feet tall, but he pretty muscular looking...  Maybe
you should ask if he needs help?  Nah...  Kill him.

long: Someone's little pet lag has gotten loose, and is sniffing about here.
description:
Awwww...  How cute!  A little baby lag.  He's about 3 feet long and you just
want to cuddle him to death...  No, you really want to kill him to tell the
truth.  But, remember, even a little lag can be a big problem.

long: The lag Guard is here wondering where that lag went.
description:
The Guard also had the job of taking care of the court jester's pet lag, but
he doesn't seem to be doing a good job of it.  He looks at you and says, 'Have
you seen that lag?  Master will have my head if I don't find him.  '

long: The court jester is here trying to make something.
description:
He is a funny looking, furry little dude.  He looks really busy trying to
mix up a batch of something or other.

long: A creepy little crawling lag thing is scuttling along the floor at your feet.
description:
Yuck!  If they'd ever clean this place maybe it wouldn't attract vermin like
this disgusting, little, six-legged, brown bug.

long: A VERY gaunt looking lag... it looks like a zombie!
description:
This guy has been lost in here too long...  It is more zombie than man now.
You would feel sorry for it, but it is moving in to attack!

long: A funny little imp-like lag thing (a quasit perhaps?) is sneaking about here.
description:
Little green, vaguely humanoid shaped creature, with a long pointed tail.
It is hard to say because before you ever get a good look at it, it darts back
into the shadows.

long: The Great Lag Monster is wondering just what you'll taste like.
description:
A massive man, with the head of a bull.  He looks as strong as bull too, but
not nearly as smart.  Actually, now that you consider it...  He looks a heck of
a lot meaner than any bull you have ever seen...  And he is coming this way!

long: The dark specter is lurking in the shadows.
description:
The soul of a long since passed on adventurer...  It lurks here waiting for
a chance to bring death to any who cross its path.

long: A lag is here annoying the hell out of you.
description:
What a jerk!  He won't shut up, and he keeps making the most irritating
comments about everything.  Better silence him with cold, tempered steel
MUHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!

long: A lag is here looking terribly confused.
description:
What a moron!  Every question that is answered in the help files, he will
ask and he will probably ask 2 or 3 times too.  This guy just doesn't get it,
best put him out of his misery.

long: A lag is here talking a lot.
description:
Well, at least this gal seems pretty cool.  Talks a lot, but she's a
friendly, interesting sort.  Seems to have a clue what she's doing also, unlike
some others you might see.

long: A lag is here wandering about aimlessly.
description:
Hmmm...  Looks like he has been around a while, but he wandered a little too
far from home this time.  Don't think he knows quite where he is, maybe you
should help him out?

long: A lag is here, and he looks quite sure of himself.
description:
Here is a guy who has it all together.  Nice equipment too, must have read
the help files, Eh?

long: You see a Gateguard standing here waiting for orders.
description:
The Gate Guard looks quite like a small knight without his powerful steed.
His armor is shiny and black.  He stands ready to give his life for the Crown.

long: You see a very large Royalty Guard.
description:
The Royalty Guard is a very large man.  Just from the looks of Him, this
could very well be your doom should you tangle with him!

long: Here stands a magnificent Knight of the dark realm.
description:
The Black Knight is here, riding his ebony black war horse.  His eyes flash
behind his visor in vengeance.

long: Here stands a magnificent knight of the light realm.
description:
The White Knight is here, riding his ivory white war horse.  His eyes gleam
behind his visor in joy.

long: A Dungeon Master stands here.
description:
The Dungeon Master seems willing to help you straight into your grave so he
can bless you properly.

short: the Queen of the Castle of Desire
long: The Queen of the Castle of Desire stands here.
description:
The Queen is a strikingly beautiful woman with pale skin and a mass of dark
hair that crowns her head like a black cloud.  If looks could kill, you would
already be dead.

short: the King of the Castle of Desire
long: The King of the Castle of Desire stands here.
description:
The King is a menacing figure.  You can easily understand why he is the king
and you are not.

long: A strange and deformed being stands here tugging on a bell rope.
description:
The being before you just happens to be named Isaac, although how you know
that is beyond you, but he is a poor and deaf hunchback, once hired by the High
Priest of the cathedral to ring the bells.  He is quite large, but appears
smaller due to his deformity, and looks to be quite strong.

long: A ghoul is here attacking a man in black robes!
description:
This being looks like a long dead and dessicated human corpse.  Its neat
translucent skin is taut about its bones and you think you can see strange
little white movements underneath it.

long: A ghoul is plodding towards the woman!
description:
This being looks like a long dead and dessicated human corpse.  Its neat
translucent skin is taut about its bones and you think you can see strange
little white movements underneath it.

long: A woman dressed in dark robes watches the approaching undead in fear.
description:
Dressed in solid black, Esmerelda is the current High Priestess of this
Cathedral.  Funny how you had never heard of a female high priestess before
this time, isn't it?  And even stranger, you know her name...  How distinctly
odd.  Anyways, Esmerelda seems to be watching the undead before her advancing
ever so slowly, maybe you can try to save her!

long: A man, dressed in black and silver robes, is fighting off some undead!
description:
This man is wearing a black and silver robe and is swinging a mace made of
what looks to be obsidian.  He seems to be sorely beset by the undead before
him.

long: It is on this ledge that Wyrenthoth sits, preening him... itself.
description:
Hmmm...  Seems that you have managed to walk in on Wyrenthoth during one of
his...  Its preening sessions.  You don't exactly understand what there is to
see beyond the bones.  Oh, wait, you didn't even know what the thing in front
of you was did you?  Well, you take the time to look, for once, and notice that
it is a large collection of bones.  And it just so happens that this large
collection of bones serves to form what looks to be a dragon, although the odd
bone or two seems to be out of place.  It does appear that Wyrenthoth is a
dracolich.

long: A pale white man dressed in a black stands before you.
description:
The man before you is dressed in all black except for his cape which has a
red satin lining.  He has dark hair and cold green eyes that catch and reflect
every movement.  Erich, as his name happens to be, is the master vampire in
control of all of the evil undead which infest this cathedral.

long: A rather large zombie is lumbering about here, quite aimlessly.
description:
The zombie giant seems to be wandering around crushing those who oppose
the...  It.  It is an enormous mass of rotting flesh and filth that smells, to
put it bluntly, really bad.

long: A skeletal human is standing here, looking rather confused.
description:
You look upon this being with a good deal of curiosity.  Then it begins to
twitch, and looks around.  You are rather shocked, until you realize that it
seems to be looking for someone in particular.

long: A zombie is wandering these halls.
description:
The thing before you is a rotting corpse, complete with flesh falling off of
it in small chunks.  It is dressed in the remains of a peasant's clothing and
seems to have a single purpose in mind (not that its mind could probably handle
any more than that).

long: A shadow made of inky blackness moves along the wall towards you.
description:
The moving shape of blackness looks like it is a shadow that lost its owner
at some point.  It looks rather malignant.  To put it mildly.

long: A hideous creature is here, mere skin and bones, howling madly.
description:
This ghastly apparition fills you with nigh-absolute terror.  Your first
conscious thought is to run.  Run fast and far that is.  However, your second
thought is to look at it a little more closely.  In doing so, you notice that
it seems to be made of mummified flesh, stretched over pointed bones.  Also, it
has strangely glowing red eyes.

long: A strange humanoid shape moves towards you.  It is a wraith!
description:
This thing looks vaguely humanoid, but does not appear to be made of flesh
but rather seems to be made of a strange electricity in the air.

long: A strange humanoid form stands in one corner of the room, singing.
description:
The once beautiful complexion of this female has deteriorated under the
ravages of time and decay, leaving only a pale resemblance to the former living
elf.  Looking closely at the clothing she wears, you notice that it appears to
be the soul of the cathedral's Mother Superior.

long: A portly ghost is sitting on an ethereal bed, singing softly to himself.
description:
This lost soul looks like he was once the Abbott of the cathedral.  He is a
portly fellow and even though he is long since dead, he looks rather jovial.
When you look at him, he stops singing for a minute, looks up at you, smiles
sadly, and then continues his song.

long: Camille the chemist stands over a cauldron mixing ingredients.
description:
Camille wears a thick brown robe that covers most of her features. Only her
hands and head stick out of her robe. Stains and burns cover her body and
clothing. She works diligently over her cauldron. Camille has been known to
concoct many different potions and is most famous for her liquid fire.

long: A magi sits against a wall wearing nothing but a towel.
description:
Sweat gleams on her supple skin.  Her black hair is wet and frames a round
face with slanted blue eyes.  She is striking in her beauty and grace.

long: An unfinished mob stands here.
description: It looks unfinished.

long: An @Mar@Cca@Bne @Mme@Crch@Bant@n tends the rune-locked cases behind the counter.
description:
Silver-streaked hair frames the measured face of an experienced dealer in minor
enchantments. Ink stains mark his fingers, warding rings circle both wrists, and
his careful gaze follows every hand that strays too near the locked cabinets.

long: The @Yba@Oke@Yr@n works beside the ovens, dusted lightly with flour.
description:
Flour dusts the baker's apron and forearms, and years beside hot ovens have
left his hands broad and scarred. He moves with the easy confidence of a
craftsman who knows exactly when a loaf is ready by smell, sound, and touch.

long: The @Wsh@Cop @Wcl@Cer@Wk@n keeps the counter orderly and watches the shelves.
description:
A sturdy clerk in a plain work apron keeps the shelves orderly and the counter
clear. Lanterns, rope, bags, boxes, and other travel necessities are arranged
within easy reach, and his quick eye notices merchandise that wanders.

long: The @Dwe@Oap@Won@Dsm@Oit@Wh@n tends the racks with a craftsman's critical eye.
description:
Soot marks the weaponsmith's leather apron, while small burns and old cuts score
his forearms. He checks edges, grips, and balance with patient concentration,
treating every weapon as a tool that must survive hard use rather than merely shine.

long: The @Dar@Wmo@Ore@Dr@n inspects a piece of fitted armor behind the counter.
description:
The veteran armorer has thick forearms, a measuring cord at his belt, and the
habit of inspecting straps and rivets whenever his hands are idle. Years of
hammer work have left him broad through the shoulders and exacting about fit.

long: The @Yin@Wn @Ost@Yew@War@Od@n keeps a practiced eye on the common room.
description: A middle-aged woman in a neat woolen dress keeps the inn's ledgers and room keys in careful order. Her practiced smile is warm, but her sharp eyes suggest that very little escapes her notice.

keywords: captain stolar boatwright boat merchant river captain
long: @BCa@Cpt@Wai@Bn @BSt@Col@War@n watches the river traffic with a mariner's patience.
description:
A weathered former river captain stands with the balance of someone accustomed
to shifting decks. Sun, wind, and river spray have roughened his face, while his
hands remain strong enough to test rope, hull seams, and oarlocks by feel.

keywords: river warehouse keeper sailor dockworker warehouseman
long: The @Bri@Cve@Wr @Bwa@Cre@Who@Bus@Ce @Wke@Bep@Cer@n checks cargo marks and warehouse tallies.
description:
This broad-backed river worker wears a patched vest over a faded work shirt.
Tar stains his hands and old rope burns mark his palms. He keeps the remaining
warehouse gear sorted with the practical care of someone who knows what river travel costs.

long: @BWa@Cll@Wy @Bthe @CWa@Bter@Cmas@Bter@n stands behind rows of sealed jugs and travel canteens.
description:
Wally is a broad, cheerful merchant with strong hands and a leather apron darkened
by splashed water. Clay jugs, stoppered bottles, and travel canteens fill the
shelves behind him, each marked for its spring or well of origin.

long: The @Bma@Cst@Wer @Bcou@Wri@Cer@n sorts sealed letters behind the counter.
description: An older man in a dark blue tabard moves between rows of pigeonholes with practiced efficiency. A brass badge bearing Midgaard's seal marks him as master of the city's couriers, and a ring of wax seals hangs from his belt beside a well-worn dispatch ledger.

long: The @Ytr@Oav@Yel@Wli@Ong @Ype@Odd@Yle@Wr@n watches passersby with a merchant's hopeful eye.
description: Road dust clings to the peddler's layered cloak, and dozens of little bundles hang from the straps of her weathered packs. She has the quick smile of someone who can make even the strangest trinket sound indispensable.

long: A @Wki@Cnd @Ws@Cou@Wl@n lingers nearby, ready to help anyone who looks lost.
description:
She immediately reminds you of your mother.  Constantly worrying about
everyone and everything.  She is always around to help out those who have hit
hard times and need a little boost.

long: A cheerful @Cci@Wty @Bgu@Ci@Wde@n waits here to help newcomers. Tell guide help for assistance.
description: A young woman in Midgaard's colors carries a well-used walking staff and a leather folio of hand-drawn maps. She seems genuinely pleased to point new arrivals toward the city's guilds, markets, inns, and gates.

keywords: veteran guild instructor trainer adventurer guildmaster
long: The @Ygu@Wi@Yld @Gin@Ystr@Wuc@Ytor@n oversees adventurers practicing and training in the yard.
description: A seasoned adventurer in a weathered cloak studies every drill with a patient, exacting eye. Old scars, carefully maintained gear, and insignias from many different disciplines show that he has spent a lifetime learning how different paths develop. He now serves the Adventurer's Guild as its universal instructor for both practice and training.

long: An @MAr@Cca@Bne @Mwa@Crd@Ben@n watches over the demonstration circles.
description: Layered robes and a rune-marked wand identify this veteran spellcaster as one of the wardens responsible for keeping dangerous experiments under control. The warden watches visitors carefully without restricting the hall to any single class.

long: A @Wte@Ymp@Cle @Wwa@Yrd@Cen@n stands quietly near the cloister.
description: A disciplined temple warden in polished mail keeps watch over the cloister. The insignia on the tabard marks service to the temple rather than allegiance to any particular adventuring class.

keywords: guild bounty hunter tracker assassin guildguard
long: A @Dgu@Ril@od @Rbo@Dun@Rty @Dhu@Rn@oter@n studies the contract traffic with a guarded expression.
description: A dark-cloaked veteran leans near the contract annex with the stillness of someone accustomed to tracking dangerous prey. Several sealed bounty tokens hang from a belt beside a well-kept blade.

long: A @Bgu@Wil@Cd @Bwa@Crd@Wen@n keeps watch over the Adventurer's Guild entrance.
description: A broad-shouldered veteran in practical armor stands beside the guild registry. The crossed-road badge of the Adventurer's Guild is fixed to the shoulder, marking responsibility for keeping order among members of every path.

long: The @Yba@Ort@Yen@Wde@Or@n works the counter with quick, practiced movements.
description:
A tired but capable bartender works the counter with the calm efficiency of
someone who has seen every kind of traveler come through the door. He keeps mugs
moving, arguments short, and a practiced eye on anyone likely to start trouble.

keywords: arcane commons steward server waiter scholar
long: The @Mar@Cca@Bne @Mco@Cmm@Bon@Ms @Cst@Bew@Mar@Cd@n keeps the shared hall in disciplined order.
description:
A composed steward in a dark, rune-trimmed vest serves scholars and hedge mages
without disturbing their arguments. He has learned which tables need more lamp oil,
which patrons forget to eat, and which experiments should remain far from the drinks.

keywords: refectory steward server waiter temple attendant
long: The @Yre@Wfe@Oct@Yor@Wy @Ost@Yew@War@Od@n oversees meals and the steady movement of diners.
description:
A plainly dressed temple attendant carries simple meals and drink between the
well-used tables. His manner is patient and unobtrusive, with the steady efficiency
of someone accustomed to feeding tired travelers, clergy, and people seeking aid.

keywords: lantern room steward server waiter guild attendant
long: The @YLa@Ont@Wer@Yn @ORo@Yom @Wst@Yew@Oar@Wd@n keeps the room welcoming and orderly.
description:
This discreet guild-side steward keeps his voice low and his attention sharp.
He serves scouts, couriers, and bounty hunters without prying into their business,
and seems to know exactly when a conversation would benefit from another drink.

long: The @Ygu@Wil@Cd @Yst@Gew@War@Yd@n manages the guild's daily traffic and requests.
description: A capable steward moves between the commons tables with mugs, meals, and a remarkable memory for who has just returned from which road. Between orders, the steward keeps an ear open for rumors that might interest the contract board.

keywords: bent copper keeper innkeeper barkeep tavern keeper
long: The @oBe@Ont @YCo@opp@Oer @oke@Yep@Oer@n keeps a wary eye on the room and its patrons.
description:
A heavyset innkeeper in a patched leather apron runs the Bent Copper with blunt
efficiency. Smoke has roughened his voice and years of dealing with laborers and
mercenaries have taught him when to pour another drink and when to end an argument.

long: A @bPe@Cac@We@bke@Cep@Wer@n watches the flow of people through the busy street.
description:
This seasoned civic officer wears practical mail beneath a clean city tabard.
A baton, whistle, and serviceable blade hang from the belt, but the Peacekeeper's
attention stays on crowds, disputes, and the small problems that can become large ones.

long: A @bci@Cty@Wgu@bar@Cd@n keeps a practiced watch over the street.
description:
This cityguard wears a weathered tabard over practical armor and carries the
unremarkable equipment of a working patrol. The guard watches alleys, doorways,
carts, and passing crowds with the alert patience of someone used to city duty.

long: A city street sweeper works patiently along the roadside.
description: Dressed in patched work clothes bearing a small Midgaard badge, the sweeper keeps the streets clear of refuse left by careless travelers. A battered handcart and stiff-bristled broom are never far from reach.

long: A hungry stray hound noses through the refuse for scraps.
description: This lean, rough-coated hound has learned to survive on the edges of Midgaard's streets. Its ribs show beneath dirty fur, but its eyes remain alert and clever whenever the scent of food reaches its nose.

long: The @Dme@Wrc@Oen@Dar@Wy@n watches the street with a professional soldier's caution.
description:
Road dust stains the mercenary's boots and cloak, while a maintained sword hangs
where it can be reached quickly. His gear is practical rather than impressive,
and his watchful expression suggests that danger is simply another part of the price.

long: A cheerful drunk sways near the tavern, singing badly to himself.
description:
His coat is rumpled, his cheeks are flushed, and the smell of ale follows every
unsteady movement. He seems enormously pleased with the world at the moment,
though his grip on both his cup and his remaining coin is becoming uncertain.

long: A weary beggar watches passersby and quietly asks for a little help.
description:
A patched cloak and worn shoes speak of long days spent on hard streets. The
beggar looks tired rather than helpless, watching the passing crowd with the sharp
attention of someone who has learned to notice generosity before it disappears.

long: A scarred stray hound prowls here with its hackles raised.
description: Older and meaner than most street dogs, this scarred hound watches every movement with hungry suspicion. Torn ears and a patchwork of old wounds suggest years spent fighting over scraps in Midgaard's alleys.

long: A gate @bci@Wty@Cgu@bar@Wd@n watches travelers and traffic beneath the arch.
description:
This gate guard wears practical armor beneath a city tabard and keeps a clear
view of both the road and the gatehouse. Dust, wagon traffic, unfamiliar travelers,
and conditions beyond the walls receive the steady attention of a veteran sentry.

long: A @gref@Gus@ye @goo@gze@n slithers wetly through the filth.
description: A wobbling mass of translucent green-brown slime creeps along the stones, trapping bits of straw, bone, and discarded cloth within its body. Whether created by careless alchemy or drawn up from the sewers, it has become an unsettling part of Midgaard's refuse cycle.

keywords: kennelmaster beastkeeper animal handler petshop keeper
long: The @Yke@Onn@Yel@Wma@Ost@Yer@n tends the animals with firm, practiced care.
description: A broad-handed animal keeper in a leather apron moves easily among cages and pens. Scratches cover his forearms, but every animal nearby seems to know his voice. A pouch of feed and several braided leads hang from his belt.

long: A curious young kitten watches the room from the clean straw.
description:
The small kitten is all oversized ears, bright eyes, and restless curiosity.
Its coat is clean and well tended, and it alternates between stalking bits of straw
and watching nearby people with the solemn concentration only a young cat can manage.

long: An eager young puppy noses through the straw and watches for attention.
description:
The puppy has broad paws, a soft coat, and more enthusiasm than coordination.
Its tail rarely stops moving, and every nearby sound seems to deserve immediate
investigation before something else becomes more interesting.

long: A compact beagle sniffs eagerly along the edge of the holding pen.
description:
The little hound has a keen nose, alert eyes, and sturdy legs built for following
a trail much longer than its size would suggest. It tests every new scent with
serious attention before looking up hopefully at the nearest person.

long: A powerfully built rottweiler waits attentively in the holding pen.
description:
The young rottweiler is broad through the chest with a dark, glossy coat and
watchful eyes. Calm under the kennelmaster's care, it nevertheless carries itself
with the confidence of a dog that will grow into a formidable guardian.

long: A large trained wolf rests alertly behind the sturdy pen latch.
description:
This wolf has been raised around handlers without losing the wary intelligence of
a wild predator. Thick fur covers a lean, powerful frame, and its pale eyes follow
movement quietly while its ears track every unfamiliar sound.

long: The @Mdr@Cea@Bmw@Mar@Cde@Bn@n stands in quiet vigilance, half-shadowed by strange light.
description:
A pale-robed woman moves quietly among the crystal alcoves, checking silver runes
and renewing the wards that shelter sleeping travelers. A faint shimmer clings to
her sleeves whenever she passes a warded alcove, then fades like the edge of a dream.

long: A putrid zombie is here.
description:
It is a prime example of the undead: sickly green skin, sunken eyes with a
yellowish tinge, and sharp, dirt-encrusted claws.

long: A poisonous asp slithers here.
description: This small snake looks quite dangerous, better take a wide detour around it.

long: Morticia, Guildhead of the Living Dead, is here.
description:
Her long, raven black hair drapes those stunning curves of hers.  How did
such a sweet thing become the leader of this cult?  As a bard once wrote, 'You
could tell she was practiced at the art of deception by her bloodstained hands.
'

long: Lazarus, Assassin and Guild Physician, is here.
description:
This master herbalist was found too valuable to the Guild as a maker of both
soothing balms and poisons.  Even death could not release him...  The
necromancers just reanimated him.

long: An undead riding beetle is parked here.
description:
A fine example of Necromancy, this giant beast can travel for miles with no
need for food nor water.  A most economical mount -- and sporty too!

long: A wraith knight stands a silent watch here.
description:
This was probably some poor adventurer, like you, before the Necromancers
got their hold on him.  Now he just awaits, blade drawn, like some ethereal
beefeater.

long: The Crypt Keeper, grinning at you maliciously, is here.
description:
The dessicated little fellow cackles with mad glee as he approaches you.
He twitches from excitement so much that his scraggly hair jostles as he
flashes his dull yellow teeth.

long: A Hermit, starved for company, is here.
description:
Although raving mad, the hermit has come out of his isolation since he has
not spoken with anyone for ages.  The shaggy hermit draws you over and begins
to tell a strange tale, 'Some 600 years ago, when I was but a lad, a great
dragon ruled the land.  His name was Ancalador.  Many heroes came to do battle
with him, but all failed and died, horribly, I imagine.  But one wizard
challenged the Drake to a magic duel.  He too died, like the others, but with
his last breath, the wizard turned the mighty Ancalador to stone!  Many
believed the dragon's evil reign ended, but after the dancing and drinking were
over, and life returned to its quiet pace, the people began to notice that the
Dragon's presence could still be felt.  Ancalador did, in fact, continue to
rule from his petrified prison through the manipulation of the minds of men.
Indeed, he has done so to this day.  Many believe he is plotting the day he can
return in the flesh, so to speak...  ' With that the Hermit begins to cackle
madly,

long: A blob of green slime drops upon you!
description: It looks like animated mucous, dissolving and eating all it touches.

long: A flame dweller is basking in fire here.
description:
Its shape changes like the flame it lives in.  One moment it may resemble a
serpent, the next, a man.  It seems to be thoroughly enjoying itself.

long: A green crystal spider is roaming here.
description:
The fantastic beast seems to be made of a crystalline substance which is
giving off a green light.  It clicks its crystal mandibles in irritation with
you.

long: A yellow crystal spider is clicking its mandibles here.
description:
Slightly smaller than its green cousin, this creature also appears to be
made of living crystalline substance which glows yellow.

long: The Petrified Warden guards the way.
description: It wears the sneer of cold command upon its stony visage.

long: A lumbering umber hulk is here.
description:
This great beast has huge mandibles and a mammals' mouth, angry animal eyes
set between unreadable insect eyes.  The effect is confusing.

long: A hideous ochre jello approaches.
description:
As it oozes slowly at you, you can make out items undigested within it.
From past unfortunates, you presume.

long: A Necromancer of the Bloodstone, creating zombies, is here.
description:
Evil reeks from his dark robes.  His hands are adorned with the long, wicked
nails which are stained with the ichor of embalmers and malignant salves.

long: The FREC stands here looking for violence.
description:
This large, purpled, mohawked warrior looks quite aggressive.  It is
probably not something anyone should mess with.

long: The Boss is standing here looking somewhat bored.
description:
This person is bearing up under University pressures quite well and looks as
if it can cope with anything.

long: The Gael is here to help you.
description:
This person is ready, and willing to help any being in trouble.  Just to top
things off, the gael is extremely well dressed.

long: An Example Mob stands here, exampling.
description:
The example mob looks indistinct, as if it hasn't been completely fleshed
out yet.

long: A professor is standing here, glaring at you.
description:
As you glance at the professor, it suddenly begins to scream about homework
and its spatial relationship to you.

long: Security is lurking in the area, watching for misbehavior.
description:
You don't want to misbehave when these guys are around.  In fact you don't
want to even be around these guys.

long: Security is lurking in the area, watching for misbehavior.
description:
You don't want to misbehave when these guys are around.  In fact you don't
want to even be around these guys.

long: Security is lurking in the area, watching for misbehavior.
description:
You don't want to misbehave when these guys are around.  In fact you don't
want to even be around these guys.

long: A Student Constable is protecting the campus from this point.
description:
These are also known as StuCons and are recruited from amongst the ranks of
everyday students of the university.  They are not much more than hired help.

long: A Student Constable is guarding the campus from this point.
description:
These are also known as StuCons and are recruited from amongst the ranks of
everyday students of the university.  They are not much more than hired help.

long: A Student Constable is guarding the campus from this very point right here.
description:
These are also known as StuCons and are recruited from amongst the ranks of
everyday students of the university.  They are not much more than hired help.

long: The student is hurrying off to its next class.
description:
This is just your average it university student, the only interests it has
are classes, work, and other its.

long: The student is rushing off to his next class.
description:
This is just your average male university student, the only interests he has
are classes, work, and other students of the opposite sex (females, you think).

long: The student is scurrying off to her next class.
description:
This is just your average female university student, the only interests she
has are classes, and work.

long: This frosh is standing here with a confused expression on its face.
description: You are looking at the everyday run of the mill confused frosh.

long: This frosh is standing here with a confused expression on his face.
description: You are looking at the everyday run of the mill confused frosh.

long: This frosh is standing here with a confused expression on her face.
description: You are looking at the everyday run of the mill confused frosh.

long: A Mary-Rotte chef struggles to poison the food quickly.
description:
With one hand he fries, with the other he flips the meat (?  ) over, and
with the other hand he sprinkles some salt into the other hand which is
holding...  Hey!  Isn't that too many hands?  This guy is good (or maybe he
isn't...  ).

long: A Coke Machine hums quietly.
description:
This machine is a marvel of engineering.  After receiving the money, it
quickly fouls up the order and delivers it with a large clanging noise.

long: This frosh is lining up here.
description: You are looking at the everyday run of the mill lining-up frosh.

long: This frosh is lining up here.
description: You are looking at the everyday run of the mill lining-up frosh.

long: This frosh is lining up here with a confused expression on her face.
description: You are looking at the everyday run of the mill confused frosh.

long: The FREC waits here for violence to come to it.
description:
This large, purpled, mohawked warrior looks quite aggressive.  It is
probably not something anyone should mess with.

long: A caf employee stands here ready to fill your order.
description: As if you'd actually order anything.

long: A rather large jock occupies the room.
description:
It (he?  ) is quite big.  It (she?  ) looks at you with undisguised
hunger...

long: A mosher moshes here.  Oh it hit you!
description: This mosher moshes with enthusiasm!

long: A mosher moshes here.  Oh he hit you!
description: This mosher moshes with enthusiasm!

long: A mosher moshes here.  Oh she hit you!
description: This mosher moshes with enthusiasm!

long: A friendly mailbox waits for your mail here.
description:
This mailbox is a staple in most of Tabrach.  Funny thing though, you've
never seen one in your life...  Hmmmm.  On the side is emblazoned the word TP
(must stand for Tabrach Post).

long: A swarm of frgos circles above the building to the west.
description:
This creature appears to have the body of a cow with eagle's wings...  How
strange.

long: A student is snoozing here.
description: This is just your average it university student, and hey, it's sleeping too!

long: A student is furiously taking notes here.
description: This is just your average it university student.

long: Chris is drooling here.
description:
The man before you is tall and stocky.  He is clothed in a stone-washed pair
of jeans and a purple beret.

long: The Residence Master is presiding over his little world here.
description:
The creature before you looks EVIL and SCARY, but you being a hearty
adventurer are not afraid!  (unless you are less than 15th level ...  That is.

long: Bennie Boo is playing The World of Xeen here.
description: He seems to need help, any ideas?

long: The Bubble Man is bubbling over.
description:
His surface is a nice mixture of color and light.  It seems to be very thin
though.

long: A chimp-like being is doing acrobatics here.
description:
It looks like some kind of cross between a human and a chimpanzee...
That's odd.  Those darned elves ...  They should never have invented gene
splicing...

long: Alex is here fleshing out the Example Mob.
description:
Alex is working hard at fleshing out the example mob which looks indistinct,
because it hasn't been completely fleshed out yet.

long: Steve is working furiously at finishing the wld file so it can be put online.
description: Steve is working hard and it looks like he should be finishing soon.

long: Bob is looking after his store here.
description:
As you look more closely, you realize that Bob is somewhat spaced out.
Looking at the sheet in his hand reveals that he is doing inventory.  No wonder
he is so spaced out.

long: Mr. Tuck is organizing shelves.
description: He seems to be locating things like candy.

long: Sue is looking after books here.
description: Actually, there doesn't seem to be any books...  Hmmmmmm.

long: The Bartender pours drinks several at a time to keep up with the rush.
description:
The Bartender looks harried as he tries to keep up with several different
orders at the same time.  Maybe you should bother him later...

long: A drunk, babbling about something incessantly.
description: The drunk person looks at you and slurs, 'Whatre you lookin' at, bozo?  '

long: Chief FREC orders you around here.
description:
It stands tall and proud...  As if being purple with golden hair can make
anyone proud...

long: A copy of Golden World lies here.
description:
It looks like the student humor newspaper, but it contains nothing to do
with actual news that you didn't know already.

long: The clock ghost flits about randomly here.
description:
The ghost resembles the late Grant Hall.  It seems to be somewhat
transparent though.

long: An ethereal wraith-like shape is here.
description: This ghostly creature is gray in color and has an amorphous shape.

long: A shaggy monk stands here quietly.
description:
This man looks like an ordinary monk, except he is really quite a big fella,
and seems to have a lot of very fine brown body hair, even on his palms..
*stare*

long: A silver statue has posted itself in the corner.
description:
Well, It doesn't APPEAR to be human.  It looks like a suit of armor, but why
the heck did it just turn to look at you?

long: Mateon's Templar is here, looking out the window.
description:
This man has dedicated his life to Mateon, and the man behind the mask.  He
turns from the window and stares at you blankly.

long: Mateon, defender of the Bull, scowers at you!
description:
Mateon is a HUGE man.  A huge ANGRY man.  He will NOT let you NEAR the man
behind the mask.

long: A Chambermaid is here, desperately trying to straighten up.
description: The Chambermaid looks harried, and glances at you with fear in her eyes.

long: A man wearing a golden mask watches you.
description:
You look at this man, and then notice something funny.  It seems to be
difficult for him to stand on two legs.  As you watch, he drops to all fours.
You see a glimpse of fur under his cloak.  He peels the mask off and you stare
into his brown eyes, and big, wet, black nose.  "Nice nose ring", you think.

long: An acolyte is here, looking for a broom.
description:
The acolyte wanders around, looking for a broom.  He is making a heroic
attempt to ignore you.

long: A tunnel troll wanders about here.
description:
The troll is small, dark, and smelly.  You would be willing to bet that he
has never seen the light of day.

long: A Black Pawn shuffles around nervously here.
description:
The pawn seems to be made of carved wood, and animated by some magical
means.

long: A White Pawn shuffles around nervously here.
description:
The pawn seems to be made of carved wood, and animated by some magical
means.

long: A black Rook stands here, having linear thoughts.
description: The black Rook stares absently into space, he doesn't seem to notice you.

long: A white Rook stands here, having linear thoughts.
