description: The white Rook stares absently into space, he doesn't seem to notice you.

long: A black Knight is here, looking for his horse.
description:
The black Knight would probably look a lot more noble if he was astride a
horse.

long: A white knight is here, looking for his horse.
description:
The white Knight would probably look a lot more noble if he was astride a
horse.

long: A black bishop stands here quietly.
description: The bishop looks at you, then stares at the ceiling and yawns.

long: A white bishop stands here quietly.
description: The bishop looks at you, then stares at the ceiling and yawns.

long: The Black Queen stands here, blocking a door.
description:
The black Queen stares into you eyes and screams, "Mop the floor, you
nitwit!  "

long: The white Queen stands here, blocking a door.
description:
The white Queen stares into you eyes and screams, "Mop the floor, you
nitwit!  "

long: A black King stands here, looking grumpy.
description:
The black King looks rather haggard.  He tells you, "Take my wife...
Pleeeaase.  " You decide that the king is not much of a comedian.

long: A white King stands here, looking grumpy.
description:
The white King looks rather haggard.  He tells you, "Take my wife...
Pleeeaase.  " You decide that the king is not much of a comedian.

long: A flying fish jumps out of the water at you!
description: The fish winks at you?!

short: a card of the suit diamonds
long: A playing card shuffles around here.
description: The playing card grins at you evilly.  He is of the suit diamonds.

short: a card of the suit hearts
long: A playing card shuffles around here.
description: The playing card grins at you evilly.  He is of the suit hearts.

short: a card of the suit clubs
long: A playing card shuffles around here.
description: The playing card grins at you evilly.  He is of the suit clubs.

short: a card of the suit spades
long: A playing card shuffles around here.
description: The playing card grins at you evilly.  He is of the suit spades.

long: The Joker bounces around, happy to see you.
description:
The Joker cackles happily and ruffles your hair.  "So nice to see you
dearie, would you like some tea?  " The Joker is NUTS!

long: A stealthy brown jaguar makes its way along the branches.
description:
It gives a lazy look in your direction and continues with its slow, graceful
slink across the Tree's branches.

long: An elven cat lies on a branch, deep in sleep.
description:
It lays in the shade with an uncaring look to it, as if everything were
completely safe.

long: A spotted leopard lazily preens its coat as you walk past.
description: It does not even glance your way as it goes about its bathing needs.

long: A small tree snake slithers past.
description: It is a very small, green thing which has made its home in the Great Tree.

long: A small tree frog hops about.
description: It is a little green thing, looking for a few good insects to munch.

long: A wild baboon ambles about.
description:
It lumbers about the tree, munching here and there on any items it finds of
interest.

long: A carnivorous ape swings from branch to branch.
description:
It has a fixed look of stupidity upon its face, one which says plainly that
it exists only by the grace of the creatures around it.

long: An Atomie Shaman walks slowly past.
description:
The Shaman wears a look of absolute seriousness upon his face, a fixed
expression of intense concentration.

long: An Atomie father works diligently for his family.
description:
The atomie is a race of highly intelligent elf-like beings who serve the
trees in which they reside.

long: An Atomie mother fusses about the tree, cleaning and straightening.
description:
Her face looks careworn and full of love.  Her labors are those of her
people, which age all prematurely.

long: An Atomie child plays about the tree branches.
description:
The child looks to be without a care in the world, existing in a very perfect
place.

long: A dryad walks about the branches with a lithe dexterity.
description: She politely nods to you and continues on her way.

long: A sylph flitters and flutters about the Tree.
description: She smiles merrily at you as you pass, a gay expression fixed upon her face.

long: A sprite moves past, all grace and mischief.
description: She grins wickedly your way and winks before moving on.

long: An ettercap lounges in a small branching of the tree.
description:
It looks to be awake but nods off every now again, jerking upright with a
start.

long: A Grig shaman moves purposefully about the Tree.
description: He is lost in deep thought, taking no notice of those around him.

long: A grig father works about the Tree.
description: The father works hard for the well-being of the Tree.

long: A grig mother clucks and tsks over the condition of the Tree.
description:
She skimpers about here and there making a fuss at the smallest of tasks
which need doing.

long: A grig child performs some small, menial chores about the Tree.
description:
The child appears solemn, even more so than the rest of the grigs in this
Tree due to her age.

long: The Lord gives you a sloppy smile and nods your way.
description:
He is obviously quite drunk most of his waking moments - and rightly so.
Being married to the dreadful wench of a Lady must be quite demanding on one's
nerves.

long: The Lady narrows here eyes at you, wondering who you are.
description:
She seems to come to some sort of decision about you, one that must have
been favorable on your part, because she suddenly dons a bright smile and comes
walking your way.

long: The Lady's handmaiden fusses about the castle, making sure all is perfect.
description:
She is a young and beautiful thing, handpicked by the Lady for her aesthetic
pleasantness.  Her manners in court are unmatched and yet she knows her place
enough to never overstep her bounds.

long: The Lord's manservant regards you solemnly.
description:
He regards you with calm, clear eyes that reflect almost nothing at all
within them.  His only desire seems to be to serve his Lord.

long: The Lady's drunk brother leans over a window ledge, his feet almost leaving the floor.
description:
He is obviously a guest-turned-permanent-resident.  The fact that the Lady
and her husband throw a nonstop party appeals greatly to this man.  Coupled
with the fact that everything is free plus whatever gold he can sponge from his
sister, he has it made.

long: A very militaristic man stands rigidly while the gala goes on around him.
description:
He is obviously unused to the informalities of court life and spends most of
his time in the field, doing whatever it is that knights do best.

long: A soldier from the Lord's brother's contingent beds down in the hay.
description:
He seems more than content to relax for this short duration, even though it
be out in this barn rather than indoors where it is much more festive.

long: An impatient soldier paces back and forth, waiting for his captain.
description:
Some of his other men may feel comfortable standing still, but this one is
ready to get back out into action.

long: A bored soldier leans against a wood post in the barn, waiting for something to happen.
description:
He stares off into space with a vacant look, idly picking at the hay beneath
him.

long: A lady-in-waiting fusses and fritters about the Lady's bedroom, tidying up.
description:
This one is a neat freak, for sure.  She seems almost on the verge of tears
when she finds the slightest smudge of dirt anywhere.

long: A lady-in-waiting wanders about the keep, searching for her Lady.
description: After all, what good is a lady-in-waiting if she can't wait on her Lady?

long: A visiting scholar rests from a long day in the Grand Ballroom.
description:
The man is obviously not one for the party life and hasn't the stamina that
the Lord and Lady possess for drinking and carousing.

long: A scantily-clad woman pats the drunk man's back soothingly, giving you a wink.
description:
She is obviously hired company for the awful man who probably is leaving
most of his dinner on the ground outside the castle at this very moment.

long: A man with a bowed fiddle plays with vigor for the room.
description:
He is older, with crows feet in the corners of his eyes that he scrunches up
every time he gets going really well into an overture.

long: A cook works about the kitchen, keeping the food fresh and tasty.
description:
He and his co-workers look more than pleased to be doing to be doing what
they are for the Lord and Lady.  They must be well paid.

long: The stable boy smiles up at you, looking to take your horse.
description:
He says nothing, only looks you dead in the eye and smiles.  Its actually
sort of annoying.

long: An ale salesman lies stretched out on the bed, catching some Z's.
description:
He must have had himself a few too many tastes of his own product last night
and now has to sleep it off.

long: Alanis the sorceress waits patiently for the Lady to return.
description:
It seems the Lady has been dabbling in magic of late and has asked Alanis to
join the staff permanently - unbeknownst to the Lord.

long: Felice, the castle healer, relaxes on the bed, reading a thick book.
description: He smiles at you as you enter, inviting you to come sit near him and talk.

long: The Baron lounges in his favorite chair, reading from a thick book.
description:
He is a short, stocky man who looks as if he might need a bit of shaping up
to be called 'in shape'.  His eyes are a bit hollowed, as are most men's eyes
spent too long reading from books.  His hair is all but vanished except for two
thin lines on the sides of his head.

long: Melinna, Cailveh's wife, holds court for her absent husband.
description:
Most of the day-to-day runnings of the court are left to Melinna, a very
skilled and shrewd politician.  It is an unspoken agreement between the Baron
and his wife that she deal with the more mundane matters so that he might
continue his studies without significant interruption.

long: Cailveh's eldest son, Gilzaan, walk about meeting and greeting the people.
description:
It is Gilzaan who will eventually succeed to the title of Baron when Cailveh
and his wife have passed on.  Gilzaan does not take this responsibility
lightly, and makes it a point to make himself known to as many of the prominent
men of the area that he can.

long: Necromocis, Cailveh's youngest son, works diligently at one of the tables.
description:
Although not as large of frame or imposing as his older brother, Necromocis
has his strength in other areas.  He has a highly developed intellect, bred
from many years of study and dedication.  His father's work with healing will
certainly go on even after his father has passed on.

long: The court astronomer peers with one eye closed through the telescope.
description:
He is a withered old man, who doesn't appear to have much longer in this
plane of existence.  He scratches notes in a small pad of paper every now and
again.

long: A quiet servant glides about the tower, keeping the guests happy.
description:
He is a stately old gentleman with long, fine wisps of hair that delicately
brush the back of his coat.

long: A robed man patiently awaits his time to speak with the Baron.
description:
He stands within the comfortable confines of the tower, yet he wears a
thick, full robe of dark wool with the hood pulled up over his head.  He
radiates a very mysterious aura.

long: A humble petitioner pleads his cause with the Baroness.
description:
He looks as if he might be a woodcutter or perhaps a simple worker, however
he bravely stands his ground and speaks with a strong voice to the Baroness.

long: An arrogant land owner noisily clears her throat as she waits in annoyance.
description:
She wears only the finest of clothing upon her body, making excellent use of
her bodice so that she might court even more favor with the locals.  It ain't
workin'.

long: A pious farmer patiently awaits his audience with his head bowed.
description:
He holds his rumpled hat in his hands, fretfully twisting and turning it in
nervous anticipation.

long: A lab assistant works about the tables, mixing various chemicals.
description:
She looks to be about middle-aged with severe features which almost seem to
be held in place with an iron will.  Her work is her life.

long: A door guard stands post at the door, clicking his heels sharply as you enter.
description:
He looks more for decoration and ceremony than anything else, but he
certainly seems to take his job very seriously.

long: A chamber maid efficiently cleans and organizes the room.
description:
She hums as she works, apparently enjoying what she does for a living a
great deal.  She apparent hasn't noticed your entry into the room.

long: A visiting cousin leans back contentedly in his chair, enjoying a meal.
description:
It looks like this one may have run low on funds and knew that good old
Cailveh would come through with a few meals and maybe a bit of spare change for
the road.

long: An old farmhand makes his way about the barn, going through his work day.
description:
He walks slightly hunched over with a bad back, but he still seems to be able
to perform his regular duties without much trouble.  He notices you looking his
way and gives a smile and a wink.

long: A fat cow waddles about, lazily chewing on some grass.
description:
No matter how long you stare, it still looks like nothing more than a big
fat cow chewing grass.

long: A busy housewife skitters about the house, cleaning everything.
description: She must not have seen you enter yet or else your shoes would be *off*.

long: A farmer snoozes in his favorite chair, his nose hairs vibrating as he snores.
description:
He is your average typical farmer - a tall, lanky guy dressed in serviceable
clothing that smells of cow.

long: A woodsman, still dressed in his work clothes, lounges in a chair.
description:
He looks so relaxed there in that chair - is it really necessary to kill the
poor chap?

long: An old man sits humbly in an old wooden chair staring up at you.
description:
He almost looks as if he might have something to say, but he just sits
there, mouth half open and quiet.

long: A poor, quiet housewife looks up in fear as you enter into her home.
description: She says nothing, only stares at you with fear-filled eyes.

long: A man sits at his small table, eating the last part of a meal.
description:
He nods at you as you enter into his home, a slightly confused expression on
his face.

long: The school marm sits at her desk, scribbling some notes.
description:
She barely glances at you as you enter, giving you a 'May I help you?  '
sort of look.

long: The barkeep gives you a warm smile and bids you welcome.
description:
He waves his arm expansively at one of his many tables, bidding that you sit
down, relax a while and enjoy a fine meal.

long: A man speaks in a loud voice, telling tales of heroism and bravery.
description:
The stories are not of his own adventures, but of those made by the
characters of his stories.  Whether these people he tells of ever lived is a
tale in itself, but it matters little - the stories are all good.

long: A man lounges back in a chair, listening good-naturedly to the storyteller.
description:
His eyes look only a little bleary - undoubtedly he has had some of the
Hall's finest after a long day's work.

long: A well-dressed gentleman sits at the bar, sipping a tankard of ale.
description:
He appears to be keeping to himself, having no desire to interact with
anyone.  He is obviously not a local.

long: A woman leans over her small table, smiling up at the storyteller.
description:
She never takes her eyes from him, intent on his story and intent on showing
as much of her bosom as she might be able to.

long: Calintra the herbalist grinds some herbs in a bowl, smiling as you enter.
description:
Calintra is a young woman for the standards of most of the business owners
in the town, and beautiful as well.  Her long, dark hair falls in her face as
grinds the herbs, causing her to brush it back with her fingers every so often.

long: A kind, plump woman beams a broad smile your way as you enter the restaurant.
description:
She wipes her hands on an apron, happily clucking over you as she leads you
toward an empty table.

long: A short, stocky man grinds at a piece of steel.
description:
Save for his shortness of stature, this man is exactly what you might
envision a blacksmith to look like.  Strong, gruff, a bit dirty - this man is
it.

long: The master apothecary is here, resting in a comfortable chair.
description:
It looks as if he must have already done the brunt of his work for the day
and is now taking the time to rest and relax a bit.

long: Mochaaska stands amid his many fine barrels of water, smiling you way.
description:
Mochaaska is obviously not originally from these parts.  His skin is of a
darker complexion, his teeth very large and white.

long: The owner of the store wipes down her main counter, keeping things clean.
description:
She glances up at you as you enter, giving you a nod and leaving you to
browse for yourself.

long: The town minister waddles past, sweat pouring from his every gland.
description:
Although everyone is well aware of the minister's ill health, no one can
convince him to abstain from his daily rounds.  Every day, he walks about the
settlement giving ministry to those who might need it, talking to those who
might wish to sit and talk a while.  And every day, he looks just a little
worse for the wear.

long: A townsman makes his way through the settlement.
description:
He looks as if he couldn't be much happier - bright and cheery, full of
vigor.

long: A young lass skips past, her pigtails bouncing.
description:
Her freckled face squinches up at you in a smile.  She winks and skips right
on past.

long: The tailor awaits to serve you.
description: He says nothing to you, only nods a great deal and smiles.

long: A guardsman stands at ease near the barrier, casually watching your arrival.
description:
The guardsman looks at you with a mixture of curiosity and mild animosity.
Seeing that you wear no colors for any of the Barons, he is not sure what to
make of you.

long: A tradesman laden down with barrels of Westlawn's finest trudges past.
description:
The man must have traveled some distance to get the brew that only Westlawn
can make so well.  He carries the barrels, one on each shoulder, a bead of
sweat running down the bridge of his nose.

long: A man with a crude wheel barrow works on the road.
description:
The road being so rutted and in poor shape, it requires constant attention
from the workers of the area.  The serf carts dirt from dry areas onto the
road, trying to dry up the areas of the road that are muddiest.

long: A little boy covered in mud and filth plays with a pile of mud.
description:
He smiles up at you with a beguiling twinkle in his eye.  How could he know
that his life is less than perfect with such a fine pile of mud right outside
his front door?

long: A little girl stands forlornly at the door to her family's hut.
description:
The poor dear does not wish to step off the doorstep because she knows she
will instantly be a mess from the muddy yard, but she does not wish to stay
indoors all day.

long: A man makes his way home after a long day's work.
description:
He is filthy, covered in dirt and grime that seems almost a pigment to his
skin rather than a covering of extra mess.

long: An old woman with a wrinkled and careworn face stands outside her hovel.
description:
Her eyes perpetually squint from the sun, her face pinched and leathery as
she watches the children at play.

long: A young child plays outside his home under the watchful eyes of his mother.
description:
He is a dirty, filthy child - a child of the dregs, who's lot it is in life
to do nothing but labor for others.

long: An old man stands behind the bar slowly and deliberately serving drinks and food.
description:
Gilsby was in the service of the old Baron, Westlawn's father for many years
before Westlawn took on the mantle of Baron.  Gilsby has seen them come and
seen them go and holds within his old head many secrets to the keep and the
surrounding area.

long: A tired-looking man leans on a table, tiredly sipping at his ale.
description:
He sits at a chair at a table, both elbows propped up on the table, slumped
over with all his weight on those elbows.

long: A man leans against the far side of the bar, his eyes trained upon you.
description:
It is his eyes, those secretive eyes, that give you pause when you look his
way.  He is certainly not one of the serfs of the area, and does not wear the
red of Baron Westlawn.

long: A woman sits upon a barrel working the leather of a harness.
description:
Her wrinkled hands move with strength and fluidity which belies the image
she presents upon first look.

long: A little boy plays on the stacks of hay, laughing in delight.
description:
He climbs high up into the heights of the hay stacks, looking down every
once in a while to assure himself that he is truly ascending.

long: A little girl coquettishly tries to act as if she isn't chasing the boy.
description:
She nonchalantly climbs the stacks after the boy, trying to make it appear
that all of this hay climbing is foolish and beneath her, but she never takes
her eyes of the boy and there is a slight smile at the corners of her mouth.

long: An old cow with sagging udders lazily wanders the field.
description: Its tail swishes back and forth, lazily swatting the flies that buzz about.

long: An old nag slowly makes its way around the area, looking for fresh grass.
description: Her back is bowed in the center, her coat patched and in poor condition.

long: One of the locals sits on the bridge's edge with a fishing pole.
description:
He idly dangles his legs over the side, swinging them lazily as the day
passes.  It doesn't appear that he really cares whether or not he catches
anything, he is just enjoying the quiet.

long: A woman hoists a large wicker basket on one shoulder, carrying it through the yard.
description:
She walks slightly bent over to one side, the contents of the basket
obviously heavy and awkward.

long: A man pushes a wooden keg through the keep, taking it to another room.
description:
This man is one of Westlawn's many servants whose main job it is to make
sure that the dining and kitchen area is always well-stocked with ale.

long: A soldier stands at post, scanning the horizon for any signs of invasion.
description:
His keen eyes do not for one moment waver from their incessant scanning of
the lands around the keep.  If this man fails in his job, many people could
die.

long: A soldier tromps about the keep, stepping in clean rhythm even though he is alone.
description:
All of Westlawn's men have been trained so well that they continue to march
in formation even when there is no formation.

long: A soldier wearing the sigil of an Elite strides past.
description:
Westlawn's Elite are feared throughout the realm by all Barons and common
folk alike.  They have been trained in the arts of battle to such a degree as
to be masters, respected as the best in nearly every fight.

long: People stand aside as Jerrod, the captain of the Elite, makes his way through.
description:
Jerrod smiles and nods as he passes by, his face set in an expression of
open kindness.  The people who he smiles at, however, smile nervously back,
hoping not to offend in any way.  Jerrod is never petty or unkind to the common
folk of the keep or the surrounding land, but the stories of his tirades on his
men are legendary - thus the reason for the wide berth that people give when he
passes.

long: A raggedy commoner walks past.
description:
He is nondescript in nearly every way possible.  His clothes are those of a
common man's - brown jerkin with a pair of sandals.

long: The foreman of the farm crew stands scribbling in a clipboard.
description:
He is probably the only man in the immediate area who is not covered in mud
and filth from head to toe.

long: Donld the smithy pounds away at his anvil.
description:
He is tall and lean, well muscled but not huge like many stereotypical smiths
of the area.  He looks up at you without stopping his pounding, winks with a sly
smile, and goes back to concentrating on his anvil.

long: The Baron Westlawn is here, talking with Donld.
description:
He is not a particularly large or imposing man, he is simply a man.  He is
better than average looking, about six foot even in height and carries himself
with a strong dignity.

long: A serving wench moves about the keep, performing her duties.
description:
She is dressed in a very fetching homespun dress that amplifies her bosoms
to the full extent.  Her hair is done up high in a nest of sorts, stray wisps
falling about her face.

long: A cook hustles about the kitchen, staying clear of Salida's spoon.
description:
He is dressed in a white kitchen-workers outfit, stained and nastified by
the many juices and fluids of the food he prepares.

long: A cook works feverishly at scrubbing the pots and pans for the next meal.
description:
She is up to her elbows in dirty dish water, her face covered in a sheen of
sweat and grime.  But she is smiling.  Who can understand women?

long: Salida booms orders in her huge voice, her large wooden spoon held at ready.
description:
Anyone who has frequented the kitchen at all knows to stay clear of this big
woman's spoon and the lashings it will endow.  Just the same, she runs a great
kitchen with great food.

long: A stray pig runs about the yard, snorting and oinking.
description:
From the looks of it, this nasty creature couldn't be happier as it rolls
and twists about in the mud.

long: An old man, one of the original serfs of the area, lounges on the floor.
description:
He looks up at you pitifully with pain-filled eyes, silently beseeching that
you let him alone.

long: One of Westlawn's servants tends to the horses.
description:
He is a younger lad - possibly fourteen or fifteen years of age - who wishes
to make a go at becoming one of the Elite.  All of the younger generation here
at Warrior's Keep have that same desire - to one day be a proud warrior who
fights at the Baron's side.

long: Roscoe, the chief stablemaster and horsebreaker, leans on the fence.
description:
He chews a piece of straw slowly, deliberately, as he watches one of the
newest of the steeds trot about the field.

long: A soldier lounges on a cot, taking a break before he goes on watch.
description:
He stares up at the ceiling, not really paying any attention to anything at
all.

long: A mischievous child darts through the kitchen, stealing any scraps she can find.
description:
She somehow stays just of reach from Salida's spoon, winking slyly and
dodging around piles of pots and pans.

long: A noble whispers quietly to the others gathered around him.
description:
He has a look of confidentiality about him - as if what he whispers is of
great import and groundbreaking news.

long: A young noble listens as the secretive one whispers.
description:
The young man looks quite open and trusting - perhaps too trusting.  He
listens raptly, nodding every now and again to what is being said.

long: A haughty noble listens to it all with an air of disdain.
description:
He frequently rolls his eyes, looking for all the world as if he couldn't
disagree more or be more bored - but he doesn't leave.

long: A noblewoman stands boldly with the men, taking her chances at being laughed out.
description:
She holds her head defiantly, listening only slightly to what the noble
whispers, worried more about her status being called down.

long: A visiting merchant walks through the yard, enjoying some time to himself.
description:
He carries most of what he owns in a bag slung over one shoulder - the rest
must be stashed away somewhere in one of the guest rooms.

long: Bud, the alemaster of the keep, brews his finest.
description:
Some people carry pride in themselves at being very fast, some are proud of
their ability to fight, others love the adventure of learning new spells.  Bud
is proud of one thing only - the man loves his beer.  Crisp and clean, always
cold-filtered, never heat pasteurized.

keywords: mara willow cup steward hostess keeper
long: @gMa@Gra@n moves between the @GWi@gll@Gow @gCu@Gp@n's kettles and tables with practiced ease.
description:
Mara is a capable middle-aged woman in a green wool dress and clean linen apron, with a
ring of cupboard keys at her belt. She runs the park pavilion with calm authority,
remembers regular customers by name, and has the unnerving ability to notice an empty
cup from across the room.

keywords: brother oren sexton chapel gravedigger groundskeeper
long: @WBr@Yot@Whe@Yr @WOre@Yn@n rests his spade nearby while tending to the grounds.
description:
Oren is a lean, weathered man in a plain gray coat marked with the silver lantern of the
chapel. Soil stains his boots and hands, but his tools are meticulously maintained. He
speaks softly around mourners and treats every grave, rich or poor, with the same
patient care.

keywords: captain dain southwatch commander chief guard
long: @BCa@Cpt@Wai@Bn @CDa@Win@n reviews the watch roster with a stern, attentive eye.
description:
Dain wears a reinforced blue-and-silver surcoat over practical mail, its edges polished
smooth by years of service. A scar crosses one brow, and the keys at his belt are
secured by a short chain. He has the composed manner of a commander who expects
discipline without needing to shout.

long: A @bSo@Cut@Wh@bwa@Ctc@Wh@n guardsman stands ready for the next patrol.
description:
This Southwatch guard wears a blue tabard over serviceable mail, with the crowned bridge of
Midgaard stitched at the shoulder. A baton, short blade, whistle, and small lantern
complete the patrol kit. The guard watches doors and strangers with professional caution
rather than open hostility.

long: @YCl@Wer@Yk @WMe@Ori@Yel@n sorts petitions and sealed civic records behind an oak desk.
description:
Meriel is a precise woman in dark civic robes with ink-stained fingers and a brass badge
of office. She moves through ledgers with formidable speed, tying finished petitions
with colored cord before passing them onward to the mayor's chamber.

keywords: edric vale lord mayor mayor magistrate
long: @YLo@Wrd @OMa@Yyo@Wr @YEd@Wri@Oc @YVa@Wle@n studies a map of Midgaard spread across the council table.
description:
Edric Vale is an older man with silver at his temples and the steady posture of a former
soldier. His formal coat bears only a small crowned-bridge clasp rather than jeweled
decoration. He listens more than he speaks, marking notes in the margins of petitions
before issuing short, practical decisions.

long: The @YMi@Wd@Yga@War@Yd @Oto@Ywn @Wcr@Yie@Or@n calls the latest notices in a carrying voice.
description:
A bright tabard, brass handbell, and leather folio identify this young herald of the
city. Between announcements, the crier checks wax-sealed notices against a handwritten
schedule and watches for a clear moment to make the next proclamation.

long: A @Wsi@Dlv@Wer-@Dne@Wck@Ded @Wsw@Dan@n glides across the water with regal calm.
description:
White feathers lie smooth over a long graceful body, broken only by a narrow band of
gray around the swan's neck. It watches nearby visitors with the imperious confidence of
a creature that has been fed by generations of park-goers.

long: A downy duckling paddles furiously after the older waterfowl.
description:
This tiny ball of yellow-brown down moves with far more determination than coordination.
It peeps at every passing shadow and quickly returns to the safety of the reeds whenever
something seems too large or too sudden.

long: A russet sparrow hops along the path in search of crumbs.
description:
Warm brown feathers and a pale breast mark this ordinary city sparrow. It has learned
exactly how close it can approach people before darting away, and it seems convinced
that every bench conceals something edible.

long: A mottled park duck waddles along with complete confidence.
description:
Brown, cream, and green feathers form a practical mottled coat over this well-fed duck.
It regards strangers mostly as possible sources of bread and has little respect for
personal space when food is involved.

long: A forest brownie scampers about here.
description:
The forest brownie winks at you and scurries away.  Quite an amicable
fellow.

long: a wolf trots by, looking for a rabbit
description:
The wolf looks rather hungry.  You see him trying to decide if YOU taste
like rabbit.

long: A brown rabbit hops along merrily.
description:
The rabbit looks up at you with big brown eyes, then scoots away..  Hey..
There goes lunch!

long: A woodsman watches you, a stalk of grass hanging from his mouth
description:
The woodsman chuckles and says, 'Howdy stranger- the name is Tomal..  Howya
doing?  '

long: A shadowy form steps out of the mist.
description:
You see a nightmarish array of teeth and claws, the guardian demon is
determined to rip your guts out.

long: The Graye guardsman is posted here.
description:
The guardsman smiles at you kindly.  He says, 'better stick with me guy--
its a dangerous world out there.  '

long: A tiny demon snarls at you.
description:
It seems like a relatively harmless little demon, but those sharp teeth
might hurt if they were wrapped around your arm.

long: A minor demon jumps out of the shadows at you!
description:
The demon resembles little, but a sinewy mass of flesh, tendons, and teeth.
It glares at you with pure fury in it's eyes.

long: A citizen of Graye rushes by here, looking over his shoulder.
description:
The citizen looks rather nervous- You would too if your town was besieged by
demons.

long: A citizen of Graye rushes by here, looking over her shoulder.
description:
The citizen looks rather nervous- You would too if your town was besieged by
demons.

long: A major demon lurks about here.
description:
You look deep into the eyes of the beast.  You sense no absolutely no
intellect, only raw power and rage.

long: A shadow wraith drifts into your way.
description: All you see is a fog-like apparition, with two glowing red eyes...

long: A jail guard patrols here, whipping the prisoners.
description:
The guard seems to be, well, mostly human.  He is covered in boils and tufts
of hair.  He glares at you with his one good eye and says, 'Put down that
weapon, prisoner!  '

long: The King's Advisor is here, weeping.
description:
He looks at you and begs, 'please!  They have taken him!  I can see that you
are a great adventurer..  Please bring him back to us!  ' The advisor turns
from you and continues to sob uncontrollably.

long: The Arch-Demon Irgon emerges from the shadows.
description:
Irgon frowns down upon you.  His oily black skin reflects the torchlight.
A thick white claw points at you, and he utters, 'prepare to die.  '

long: Scrytin, the demon lord's apprentice, smiles at you.
description:
Scrytin looks at you kindly, and suddenly you feel very peaceful and
relaxed.  You stare directly into his eyes, and feel yourself slipping deeper
and deeper...  NOOO!!  Scrytin growls, 'Won't become a minion of mine eh?..
Then you shall DIE!  '

long: The good king Relnar is here.
description:
You look into the eyes of the descendant of Graye, and know now why his city
is so prosperous and happy.

long: All three sets of a chimerae's eyes glare straight at you.
description:
It stands still as a statue, its stance rigid and unmoving.  It has the
hindquarters of a goat, the forequarters of a strong lion and the wings of a
black dragon.  It is enormously and evilly impressive.

long: A gorgimera turns two of its heads your way as you enter the cave.
description:
It is a grotesque abomination to nature, a freak of creation that has
managed to stay alive due to its brute strength and ferocity.

long: The undead remains of a huge dragon rises as you approach.
description:
Two tiny pinpoints of light glare from its eyelets, its skeletal frame
moving jerkily as it moves to block your progress into the cave.

long: A black dragon moves about in the darkness of the room.
description:
It is hard to make out any details of the creature save for the fact that it
is an enormous thing, its bulk seeming endless.

long: A blue dragon turns its malevolent eyes upon you.
description:
Its eyes narrow to mere slits as it takes in the fact that someone of your
stature was not only stupid enough to enter into its lair, but also somehow
wily enough to get past the guardian.

long: A red dragon tosses back its head and jets a plume of fire into the air.
description: The dragon appears less than pleased that you have intruded upon its domain.

long: A white dragon turns it icy gaze your way, eyes narrowing.
description:
The gleaming scales of the dragon glow with a bright, cold beauty which
detracts from its powerful evil.  Do not be distracted by the beauty and wealth
of this creature.  It will kill you.

long: A green dragon mucks about in its own excrement, not even aware of you.
description:
The dragon appears perfectly content to rot and wither, laying in a pile of
its own refuse.  It is old and no longer has the desire to fight and rampage.
It must soon find a successor.

long: A topaz dragon storms in a rage at you, screeching its anger.
description: So much for a little PR work, here.

long: A crystal dragon appears pleased that you have come to call.
description:
Come to call?!  This is the den of a dragon!  And yet this beast seems
extremely pleased that you are here, indeed looks ready to engage in
conversation.

long: An emerald dragon instantly assumes a defensive posture as you enter.
description: It does not attack, however it looks more than ready for a fight.

long: A strange, small lizard with wings and a big grin flies at you.
description:
With its full of mischief, it opens its mouth to reveal a set of long,
spiked teeth and a forked tongue.

long: What looks to be a young red dragon flies straight for you, jetting flame.
description:
It is much too small to be a dragon of any sort, however its speed and fire
breath seems more than sufficient to give it some credibility as a dangerous
foe.

long: A gryphon stands proudly before the entrance into the cave.
description: It blocks entry with a firm look and a level stare.

long: A long, leathery brown serpent flies at you with its teeth bared.
description: It speeds directly for you, intent on a strong, aggressive attack.  Run?

long: Alain Longstride strides about the area, protecting the innocent lepers.
description:
Alain is probably the only man on the island who is not a leper himself.
His mother was sent here when he was a baby.  When he became old enough, he
journied for many months to get to this place.  Upon arrival, he found that she
had already submitted to the Eternal Flame.  Heartbroken, he wept for days.
When he finially came to his senses, he vowed that no leper would ever again be
prosecuted, and so he set about protecting them and their awful home as best he
could.

long: A man in flowing robes sits upon the crest of the volcano, eyes closed in a trance.
description:
He sits cross-legged with his arms resting palms up in his lap.  Looking
down at his hands, you see that two of his fingers are missing.  This man is a
leper!

long: A wild old hermit begins screaming "GET OUT OF MY TREE!!!" as soon as you enter.
description:
This poor man is obviously in the grips of some sort of dillusionary side
affect from his leprosy.

long: A lioness looks up at you with a slow, purring growl and licks her lips.
description:
She is really quite a fine specimen, for a lioness.  The fact that she
appears to be sizing you up in proportion to a dinner plate does not give much
time for admiration, though.

long: A man riddled with pussing pustules walks vacant-eyed about the area.
description:
He looks neither right nor left as he makes his way to where ever it is that
he is going.  In fact - it doesn't even appear that he looks straight ahead, so
mechanical is his gait.

long: A woman stares off into space, no longer caring about much of anything.
description:
Her once-beautiful face is now almost unrecognizable as human.  She is
swathed from head to toe in wet bandages which soak up most of the festering
wounds all over her body.

long: A terribly diseased man stands at the fence to the pen, gripping the rail.
description:
He does not move nor speak.  He stares into open air, his mouth half open
with the occasional spittle dripping down his chin.

long: An awfully disfigured woman walks through the camp, head down.
description:
She does not look up, even when she stumbles over something.  She simply
wanders this small area in hopelessness.

long: Tomm Walker strides about the community, encouraging faith in the Gods.
description:
Tomm truly believes that through supplication to the Gods, some lepers may
find absolution and be heals through divine power.

long: A dying leper lies amid stained sheets and cloths, gasping his last breathes.
description:
His face is beyond description, the disease having such a hold on him that
it is a wonder why he has not been thrown to the Sternal Flame as of yet.

long: A boa constrictor lazily unwinds from a tree branch, eyeing you thoughtfully.
description:
It is roughly eight feet in length and it does not look all that fat right
now.  It might be a good idea to sort of back up - real slow-like.

long: A wild boar snorts a couple of times and then lowers its tusks.
description:
The snorting, the lowering of the tusks.  It seems to spark a small rule of
thumb for wild boars...

long: Argus walks about the area, tidying up here and there.
description:
For a leper, keeping things clean and organized is a way of prolonging life.
Most of their extremities are numbed or missing, making it easy to receive a
wound without noticing it.

long: Jantry hums an old ballad as she rakes the garden slowly and deliberately.
description:
Jantry is the resident in charge of keeping the garden plentiful and free of
disease - a very important job which she herself takes quite seriously.  This
garden is the area's main source and backup for foodstuffs when the Lord of
Jareth runs into snags or delays in sending shipments.

long: A horribly scarred man kneels at the altar, praying feverishly.
description:
His eyes are closed tightly, his hands clasped together in the traditional
position of prayer and supplication.

long: A crazed, half-naked man leaps from behind a tree, assaulting you with a cry.
description:
He wears only a short loin cloth, which would be terrible enough all by
itself, but the fact that he is a leper with pussy pustules all over his body
is enough to make even the most stalwart of men retch in agony.

long: A pathetic excise for a chicken clucks about half-heartedly.
description:
It is dirty and mangy as a chicken can be, its feathers covered in muck and
filth.

long: Dalgon walks about the village trying his best to remain productive for the community.
description:
He has the age lines of a man of advanced years, the permanent frown that
only age can bring.  He is twenty-two.

long: A tall gangly man ambles through the area.
description:
Alvah is the village idiot, so to speak.  He is liked by everyone but
respected by none.

long: A goblin raider runs crouched-over through the fields, looking for people to kill.
description:
It runs with its arms almost dragging on the ground through the fields, its
nose twitching as it sniffs for prey.

long: A goblin walks through the smoke and ash carrying a torch.
description: He looks right and then left - he must be searching for something to burn.

long: A goblin sits cross-legged on the ground gnawing on a human leg.
description:
Blood and muscle tissue drip down its face, its pointed noise dripping with
goo and gore.

long: A goblin commander grunts and screams his troops into organization.
description:
His green warted skin stretches tight over his squinted eyes, he sniffs the
wind every now and again for signs of human flesh.

long: A goblin scout walks cautiously past, sniffing and searching.
description:
A goblin scout here could mean only one thing - there are more in the area.
Best to keep a close eye out.

long: A goblin searches through the wreckage of the fields for scraps.
description:
It rummages through the blackened dirt, looking for any valuables that might
have been overlooked by the troops when they came through.

long: A goblin hordesman tromps confidently along, looking for a fight.
description:
Its weapon is constantly held at ready while it scans the smoke and ruin for
any signs of life.

short: the Commander of the Lord's Retinue
long: The Commander of the Lord's Retinue leads a weary gaggle of men through the desolation.
description:
His face is covered in black dirt and ash, his once-fine armor dented and
dirty.  By the look in his black-rimmed eyes, he is a man at the end of his
rope.

short: a member of the Lord's Retinue
long: A member of the Lord's Retinue strides wearily past.
description:
He appears to have lost much of his hope in eliminating the threat of the
goblins in this region.  The the constant raids and the lack of sleep has made
him less than the highly-trained soldier that he was when he arrived here some
months back.

long: A soldier is curled into a ball, knees clutched, sobbing into the black dirt.
description:
He does not acknowledge your presence nor does he stop his sobbing.  He
seems to have lost his mind, reduced to a whimpering infant.

long: Jon Boggins strides through his fields, a heavy pitchfork held at ready.
description:
Jon has lost not only his son the Horde, but has lost his wife and daughter
as well.  He is a man with no ties and no love of life - that is what makes him
so dangerous.

long: A desperate farmer crouches in this barricade, eyes wide with fear.
description:
The poor man has lost his livelihood, but he will BE DAMNED if he will lose
his land as well to the very creatures who destroyed it.  He will die before he
gives this small stand up to the enemy.

long: An angry farmwife squats beside her husband, lending him her strength and support.
description:
Against her husband's numerous requests, she has stayed here in their last
ditch stand to make an effort at saving their home.

long: X'Raantra kneels with his knees deep in the blood-filled floor, his arms held high.
description:
His eyes are tightly clenched closed, his right fist holding fast to a
curved dagger held high to his God.  He sporadically mumbles words, garbled
phrases or prayers which may or may not have meaning.

long: A Believer kneels proudly beside his saviour.
description:
His eyes are a bit glazed over, blood spattered over the front of his grubby
jerkin.  He never seems to lose sight of the blade which is raised high by
X'Raantra in anticipation of the next kill.

long: A man is slouched against the wall, badly bleeding and broken.
description:
He almost does not notice you from the pain that he is in, but then he
obviously must have as he is trying to speak to you.

long: An elf is curled up at the fountain's base, retching and vomiting terribly.
description:
He looks up at you with terror-stricken eyes and pleads without words for
you to help him, somehow help him.

long: A woman walks with a very deliberate gait across the courtyard.
description:
She holds her tattered clothing tight against her as if she were cold or
afraid of prying eyes.  It is certainly a gesture of fear or discomfort.

long: A man lies on the floor, stretched out on a raggedy blanket.
description:
He has a wealth of nasty stubble and the smell - it might be better not to
talk about the smell.

long: A terrified child lies huddled in a corner, squinting against your light.
description:
The child is wearing no clothes whatsoever and is covered in welts and
bruises.  He couldn't be much more than ten or eleven years old.

long: A man sits curled up in ball, weeping uncontrollably.
description:
He alternates between rage and sadness - touching the mangled remains of his
son's body, stroking the blood matted hair back from the cold, lifeless ears.

long: A rat scurries past, its feet clicking on the stone floor.
description: It looks very much like your every day typical disgusting rat.

long: Gunter wanders the compound, spreading the word of the Chosen.
description:
Gunter is a small, pale man who looks as if he may be a bit ill.  His main
task which has raised him in the ranks of X'Raantra's Chosen, is to go out and
Select the next of the Chosen.  It is quite an honor.

long: A man stands near the doorway, a hideous sneer on his face.
description:
A horrid scar runs down the left side of his face, he looks you up and down
and uncrosses his arms, readying his whip.

long: A grubby man stands before the fire barrel, warming his hands.
description:
He looks pitifully poverty-stricken, enough so that it is obvious at first
glance.  He is covered in dirt and grime and has a few pussing welts on his
face and hands.

long: A man in a hooded cloak walks slowly by mumbling to himself.
description:
The mumblings are not coherent, they are words spoken in garbled phrases,
words that mean nothing.  They are the words of one who is delusioned beyond
regainment of full mental faculties.

long: One of X'Raantra's Believers hides in the shadows.
description: The Believer notes your look with a look of her own, giving you a curt nod.

long: A bat dive bombs you, coming inches from your head!
description:
It is hard to get a good look at the little fella, but that really doesn't
matter, just aim for the blackish-brown blur.

long: A small, hairy spider moves across the ground before you.
description:
It is not an aggressive type of spider, nor is it large by any means - but
it is a spider, nonetheless, and is disgusting and wrong.

long: A DeathKnight wanders about, staggering in a daze.
description:
He holds his weapon as if he had never used it before, a slight line of
drool running from the left corner of his mouth.  His eyes hold a faraway,
dazed look in them.

long: A man in warrior's traveling garb lies upon the floor, looking very surprised to see you.
description: Looks like he was catching a nap where he thought he might be safe.

long: A humanoid is hunched over the corpse, hands and face dripping with blood.
description:
This awful scavenger looks up at you with a snarl and spits some blood on
you.  It goes back to its feast without another glance.

long: A Believer stands menacingly over the boy, a look of glee on his face.
description:
The Believer looks as if this sort of sport were his passion, his only
reason for living.  Indeed, it may be from the look of the boy's back.

long: A screeching boy is thrown face down over a desk, his shirt torn off, blood everywhere.
description:
It appears that this man has been at this boy for some time.  The slashes
across the boy's back are many and deep.

long: Kire, the patrol captain, is walking here.
description:
At first glance, this man would not seem to even hurt a fly.  As you look
closer, you notice a long scar running down the left side of his face.  You
think that perhaps looks can be deceiving and that you might not want to mess
with him.

long: A commoner is here searching for goods.
description:
She is rather plain, wearing her hair up in a bun, and she's dressed,
well...  Plain.

long: A street rat is here, begging for food.
description:
The boy is caked in dirt, and smells of dead fish.  You may want to give him
a few coins just to go away.

long: A peddler tries to do business with you.
description:
The man is uninteresting, except for his dirty turban, which seems unusually
large.

long: A guardsman patrols the streets and shops of McGintey Cove.
description: He looks to be a kind, jovial man.  But I wouldn't test it.

long: A toll booth worker is here, taking your fare for crossing into the city.
description: She notices you looking and smiles at you.

long: Jon the barkeep is here serving dinner and drinks.
description:
This man looks as if there could be no other place he'd rather be then here
at this inn, serving drinks and making everyone's food.

long: The receptionist waits patiently for you to decide on a room.
description: Such a bright and cheery lady, she beams a happy smile at you.

long: Cindii the Info Lady sits behind the desk, smiling happily.
description:
She looks so pathetically blonde, you are almost afraid to ask for any
assistance.

long: Samuel himself is here, pouring the drinks and getting rich.
description: Samuel looks like he may have poured a few extra tonight.

long: A postal worker is here, ready to send or get your mail.
description: Be careful.  No sudden moves.  You know how these guys get....

long: Juan the potion pusher is here, trying sell you some potions.
description: He's got that money-hungry glint in his eyes.  Watch your wallet.

long: Alandra the jewelry maker is here, working on some pieces.
description: She almost didn't notice you come in, so focused on her craft was she.

long: The armorer waits patiently to help you.
description:
He looks quite competent, quite relaxed.  He must make a good living in
spite of his reputation.

long: Shellee waits here, hoping to find good homes for her little friends.
description:
Shellee is quite an attractive woman, however you notice that she lacks a
bit upstairs.  Yes, she is blonde.

long: Jak the weaponsmith is here, currently taking a break.
description:
Man, this guy is ALWAYS taking a break.  Must be because he sells no
weaponry.

long: A clerk is here, waiting to take your money.
description: Poor guy looks a little bored - must be the only job available in town.

long: Pauletra the pottery woman stands next to her cart, selling her goods.
description:
She looks like she's come a long way to sell her goods in this famous market
place.

long: Herb stands here.  Know what he's selling?
description: Kind of makes you wonder if Herb was always his name, doesn't it?

long: Bones stands here, selling his exotic jewelry.
description: Bones has all kinds of strange bone-made jewelry hanging from his body.

long: Farah has a nice little booth set up to display her wares.
description: Although tired, she looks very happy.

long: A farmer stands next to cart selling fresh vegetables.
description: Just a normal, average, every day country bumpkin.

long: A man is here selling candles.
description: Numerous little burn scars mark his hands.  Dangerous job, this man has.

long: A fisherman sells good quality fish fresh from the sea.
description:
This guy...  There's something fishy about him...  Get it?  Fishy?  You
know, he's a fisherman, and...  Forget it.

long: A glass blower is here, her items carefully stacked on portable wooden shelf.
description:
She looks like a world traveler, one who has seen and been almost
everywhere.

long: A carpenter is here, selling his woodwork.
description: Big, strong with hands as big as sledgehammers.

long: Darva, the cape maker, is here with his many fine threads for sale.
description:
The man wears a very fine looking cape.  You notice that his isn't for sale,
it must be a special one.

long: A robed man with the power to heal stands here, hands folded before him.
description: This cleric looks quite at peace with himself, tranquil even.

long: The Leatherman stands next to his cart, his many leather goods for sale.
description: Clad all in leather, this guy looks like he could be friend or foe.

long: Shantar sits under an umbrella, relaxing as she sells an assortment of rings.
description:
Sipping her cool drink, you cannot help but feel just a bit jealous of her
comfort and ease.

long: Shades the eyewear man displays his assortment of eyepieces and glasses.
description:
Shades wears a pair of the blackest sunglasses you have ever seen.  Kind of
makes him look a bit sinister, you know - cool.  I think that was his intended
effect there.

long: A blacksmith sells assorted daggers here.
description:
This huge man seems very out of place here in the middle of this bazaar,
where he is forced to remain in one spot.

long: A man is here selling various burlap goods.
description: This huge guy seems quite comfortable relaxing and selling his goods.

long: A woman is here selling scarves.
description: She has a whole lot of scarves, a whole lot.  Buy one.

long: A man is here with stacks and stacks of hats, all of them for sale.
description: The is wearing like ten hats on his own head.  What a goof.

long: An elven vendor is here offering an assortment of drinking vessels.
description:
This elf has the look of one who has been down a few rocky roads in his
time.  His mistrust of most everyone is quite apparent.

long: A baker stands proudly next to her fine baked goods.
description:
It is quite obvious that she loves her vocation from the look of enormous
pride on her face.

long: A very large man stands next to his display case.
description:
This man is so large, he almost seems intimidating enough to MAKE you buy
something.

long: A dwarven smith stands here selling helms.
description: This stocky little guy has arms that look like miniature tree trunks.

long: Shalaylia sits peacefully, selling rolling papers to any who are in need.
description:
She sure looks comfortable.  In fact, she looks as if she might even be a
bit sleepy.  Her eyelids droop and she has this sloppy grin on her face.

long: Sazaindin the mage rests comfortably here, ready to brew you a potion.
description:
You have to wonder just what type of potions she is selling, the way she is
huddled into this far corner of the bazaar.

long: The lease manager is here, ready to take your application.
description: She smiles prettily at you and thanks you for stopping by.

long: The jeweler stands behind the counter waiting to help you.
description: Tall, thin, and wiry.

long: A physician is here, ready to tend to your wounds.
description:
A fairly pleasant looking person stands before you wearing a white coat.
They seem eager to get your business, and take care of whatever wounds you may
have.

long: Aelsa, one of Fatima's full timers, is here working on some boots.
description:
She looks quite exhausted, as you see a bead of sweat roll her face.  The
leather apron she's wearing is caked in soot, and doesn't appear to be in a
good mood, so you should better hurry up with whatever you want.

long: Randon stands ready to sell you a scroll or two.
description: He looks like a nice young man.  A man who never cheats his customers.

long: Curley hustles about the room, tending to his customers in a very timely fashion.
description:
From the way this guy runs around this place, you would think it was all he
ever wanted out of life.

long: Tephe, the water guy, sits on a stool behind a counter, twiddling his fingers.
description:
An overweight man looks at you with pleading eyes, begging you to buy
something to liven up his day.

long: A man sits at a desk patiently sewing a pair of leather gauntlets.
description:
He looks up and tells you that if you need anything just ask.  Then he goes
back to his sewing.

long: A merchant stands here trying to persuade you to buy his goods.
description:
You can tell this man knows what he's doing when it comes to sales.  He's
almost gotten you to buy several of his items more than a few times.

long: A local youth walks by, looking for something.
description: They seem eager to find something to spend their money on.

long: A gull flits about, pecking the ground for dropped food.
description:
WHOOA!  The bird just tried to attack you, better give it some food
before...  Ooops...  It just shit on your boots.

long: An albatross rests on a nearby post.
description: A large, white bird rests its wings from a long flight.

long: You see McHale, the patrol lieutenant, out of the corner of your eye.
description:
A silhouette of a man lurks in the distance, you can' tell much about him
except that he is avoiding being seen.

long: Sergeant Tess, the Bazaar overseer, stands ready for any trouble.
description:
She is a hefty guard, but make no mistake that doesn't set her back.  She
peers in your direction, making sure you have no plans of doing any harm.  She
smiles and you can see chunks of her last "victim" in her teeth, you turn away
quickly in disgust.

long: A young deputy is here.
description:
They look vibrant and full of life as if never even seen any action in their
entire lives.

long: A fearless wildcat is waiting here patiently.
description:
Though this cat has a wild look in its eyes, it waits here patiently for
something to happen.

long: A hawk waits faithfully for an order to be given.
description:
This beautiful winged creature is faithful only to it's master.  Don't mess
with it, it may decide to peck your eyes out!

long: A man in a Mage's Guild robe awaits to teleport you to your desired locale.
description:
His manner and bearing are both that of a perfect gentleman and
professional.  It seems the Mage's Guild in this town must have a hard time
making the rent payment, so they rely heavily on the business from this shop to
support most of their payment.

long: Alaantra the Newbie Helper is here, helping newbies go to the Newbie Headquarters.
description:
She smiles charmingly at you and says, 'I can get you to the Newbie
Headquarters in a snap - just type NEWBIE and you will be instantly
transported.  '

long: The city banker waits impatiently behind the counter.
description:
He sneers a welcome at you and asks in a nasal voice if he might be able to
help you.

long: Cynder stands here, guarding the warrior guild entrance.
description: Don't even think about it, she'll kick your head in.

long: A warrior guildmaster is here, waiting to train you.
description: There is nothing special about this master.

long: Nnoa is here, preventing all those who may enter the Ranger training grounds.
description:
A very earthy looking man, dark hair, scruffy beard and very plain clothing.
He is respected by all, and feared by many, many more.  His skill of earthy
elements will make anyone hurt.

long: A Ranger guildmaster is here, waiting to train you.
description: There is nothing special about this master.

long: Deke stands silently, allowing only the holiest to enter.
description:
He stands silently with arms crossed, hands concealed in his robe.  With
hood covering his face, you can not tell his intentions, lest you try and pass
him.

long: A Cleric guildmaster is here, waiting to train you.
description: There is nothing special about this master.

long: Sersin is here, guarding the mage guild.
description:
He fiddles with his cape, organizing many scrolls making sure not to lose
track of a single one.  He lifts an eye for a second, and then retrieves a
scroll from a pouch on his belt.

long: A Mage's guildmaster is here, waiting to train you.
description: There is nothing special about this master.

long: Ryske peeks at you from the shadows.
description: Watch It!  You'll go blind, literally, if you stare that long.

long: An assassin guild master is here, waiting to train you.
description: There is nothing special about this master.

long: Alexa stands with back to the wall, eying you curiously.
description:
Her hair lies loosely on her shoulders, covering half her face.  She brushes
it back and leans casually against the wall thinking nothing of you.  She
crosses her arms a closes her eyes, almost daring you to pass.

long: A Deathknight guildmaster is here waiting to train you.
description: There is nothing special about this master.

long: A Deathknight is here, quietly waiting to sell you something.
description: With no expression whatsoever, this man goes about his business.

long: A lovely female assassin is here, helping others find what they need.
description:
Too bad she could probably drop you with one good blow (get it, blow?  ),
otherwise you could ask her out.

long: A monk from the guild stands here quietly, waiting on you.
description:
This guy looks perfectly happy to just stand and contemplate all the live
long day.

short: a member of the Mage's Guild
long: A member of the Mage's Guild awaits your purchase behind the counter.
description:
You cannot tell if this man be evil or good aligned, nor where his loyalties
may lie.  Who cares, he has good stuff for sale!

long: Gendar the elven thief leans in a corner of the room, a small grin on his face.
description: Gendar looks almost amused by the fact that you were startled so easily.

long: Wirntyn grins as you walk in.  Man, he looks even uglier when he smiles!
description: Ugly, maybe, but just as deadly.  Don't piss him off.

long: Griselda tends bar for all her warrior friends.
description:
This tough little bitch has beaten down more foes than most men can boast
their friends have all added together.  And she's a hottie.

long: A drunken warrior is in the midst of hefting another chair, this time taking careful aim.
description:
You'd think that if you could get past the first chair tossing, they'd leave
you alone, but it looks as if you are in for a bit of fun...  Duck!

long: A drunk warrior grins his toothy grin at you, flexing his huge biceps.
description: You can smell him from here.

long: A bookie stands here, willing to take any bet.
description:
Dressed in the finest armor, this man obviously preys on the stupidity of
the people of the Cove.

long: The Ticket Master, a beautiful and enticing woman, waits to sell you your chance to die.
description:
Just from the way she looks makes you want to get in that Pit and risk your
life.

short: an employee of the warrior guild
long: An employee of the Warrior Guild is here waiting to help you.
description:
More of an apprentice than anything else, this employee is one who pulled
extra duty for misconduct within the guild.

short: a member of the Mage's Guild
long: A member of the Mage's Guild waits patiently for you to buy something.
description:
This man could be good or evil, or whatever - but who gives a shit - he has
kickass eq for sale!

short: a member of the mage's guild
long: A member of the Mage's Guild stands behind the counter.
description: She looks eager enough to sell you the goods.

short: a member of the Mage's Guild
long: A member of the Mage's Guild waits patiently for your purchase.
description:
He seems intent on the workings of one of the scrolls, making sure that it
will perform its proper function.

short: an employee of the warrior guild
long: An employee of the Warrior Guild is here waiting to help you.
description:
More of an apprentice than anything else, this employee is one who pulled
extra duty for misconduct within the guild.

short: an employee of the warrior guild
long: An employee of the Warrior Guild is here waiting to help you.
description:
More of an apprentice than anything else, this employee is one who pulled
extra duty for misconduct within the guild.

short: an employee of the warrior guild
long: An employee of the Warrior Guild is here waiting to help you.
description:
More of an apprentice than anything else, this employee is one who pulled
extra duty for misconduct within the guild.

keywords: yolanda babe honey whore slut dancer
long: Yolanda the Bar-Slut dances on the only remaining intact table.
description:
You can almost smell her putrid breath from here.  As you watch her
pirouette clumsily on the table, you notice a breast fall saggily and limply
out of the loose rag she wears.  Seemingly unembarrassed, Yolanda tucks her tit
back into her rag and continues her 'extremely seductive' dance.

short: a member of the Cleric's Guild
long: A member of the Cleric's Guild waits patiently for you to shop.
description:
He stares into what you would assume is empty space, but for him is the
space that his God occupies.

short: a member of the Cleric's Guild
long: A member of the Cleric's Guild waits patiently for you to shop.
description:
He stares into what you would assume is empty space, but for him is the
space that his God occupies.

short: a member of the Cleric's Guild
long: A member of the Cleric's Guild waits patiently for you to shop.
description:
He stares into what you would assume is empty space, but for him is the
space that his God occupies.

long: A Deathknight sneers as he waits for you to buy something.
description:
He notices you looking and his sneer becomes even more pronounced than
before.  Better just buy your stuff and get out of here.

long: A Paladin Seamstress works diligently on some fabric as you browse the goods.
description:
She looks up at you as she sews and smiles a pretty smile, going back to her
work while keeping an eye out in case you need any assistance.

long: A Paladin smith works here, pounding away at the forge.
description:
He seems to be very happy with his work, the allotment that the Guild has
given him.  It is a rare and fine thing to see such pride from a man who could
be more if he desired.

short: a member of the Paladin Guild
long: A member of the Paladin Guild is here helping the customers.
description:
He beams a smile your way and holds up one finger - be with you in just one
moment!

long: Shindoz stands proudly at the entrance to the Guild, gently keeping non-members out.
description:
Paladin through and through - you can tell this guy is the Master's Pet, a
real ass-kiss and butt-puppy.

long: The Master stands calmly here, ready to train if that is your need.
description:
He smiles and looks you in the eye, as if reading your thoughts and virtue
all in one glance.  It almost makes you uneasy.

long: Alastor looks just a bit unhappy about being a monk, but guards the door just the same.
description: It's a looooooonng story - don't ask.

long: The Monk Guildmaster awaits your need quietly.
description: He speaks no word, makes no move.  He simply waits.

long: The Mayor of McGintey Cove parades by you.
description:
He looks quite decadent, draped in sheer, golden silk and satin teal
sashes.  He turns his head suddenly to catch a glimpse of a young noblewoman
and you see a small teal ornament hanging loosely from his right ear.  The
trinket looks quite valuable.

long: Maree is here serving drinks.
description:
She is one of those women who could be twenty-five or could be forty.  She
has that timeless look about her that lends a quiet, dignified beauty.

long: A town noble stands nearby, disgusted by your mere presence.
description:
He is dressed in the finest clothes money can buy, and as he dusts of his
shirt and tidies his hair he turns his head from you, not acknowledging your
presence there.

long: The proprietor of the Inn is here, making sure everything is perfect.
description:
He hurries here and there and everywhere, always fussing or whining that
something is wrong or out of place.

long: A waiter is here scurrying from table to table.
description:
He keeps glancing up at the proprietor, as if he were a stray dog expecting
to beat at any moment.  Poor fella, he probably gets at least one good tongue
lashing a day.

long: The Mayor's wife stalks silently by.
description:
Yes, her clothes are of the finest make but you can tell she does not
belong.  Her features are long and sad looking, as if she had no desire to be
the mayor's wife.  She moves away quickly, trying to remain unseen.

long: A strikingly beautiful woman stands at the wheel, taking bets.
description: She gives you a very big, very seductive smile and urges you to place a bet.

long: Baagh is here, dealing the next the grueling round of war.
description:
Baagh does not look all that smart.  Seems that this card game is just his
speed.

long: A blank-faced dealer is here, getting ready to take your money.
description: This guy is the poster child for poker faces.

long: A noble's wife is standing here.
description:
She has the same contempt of you as a nobleman has, full of disgust.  She
tries to be as far away from you as she can.

long: Sam the blackjack dealer is here flipping cards to players.
description:
Sam looks almost bored as he turns over one card after another.  You can
barely hear him mumble, 'push, we got a winner, oh too bad, and every now and
then an almost audible blackjack!  '

long: A stealthy burglar is attempting to hide himself in the shadows.
description:
Crouched back in a corner, head low, this man thinks that you are unable to
see him.

long: The Park Ranger is here, tending to the park.
description:
She is dressed all in brown and green, with rake in hand.  She looks like
she knows her way around both forest and city.

long: A little boy plays tag with a little girl, laughing and giggling as he runs.
description:
With lunch stains all over his shirt and grass stains all on his knees, he
looks like he couldn't be any happier than he is now.

long: A little girl laughs as a boy tries in vain to catch her by the ponytails.
description:
With her bright red hair up in ponytails, she kind of looks like Pippy
Longstocking.

long: The matre de looks disdainfully at you.
description: This man may have to get a bit snooty, better watch it.

long: A well dressed waiter is moving gracefully through the room, serving customers.
description:
Resplendent in his black tuxedo and shined shoes, this man would be graceful
falling down.

long: A waitress moves through the room serving drinks.
description:
This woman could only be described as elegant the way she sways and moves
through the clientele dining here.

long: A receptionist sits behind an ornate mahogany desk, taking reservations for the night.
description:
She looks almost bored with her job as she efficiently writes dates, names,
and times in ledger.

long: A woman is planting flowers here, pulling weeds here and there.
description:
She looks in her element here, digging in the dirt, like she couldn't be
happier anywhere else.

long: A man is here serving all the diners quietly, efficiently.
description:
A very somber seeming man, you cannot see a glint of a smile or any kind of
emotion on his face.  His work seems to be his passion.

long: A grave digger is resting under the shade of a tree, shovel on the ground next to him.
description:
He wipes the sweat from his brow, smiles, and asks if you might like to join
him for a bit of a rest...?

long: The hotel manager stands behind a large desk, ready to sell you a room.
description: He smiles and asks how he can help you today.

long: She stands smiling at you, waiting for you to take a room.
description: Hmmmm....  Wonder if she is part of the price, too...

long: A drunken sailor stumbles past you, the fumes all whiskey and vomit.
description:
His white and black striped shirt is speckled with the stains from his last
meal.  The stubble on his face is only overshadowed by the hair which grows out
of the top of the back of his shirt.

long: A gambler is here, shouting at the top of his lungs at the cocks fighting in the street.
description:
You want to tell him the cocks don't understand, but then you realize that
HE would probably not understand.

long: A Dead Boy eyes you evilly.
description:
The unwashed boy seems to be eying you rather fiercely.  You don't know what
you did to offend him but hey, it could be any...  Nothing.

long: A member of Bloody Scythe eyes you evilly.
description:
The unwashed boy seems to be eyeing you rather fiercely.  You don't know
what you did to offend him but hey, it could be any...  Nothing.

long: A giant cockroach looks about ready to eat you.
description: QUICK!!!  Squish it, before it squishes you!!

long: A beggar stands here, pleading for a few coins.
description:
You see an old dirty beggar with no teeth trying to get coins by passer
byes.

long: Marcko, gives you a slight smirk.
description:
Less dirty than the rest of his disciples, he no less ruthless.  He grins at
you, almost pleasantly, until he flashes the knife in his hand, in which his
pleasant smile fades.

long: Ie, sits here reviewing the days collections.
description:
A woman sits before you, ruffling through papers, not bothering to look up
to see or greet you.  She drops one of her papers onto the floor, as she bends
down to pick it up she notices your boot and gets up suddenly, preparing for
your attack.  She taps her boot heel to the ground and a razor juts out the toe
of her boot.  You sense that this isn't going to be pretty.

long: A man is here, hammering on some rounded ship's boards.
description:
Bathed in sweat and looking quite the strong type, you can't help but wonder
what motivates a man who does a job such as this to get up every morning.

long: The shipyard foreman struts through the room, kicking his workers, telling them to work harder.
description:
Complete with his fat cigar, this man is the poster child for alcoholics
anonymous.

long: A hard working sailor struggles along, loaded down with nets and rigging.
description:
Poor fella, almost makes you want to help him with his load, but then,
nahhhh...

long: A very self important woman stands here with a clipboard.
description:
She supervises and regulates the loading and unloading of cargo and
passengers to every ship that docks in this cove.

long: The Dockmaster's assistant proudly follows along beside her.
description:
This little guy looks like he finally found someone bigger than him that
wouldn't kick his ass, so he's hanging on for dear life.

long: A bum lays on a bench, snoring softly.
description:
You might even be doing this guy a favor...  One good bop to the noggin and
he's done.

long: A woman sits behind the glass, selling boat tickets.
description:
She moves at lightning speed, with the assurance of one who has done her job
for a long time.

long: A midshipman passes by you, mumbling something.
description:
The man walks with hands in his pockets and head bowed, continually mumbling
something to himself.  Perhaps he's looking for a bar or a fight, who knows.

long: A pack rat is sifting through trash.
description: It's a large, fat rat, what else would it be.

long: Cap'n Darby is here, fighting.
description:
It seems like every time you see Cap'n Darby, the guy is fighting.  Doesn't
this old sailor EVER take a break?!?

long: The netweaver is here, sewing some netting together.
description:
He has small, horn rimmed glasses, and a large net draped across his body,
which he is currently working on.

long: A street punk is here, getting to throw a set of dice.
description: He looks up and growls.  It must be that no one usually upsets the game.

long: A sailor is lounging near the piano, singing his heart out.
description:
He looks like if he were to let go of the piano, he may not end up on his
feet still.

long: Madame Myra is here, selling herself and any of her girls for the right price.
description:
Large breasted, large assed, and smothered in make-up and perfume, this lady
is one nasty specimen.

long: The man reads his book behind the glass without glancing up.
description: You clear your throat, but he just continues to ignore you.

long: A sea zombie rises from the sea with a blast of water and attacks!
description:
This long dead soul of a sea captain deigned to forsake the chance to Pass
Through to the next life, instead wreaking his vengeance on all those who cross
the place where he himself perished.

long: A giant squid moves through the water at a lightning pace.
description:
