It looks very slimy to the touch and extremely mean.  Watch that it does not
decide to make a meal of you.

long: An enormous dragon turtle glides across the surface of the sea, searching for food.
description:
It does not move very fast, in fact it still has not seemed to notice that
you are here, but it is larger than a killer whale.  And stronger.

long: A pelican glides over the surface of the water, skimming for food.
description:
Its enormous beak dips in and out of the water in constant search for a
morsel to eat.

long: A killer whale skims just under the surface of the water.
description:
The teeth are the visible part of this animal, even when its mouth is closed
- could it just be your imagination?!?

long: A curved fin is visible swimming very near to you.
description:
Is this something that you really feel you'd like to investigate?  If it IS
a shark, it is probably best left alone.

long: The head of a sea elf pokes out of the water nearby.
description:
The elf gives you a smile and a laugh and then dives for the depths of the
sea.

long: A small red crab bobs at the top of the water.
description:
Its two little whiskers bounce wetly above its bulbous eyes.  It almost
seems like it might be looking at you, even smiling...

long: A gooey mass of greenish yuck is floating on the surface.
description: That damn stuff is alive!  Its a jellyfish!

long: The dark colored head of a walrus is all that is visible from here.
description:
It almost looks goofy with its big buck-toothed tusks and the whiskers.  It
sees you and gives a bark.

long: A seal gracefully leaps the waves as it happily plays on the surface.
description: It barks and claps it fins as plays, noisily voicing its delight.

long: A merman gives a gasp as he realizes you've spotted him and dives under.
description:
All that is left of where he was is a small ripple on the surface of the
sea.

long: A mermaid's eyes get very wide and afraid as she spots you.
description:
She immediately ducks under the water, only a small ripple left of where she
was.

long: A water elemental swirls in with a rush of water and wind.
description: It is in constant motion, churning and swirling with force and fury.

long: A sea demon snarls in fury as you enter into its domain.
description:
Sea demons are extremely protective of their area, almost as if they felt
that they owned their section of the seas.  Indeed, many seafarers might not
argue that.

keywords: river rat vermin water rat riverward
long: A @yRi@Yve@yr @Dra@Wt@n noses through debris along the river wall.
description:
This lean brown rat has learned to live where the city meets the water. Its coat is
dark with river spray, and its narrow paws find purchase on slick masonry that would
send a larger creature tumbling into the current.

keywords: mudback crab river crab mud shell
long: A @yMu@Odd@yba@Ock @Dcr@Wab@n picks its way across the river stones.
description:
A broad shell the color of wet clay protects this river crab. One claw is heavier than
the other, scarred from forcing apart mussels and scraps caught along the embankment.
It reacts to nearby movement by raising both claws and refusing to surrender ground.

keywords: silverfin river eel fish eel silver
long: A @Csi@Wlv@Cer@Wfi@Cn @bri@Cve@Wr @bee@Cl@n twists through the dark current.
description:
Silver along the fins flashes whenever this long river eel turns beneath the surface.
Its back is slate-dark and difficult to follow in shadowed water. Small hooked teeth
show when it opens its narrow mouth to test anything drifting close enough.

keywords: river heron bird gray levee fisher
long: A @Wri@Dve@Wr @Che@Wro@Cn@n stands motionless near the levee steps.
description:
This tall gray heron watches the shallows with unnerving patience. Its long legs are
built for wading between submerged stones, and its spear-like beak snaps forward with
startling speed whenever a fish or insect breaks the surface.

keywords: mossback river turtle turtle moss shell
long: A @gmo@Gss@gba@Gck @yri@Ove@Yr @gtu@Grt@gle@n drifts beside the warehouse pilings.
description:
Age and river growth have roughened this turtle's heavy shell until moss clings between
its plates. It moves with deceptive slowness, surfacing beside old pilings to feed on
weed, shellfish, and whatever scraps the warehouse quarter loses to the river.

long: A strong dock worker loads and unloads heavy crates.
description:
He bulges from the tight short sleeves of his shirt, a tattoo peeking out
from beneath.

long: A man who's sole job it is to lug crates lugs a crate past you.
description:
The crate does appear to be at all light in weight, however this guy carries
it along with both arms as if it were nothing more than a trifle.

long: A woman in a tight fitting body suit helps passengers on board their boats.
description:
She gives you a quick look and decides that you are not one of her clients.
She sniffs quietly and turns away.

long: A sailor pushes past you, intent on finding the nearest brothel.
description:
The man still walks with that rolling gait that most sailors affect.  He
will probably continue to do so, unless he finds another profession,.

long: A boatman tips his hat to you as he passes.
description:
He appears to be a resident of these docks, as he is intent on making sure
that his ship in good condition.

long: A passenger waits to board their ship.
description: They tap their feet impatiently, frequently glancing at the sky.

long: A fisherman floats lazily in a small boat, trying to catch some dinner.
description:
He stares glazy-eyed at the water, as if it has transfixed him.  He raises
up his pole, bringing the line and casting out again without blinking or
looking up.  In the same motion, he raises a bottle of whiskey to his lips with
his free hand.  The whiskey is also swagged without blinking.

long: A dolphin playfully splashes you with its tail.
description:
It makes little squeak noises, twisting its body back and forth in its
excitement in seeing you.

long: A seagull squawks past overhead, searching the water for dinner.
description:
Best to watch above from now on, you never know when one of those pests
might have to let a load go.

long: A wealthy ship owner walks past, regarding you with disdain.
description:
He must realize that you are not a part of the elite crowd that owns the
vessels which dock here.

long: A customer service representative stands ready to attend to any passenger's needs.
description:
He opens his mouth as if to say 'Can I help you?  ' and sees that you have
no ticket or luggage.  Assuming you are yet another vagrant from the dock area,
he turns away in disgust.

long: The wall seems to shift slightly, as a rockman makes himself visible to you.
description:
This huge slab of rock shaped into something vaguely humanoid looks massive
and powerful enough to blast anyone or thing to smithereens.

long: The Pale Man regards you intently, as if forming a plan with you in mind.
description:
He is no more than five feet in height, however with his massive guardians
at his side, he needs not stature to seem impressive.  His skin is milky white,
his eyes a dark charcoal black.  He has no hair upon his head.

long: An aboleth lumbers toward you, intent on devouring you in one gulp.
description:
It looks almost like a very large but intelligent fish, about twenty feet in
length, its skin blue-green with splotches of gray.

long: An aboleth baby follows its mother in anticipation of a good supper.
description:
It looks much the same as it its mother, only smaller and with no splotches
of gray.

long: A large bat swoops down at you from the ceiling!
description:
Its eyes are shot through with red, its fangs bared as it moves in for the
attack.

long: A rot grub slunks toward you, sucking debris from the floor.
description:
It is a lump of grayish flesh and blood that has almost no mind - it only
knows to consume.

long: A carrion crawler moves about the caverns, taking scraps where it can.
description:
This thing looks like a giant grub with teeth.  It takes whatever leftovers
there are from scraps left behind in battle.

long: A Death Kiss floats toward you, its tentacles reaching out.
description:
It looks like a beholder kin, but larger and with more tentacles.  Its many
eyes rotate this way and that, a few always upon you.

long: The bugbear chief growls angrily from his place of rest.
description:
This thing does not look as if it desired to be intruded upon.  Possibly a
hasty departure might be in order...

long: The bugbear leader howls a mindless warcry and charges!
description:
Your time is quite limited in that the leader has decided to kill you on
sight.  He looks like many of the other bugbears, just larger and meaner with
larger fangs.

long: The bugbear shaman looks up at you in anger. You interrupted it.
description:
It appears that even bugbears can read - somewhat.  This one was reading
from an old tome.

long: A DeepSpawn sits in the center of the room, its many eyes glaring at you.
description:
This abomination of nature rests casually in this dark, stinking place
creating minions of Hell, sending them out to wreck havoc upon the lands.

long: Gasp! You have stumbled upon a sleeping Feyr.
description:
This mystical creature they say is born from the nightmares of others, the
deepest, darkest fears of many coalescing into one single horror.  This must be
a melding of all the horrors in the minds of those at X'Raantra's.

long: The statue of a gargoyle stands against the far wall.
description:
It appears almost as if it might really BE a gargoyle, almost as if it were
alive.  Did its right fore-claw just move?

long: An extremely large statue of a gargoyle rests on its laurels in the corner.
description:
It is curled into a ball on the floor, its arms around its drawn-up knees.
Its head is in its arms, however it almost appears as if one eye might be
watching you.

long: A small, vocal, hunchbacked man rushes at you with sword drawn.
description:
This screaming, jabbering, howling hunchback seems more an annoyance than a
threat, however you never know.

long: A huge gorgon stamps its feet and snorts, eyeing you with hunger.
description:
It is a huge bull-thing with horns as large as a minotaur's.  In fact, it
almost looks like a minotaur but less humanoid.

long: A disgusting manlike thing ambles toward you, arms outstretched toward you.
description:
It is dressed in nothing more than a few filthy rags, the rest of its body
is covered in long, dirty, black hair.  Any skin which shows through is gray
and scaly.

long: A hook horror spots you and immediately rushes!
description:
It is huge, almost nine feet tall and at least three hundred pounds.  It is
a cross between a vulture and a man and has hooks for claws.

long: A brown mold sucks up all the heat around it, including yours!
description:
It is nothing more than a lump of mold on the floor of the cave, however it
exudes a power which takes in all heat sources in its immediate vicinity.
Whenever directly approached whether by animate or inanimate, its shoots a
tentacle from its center, grabbing the offender of its space and killing it.

long: A mold man sees you and squats down in a fight-ready stance.
description:
He is not large at all - about four foot, nor does he appear to be of any
particular strength.  He does appear to know his way around a spear, though.

long: A bugbear clansman lumbers along.
description:
He is covered in thick fur, his large shaggy eyebrows drooping low over his
eyes lending him both a sad and sinister look at the same time.

long: A Deep Dragon regards you with curiosity.
description:
She probably wouldn't even bother to be curious if it weren't for the fact
that only a fool human would walk straight into a Deep Dragon's den and stand
there.

long: A fat cow stand here chewing her cud.
description:
She may not be the most hygienic animal, but she sure has a good load of fat
meat on her!  And look at them tits!

long: A mean bull stamps it feet and snorts at you.
description:
Papa always said make sure you never get behind an angry bull.  Also said
never get in front of one.  So where does that leave?

long: A proud war horse tosses its head whinnies.
description:
This large animal is trained to hate every human except the one who rides
him.  Beware his kicking hooves!

long: A sturdy work horse grazes the tall grass.
description: It takes almost no notice of you, just continues on with it's lunch.

long: The Forgemaster stands near the fire directing his workers in their labors.
description:
He is quite large with tree-trunk arms.  He is definitely not someone to
trifle with even on one of his bad days.

long: A sweating smithy soldier pumps the coals with a bellows.
description:
The sweat drips from his bare back as makes sure that the fire does not get
low.

long: A smithy pounds away at a piece of metal, shaping it into a usable piece.
description: His muscles bulge and the hammer rings.  This guy could do commercials.

long: A soldier works diligently at tanning hides.
description:
He wipes his sweating brow and gives a smile.  At least he seems to enjoy
his work a bit.

long: A soldier grunts as he lifts a bale of hay up onto the stack.
description:
He is sweating from most every pore in his body - it does not appear that he
is enjoying his labors.

long: A soldier is here branding the cattle and the horses of the Eastern Army.
description:
He stands with a sly grin on his face, as if he might enjoy his work just a
bit too much.

long: A soldier rustles a cow into a prone position so that the brander might place his mark.
description: He looks strong enough to wrestle an ox - indeed he often does.

long: A footman trudges wearily back toward the barracks tents.
description: His job is done for the day and he is quite glad of it!

long: General Tso walks among his troops, a look of disapproval fixed upon his face.
description:
Tso appears the type that would never be satisfied no matter what the length
a soldier might go to to obtain his approval.

long: A patrolman walks his rounds, watching for signs of invasion.
description:
He does not appear all that concerned about invaders as he drearily walks
his rounds.

long: An army scout walks lithely through the camp.
description:
He moves with a sinuous grace that speaks well of his abilities in the
forest.

long: The camp surgeon is here tending to the wounded.
description:
He is a very energetic young man, fully trained by the Eastern Army's best
surgeons.

long: A medic bustles along self-importantly.
description:
He gives you a look and sees that you don't appear hurt.  He then pointedly
ignores you and continues on.

long: A marksman keeps a keen eye out for trouble.
description:
He looks a bit startled at your intrusion, but quickly recovers seeing that
you are not the enemy and goes back to watching out the peepholes.

long: A wounded soldier limps past.
description: He gives you a curt nod and then continues on his way.

long: An off-duty cavalry officer walks past.
description:
He has that odd gait that suggests that more of his time is spent in the
saddle than on his feet.

long: A young soldier is here filling his water pails to carry them up to the mess tent.
description:
He grumbles under his breath as he works, feeling that his position in the
Army's ranks are very unfair.

long: A soldier looks up in shock as you enter into this small and private area with him.
description:
He clutches to the sides of the seat, wondering just what sort of person
would intrude on one in such a place!

long: A man runs past, flipping and somersaulting his body in the air as he runs.
description:
His only break from the constant flips and jumps are when he runs along at a
steady pace.  He looks your way and gives a wink.

long: A juggler walks slowly past juggling five colored balls in rapid succession.
description:
She is so good at her juggling that she is able to nod to passersby who give
gasps of astonishment at her ability in juggling and smiles to excited
children.

long: A street bard wanders past strumming on a lute.
description:
His clear tenor voice mingles in with the flawless precision of his lute,
creating a soulful melody that uplifts spirits and makes the day just a bit
brighter.

long: A wandering minstrel strolls past, her voice raised in jubilant song.
description:
She seems entranced by her own song - she sings with eyes closed, with such
feeling and power.

long: A man in bright traveler's garb bids you welcome.
description:
He motions you closer and closer and then closer yet.  He whispers to you
that his tonics can make a man think better, run quicker and cause the woman of
his dreams to fall immediately in love with him.

long: Milissin reads from her tome, her voice changing with each character's lines.
description:
Milissin has the rare gift of the ability to change her voice at command.
She can sound mean, sad, scared or happy at will, making her a very effective
storyteller.

long: A small monkey dances in time with the melody of the bard.
description:
The monkey keeps tethered to the bard's waist by means of a thin rope which
is attached to a collar around the monkey's neck.

long: A parentless little kid runs past, screaming in delight at the wonders around him.
description:
He seems to be everywhere at once, a flurry of movement and noise that no
one can get a lid on.

long: An old crone sits unmoving in the darkness of this place.
description:
She sits with her hands folded over each on the table, neither looking
toward you or away from you.  Looking closer, you begin to think that she may
be very blind.

long: A woman sits cross-legged on the ground, a deck of strange cards spread out before her.
description:
She concentrates on the cards before her, as if reading something of some
important in the way they lay on the ground.

long: A gypsy dancer sways with the beat of the music, her hips a gyrating phenomenon.
description:
It is hard not to blush watching this full grown woman go through her
sensuous moves - but then, it is just as hard to look away.

long: A gypsy man attempts to keep time with his female counterpart.
description:
He is a wonderful dancer in all rights - she is simply a bit more interesting
to watch than he is .

long: A man covered in tattoos and piercings serves food from a large grill.
description:
The man sings and talks jovially to all of his customers, as if there is no
other place in Dibrova that he would rather be.

long: A little kid bumps into you and goes off running in another direction.
description:
That almost felt like the little punk was trying to lighten your load a bit.
Best to try and ask him what his intentions were.

long: A woman sits upon the grass, watching the performance on the stage.
description:
She seems riveted by the performance, although there really isn't much to it
- the actors are definitely not professionals.

long: A vendor walks the festival, carrying a crate filled with foodstuffs.
description:
She calls in a loud voice to all who will listen to get what she has while
she still has it - only a few left and going quick.

long: A rootless man roams the festival, heading in no particular direction at all.
description:
He walks with his hands in his pockets, a travel-worn cape slung over his
left shoulder.  He meets no eyes nor does he evade them, he simply strolls
along minding his own business.

long: A bard rests upon the stump, lost in song as he strums his lute.
description:
He sways gently in his position on the stump, eyes closed and humming to the
song his lute carries.  It must be a fine thing indeed to be so very in tune
with one's inner self.

long: A woman sits at the riverbank, softly playing a song through a bamboo reed.
description:
The song is as fine as any produced through a metal instrument such as a
flute.  She plays with such skill and feeling that even the wind seems to
listen to her song.

long: A woman dressed as a cat enacts her part in the production.
description:
The woman sports a long tail and a set of whiskers made to make even the
most stoic of onlookers grin.  She plays her part well.

long: A man dressed as a huge mushroom stands still as he recites his lines.
description:
It really does not take a great deal of talent to play the part of a
mushroom, however the man recites his line with precision and clarity.

long: A gypsy woman kneels at water's edge cleaning her clothes.
description:
She hums as she scrubs and cleans, apparently happy with her lot in life and
pleased to be cleaning clothes in a river.

long: A burly gypsy mends a broken wheel on the wagon.
description:
He wears only the baggy pants commonly worn by the gypsy clans, sweat
pouring from his body.  Maybe you ought to help the poor fella?

long: A gypsy man shoes a horse, tapping nails in gently.
description:
He is quite stout but makes up for his lack in height in strength.  His arms
are heavily muscled and tanned.

long: A mime silently moves past, acting as if trapped in a moving glass prison.
description:
There really is nothing worse than a mime, except maybe a politician.
Please put this one out of its misery.

long: A smiling gypsy woman paints the faces of delighted children.
description:
She seems to truly enjoy the fun and excitement that each child exhibits
when a new face is painted on and the child leaps from his or her chair,
laughing in delight.

long: One of the performers rests after a gruelling performance on stage.
description:
He massages his shins and lower legs, getting the cramps out from the
performances onstage.

long: A woman lies on her back, catching her breath after a tiring show.
description: She stares at the sky as she breathes, lost in thought.

long: A townsman walks along, taking in the sights and sounds of the festival.
description:
He walks along attempting to appear unimpressed by the antics of the
gypsies, however his open eyes and twisting neck give him away.

long: A wide-eyed countryman walks the festival, amazed at all the people and sights.
description:
This bumpkin makes no attempt to hide the fact that he only sees this many
people when he comes to town once a month - and then only the same faces.

long: A townswoman sniffs at the workers of the festival, taken aback at their filthiness.
description:
It appears that this woman feels that these workers are not of the same
level of stature as she and that they should pay heed to where she treads.
Most of them pay her no heed at all.

long: An elven wanderer walks the festival, his gait steady and dextrous.
description:
Although he seems to enjoy a great many of the tricks and shows that go on,
he still keeps one hand on his dagger - just in case any of those MoS types
show up.

long: A stout countryman's wife bounces through the festival, smiling warmly.
description:
She seems so happy, so pleased to be out and about among people.  Poor
thing, she must not get out very much.

long: A farmer walks through the festival with a disbelieving look fixed upon his face.
description:
This is a simple man, a man of low birth who has never known much of the
fine life or wandering.  All of this is almost too much.

long: A woman in a simple spun dress looks around in joy and wonder.
description: She looks around in all directions, trying to see everything at once.

long: A midget runs through the crowds, back-flipping and somersaulting.
description:
He does all of his tricks with a smile and a flourish, sometimes including
people in his routine as he dives and rolls between their legs.

long: A man walks through the festival on tall wooden poles.
description:
The poles seem almost an extension of his own legs.  He never falters,
stumbles or rests for any period of time.

long: A gyspsy lounges on the grass, arms folded under his head.
description:
He does not appear to be bothered that he is taking his break, or more aptly
put, nap in the middle of this throng of people.  He rests easily, his chest
rising and falling in rhythmic sleeping patterns.

long: A man in a silver tunic juggles curved broadswords with his partner.
description:
He tosses the swords, spinning them away as fast as he catches them toward
his partner in red who does just the same right back.

long: A man in a red tunic juggles curved broadswords with his partner.
description:
As his partner catches and throws the spinning swords back at him, this man
talks animatedly with the crowd, urging them to throw a coin or two their way.

long: A woman tends to the animals, keeping a close watch on them.
description:
Her main function is to be sure that these animals do not injure the
children who pet them.  And that is exactly what she does.

short: a child with his face painted
long: A child runs past, his face painted like a lion.
description: He looks up at you.  He smirks and says, 'Roar.  '

long: A man stares off into space, reciting his lines quickly and quietly.
description:
He bobs his head with each word he whispers, as if agreeing that what he is
saying are the proper lines, psyching himself for his time on stage.

long: A woman nervously paces back and forth at the edge of the stage.
description:
As she paces along she mutters to herself, praising her own ability to sing
and dance, giving herself confidence for her time on stage.

short: a child with her face painted
long: A child pushes past, her face painted up like a kitty-cat.
description: She squeals in delight as she runs along, meowing and purring at intervals.

short: a child with his face painted
long: A child with a painted-on skeleton face looks somberly up at you.
description: It is only face paint, but he appears to be taking his role quite seriously.

long: A man leans out of his cart, bidding you to take a look at his fine goods.
description:
He is fat and red-faced, a dirty turban wrapped around his head.  He wears a
set of soiled robes which have at least on hue of every color under the sun on
them.

long: A woman draped in awful-colored clothing stands proudly at her wagon.
description:
She offers the 'finest in all the land' for exotic cloth, found only at the
outer fringes of the world and beyond.

long: A woman draped in cheap jewelry beckons you in closer.
description:
She bids you to take a look at her fine wares, all at a price which can be
made specially for you - but only today, right now!

long: The puppet master causes his little creatures to dance and cavort comically.
description:
He looks up from time to time to make sure his audience is enjoying the
show, but for the most part this rat-nosed man seems engrossed in his job.

long: A sturdy pack horse patiently waits on his shoes.
description:
Every now again a muffled snort or a swish of the tail is affected - other
than that, it just stands there looking bored.

long: A gypsy man with a big sloppy grin serves the ale.
description:
His eyes are a bit red around the edges, his smile a bit too loose.  He may
have taken a couple swills himself...

long: A man is here throwing back the beers.
description: He is a tall, broad-shouldered man who takes his drink very seriously.

long: A farmer drinks some ale as he watches the stage show.
description:
It doesn't appear that he is a heavy drinker, but he does keep a firm grip
on his mug.  Maybe he is afraid the misses will take it away...

long: One of the locals of the area stands near the keg, refilling his glass frequently.
description:
He tries to start conversations with just about anyone who will listen - he
has a story for just about everything.

long: A farmhand watches starry-eyed as the gypsy dancer moves her hips.
description: He looks no older than fifteen or sixteen, with freckles and all.

long: A young lad of the city blushes as he watches the gypsy dancer move.
description: He may be blushing, but he sure ain't turning around, either.

long: An older woman clucks in disapproval at the display onstage.
description:
She sure makes a lot of racket for someone who hasn't moved from her spot in
front of male gypsy dancer for the last hour and a half.

long: A gypsy watches his fellow brethren as they go about their dance.
description: He must be on break or between shows, the lucky guy.

long: A young country girl watches in rapture as the dancers make their exotic moves.
description:
This poor little dear is certainly a candidate for recruitment into the
gypsy band.

long: A gypsy woman prepares food for the hungry festival-goers.
description:
She is spattered in stains and grease, but seems to be enjoying herself just
the same.

long: An excited child waits as he gets his face painted.
description:
He tries not to appear too excited, but he bounces from foot to foot with
anticipation in his eyes.

long: A wide-eyed child listens raptly to the story.
description:
A thin line of spittle runs out of the corner of his mouth, but he doesn't
notice it.  He stares up in awe at the storyteller as the relates the story.

long: A little girl listens raptly as the story unfolds.
description:
Her ponytails droop unmoving as she listens to the story, not moving muscle,
listening with every part of her being.

long: A young lad listens to the story with wonder in his eyes.
description:
He almost looks as if he were in a trance of some sort, lost so deeply in
the plot of the story that he lost track of the real world.

long: Duvois' personal butler stands here ready for your request.
description:
An old english looking fellow with gray hair and a gray moustache.  He
features are warm and friendly, and he seems overly exciting to satisfy your
request.  He is dressed in the traditional butler's garb and is standing
upright like a englishman should.

long: A footman trudges past you, looking worn and tired.
description:
Poor guy must have been marching all day long.  You notice that the only one
with a canteen is the guy in the front - must be one of the rank things.  '

long: A footman marches along steadily with the rest his troop.
description:
This man looks as if he could probably march all day and all night without a
complaint.  Must be what the army would call 'Gung Ho'.

long: A footman trudges along with the rest of his troop, trying to stay in step.
description:
This slob can't seem to keep step no matter how hard he tries.  He keeps
hopping from one foot to the other, watching his fellow footmen, trying to get
in synch - but to no avail.

long: A cavalry soldier walks his horse along the road, giving the steed a rest.
description:
This man appears to be most proud of not only his steed, but of the position
he has attained within the Army's Ranks.

long: A patrolman walks his rounds, on constant alert for signs of danger or invasion.
description:
His eyes seem constantly squinted to the sun, even when there is none.  He
walks with a slow, deliberate gait that suggests readiness and watchfulness.

long: A guard stands at rigid attention, eyes boring down on you as if reading your intent.
description:
Strict orders have been placed upon this poor lad - no one in civilian
clothing may pass without authorization forms from a higher power.

long: A lookout appears shocked by your intrusion here.
description:
These platforms were created in the interest of safety and security, to keep
invaders from launching surprise attacks upon the camp.  You are now considered
a breach of security.

long: A man is here with his back turned to you, unaware of your presence.
description:
He appears to be watching something through the trees, so intent on whatever
he is watching, he does not notice that you have entered into his small space.

long: The lookout is here, fast asleep against the trunk of the tree.
description:
He is someone you could almost miss were you not searching for someone, he
is so camouflaged by his face paint and attire.

long: A logger is here, pounding away at a tree.
description:
This man is built like an ox - muscles to match.  Might be a good idea to
make friends with this one...

long: A logger is here taking a break from the chopping, leaning on his axe.
description:
This man is lean and wiry, with small, solid muscles that bely his true
strength.

long: A logger is propped up against a stump, snoring away.
description:
If this man can sleep through the sound of loggers hacking at trees with
axes, then this man has my respect and admiration!

long: The logging chief is here barking orders at the top of his lungs.
description:
How could a man spend his days screaming at the top of his lungs, in
competition with a dozen axes pounding at trees?  This guy is special...

long: A dryad sits upon the stump of the huge tree, weeping for its loss.
description:
Her brown skinned cheeks are saturated by the tears that stream down her
face.  She does not seem to notice or care that you have entered into her area
- she looks at a point in the air just past where she sits - staring at nothing
and crying for her loss.

long: A soldier jogs past you, getting a bit of exercise.
description:
He looks a bit red in the face and maybe even winded, but he continues on.
A real trooper.  No pun intended.

long: A soldier marches past you, intent on his rhythm.
description: He looks neither right nor left, simply straight ahead at where he is going.

long: A wagon driver stands beside his wagon, mopping his face and forehead from the heat.
description: He glances up with a small smile and a wave.

long: A little squirrel runs across your path.
description:
It stops at the edge of the path, raises up on its hind legs and twitches
its nose at you.

long: A small bird hops about on the forest floor, looking for worms or bits of seed.
description: It shies away from your approach, but doesn't take to flight - yet.

long: A little rabbit sprints across the path just ahead of you.
description: It pauses just at the fringe of the forest and wiggles its pink nose at you.

long: A drill sergeant runs along side his men, barking the rhythm.
description:
He wear his hair in a long ponytail braid, severely pulled back on the
sides, lending him an air of hostility and savagery.  He looks mean to the
core.

long: A farmer walks around, looking for something to do.
description:
This farmer is a resident of Stanneg by the Mountains, and as such, is one of
the most boring people on earth.

long: A bored storekeeper waits for you to do something.
description:
The bored storekeeper keeps a lazy eye on you as he waits for you to buy
something.  Whee.

long: A cowgirl stand here ready to defend her horses...
description:
This woman seems ready for anything you might do...  She is truly a woman to
be reckoned with...

long: A horse does horsely things here.
description:
This horse looks like a nice horse.  It looks at you with soft brown eyes and
you want to give it a carrot.

long: A farmer's wife offers you some vegetables.
description:
This woman has many different types of fruits and vegetables for you to buy.
She looks bored, though.

long: The Dragon Prince, Aglandiir, sits here looking at you curiously.
description:
Aglandiir is a prince of his kind, and he didn't get where he is today by
letting people steal from his horde!

long: A Cyclops is here, trying to judge range with no depth perception.
description:
This Cyclops throws rocks real good.  With one eye though, hitting the target
is another matter.  He looks at you and growls as he misses again!

long: A woman ignores you completely, so intent is she upon her sword.
description:
She is a stunning woman, all hair and eyes, it seems.  Her clothing is of the
same tawny brown of her skin and hair.  Her blue eyes look at you appraisingly,
seemingly to show great intelligence.  Her mouth twitches into a sneer...

long: A truly immense man laughs at you, and draws his knife!
description:
This has to be one of the biggest men you've ever seen.  He is a full seven
feet toe to head, and weighs a good three hundred pounds -- mostly on his biceps
and pectorals it appears.  An ornate scabbard slaps by his side, with the pommel
of a silvered dagger sticking out...  A tiny weapon for such a large man!

long: A receptionist offers you a room.
description:
He looks like a retired farmer now making an honest living in an inn.  More
power to him!

long: An aged innkeeper greets you as you enter.
description:
He is old and graying, but seems to have been able to keep his mental
faculties through the years.  A large woolen sweater is wrapped about him for
warmth.  His blue eyes dance with amusement as he notices your weapons, but he
doesn't seem too terribly startled.

long: A hunter walks through the town streets on his own time.
description:
He looks mean, as if the very personality of the mountains had infected him
with hardness.  His stride is purposeful, his face weathered, his eyes cold and
dark.  Others are standing out of his way as he walks on by.

long: A waiter rushes by, intent on his business.
description:
He looks harried from the way he hastily takes orders and rushes in the back
to get food, and to the bar for drinks.  He doesn't even spare you a glance as
he passes by.

long: A waitress rushes by, intent on her business.
description:
She looks harried from the way she hastily takes orders and rushes in the
back to get food, and to the bar for drinks.  She doesn't even spare you a
glance as she passes by.

long: A bartender washes a glass idly here.
description:
He nods, smiles, and asks you what you would like to drink.  As you decide,
he slowly polishes a glass with an old bar rag.  The glass is completely clean,
but he polishes it anyway.  Go figure.

long: A bandit springs into action upon seeing you.
description:
Whew!  Has this guy ever seen a bath?  His face, hands, arms...  Nearly every
bit of him is covered with grime, dust, dirt and decay.  His sword is polished
and cleaned though...

long: A bandit guard stands at attention here.
description:
He may be a bandit, but he's no slacker.  You wonder who would be able to
keep these bandits in line enough to pull a good guard duty...  (boy is this guy
DIRTY!!!  )

long: A slave here is mining out a new passageway.
description:
The slave looks up at you with pleading eyes.  He wants his freedom.  The
chains around his ankles are tight, and you wonder if you should set him free,
and if you even can.

long: A farmer walks around, looking for something to do.
description:
This farmer is a resident of Stanneg by the Mountains, and as such, is one of
the most boring people on earth.

long: A hunter walks through the town streets on his own time.
description:
He looks mean, as if the very personality of the mountains had infected him
with hardness.  His stride is purposeful, his face weathered, his eyes cold and
dark.  Others are standing out of his way as he walks on by.

long: A @Cch@Wro@Cma@Wti@Cc @Wsentinel@n turns slowly across the crystal path.
description:
This guardian resembles a broad-shouldered figure grown rather than
carved from interlocking crystal plates. Threads of blue, gold, and
violet light travel beneath its translucent shell, flaring whenever
movement disturbs the grotto. Its blunt hands and heavy stance suggest
a creature made to hold ground rather than pursue prey.

long: A @Wgl@ca@Wss@cw@Wi@cn@Wg @cscavenger@n picks delicately through the fractured crystal.
description:
This insectile scavenger balances on six needle-thin legs beneath a
narrow body of smoky quartz. Two broad wings, clear as freshly cut
glass, tremble above its back and scatter tiny rainbows across nearby
stone. Its hooked mouthparts scrape loose mineral growths and magical
residue from cracks in the grotto.

long: The @Cfa@Wce@Cted @Wcustodian@n patiently adjusts a wall of mirrored crystal.
description:
Taller and more intricate than the common sentinels, this ancient
keeper is built from dozens of precisely fitted crystal facets. Four
slender hands test angles, clear mineral dust, and nudge loose growths
back into alignment with tireless care. Light bends around its torso
in disciplined bands, making its true outline difficult to judge.

long: The @Mheart@W-@Cprism @Wwarden@n stands within the converging beams.
description:
A towering guardian of dark crystal stands between intruders and the
Heart Prism. A smaller living prism turns inside its chest, throwing
hard bands of crimson, cobalt, and violet through joints that should
be opaque. One arm narrows into a flawless blade-like edge, while the
other ends in a heavy faceted hand capable of crushing stone.

long: A @Mpr@Wis@Mm@Ww@Min@Wg @Mmoth@n drifts between the crystal reeds.
description:
The moth is the size of a small hound, with four translucent wings
dusted in shifting bands of violet and blue. Its soft body is protected
by overlapping crystal scales, and a coiled feeding tube probes glowing
mineral blooms for nectar.

long: A @Ccrystal@Wback @Cbeetle@n grinds mineral fragments beneath its shell.
description:
A broad beetle nearly reaches a warrior's knee, its back covered by
overlapping plates of cloudy blue crystal. Powerful mandibles crack
loose mineral growths for food, while the heavy shell turns aside
glancing blows with a sound like struck glass.

long: An @Ya@Wm@Yb@We@Yr@Wg@Yl@Wa@Yss @Wwasp@n hangs in the air on needle-thin wings.
description:
This predatory wasp is built from dark chitin and translucent amber
plates. Its four narrow wings beat too quickly to follow, and a long
crystal stinger folds beneath the abdomen like a dagger waiting to be
drawn.

long: A @Clu@Wmen @Cslug@n leaves a ribbon of silver light across the wet stone.
description:
The slow grazer is nearly three feet long and translucent enough to see
luminous organs pulsing beneath its skin. It rasps glowing mineral film
from damp crystal with a ring of tiny teeth, leaving a bright trail that
fades over several minutes.

long: A @Wsh@Car@Wdm@Can@Wti@Cs @Wpredator@n waits perfectly still among the razor facets.
description:
This tall insect folds two immense crystal forelimbs against its narrow
chest until they resemble harmless quartz blades. Its faceted eyes
mirror the surrounding cavern, and every joint is arranged for a sudden
explosive strike.

long: A @Wmir@cro@Wrew@ceb @Wspider@n crouches behind a curtain of false reflections.
description:
Eight long legs support a flattened body plated in mirror-bright
crystal. The spider's web reflects whatever lies behind it, hiding both
strands and hunter until prey is already entangled. Its fangs are dark,
polished, and completely free of reflection.

long: A @Cgem@Wjaw @Ccrawler@n bites chunks directly from the cavern wall.
description:
Low, broad, and heavily muscled, the crawler is armored in dull gray
scales except for a jaw lined with brilliant blue crystal teeth. Those
teeth can crush quartz like bread crust, and fresh mineral dust coats
its powerful forelimbs.

long: A @Rpr@Yi@Cs@Mm @Wstag@n watches through a crown of many-colored antlers.
description:
The stag's lean body appears carved from pale stone until it moves with
unmistakable living grace. A magnificent rack of translucent antlers
branches above its head, each tine holding a different color. Its hooves
strike sparks from bare crystal.

long: A @Dhollow@W-@Cfacet @Wmimic@n unfolds from what looked like an empty geode.
description:
At rest the creature is almost indistinguishable from a split geode.
When disturbed, mirrored plates open into hooked limbs around a dark
hollow core. Reflections inside that emptiness continue moving even when
everything outside has gone still.

long: The @RS@Yp@Ce@Mc@Rt@Yr@Cu@Mm @WBroodmother@n towers over a nest of luminous crystal eggs.
description:
The enormous insect queen fills the heart of the geode nest. Layered
plates of crimson, cobalt, amber, and violet crystal protect a long
segmented body, while six heavy legs end in hooked mineral claws. Her
wings are too small for flight but beat hard enough to fill the chamber
with cutting shards of reflected light.

long: A @Wgl@ca@Wss@c-@Wsh@ce@Wll @clarva@n gnaws quietly at a soft mineral bloom.
description:
The pale larva is as long as a forearm and protected by a translucent
shell that has not yet hardened into adult crystal. Its many tiny legs
cling easily to steep stone, while blunt mouthparts scrape mineral film
from the grotto walls.

long: A @Cpr@Wis@Cm @Wcicada@n vibrates against the crystal with a chiming buzz.
description:
Broad glassy wings cover a squat insect body of pale blue crystal.
Instead of an ordinary drone, the cicada produces a layered ringing note
that resonates through nearby mineral formations and returns in
different colors of sound.

long: A @YQ@Wu@Ya@Wd @YB@We@Ye@Wt@Yl@We@n lowers its massive horn and scrapes eight armored legs across the stone.
description:
This enormous beetle is built like a living siege engine. Four pairs of
thick armored legs support a low body protected by amber-black crystal
plates, while a huge forward-curving horn dominates its head. When
angered it digs every foot into the ground and launches itself with
terrifying force.

long: The @RC@Wl@Ro@Ww@Rn @RSp@Wid@Rer@n watches from its painted web with a terrible crystalline grin.
description:
The enormous spider is nearly as broad as the chamber itself. Its
polished white shell is slashed with vivid red, yellow, and blue
markings that resemble festive paint, while eight black crystal legs
move with grotesque delicacy. A natural grin-like pattern spans the
front of its crown above clustered jewel-bright eyes.

long: A @Rp@Wa@Ri@Wn@Rt@We@Rd @Wspiderling@n scuttles across a stripe of bright webbing.
description:
This young spider already bears the bright painted markings of the
greater Clown Spider, though its body is only the size of a large
shield. Thin crystal legs let it move almost silently across web and
stone alike.

long: A swarm of @Rc@Yh@Cr@Mo@Rm@Ya@Ct@Mi@Rc @Wmites@n glitters across the cracks between crystals.
description:
Hundreds of pinhead-sized crystal mites move as a glittering carpet,
feeding on mineral dust and anything organic left behind by larger
creatures. Individually harmless, they become a painful biting cloud
when disturbed.

keywords: censure sentinel hall watcher restraint custodian
long: The Censure Sentinel stands silently at attention.
description:
A tall warded construct of dark stone and pale brass has been assigned
to the conduct wing. It exists as a controlled staff sentinel, not a
punishment mascot. Its smooth face bears only a narrow blue-white line
of light, and its posture is patient rather than threatening.

keywords: refreshment steward attendant keeper coffee hall
long: The Refreshment Steward checks the supplies behind the counter.
description:
A neatly dressed attendant keeps cups, hot drinks, water, and simple
provisions organized in the refreshment alcove. His role is practical
hospitality for staff on duty, and his manner is helpful without the old
jokes and crude theatrics.

long: The Senior Scribe reviews a violet rune-slate beside the records desk.
description:
A professional staff scribe in a dark blue service coat carries a violet
rune-slate and a ring of archive keys. She tracks correspondence,
meeting notes, and action items for senior staff without being treated
as decoration.

keywords: conduct mediator justice staff healer aide
long: The Conduct Mediator reviews a sealed case ledger.
description:
A composed mediator in white and deep blue robes keeps evidence ledgers
and procedural notes for difficult conduct reviews. His authority is
administrative and limited by policy, documentation, and the expectation
that staff use restraint.

keywords: service spirit custodian hall cleaner ward
long: A quiet service spirit tends the halls.
description:
A translucent household spirit moves through the complex carrying a
cloth, small brush, and ring of maintenance tags. It serves by old
agreement and cheerful habit, not punishment or debt, and quietly
handles the ordinary upkeep that keeps the halls usable.

long: The Garden Keeper tends the lantern garden.
description:
A practical groundskeeper in green and brown work clothes carries
pruning shears, cord, and a small lantern. She tends paths, water
channels, trees, and flowering beds that give staff a place to think
away from administrative rooms.

keywords: stone warden staff guardian sentinel golem
long: A stone warden keeps watch over the operations gallery.
description:
A broad stone construct bears simple service runes across its shoulders.
It is stationed at major staff junctions to discourage misuse of
restricted areas and to remind visitors that access is based on assigned
responsibility.

keywords: air warden staff guardian sentinel golem
long: An air warden circles quietly beneath the rafters.
description:
A translucent warden of bound air and pale runes patrols upper passages.
Its task is observation and access control rather than intimidation, and
it reacts only when restricted staff spaces are misused.

long: An old grounds keeper works here.
description:
The man is hunched over from years of hard work. His skin hangs off his
already skinny body. His eyes shown with he light of madness. He wears denim
overalls with a dirt stained white t-shirt.

long: A ghost floats here looking for its next victim.
description:
Transparent and hard to see, the ghost seems must have been a patient at the
nearby asylum. Already insane in life, death has turned it into an unrelenting
killer.

long: A doctor with a bloody lab coat stands here.
description:
The doctor is a tall lanky man. His face is stubbly and his hair unkempt.
His eyes are sunken in to his skull and shown with the madness that affected
some many others in this place. Perhaps the most startling aspect of him is his
white lab coat that is now almost red wit the stains of blood.

long: A mental patient shuffles along here.
description:
The person before is dressed in a ragged hospital gown, dirty from being worn
for so long. The skin is a pale white from the lack of sun and the stench
coming from him is horrendous at best. Unable to figure out what he is doing,
he is doomed to roam these halls forever. Even death is not a barrier for his
suffering.

long: The operation victim stands here.
description:
This man is bleeding severely from an incision in his chest. While he is
losing blood a fire burns in his eyes. Having his mind completely shattered by
the ordeal that he has just gone through, he rages against anyone foolish enough
to get in his way.

long: A tortured patient stands here.
description:
The person before has been so horribly disfigured by the 'treatments' at this
facility that it is no longer possible to tell if they are a man or a woman.
It wears a tattered hospital gown and cowers in fear at almost everything.

long: @ME@Wly@Mri@Wa @DNi@Wgh@Mtf@Wall@Me@Wn@n stands here with effortless command.
description:
Elyria's elegance never softens the certainty that she is one of the
most dangerous people in the Crimson Citadel. As First Lady she
controls household access, senior guests, internal discipline, and the
Veiled Blades with polished efficiency and a tongue sharp enough to
make most visitors reconsider their wording. Her patience for
strangers is limited and her courtesy often carries an unmistakably
cutting edge. Around Kokudar, however, that armor changes. Warmth
enters her expression, private humor replaces formality, and the
fierce devotion beneath her command becomes impossible to miss. She is
still perfectly capable of teasing him, arguing with him, or refusing
to indulge his ego, but the affection is genuine, chosen, and openly
hers.

long: @DVa@Mel@Wre@Dth@n studies a stack of active reports.
description:
Vaelreth is composed, analytical, and relentlessly useful. He
translates Kokudar's broad instructions into concrete tasks, follows
problems personally when necessary, and treats wasted time as a
correctable defect.

long: @WKa@Cel@Wen@n watches the hall with a commander's stillness.
description:
Kaelen runs guard rotations, drills, escorts, and physical defense.
His equipment is immaculate, his questions are brief, and his patience
for sloppy security is famously short.

long: @MXy@Wli@Ma@n traces violet runes across a slate.
description:
Xylia oversees dangerous rituals, portals, containment, and
experimental magic. Her devotion is expressed through competence
rather than worship, and she is most comfortable when every magical
catastrophe has at least three prepared answers.

long: @DMal@Mph@Was@n is present with unsettling quiet.
description:
Malphas handles intelligence, counterintelligence, interrogation, and
difficult visitors. He rarely raises his voice and almost never
answers a question without learning something in return.

long: @WSe@Mra@Wph@Mine@n reviews the battlemaids' duty slate.
description:
Seraphine commands the battlemaids beneath Elyria. She is a flawless
household officer, a precise swordswoman, and the person most likely
to know where every member of the citadel is supposed to be.

long: @CMi@Wre@Cll@We@n balances a polished dueling blade across one palm.
description:
Mirelle is quick, competitive, and painfully precise. She can serve a
formal table without a mistake and then spend an hour proving exactly
why the household silver should never be mistaken for her preferred
weapons.

long: @DNy@Mxa@Wra@n seems to have appeared without using the obvious door.
description:
Nyxara handles night patrols, hidden routes, discreet security, and
tasks that are easier when no one notices they were performed.

long: @GTh@Wali@Ga@n checks a healer's satchel with practiced speed.
description:
Thalia divides her time between household duty, battlefield medicine,
and preventing the other battlemaids from treating avoidable injuries
as a competition.

long: @MVes@Wpe@Mra@n watches a line of violet ward-light crawl over her glove.
description:
Vespera supports Xylia's ward work while remaining a full member of
the battlemaid order. She has a habit of testing enchantments on
cleaning tools simply because no rule explicitly forbids it.

long: @RBr@Wie@Rnn@We@n stands beside a weapon that should probably require two people.
description:
Brienne handles heavy combat, kitchen assistance, furniture moving,
and any household problem that becomes simpler when enormous strength
is applied carefully.

long: @WOr@Cin@Wth@n is comparing two nearly identical catalogue entries.
description:
Orinth runs the citadel's archives with scholarly severity. He can
locate a campaign note from decades ago in moments and will then
complain for considerably longer about whoever filed it incorrectly.

long: Master Durn examines a rune plate through a smoky lens.
description:
Durn maintains enchanted tools, seals, constructs, and damaged
artifacts. The forge has permanently stained his red leather gloves
with heat and scale, while improving his opinion of very few people.

long: Elaris checks a ring of portal keys and destination seals.
description:
Elaris maintains portals, teleportation circles, dimensional locks,
and guest permissions. She treats an unlabeled portal like a loaded
crossbow pointed at the household.

short: Garrick, Master of the Citadel Kitchens
long: Garrick is already annoyed about something missing from the pantry.
description:
Garrick runs the kitchens with the authority of a battlefield
quartermaster. He is one of the few residents willing to tell Kokudar
directly that magic does not make a burnt dinner less burnt.

long: Ysmera smells faintly of hay, herbs, and something draconic.
description:
Ysmera manages familiars, mounts, summoned creatures awaiting
classification, and every living thing Kokudar has ever brought home
while saying that he intended to keep it temporarily.

long: Tovren carries three ledgers and looks prepared to acquire a fourth.
description:
Tovren handles supplies, rooms, linen, household inventories, guest
preparation, and all the mundane systems that allow the spectacular
parts of the citadel to function.

long: The @WP@Dale @MLi@Wbr@Maria@n turns a translucent page.
description:
The spectral librarian remembers records that predate several versions
of the archive. It rarely speaks above a whisper and has strong
opinions about fire, ink quality, and visitors who fold page corners.

long: The @OCl@Woc@Okk@Wee@Oper@n's brass rings turn with quiet clicks.
description:
The Clockkeeper is a complicated construct assigned to chronomancy and
temporal accounting. It frequently reports correct information in the
wrong tense.

long: The @DVa@Wul@Dt @MWa@Wrden@n stands motionless before the sealed approach.
description:
The massive crimson-steel construct is intelligent, literal, and
utterly devoted to procedure. Silver ward-lines cross its red armor
plates like a ledger written in metal. It considers authorization a
sacred concept only in the bureaucratic sense.

long: A towering @GCi@Wta@Gdel @DGroundskeeper@n tends the citadel's living spaces with extraordinary care.
description:
The groundskeeper is enormous enough to terrify an unprepared visitor
and gentle enough to spend an hour repairing a damaged flower bed by
hand. The battlemaids trust him with both gardens and injured animals.

long: A @rve@Rno@om-@rsp@Our@Rred @rci@Ond@Rer @rwy@Ove@Rrn@n circles low above the trees.
description:
Broad soot-dark wings carry this lean predator through the canopy with terrifying
ease. Rust-red scales armor its chest and shoulders, while a hooked tail ends in
black venom spurs. Its jaws and talons are stained from recent feeding, and a bitter
chemical reek clings to every hiss of breath.

long: A @gGr@Gee@Ynb@glo@God@n goblin raider prowls the trail with a scavenger's caution.
description:
Lean even for a goblin, this raider wears patched hides beneath scraps of stolen
cloth and leather. Ash-green paint marks his cheeks in the sign of the Greenblood
band. He watches the brush more often than the road, moving with the nervous
discipline of someone expecting larger predators to appear without warning.

keywords: gnoll emberfang reaver warrior hyena beastfolk
long: An @rEm@Rbe@Or@rFa@Rng@n gnoll reaver prowls here with a jagged cleaver in hand.
description:
This hyena-headed warrior stands nearly a head taller than the goblins that haunt
Cindervale. Soot-red war paint streaks his muzzle, and scars cross a powerful frame
wrapped in hide and scavenged iron. He carries himself with the confidence of a
predator accustomed to driving weaker creatures from whatever territory he wants.

keywords: vargash ember-maw ember maw packlord gnoll emberfang chief beastlord
long: @rVa@Rrg@Oas@rh @REm@Obe@rr-@RMa@Ow@n looms over a charcoal map of Cindervale.
description:
Vargash is a massive old gnoll whose dark mane has been braided with iron rings,
goblin teeth, and scorched bits of bone. One side of his muzzle is permanently
blackened by an old burn, exposing a yellow canine when he snarls. He studies the
vale like a hunter studying wounded prey, patient enough to let others bleed first.

keywords: tomas fen boy wounded woodcutter son survivor
long: @WT@Yom@Was @OF@Yen@n sits beside the broken trail, trying hard not to cry.
description:
Tomas cannot be more than ten or eleven years old. His sleeves are torn, his face
is streaked with dirt, and shallow cuts cover his hands and knees. He clutches a
small carved charm with both hands and keeps glancing toward the western trail,
as though he expects the riders who attacked his party to return at any moment.

keywords: harlan vey keeper innkeeper woodsman hearth
long: @YHa@Orl@Yan @WV@Yey@n tends the bar while keeping one eye on the door.
description:
Harlan is a broad-shouldered man with iron-gray hair, rolled sleeves, and the
scarred hands of someone who worked timber long before he poured ale. He speaks
quietly but watches every traveler closely. A loaded crossbow behind the bar and
an axe scar across one forearm show how dangerous innkeeping in Cindervale has become.

keywords: corren vale bard minstrel traveler road worn
long: @CCo@Brr@Wen @CVa@Ble@n sits over an untouched cup, staring into the fire.
description:
Once-bright traveling clothes have faded beneath road dust, rain, and too many
nights spent in the same chair. Corren's instrument case is battered but carefully
maintained. His hands occasionally tremble when raised from the table, and whenever
someone mentions Dreary Hollow his attention sharpens despite the drink before him.

keywords: blackbriar rider brigand horseman outlaw mounted
long: A @DBl@Wac@rk@Dbr@riar@n rider waits in the shadows beside a restless black horse.
description:
Dark riding leathers and a soot-colored scarf hide most distinguishing features
of this mounted brigand. His gear is chosen for speed, concealment, and ambush.
A thorn-shaped brand has been burned into one shoulder guard, marking him as part
of the Blackbriar riders who prey on the weakened roads through Cindervale.

keywords: gnoll emberfang hunter stalker hyena beastfolk
long: An @rEm@Rbe@Or@rFa@Rng@n gnoll hunter pads between the trees, testing the air.
description:
Lean and long-limbed, this gnoll wears a patchwork mantle of fox, wolf, and goblin
hide. Bone hooks and lengths of black cord hang from his belt for snares and traps.
His ears turn constantly toward distant sounds, and his nostrils flare as he follows
scents that would be meaningless to a human tracker.

keywords: bristlehide boarfolk marauder beastman beastfolk tusked
long: A tusked @oBr@Ois@ytl@oeh@Oid@ye@n marauder shoulders through the undergrowth.
description:
Coarse brown-black bristles cover this broad beastman's neck, shoulders, and heavy
arms. Two chipped tusks jut from a scarred boar-like muzzle above a necklace of
knotted cord and teeth. He smells of wet hide, smoke, and churned earth, and seems
far more interested in force than stealth.

keywords: carrionwing ravenfolk scavenger crow beastfolk feral
long: A @DCa@Wrr@Ci@Don@Wwi@Cng@n scavenger watches from beneath a ragged mantle of black feathers.
description:
Black feathers cover the head and forearms of this wiry birdlike humanoid, fading
to leathery gray skin across the torso. Bright eyes dart from pack to corpse to
weapon with restless calculation. Bits of copper wire, bone, and colored glass
decorate a ragged mantle assembled from whatever others failed to guard.

keywords: obsidian pawn court construct soldier chess
long: An @DOb@bsi@Bdi@can @Dpa@bwn@n stands at rigid attention, sword lowered before its shield.
description:
Nearly ten feet tall, this pawn is carved from dark basalt and plated in enchanted
black stone. Cobalt runes shine through the joints while an expressionless knightly
mask tracks movement with unsettling precision.

keywords: ivory pawn court construct soldier chess
long: An @WIv@wor@Yy @Wpa@wwn@n waits in perfect formation, pale blade held across its chest.
description:
This towering soldier-statue is carved from warm ivory marble reinforced with gold-veined
plates. Fine amber runes move beneath its surface like trapped sunlight, illuminating
old chips where the construct has been destroyed and restored before.

keywords: obsidian rook court construct siege tower fortress chess
long: The @DOb@bsi@Bdi@can @Cro@Bok@n looms here like a fortress taught to move.
description:
A squat mobile citadel of black stone rises far above ordinary warriors. Crenellations
crown its shoulders, a tower-shield forms one arm, and rune-driven stone wheels grind
beneath its armored base. There is no crew. The entire fortress is the piece.

keywords: ivory rook court construct siege tower fortress chess
long: The @WIv@wor@Yy @Yro@Wok@n towers over the square, a pale bastion on enchanted wheels.
description:
This enormous mobile fortress is carved from pale stone banded with gold-bright metal.
Decorative battlements make it resemble a keep torn from its foundations. Great rune-bound
wheels carry it in brutally straight lines across the board.

keywords: obsidian knight cavalry horse construct chess
long: The @DOb@bsi@Bdi@can @Ckn@Big@cht@n waits as one fused sculpture of rider and warhorse.
description:
Horse and rider are one impossible basalt construct. The steed's carved muscles knot beneath
the rider's armor while a long black lance points across the board. Blue runes gather
around the hooves whenever the piece prepares one of its sudden rule-bound leaps.

keywords: ivory knight cavalry horse construct chess
long: The @WIv@wor@Yy @Ykn@Wig@wht@n stands poised to leap, rider and steed carved as one.
description:
A pale marble warhorse rears beneath an armored rider, yet no seam divides beast from knight.
Golden sigils circle the hooves and lancehead. The whole statue seems impossibly heavy
until it moves, at which point ordinary distance stops mattering.

keywords: obsidian bishop oracle warpriest construct chess
long: The @DOb@bsi@Bdi@can @Mbi@Bsh@cop@n traces a diagonal through the air with a rune-carved staff.
description:
A tall robed oracle-statue stands with its face hidden inside a deep black cowl. The folds
of the robe are solid stone yet shift like cloth when the piece turns. Violet and cobalt
sigils along its staff always align with distant diagonal squares.

keywords: ivory bishop oracle warpriest construct chess
long: The @WIv@wor@Yy @Cbi@Wsh@yop@n stands in pale robes, staff aligned along an unseen diagonal.
description:
This towering priestly construct is sculpted from warm pale marble. Its hood shadows a smooth
featureless face while thin gold and cyan runes spiral down a long staff. When danger nears,
those runes snap into perfectly straight diagonal patterns.

keywords: obsidian queen monarch court construct chess
long: The @DOb@bsi@Bdi@can @MQu@Bee@cn@n stands with terrible elegance beneath a dark crystal crown.
description:
Tall even among the royal constructs, the Obsidian Queen is carved with the severe beauty of
a forgotten monarch. Violet runes flow across her armor like living calligraphy. Nothing
about her stance suggests weight, distance, or ordinary limitation.

keywords: ivory queen monarch court construct chess
long: The @WIv@wor@Yy @MQu@Wee@Yn@n watches the board beneath a radiant crown of pale crystal.
description:
The Ivory Queen resembles a giant royal statue brought to impossible life. Gold-white runes
pass over graceful armor and vanish beneath a long stone mantle. Her expression is calm rather
than kind, carrying the certainty of a piece able to answer threats from nearly anywhere.

keywords: obsidian king monarch court construct chess
long: The @DOb@bsi@Bdi@can @RKi@Bng@n stands within a slow-turning cage of cobalt ward-runes.
description:
A monumental crowned warrior of black stone grips an ancient sceptre. Layered plates make the
construct broader and heavier than the Queen, and interlocking ward-runes rotate through the
air around him. The entire Game seems built to prevent this one piece from falling.

keywords: ivory king monarch court construct chess
long: The @WIv@wor@Yy @YKi@Wng@n waits behind a halo of ancient golden wards.
description:
This massive pale monarch carries the weight of a ruined dynasty in every carved feature.
A gold-veined sceptre rests in one hand while defensive sigils orbit his armor in slow
geometric paths. The magic protecting him feels older than Midgaard's walls.

keywords: arbiter eternal game construct judge chess
long: The @CAr@Wbi@Bte@Dr o@Cf t@Whe @BEt@cer@Dna@Bl @CGa@Wme@n stands motionless between the two Courts.
description:
Unlike the royal pieces, the Arbiter is neither black nor ivory. Its tall body is built from
alternating bands of both stones around a core of clear crystal. Hundreds of tiny chess
notations turn inside that crystal as it observes the board without allegiance.

keywords: rune wisp geometric light chess board
long: A @Cru@Bne @Cwi@Wsp@n drifts just above the marble, tracing tiny geometric paths.
description:
This fist-sized knot of blue-white light is made from loose board magic. It moves only in
precise angles, occasionally splitting into lines before drawing itself back together.

keywords: shattered pawn husk broken construct chess
long: A @Dsh@bat@Bte@cre@Dd @Cpa@Bwn@n @Dhu@bsk@n drags itself across the board on broken stone limbs.
description:
Only half of this old pawn remains intact. Its shield arm is gone and a deep fracture splits
the helmet, but damaged runes continue issuing obsolete commands that the husk still tries
to obey.

long: A @Dma@Wrb@Cle @Gsc@gav@Gen@Gge@gr @Dga@Wrg@Coy@Dle@n chips fragments from a fallen construct.
description:
This squat winged scavenger was never part of the original game. It has adapted to feed on
loose enchantment, cracking damaged chess pieces apart to pry glowing rune-cores from inside.

keywords: fallen obsidian champion knight broken chess
long: A @Dfa@Bll@cen @DOb@bsi@Bdi@can @Rch@Bam@cpi@Don@n stalks the center files, no longer bound to formation.
description:
Once a favored Obsidian cavalry construct, this champion bears mismatched repairs from many
eras of the Game. Its command-runes have fractured, leaving only battle instinct and a dim
memory that everything on the board is an enemy.

keywords: fallen ivory champion knight broken chess
long: A @Wfa@Yll@wen @WIv@wor@Yy @Rch@Wam@ypi@Yon@n wanders the center ranks beneath flickering gold runes.
description:
This former Ivory champion has outlived too many restorations. Gold-white sigils flash out of
sequence across cracked armor while its fused warhorse body moves with dangerous, erratic
speed. Whatever strategy it once followed has long since collapsed into violence.

long: A lean sewer rat noses through the runoff here.
description:
This rat is large enough to make ordinary vermin look harmless. Its wet
brown fur is patchy, its incisors are chipped from masonry, and its
narrow body is built for slipping through the drains. It is aggressive
when cornered but still more scavenger than monster.

long: A scarred sewer rat prowls the brick ledge.
description:
Old sores and pale scars cross this heavy rat's muzzle and shoulders. It
has survived traps, disease, floods, and fights with its own kind,
leaving it wary and mean. The animal watches hands and feet with equal
interest, ready to bite whatever looks weakest.

long: A massive nest-guard blocks the way into the warrens.
description:
This broad-shouldered rat bears the scars of repeated fights around the
colony. One ear is split and several teeth jut at crooked angles, but it
holds its ground with deliberate aggression. Unlike the scavengers
outside, this creature is defending territory.

long: @RA monstrous scarred rat crouches over a heap of stolen tribute.@n
description:
Gristlefang is enormous even by the standards of the underworks colony.
Old trap scars ring one foreleg, one eye is clouded, and a broken brass
circlet has become tangled permanently in the fur behind his ears.
Smaller rats defer to him instinctively. Whatever magic or brutal
selection made him this large, he has ruled the warrens long enough to
become part beast, part local legend.

long: A small pipe bat clings to the damp brick overhead.
description:
This soot-gray bat is little more than wings, ears, and needle teeth. It
sleeps through much of the day in cracks between the sewer bricks and
becomes a frantic hunter when insects gather over the runoff.

long: A broad-winged bat circles restlessly through the tunnel.
description:
The duskwing is larger and darker than the common pipe bats. Its long
wings let it turn sharply in confined passages, and its pale ears
constantly twitch toward tiny sounds. It is bold enough to dive at
anything that disturbs the roost.

long: A huge bat hangs above, giving an ear-splitting shriek.
description:
This bat has grown to the size of a hunting hound. The skin of its wings
is scarred from stone and iron, and its oversized ears make every sudden
sound an irritation. When threatened it releases a piercing shriek
before plunging teeth-first at the source.

long: A red-muzzled bloodwing bat watches from the darkness.
description:
The bloodwing is a heavy cave bat with reddish membrane along the inner
wings and fresh stains around its muzzle. It feeds on wounded animals
and anything too slow to escape the roost. Its eyes track exposed skin
with unsettling focus.

long: A silverfin trout flashes beneath the reservoir water.
description:
This healthy trout has found its way into the underworks through natural
waterways connected to the river. Its silver scales catch even the
faintest light as it searches the reservoir shallows for insects and
drifting scraps.

long: An eyeless white cavefish drifts through the dark water.
description:
Generations in darkness have left this pale fish without useful eyes. It
navigates by current and vibration, moving calmly through water that
would hide it completely from surface predators.

long: A giant pale mussel rests on the reservoir floor.
description:
This ancient freshwater shellfish has grown far beyond ordinary size in
the mineral-rich reservoir. Its ridged shell is thick enough to turn
blades, and it snaps shut with surprising force when disturbed. The
oldest specimens sometimes hide valuable pearls.

long: A lean brown hare picks through scrub near the old works.
description:
This wary hare lives among the rocks and weeds outside Midgaard's walls,
feeding on whatever survives around the drainage slopes. It freezes at
unfamiliar sounds before bolting for the nearest cover.

long: A lean striped cat watches the sewer vent with professional interest.
description:
This half-feral cat has learned that the forgotten vent provides an
endless supply of rats, bats, and insects. Several small scars cross its
nose, but its yellow eyes remain bright and calculating. It tolerates
people only when they do not interfere with the hunt.

long: A red fox pads quietly along the old service path.
description:
A healthy fox patrols the low hills outside the city, hunting rabbits
and rodents drawn to the drainage works. Its coat is dusty from the
rocks, and it keeps a careful distance from anything larger than itself.

long: A huge scarred rat worries at the ironwork around the sluice grate.
description:
This broad sewer rat has grown heavy on the richer refuse washed down
from the upper city. One side of its muzzle is scarred white, several
incisors are worn flat from chewing iron, and its shoulders are thick
enough to make the creature look almost boar-like. A corroded key has
become tangled in cord and wire around its neck.

long: The still form of Slaive lies beside a narrow black-bladed knife.
description:
Slaive was once one of Midgaard's most elusive thieves, and death has
done little to make him less dangerous. His flesh has dried tightly
over the bones, old leather armor hangs in strips from his frame, and
one ruined eye remains fixed on the room as if waiting for a mistake.
Nightneedle rests close to one hand. The corpse is too carefully
positioned to feel truly dead.

keywords: bone fed sewer rat pale rat
long: A lean pale rat noses among fragments of old bone.
description:
This lower-underworks rat is smaller than the sluice-maw above but
quicker and far less cautious. Its fur has faded to a dirty gray, and
tiny chips of bone cling around its muzzle. The creature has learned
that the breached burial passages provide easier food than fighting
the stronger rats of the upper sewer.

long: A slick gravewater lurker clings to the edge of the dark channel.
description:
The creature resembles an enormous segmented leech with short gripping
limbs along its underside. Its translucent skin shows dark fluid
pulsing through the body, and a circular mouth flexes whenever
something warm approaches the water. It thrives where old burial
runoff mixes with the sewer current.

long: A waterlogged crawler drags itself from a broken burial niche.
description:
This hunched corpse was trapped when the old burial works flooded.
Mineral deposits crust its limbs, scraps of funerary cloth cling to
its torso, and its fingers have worn to exposed bone from clawing
through stone and silt. It moves without breath or hesitation, drawn
toward noise in the violated catacomb passages.

long: An ancient ossuary sentinel stands rigid among the burial niches.
description:
Bronze plates and rotted ceremonial wrappings cover a desiccated
guardian corpse. A funerary mask hides the face, but dim light burns
behind its eye slits whenever someone approaches the sealed catacomb.
The sentinel was placed here long before the sewer cut through the
burial complex and still follows an order no living citizen remembers.

long: The Pale Undertaker waits before the sealed threshold.
description:
Tall and unnaturally thin, the Pale Undertaker wears the remains of
layered burial robes beneath a mantle of gray dust. Its hands are
wrapped in old linen and hold no visible weapon. A smooth funerary
mask bears no mouth, yet the creature turns toward every sound in the
chamber. It seems less like a wandering corpse than the final
custodian of a place deliberately sealed away.

long: A eunuch stands here, guarding the harem.
description: He doesn't have any expression, nor anything special about him.

long: A sightseer is here, smiling at the sights.
description:
The woman looks as though she would be content wandering around all day,
seeing everything there is possible to see.  She is a traveler, judging by her
semi-poor clothes, and probably not possessing of a lot of material wealth.

long: A man is here, wandering aimlessly.
description:
The man just wanders around, his dull eyes absorbing all of the sights he can
see.

long: A woman is here, wandering around aimlessly.
description:
She looks like she has all the time in the world and nowhere to be.  She is
obviously very content with just seeing the sights.

long: A carver is here, selling his wares.
description:
The carver is middle-aged and obviously very proud of the works he displays,
carried in the two bags at his waist.  He politely encourages you to buy some of
his works, unlike some of the people around DEMANDING you buy their wares.

long: A woman yells here, selling kitchenware.
description:
The woman looks rather poor, but happy in her work of yelling at the passers
by to buy her wonderful kitchenware!

long: A man stands here, selling his furniture.
description: This man is selling his furniture, and would like your business.

long: A maid stands here, looking for dust.
description:
She looks as though dust is her worst enemy - and she shall wipe out the
entire species if she can!

long: Degruziel's advisor stands here, looking important.
description: He looks like he thinks himself very important.

long: A bodyguard stands here, looking mean.
description:
The bodyguard looks as though he knows what he's going - protecting.  He also
doesn't look like the kind of person to mess with without thinking about it
first.

long: An elite patrolman is here, walking Haven and looking for trouble.
description:
He looks as if he enjoys keeping the peace for Haven.  It would be unwise to
make him angry.

long: An elite guard stands here, protecting the innocent.
description:
This guard looks as if he knows the use of his weapon well.  It would be a
bad idea to cross him.

long: A citizen is here, resting and looking about himself happily.
description:
This man is obviously enjoying his life.  He loves his town, Haven, and just
sits here, enjoying all of the life that goes on around him.

long: A bard is here, singing to a strummed tune.
description:
His voice is clear and strong.  It is so good it might make you wish to give
him coin...  Or buy him supper.

long: A tumbler is here, doing handstands.
description:
This tumbler is tall, thin, and lightning quick.  He draws a crowd on good
