days, and appears to make a living off his skill.

long: A busty tavern wench is here, serving drinks.
description:
She looks rather busty, but don't try anything...  She looks as though she
wouldn't take any crap from anyone.  Some of the men in the room give her
fearful glances if she so much as makes a slight threatening move.

long: An unusual-looking mud slick is here, swirling.
description: It looks dirty....  It looks like mud.  Wow.  It might even be a snake.

long: Little bubbles pip up through the water here.
description: There is something strange about those bubbles...

long: A yappy dog stands here, barking... and barking... and barking...
description:
This dog is small and white, with brown markings.  Apparently she likes to
bark because she barks at everything that moves...  And even things that don't
move.  This dog barks at her own shadow.

long: A cat is here, looking small but fast.
description:
This cat is small, but has muscles that indicate it could move like
lightning.

long: A rabid dog stands here, looking mean.
description:
This dog is skinny and on his last leg of life.  Foams surrounds his mouth.
He is obviously rabid.  He is also obviously a very LARGE dog.

long: A rat is here... boy is it huge.
description:
This rat looks at you with beady, unafraid eyes as if it can see right
through you.  It appears completely unafraid.

long: A serving boy is here, bearing a pitcher full of wine.
description:
This boy walks around the room asking those with glasses if they would like a
refill.

long: A gentleman stands here, looking about himself in disgust.
description:
This gentleman is obviously used to company with more morals and higher
intelligence.  He looks around at the opulence around him with disgust, appalled
at such wasteful spending.  After all, this money could go to help the poor!

long: A well-born lady stands here, busily seducing the other guests.
description:
This lady is wear a dress that hints at everything but reveals nothing.  Her
demeanor and speech is of the high born, but she acts like a harlot, using her
feminine allure on everyone nearby.

long: An honored guest stands here, arrogantly sipping some wine.
description:
Between his arrogant sips this guest talks about the downfalls of killing off
all the poor people in the world, as if he is convincing himself not to.  His
manner shows he was born rich and has never known poverty as anything but
missing a meal.

long: A manor guard stands here, guarding.
description:
This manor guard looks as if he is very importantly guarding...  Something.
It must be important to him at least.  He closely scrutinizes everyone that
walks past.

long: Degruziel's bodyguard stands here, watching him protectively.
description:
He looks very strong, and he plainly wishes to take care of anyone and
everyone that might wish harm his master...  By putting them six feet under.

long: A smiling woman stands here, not looking... very smart...
description:
This woman is blankly smiling at air, ignoring anything and everything around
her.  One might mistake her for the typical high-born woman, but there is some
sort of glint deep in her eyes that you can't quite place.

long: A filcher stands here, half-hidden by the shadows.
description:
The filcher looks as though he is trying to hide in any and all nearby
shadows.  You would think that attempting to hide in shadows would make you
inconspicuous, but apparently that isn't the case.  Dodging around and trying to
walk quietly is only getting this filcher noticed.

long: A pickpocket is here, trying to blend in with the shadows.
description:
He has long, slender fingers that he twists along the bottom of his shirt
with a deft twist.  As he sees you looking his way he tries to fit into the
shadows.

long: A small child stands here, adjusting her fake peg leg.
description:
She looks as if she is already a professional at her young age, about to go
out and cheat a few tourists out of their money.  She adjusts her fake peg leg
and gets ready to go out for a round of begging.

long: A smiling man stands here, rubbing at his slightly crooked moustache.
description:
The man is short and slender, rather curvy for a man.  He wears black, baggy
clothes.  His black moustache is slightly crooked.  It looks as if he messed up
his trimming slightly.

long: A shadowy form is here.
description: You can't really make out the features.

long: A man is here, sleeping in his bedroll.
description: He is quite obviously asleep in his bedroll, and that is that.

long: A black-clad bully stands here, picking his nails with a dagger.
description:
He looks as if he would push around his own mother until he received all of
her money.  Then he might just kill her for the fun of it.  He doesn't look like
a nice guy.  He is clad all in black, and would blend in well with any shadows.

long: The King of Luna's Alley is here, appearing slightly more sane than his peers.
description:
The King of Luna's Alley has a small glint of sanity left in his eyes, though
why somebody would want to be the king of this place is a sign of insanity in
itself.  Some people are just different...  Whatever floats your boat.

long: A bum stands here, quietly cackling.
description:
This bum has obviously gone insane, as he just stands here quietly cackling
to himself.

long: A paranoid schizophrenic stands here, screaming at the world.
description: It looks as if this crazy person is on one of their screaming phrases.

long: A halfwit sits here, drooling.
description:
The halfwit is thoroughly content to just sit here and stare at the ground
all day, watching their drool accumulate into a small puddle.

long: A gibbering madman stands here, talking to the wall.
description:
He looks quite insane, but his face is sincere as he talks to the wall in a
language that only they can understand.

long: A raving lunatic is here, preaching the destruction of the world.
description:
The raving lunatic is clad only in what rags he could find.  He might have
once been a handsome man, but now he has scars across his cheeks.  The look like
they might have been caused by fingernails.  Perhaps his own.

long: The ship's cook stands here, brandishing a baked bread nastily.
description:
He looks just like any other sailor, except he wears an apron and angrily
brandishes a herring at his simmering delights.

long: Mithroq stands here, his horns almost scraping the ceiling.
description:
Mithroq is a huge minotaur.  His muscles bulge and twist as he works at his
art, creating weapons.  He looks super-strong, and has the marks of many
battles.  His left horn is broken in half, and scars mark his brown fur.  He
doesn't look like someone you would want to mess with.

long: Tia stands here, mixing a potion and looking ready to help you.
description:
The mistress of the shop is here.  Tia is a thin, frail woman who wears
flowing blue robes.  She can always be seen mixing a potion or two, or helping
people find things in her shop.

long: Milos stands behind the counter here, happily counting his money.
description:
Milos is a short, thin man of middle age with a short moustache.  His only
love in life is his money, and your money.  He would love to hold your money for
you while you are out adventuring.

long: The wandering shopper stands here, looking for a merchant to spend money on.
description:
One of the many wealthy shoppers looking to waste more off their hard earned
money.

long: A fisherman's wife stands here, looking around and muttering.
description:
She looks as though she is looking for someone, and she is not very happy
about it.  Perhaps her husband went to the bar again and she doesn't yet know
it.  No matter, she is angry anyway.

long: A sunbather lies here, enjoying lying in the sand.
description:
She looks as if she could just sunbathe all day long and then look at the
stars all night.  She doesn't appear to have a care in the world.

long: A citizen is here, strolling past.
description: He looks as if he is enjoying the fine scenery.

long: A citizen is here, strolling past.
description: She looks as if she is enjoying the fine scenery.

long: A king crab is here, looking mean.
description: The king crab does @RNOT@n like intruders in his lair.

long: The Captain's woman is here, looking at the Captain with dreamy eyes.
description:
She looks as if she is lost in her own little world.  She is staring at the
Captain as if she doesn't really see him, but there is a wide smile on her face
as if she is remembering something pleasant.

long: The Captain of the ship stands here, looking off into space.
description:
The Captain of the ship is very involved with his daydream.  After all, he
has no work to do now that the ship is in the port.  He wears a soft smile, as
though his daydream is good.  He also doesn't like people in his quarters...

long: A man stands here, next to the rope connected to the net.
description:
This man looks as though he will, when ordered, pull the rope so that the net
will drop all of its fish onto the deck.  He has a spare net draped over his
shoulder, in case the current one needs repairs.

long: A fish pitcher is here, throwing fish over the edge of the deck.
description:
He goes about his work like a pro, throwing the heavy fish over the edge of
the deck without even looking.  He knows there is and always will be cartmen
down there waiting for him to throw a fish down into their carts.

long: A man with a cart stands here, waiting patiently.
description:
He stands next to a ship, waiting patiently for his turn to get his cart
filled so that he may hurry away to the market and the vendor that wishes to
purchase the fish.

long: A man speeds through the crowd here with his cart.
description:
He looks as if he is in a hurry to get himself and his cart to wherever it is
he is going, and he isn't going to stop for anything if he can help it.

long: A patron of the bar stands here, singing loudly.
description:
He looks as if he has enjoyed a few too many of the local drinks.  He sings
in a loud clear voice, a bawdy sailing song.

long: Gilles the Bartender stands here, patiently polishing glasses.
description:
He doesn't look like much.  He is young, slightly handsome, but his eyes have
a hard glint to them that shows you he has seen his share of fights.  His
muscular arms could easily break up any brawls, should they start.  He doesn't
look at you, but you know he wishes you to buy a drink if you wish to stay any
length of time.

long: A drunken man is here, stumbling around in circles.
description:
This man stumbles and drools in such a manner that it is very obvious he has
had more than a few too many drinks.  He occasionally mutters insults to his
imaginary friend, whom the drunk often accuses of tripping him.  You can see
some of the people nearby looking at him with obvious disgust, but some just
plain don't care.  They see enough of his kind since the tavern was built.

long: Aramut the wizened old man stands here, waiting to help you.
description:
Aramut is tall and skinny, and has the rolling walk of one who had once been
a sailor.  He looks very old, but not at all weak.  His skinny frame is wiry
with the muscles he had acquired, as he has worked for long years as the armorer
of Haven.  He impatiently taps his fingers on the counter as he waits for you to
tell him what you wish of him.

long: A cartman stands here, rummaging around in the back of his cart.
description:
This cartman is casually rummaging around in the back of his cart, looking
over his goods.  It looks pretty full, and the man looks very alert and
possessive of it.  The cartman is a big, muscular man who looks as if he knows
the use of his weapon.  His muscles ripple as he casually tosses heavy chairs
and such from one side of his cart to the other.  From his dress he looks like a
sailor, as do most of the people in Haven.

long: An especially beautiful harem girl is here, being over-pampered and envied by the other girls
description:
It looks unfinished.  C/c This harem girl looks as if she gets all the
special attention she could ever want or need.  She even has a few gifts from
Degruziel to her.  She appears very happy with what she does, even though some
other people might not like it...

long: A harem girl lounges here, beautiful and not wearing much.
description:
The harem girl looks very young, but it doesn't appear that she minds her
job.  After all, most of her day is spent sitting around and looking pretty.
She gets well-fed, well-paid, and she hardly has to do anything now that
Degruziel has a favorite, and it isn't her.  She thinks she has it made, and it
shows on her pampered face.

long: A kitchenmaid stands here covered in flour, mixing something.
description:
The young kitchenmaid glances apprehensively over her shoulder as she
hurriedly pours contents into a mixing bowl.  Sometimes her glance will stray to
Tiama, if she is present.  It is quite possible this young girl is afraid of the
head cook, like so many of her smart peers.

long: A half-mad prisoner is shackled here in the filth, muttering to himself
description:
The prisoner looks as though he has been beaten several times and starved, he
is as thin as a toothpick.  He is manacled to the wall, and muttering all sorts
of nonsense.  Occasionally he will let out a yell for help, however.  Maybe you
should listen to him.

long: Degruziel's Master of Torture stands here, looking very sinister.
description:
The Master of Torture doesn't like intruders into his lair....  Which means
you.

long: Tiama, the Head Cook of Haven, stands here covered from head to toe in flour.
description:
Tiama is plump from tasting her own creations, but she waves her spoon around
as if she isn't afraid to give any of the kitchen girls a good whack.

long: Degruziel, the Lord of Haven, is here, lounging lazily and conversing with his guests.
description:
Degruziel is lazing around, but the way his eyes quickly shift to take
everything in tells you he is an experienced warrior.  His hand rests casually
on the mace at his belt, as if he wouldn't be afraid to use it if things got out
of hand.

long: A rich guest stands here, casually sipping some expensive wine.
description:
With his well-tailored clothes and his expensive jewelry, this painted man
looks as though he cares nothing about the poor or their welfare.  The glass of
wine he so casually sips looks as though it could be sold for enough money to
feed a fishing family for weeks.

long: A manservant of Degruziel stands here, attending to... whatever it is he's attending to.
description:
This manservant looks like he's hurriedly going about doing something very
important...  Though what exactly it is he's doing is unapparent.

long: The Stablemaster stand here... what?! A WOMAN?!?!
description:
This woman looks as tough - if not tougher - than any man around.  How else
would she get the job as stablemaster?  She talks to the horses as if she speaks
their language.

long: A stableboy stands here, contemplating life as he mucks out stalls.
description:
He looks very unhappy with his job, but at least it gets him food and a warm
bed.  He mucks out the stalls mechanically, giving his pitchfork an expert twist
every time he throws something into the nearby wheelbarrow.

long: A donkey is here, plodding away with its head down.
description:
The plodding donkey looks like she is very bored, but the muscles she has
received from hauling things to and fro all day have given her bulging muscles.

long: A cartman stands here, swearing profusely at the traffic and his draft animal.
description:
The swearing cartman is red in the face from anger.  The long strings of
expletives coming from his mouth make the people around him wince and cover
their children's ears.

long: A prancing horse stands here, tossing its pretty head.
description:
The horse tosses its head and snorts, full of energy and eager to be off.
It looks more like a rider's horse, not a cart horse, and is full of spirit.

long: A merchant stands here, advertising his wares at the top of his lungs.
description:
This merchant looks disappointed - apparently he hasn't had much business
today.  He keeps his hand on his weapon as if he knows it well, probably to ward
off thieves.

long: A sailor stands here, walking like he belongs on the sea.
description:
He looks rather burly and rather mean, so you might want to leave him alone.
He also looks like he could hold his own in a fight.

long: An outlander stands here looking very confused.
description:
He is short with wavy black hair, something that doesn't fit the setting of
Haven very well.  He also appears very confused, listening intently and trying
to figure out what people around him are saying.

long: An admirer of Haven is here, appearing awestruck.
description:
The woman is clad in the garb of one who travels much, and her mouth is
slightly open as she looks around with wide eyes at the sights.

long: A little boy stands here, smiling happily.
description:
The little boy is happily whistling as he looks around.  Something about his
manner tells you that he is probably skipping out on his chores to view the
town.

long: A woman of Haven is here, humming softly to herself.
description:
A tall, stately woman is here in a pretty dress, probably on her way to a
vendor in the market.  She appears to be richly dressed, and is probably a
merchant's wife.

long: A short, matronly citizen of Haven is here, her patched dress billowing in the constant breeze.
description:
This motherly woman stands here in the breeze, her colorful and heavily
patched dress billowing.  She calls out a name, probably of her child, and she
has an angry look on her face.  Boy, is somebody in trouble.

long: A citizen of Haven
description:
The burly man of Haven stands here, his pipe hanging from his mouth.  He
looks as though he is talking to himself about the market prices.

long: An elite gatekeeper stands here looking bored.
description:
An elite gatekeeper often wonders why he was chosen for the monotonous job
of watching Haven's gates.  The usually peaceful city doesn't see much trouble
from the merchants and tourists, so his days pass slowly as he wishes for
excitement.

long: A diligent carver stands here, biting on the end of his knife.
description:
Having devoted his entire life to this work, the diligent carver is almost
completely absorbed in the gates of Haven, always seeking to improve them with
his skillful hand and his sharp knife.

long: A grass snake is coiled up in the grass.
description:
He really isn't very big, but he looks very mean.  He watches the surroundings
with his yellow eyes, ready to attack.

long: A giant mosquito is here.
description:
The creature is rather large looking.  She is almost the size of a bird!
It would be wise to not upset her.

long: A firefly is here.
description:
This creature flits around through the various tangled weeds.  She appears
much larger than any average firefly would be.

long: A bluebird flies past you and lands on a nearby branch.
description:
The creature is rather small, but looks to be quite tough.  It would be a
mistake to under estimate him.

long: A large bear is standing here.
description:
The creature is enormous and could very easily rip an average humanoid to
shreds.  Maybe it would be wise to just leave him alone.

long: A small chipmunk is here looking at you.
description:
She chitters at any intruders, warning them to stay away.  Her teeth are
razor sharp and one of her ears has a small hole in it.  No doubt a battle scar.

long: A cricket is sitting here.
description:
The creature blends in with the grass and she is very hard to see.  She can
easily hide from her enemies in here.

long: A cute little mouse is here.
description:
The mouse looks up with his big black eyes.  He looks to be harmless, but
looks can be deceiving.

long: A zombie staggers limply around.
description:
The creature is quite horrid looking.  His skin has just about completely
rotted away.  The skin that is left is gray and holds a nasty odor.  Strangely
enough, his teeth are in perfectly chiseled condition.

long: A mean looking ghoul is here.
description:
This strange creature shimmers in and out of existence, its body shadowy and
surreal.

long: A skeleton stands before you.
description:
There is not much left to this creature.  It's just a stack of bones, but its
grinning teeth and large empty eyes seem to have a predatory gleam.

long: An enormous slug is here.
description:
The creature is filthy from the dirt and looks to be very slimy.  It doesn't
look like it could do much to protect itself, but looks can be deceiving.

long: A rat sniffs about for food.
description:
This large hairy rat looks insatiably hungry, its nose twitching
uncontrollably as it scuttles about searching for something to eat.

long: A beautiful redbird is sitting on the side of the bridge.
description:
The bird is rather simple looking.  He appears to be missing a few feathers,
likely from previous battles.

long: A muskrat is here.
description:
She glances around warily with her mangled face.  Her face is covered in
battle scars.  She hisses at any intruders, warning them to stay away.

long: A slimy leech is here.
description:
The creature sticks to some weeds that are sticking out of the water.  She
watches for intruders very closely, ready to attack.

long: A bullfrog is sitting here.
description:
The creature ribbits leisurely to itself as various other animals wander by.
He is by far most bigger than most bullfrogs would ever naturally be.

long: A crow is flying around above you.
description:
Her beak is enormous and she could probably swallow a large animal whole!
Her claws are in bad need of clipping.  You notice she is missing a few
feathers.

long: A grasshopper hops from place to place.
description:
She looks like any other grasshopper, but it wouldn't be wise to
underestimate her.  She could be quite tough.

long: A small boy is here playing in the dirt.
description:
He looks up at the hint of any disruption.  His hands are covered in dirt.
You can see a slight glowing aura within his eyes.

long: Jedidiah is standing here, waiting to help you.
description:
Jedidiah is a tall man with dark eyes.  He looks very mysterious, but
friendly.

long: A teenager is standing here.
description:
She stands at the side of the road looking at you.  You suddenly feel like a
stranger.  She looks harmless enough, but you shouldn't anger her.

long: Samuel the shopkeeper is here.
description:
He is a shorter man with no hair.  He is slightly on the chubby side, but
looks very friendly.

long: A caterpillar is here.
description:
The creature is covered in fur, ranging from brown to black.  She looks much
larger than a normal sized caterpillar.

long: A rabbit is here.
description:
He looks at you curiously, watching your every move.  His fur is very fluffy
and clean.  It doesn't look like he's ever been dirty.

long: A raccoon is standing here.
description:
The raccoon stands there watching you.  You notice her eyes start to glow as
a low growl begins coming from within her.

long: A mean looking coyote is here.
description:
He looks at you with his cold dark eyes.  You suddenly feel like maybe you
shouldn't have come here.  As he snarls at you, you see some blood dried to his
teeth.

long: A ghost is floating around before you.
description:
You can see right through the creature, almost as if it wasn't there at all.
You can hear a soft crying noise coming from within it.

long: Zachary the shopkeep is standing here.
description:
He is a rather small man, but appears to be very tough.  You probably
couldn't fight him alone.

long: A finch is here.
description:
The creature is very small and delicate looking.  She seems to be in
excellent condition, but looks can be deceiving.

long: A wolf is standing here.
description:
He looks at you with his cold eyes, ready to attack.  Maybe if you're quiet
and sneak past him he won't attack you.  But then again, maybe not.

long: A large dreadful snake is at your feet, hissing at you.
description:
This heavy-bodied snake is about 5 feet long.  It is gray with black
crossbands that are chevron-shaped.  These rattlesnakes are generally passive if
not disturbed or pestered in some way.  When a rattlesnake is encountered, the
safest reaction is to back away -- it will not try to attack you if you leave it
alone.

long: A small green snake is here, and it doesn't look too friendly...
description:
It looks harmless.  It appears to be a slender garter snake.  It is about 2
feet long and starts slithering away as you approach.

long: A small centipede is here, making its way across the floor.
description: It looks completely harmless.

long: An ugly kobold is here, searching for dinner.
description: It looks ugly.

long: The orc walks around, looking for someone to kill.
description: You notice an evil look in its eyes...

long: A large orc is here, looking really mean.
description: He looks dreadful.

long: A tall warrior is here.  He has more scars than anyone you have ever seen.
description: He seems to be a strong, brainless fighter.

long: A tall warrior is here.
description: He seems to know his way with weapons.

long: A small hobgoblin stands here.
description: The hobgoblin looks quite lost.

long: A brown snake watches you.
description:
The snake looks quite mean.  It stretches about 4 feet long.  The color
pattern is variable, but the back is drab brown.  The snake stands its ground
and hisses at you.

long: A white centipede is here.
description: The centipede doesn't really seem to notice you.

long: A large hobgoblin is here.
description: The hobgoblin looks quite dangerous.

long: An orc is here, looking for something (or perhaps someone?) to eat.
description: Well, he doesn't seem to be friendly.

long: A mountain lion is here, growling at you viciously.
description: The lion looks very nasty with huge claws and big teeth.

long: A hill giant is here, tossing some rocks around.
description:
The hill giant looks like he's about 9 feet tall.  By his actions you quickly
come to the conclusion that he isn't very intelligent.

long: A small intelligent looking mage is standing here.
description:
His IQ makes almost any normal person look stupid...  It looks like he knows
his way with magic.

long: A large mean-looking troll is here.
description: Well, it looks dangerous!

long: A large green snake is here, looks like a guardian for an evil force.
description:
You see a evil creature.  The snake measures at least 5 feet in length and is
coiled into a tight circle hissing at you.

long: A thief is here, all dressed in black.
description:
He seems to be counting a handful of coins.  Maybe you ought to count YOUR
gold too...

long: A ugly orc is standing here.
description: It is quite disgusting to look at.

long: A small harmless centipede is here.
description: Well it doesn't seem to pay any attention to you.

long: A human warrior is here.  He has a evil grin in his face.
description: He doesn't look friendly at all...

long: A green kobold is here.
description: It looks slimy..

long: A red dragon is curled up here.
description:
As you get close enough to see the small details, the dragon whips its snout
toward you, breathing a small cloud of smoke.

long: The King of the Dragons reclines on his tail here.
description:
He looks extremely large, and as you lean a little forward to look closer, he
narrows his eyes and breathes a cloud of sulfur smoke into your face, making you
cough and take a step backwards.

long: A dragon hatchling is lying here curled up into a ball
description: It looks up at you and breathes a small tongue of flame.

long: A large, hulking troll is standing here.
description: It looks big, and very hungry...

long: A dragon is here, blocking your way
description: He looks at you, and you see a dangerous glint in his eye...

long: An elf is here, mopping the floor.
description:
She looks up at you sadly, and you can tell by her eyes that she was broken
by the dragons long ago.

long: A green dragon is standing here!
description:
The green dragon is big, strong, and dangerous, Unfortunately for you, it has
already seen you, so there is no good in running.

long: The King of the Dragons reclines on his tail here.
description:
He looks extremely large, and as you lean a little forward to look closer, he
narrows his eyes and breathes a cloud of sulfur smoke into your face, making you
cough and take a step backwards.

long: Guldane's Income mob.
description: I have not idea what this is for.

long: Guldane's Shopkeeper stands here
description: He has only 2 items....

long: A black penguin waddles around here.
description:
This penguin looks very hungry.  But he also looks very determined.  He looks
toward the large body of water to the east probably waiting for food to come
from the females.

long: A new born penguin is standing here.
description:
The new born penguin is very small, roughly one-forth the size of an average
human.  It is very fluffy with down to keep it warm.  The little penguins
parents are never too far away from it if ever.

long: The royal penguin is here, lounging in his chair.
description:
This penguin is the authority of this little land.  His coat his black and
white as usual with penguins, but he is the most well groomed penguin you've
seen.  On his head sits a crown of ice and in his hand a scepter of great power.

long: The royal penguin's guard is here, protecting his king.
description:
This penguin looks, well, buff.  It's hard to believe but a buff penguin is
here with a blank stare.  He seems to be looking at absolutely nothing but you
feel his eyes looking you over.  Should you be here?

long: An orphaned penguin stands here, lonely.
description:
This penguin looks so depressed.  You can't help but feel sorry for it.
It's cute little eyes and fluffy self...  Snap out of it!  Muahahahaha!

long: The penguin caretaker stands here, watching her adopted children.
description:
This penguin looks just like-a- house wife!  The tired eyes and the whole get
up.  That has not got to be fun.

long: The penguin caretaker is standing here, keeping a watchful eye out.
description:
The penguin looks a little better trimmed than the female but just as
exhausted.

long: A walrus is here, flopping around.
description:
This walrus is a fine looking specimen.  Fat, blubbery, and well, fat.  It's
tucks are at least a foot and a half long and the shiniest white.

long: The eskimo baker stands here, waiting to serve you.
description:
It looks unfinished.  The baker is here bundled up in eskimo finery, skins
and fur.  He stands behind the counter of this igloo with meat of different
kinds hanging from the walls.  He turns toward you as you enter, ready to serve.

long: The weaponrist is here shaping a new spear.
description:
The weaponrist is working here.  She has a large hammer that is striking a
long, thin sheet of metal with a point at one end.  She is sweating bullets as
you freeze your bum off outside.

long: The outfitter is here ready to send you away warmly clothed.
description:
This eskimo is garbed inn finely laid and pressed hide and fur clothes.  Her
eyes pierce your soul though you cannot see her except for those eyes.  She
stands as you enter trying to help as much as possible.

long: The butcher is here hacking away at another piece of meat.
description:
He looks very pleased with himself as he hacks down another mass of flesh and
bones.  He looks very fierce with that large butchers knife in his hand.

long: A seriously menacing orc is here, growling at you.
description:
This orc looks really ugly, and you realize that wherever he's from, he sure
wasn't first in line when the gods handed out beauty.  However, there seem to be
nothing amiss with his sword arm, and he doesn't seem to like you.

long: A seriously menacing orc is here, resting.
description:
The terrible orc is here, resting and having a quiet and of course
unintelligent conversation with his friends.

long: A seriously menacing orc is getting a - much needed - beauty sleep here.
description:
The orc is battle-scarred, and seem to have just been in a fight.  You guess
he's just getting ready to go back in the fray.

long: H'Ogh the Half-ogre is here, guarding the Boss' tent.
description:
A closer examination of H'Ogh reveals an extremely ugly halfogre.  He
obviously lives in this room, just to protect the Boss around the clock.  As if
he knew what that is.

long: Dra'L the Half-ogre is here, guarding the Boss' tent.
description:
A closer examination of Dra'L reveals an extremely ugly halfogre.  He
obviously lives in this room, just to protect the Boss around the clock.  As if
he knew what that is.

long: The Boss, chief of the raiding orcs, is sitting on his throne, contemplating.
description:
The Boss is not even an orc himself, but actually an ogre, which gives him a
big physical advantage over his people.  This also makes for small differences
in world view, but after the introduction of his personal guards H'Ogh and
Dra'L, there has been little said against his position.  As you look closer he
turns to you and reaches for his sword.

long: The orc Shaman is here, screaming, because you interrupted the spell.
description:
This little orc is not pretty, but being totally covered by a purple robe
helps a bit.  He seems to be all but out of his mind, and you decide to put him
out of his misery.

long: A ferret wearing monk robes stands here.
description:
You see a very calm monk.  He walks around with a serene look on his face.
This is a creature completely at peace with him self.  He is dressed in some
nice red robes, and wearing a pair of worn out sandals.

long: A mousy looking monk stands here.
description: You see a mouse wearing a monk's robe.  He is walking about intently.

long: A squirrel monk darts around.
description:
You see a monk.  This one has a rather large, bushy tail, and seems to have a
weird twitch.

long: An assistant stands here nervously.
description:
You see a rabbit wearing an apron.  He looks exhausted and overworked.
Maybe his shift has been a little too long...

long: A large badger stands here, barking orders.
description:
You see a VERY large badger.  She is ranting and raving at various helpers
within the kitchen.  She looks upset.

long: A phoenix nests here.
description:
You see one of the legendary phoenix's here.  It is scarred and is missing
patches of feathers.  One wing hangs slightly limp.  It's head contains a crest
with several very long ornamental feathers.

long: The abbot calmly stands here.
description:
You see a large otter wearing saintly robes.  He is standing quietly,
watching the people sitting within the pews as the choir behind him sings
quietly.

long: A gopher sits here, watching you intently.
description: You see an ordinary gopher.  It seems a little big for it's kind.

long: A guard stands here.
description:
You see a cleanly shaven man in a military uniform.  He is dressed in a green
suit.  On his back hangs a quiver and a bow.  A sword hangs loosely by his side.
He stares at you, waiting for a response.

long: A sentry stands here.
description: You see a very alert guard, intently gazing into the surrounding territory.

long: A large green dragon prowls here.
description:
A large green wall of muscle stands before you.  As it moves, you can see
large thick muscles ripple under is skin as it moves silently through the
forest.  To large red eyes turn and concentrate on you.  You shudder as you feel
a wave of hate and anger ripple through you from the dragon.

long: An archer patrols the walls.
description:
You see a strongly build guard.  He walks around, watching over the wall for
any sign of movement in the forest, which he takes care of with one quickly shot
arrow.

long: A green worker ant toils away mindlessly for its queen.
description:
The green worker ant is the powerhouse behind this anthill.  It slaves away
almost constantly, digging new tunnels, gathering food, and even protecting the
hill from other bugs.

long: A red soldier ant is invading the anthill.
description:
Sent by the red queen to seek and destroy for progression and expansion of
the red ant colony.  This red soldier ant has been sent here to eliminate the
existing residents.

long: A green soldier ant is protecting the anthill.
description:
The green soldier ant was born and raised to protect the queen and the entire
anthill.  They do no work, but will sacrifice themselves for the queen.

long: A huge green soldier ant stands here ready to die protecting the Queen.
description:
This special soldier ant has been given the sole responsibility of protecting
the queen from attack.  It is by far one of the largest ants in the entire
anthill.

long: The green queen ant is ensuring the survival of the species.
description:
She has no purpose other than to lead the anthill, and breed.  She is huge
and it doesn't look like she could ever fit through any of the tunnels.  She
guards over her newborn larvae.

long: A large green dominant male ant skitters about, making sure the workers tend their jobs.
description:
This large dominant male green ant is second only to the queen.  Its purpose
is to ensure everything gets done and the queen keeps pumping out cute little
larvae.

long: A cute little bunny is here.
description: She is white with red eyes and looks harmless, but looks can be deceiving.

long: A dirty boy is waiting for the next apple to fall.
description:
This little thief is too short to reach the apples over his head.  Instead
he waits for the ripe apples to fall from the breeze.

long: A small mouse is here.
description:
He is rather small and scrawny looking.  His teeth look very sharp and would
hurt terribly if he bit you.

long: An old farmer sits underneath the shade of the apple tree.
description:
He wears a set of old ratty coveralls and is picking his teeth with a bit of
hay.

long: An ugly little rooster is here.
description:
He is perhaps the ugliest rooster you have ever seen.  He is missing over
half of his feathers and has a large scar over his left eye.

long: A large rat is here.
description:
The creature looks up at you with it's big dark eyes.  They look black.
The hair on the rat is matted down, probably from some sewer water.

long: A sly looking weasel is here.
description: She looks very sneaky and could easily sneak up on her prey.

long: A goose is here, walking along the trail.
description: Her feathers are as white as snow, she looks friendly enough to touch.

long: A furry little chick is here.
description: She is a small little thing and looks quite weak.

long: A hen is here.
description:
She is mean looking and quite ugly.  Her eyes give you the chilling feeling
of death.

long: A large dog is here.
description:
He is very bony, but appears to be very tough.  It might be wise to leave
him alone.

long: Farmer Pete is here, busily working.
description:
He is a husky man.  Well built, but friendly looking.  His silver hair
reflects in the sunlight.

long: A cow is here.
description: She is very clean and well groomed.

long: A lazy barn cat is roaming around here.
description:
He is a large creature, and could probably use a diet.  His fur is orange
with stripes of brown.

long: An ugly crow is here.
description:
He looks like he should be dead.  He is covered in scars.  You notice some
blood on his beak.

long: Helen, the farmers wife is standing here.
description:
She is a kind looking old woman.  Her hair is still its natural brown.  She
must be younger than the farmer.

long: A sheep is here.
description: She looks very tired.  Maybe you should let her rest.

long: A small calf is here.
description:
She looks up at you with her young innocent eyes.  How could you ever harm
her?

long: A young farm boy named Jonathan is here.
description:
He is a scrawny little thing, but quite tall.  He makes you think of a twig.
His face is boney and looks like it's been caved in.  How gross!

long: An owl is here
description:
She is quite large, but very beautiful.  Her white feathers look like
freshly fallen snow.

long: A furry sheepdog is here.
description: He is quite friendly looking.  He must belong to the farmer.

long: A blackbird is flying around above you.
description: She is old and mean looking.  She carries a lot of battle scars.

long: A raven is here.
description:
Her beak is long and sharp.  It would hurt greatly if she decided to bite
you.

long: A snarling wolf is here.
description:
His teeth drip with drool as he snarls at you, warning you to stay back.
Maybe you should just leave him alone.

long: A cute little squirrel is here.
description:
He is a cute little thing and probably wouldn't attack you unless you
provoked him.

long: A small gopher is here
description: She must be a baby.  She is half the size of a normal gopher.

long: A small bat is hanging from the wall.
description:
He is a small thing, but rather nasty looking.  His eyes look like 2 small
black holes.  They remind you of death.

long: A fiery colt is here.
description: He looks quite mean.  He must be the bully of the farm.

long: A mare is here.
description: She is a cute little thing, almost too weak to stand on her own.

long: A beautiful horse stands here.
description:
Her coat is a shiny brown.  You notice she has some white splotches on her
legs.

long: A fierce looking stallion is here.
description:
His eyes almost seem red as they stare at you, almost making you want to
leave.

long: An annoying turkey is here.
description:
He is more than ugly.  He is hideous looking!  His eyes seem to have a fog
in them.  Maybe he can't see as well as he used to.

long: A beautiful butterfly is here.
description:
His wings are splotched in many bright colors.  He is the most beautiful
creature you have ever seen.

long: Arthur is sitting here in his rocking chair, warming himself by the fire.
description:
He smiles at you when you look at him.  He must work somewhere on the farm
and hunt in his spare time.

long: A coyote is here.
description:
He is fierce looking.  His teeth are probably razor sharp and could easily
tear you open.

long: A hawk is here.
description:
She looks like a normal hawk, but her wings seems to be somewhat longer,
enabling her to fly faster.

long: A large roach is here.
description:
He is an ugly thing.  He has hair growing off his legs and is head looks
some what deformed.

long: A small sparrow is here.
description: She is delicate looking, but looks can be deceiving.

long: A raggedy dervish walks on aimlessly.
description: Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use some rest.

long: A large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
description: Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use LOTS of rest.

long: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
description:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.

long: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
description: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

long: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
description: He's big, mean, and purple.  Watch out!

long: A very large brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says 'Hello.'
description: Then adds to it, 'Prepare to die, have a nice day!  '

long: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
description:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread.  At his side is a large,
engraved cutlass.  He has an especially haughty air about him.

long: The nomad commander stands here staring at you suspiciously.
description:
This is the nomad leader's second in command.  His clothes are richly woven
of silk and gold thread.  A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.

long: A proud nomad warrior stands here.
description: This warrior is dressed in typical nomad clothing and looks quite mean.

long: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.
description: She looks quite thin and weak.

long: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
description:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.

long: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

long: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
description: The duergar could probably crush your head as easily as he does those rocks.

long: A myconoid lumbers along peacefully.
description:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably has the same
effect).

long: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tongue.
description: The shaman shoots spores into the air.

long: A small oasis invites you to dive in.
description:
Looking a little closer at this oasis, you begin to wonder why it seems to be
moving about...

long: A very dangerous creature, a camel, snorts at you.
description:
It is advisable not to mess with this creature.  After all, you have heard
many a horror story about experiences with camels.  Bad experiences.

long: A goblin slave lies here asleep.
description: The defenseless goblin begs for mercy.

long: A drow commoner is here, walking around on guard duty.
description: I doubt he is the type to give directions.

long: A drow warrior stands here guarding his home.
description: He looks kind of annoyed!

long: A drow mage is here protecting his home.
description: The mage prepares to cast a spell...  At you!!

long: A drow priestess is here shouting orders.
description: I wouldn't want go get on her bad side!

long: A drow master stares at you angrily.
description: The drow master is ALWAYS ready for a fight.

long: A drow weaponsmaster is here shadow boxing.
description: He definitely know his way around in combat.

long: The Matron Mother of the house is standing here.
description: She looks really and truly annoyed that you have found your way here.

long: The Matron Mother of the first house is waiting for you.
description: She looks like she is about to rip your head of and eat it.

long: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

long: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

long: A yochlol forms out of a swirling mist...
description: The yochlol is not in a good mood.

long: You meet a beholder's deadly gaze!
description:
It has a large central eye that projects an anti-magic ray and ten eye-stalks
atop the round body which can do anything from charm you to disintegrate you.
Beholders are not known for their personality.

long: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast.  She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

long: A strong chest lies in one corner of the room.
description:
A strong, wooden chest bound with iron straps and a heavy padlock on the
front.

long: Two skeletons lie crushed under a large boulder.
description:
This large boulder seems to have been dropped here at some point, since there
aren't any boulders native to this area.  The two skeletons beneath it are
simply that, bones...  No rags or anything else appears to be attached to them.

long: The stone floor of this house has been ripped apart.
description:
What a mess, you wonder to yourself what could have caused this rampant
destruction.

long: Some broken shards of pottery lie strewn about the floor.
description:
The pottery shards appear to have been part of a large vase at one point,
probably before the city fell.

long: A few wooden planks lie stacked on a low shelf.
description:
The fact that these planks still rest on this shelf leads you to believe that
someone has been here before you...

long: A small horned lizard flicks his tongue and slithers away.
description: A cute little lizard -- that is, if you like reptiles!

long: In the corner you see a large, stone golem faithfully standing watch.
description:
It is a big chunk of rock that has been magically formed into a giant stone
creature.  He stands here still guarding the city.

long: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast.  She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

long: A small, poisonous asp slithers over your feet.
description:
The asp is a small, smooth-scaled snake the color of worn pottery.  The
poison bite of this snake has felled many a mighty pharaoh.

long: A cobra snake rears up and opens its fearsome hood.
description:
The cobra snake waves back and forth before you, its hood displaying
brilliant colors designed to serve notice to its prey that it is about to
strike.

long: A small mongoose slinks along the ground, hunting snakes.
description:
The mongoose is a wily rodent, a quick hunter of nasty poisonous snakes.
She sniffs you and appears to be looking for food in your hand.

long: The pyramid watcher protects the tombs from intruders.
description:
The pyramid watcher has made a pledge to destroy any would-be looters of the
tombs of the pharaohs.  He is clad from head to foot in utilitarian sand-colored
clothing.

long: A sneaky tomb thief moves about in search of treasure.
description: The thief brushes against you briefly, then slinks back into the shadows.

long: Ali Baba is here, hunting for the pharaoh's tomb.
description:
You see a tall, full-bearded man with a mischievous glint in his eye.  Ali
Baba has made his life from stealing things from others, including many items
stolen recently from under the nose of the hapless guardians of this pyramid.
Someday he might get caught, but not today...

long: A small woven carpet lies under your feet.
description:
The carpet is simply beautiful, made from intricately woven silken material.
It seems to rise up at the touch of your feet.  Wait, it is rising, a few feet
above the ground!  In fact, it seems to be ALIVE!

long: A mummy reaches for you, disturbed by your presence.
description:
You only see the disfigured, rotting features of decaying human flesh,
animated by the distempered spirit of a long-deceased person.

long: A sandman rises up from the desert floor.
description:
The sandman is exactly that -- some sort of strange being formed from the
sands of the desert floor.  It seems quite large and strong and at home in the
heat and sandy winds.

long: The efreeti stands here, sheathed in a column of fire.
description:
The efreeti is a mighty being formed from living fire.  He gazes down at you
with disdain and scorn, arms folded across his mighty chest.

long: A sandstone column stands here, carved into a feminine figure.
description:
The column has been carved into a set of four shapely women, each facing
outward into the room.  The sandstone of the caryatid is smooth with age, but
you can still make out a deadly stone sword in the hands of each figure.

long: The djinn issues forth from the confines of a small lamp.
description:
The djinn is a mighty being formed from the air itself and frequently
imprisoned in a small lamp, used to do the bidding of those who find him.  He
smiles down at you congenially, arms folded across his blue-tinged skin, and
strokes his goatee.

long: A hieracosphinx looks at you cunningly.
description:
The hieracosphinx are cunning, small, but nasty creatures, having the heads
of birds, mighty wingspans, and a full set of four paws to rend their victims to
pieces.  They tend to be quite jealous of the sharper wits of their older
cousins.

long: A gynosphinx sits here, befuddled by a riddle.
description:
The gynosphinx is a crafty but gentle creature, having the body of a
beautiful dark-skinned woman from the waist up, a feathery set of wings and the
hind legs of a mighty cat.  Right now she is confused, having just heard a
puzzling riddle from a cousin criosphinx.

long: A criosphinx calmly watches you.
description:
The criosphinx is a calm and friendly creature, having the head of a ram atop
the body of a well-furred feline with eagle-like wings.  He delights in riddles,
and in poking occasional fun at his easily confused lesser cousins.

long: A mighty androsphinx tosses its lion-like mane.
description:
The mighty androsphinx is a huge creature, with the body of a lion whose face
is quite man-like, perhaps even handsome, and a massive pair of feathered wings.
Tales are told of pharaohs that were rendered permanently deaf by the mighty
roar of this sphinx.

long: A mighty sphinx rests here in the sand, dormant now for centuries.
description:
The great sphinx towers tens of feet above you, resting here in a state of
dormancy.  It has become almost indistinguishable from the sand that surrounds
it, although you can still make out the features of the handsome face that once
advised many rulers.

long: You have awakened the mighty servant to the pharaohs, Ramses.
description:
As your light spills over his face and body, you can see his features begin
to fill out, swell, and harden, until an apparently healthy man stands before
you, clad only in the raiments he was left in when he last slept.  His hair is a
soft black, his skin a deep chocolate, and his tall frame is totally still, his
chest not even moving to breathe.

long: Your guildmaster stands here.
description: An old man peering through ancient tomes rests here.

long: Your guildmaster stands here.
description: An older man wrapped in purple, long-flowing robes meditates here.

long: Your guildmaster stands here.
description: A smaller man dressed in black robes stands here waiting to train you.

long: Your guildmaster stands here.
description:
A small human dressed in black rests in the corner.  As you enter he grabs a
knife and throws it at you.  It lands in the wall next to your left ear.  'We
will now begin', is all he says.

long: A dark skinned, veiled woman greets you from behind the desk.
description:
This Arabian beauty is obviously the daughter of some high ranking official.
As you attempt to sneak a peek under her veil you notice a small moon-shaped
birthmark on her left cheek.

long: An old withered man leans against the bar.
description: He looks distracted as he pours five drinks at once without error.

long: Brother John, lead singer for the Lokettes stands on stage.
description: You see the lead singer of the Lokettes lip synching to an old Zochan tune.

long: A panhandler rests here.
description: A small skinny man rests here hoping to find a warm heart.

long: A panhandler rests here.
description: A small skinny man rests here staring at your clothes.

long: A grubby beggar sits here in the filth.
description: This poor soul seems down on his luck, perhaps you might spare a dime?

long: The baker stands here playing solitaire.
description: You see a large man in a white apron covered in flour from head to toe.

long: The shopkeeper stands here.
description: You see a half-elf sitting on a stool behind his counter.

long: A banker stands here waiting to help you.
description: This small halfling seems adept at counting money.

long: Ahkeem the tailor welcomes you to his store.
description:
This middle-aged man looks over you with disdain and quickly suggests a new
wardrobe.

long: Vera the veggie lady beams as you look over her stand.
description: A tall slender woman stands before you smiling broadly.

long: Butch the meatcutter stands here in his bloodied apron.
description:
This stocky dwarf has a mad glint in his eye as he twirls his clever
carelessly into the air.

long: Abdul stands here, waiting to help you.
description:
Abdul returns your gaze with a steady eye.  You quickly glance away under his
cold stare and place your order.

long: Igor stands here doing... something.
description: You see a small dwarf with a large hump on his left shoulder.

long: Cassandra stands proudly over her selection.
description:
You see a happy weather-worn face whose lines suggest many years on the open
sea.  It is only through years of fishing that she is able to withstand the
smell that permeates the air.

long: The foreman stands here screaming at the workers.
description:
A worried working dwarf stands here constantly making notes in his book and
looking at his watch.

long: A construction worker steadily works here.
description: A large sweaty looking man doesn't even return your glance.

long: The statue of Brahman stands here.
description:
The statue made of solid marble depicts the mighty God defeating Siva in
magical combat.

long: The statue of Siva stands here.
description:
The statue of the High Lord of Destruction stands here beings attacked by
Brahman in magical combat.

long: The statue of Indra stands here.
description: This statue looks like an enormous elephant.

long: The statue of Yama stands here.
description: This is a statue of the God of Death.  It is covered with odd runes.

long: The statue of Surya stands here.
description:
The statue of Surya, the God in charge of the Sun, almost glows with a fiery
aura.

long: The statue of Kali stands here.
description:
The statue of the Black Mother, Kali, is made of black marble and is covered
with silver runes.

long: The statue of Brihaspati stands here.
description:
The statue of Brihaspati, the God of Scholars and Knowledge is made of a
weathered marble.

long: The statue of Puchan stands here.
description:
The statue of Puchan, God of Travellers, is covered with dust and worn as if
it had been dragged a long way down a dusty road.

long: Aziz the Human Canon stands here.
description: This big and burly man grins at you as he draws his sword.

long: Mustafah the Human Robber stands here.
description: This man is lithe and has an evil smirk upon his face.

long: Fatima the Elven Invoker stands here.
description:
This female elf has dusky skin and black hair.  A combination you don't see
very often on elves.

long: Kareem the Dwarven Mercenary stands here.
description: This short stocky fellow has a chest the girth of a barrel.

long: A nomad merchant looks you over.
description:
This robust fellow returns your gaze with a smile, but something inside tells
you not to trust him very far.

long: A bodyguard sizes you up.
description: The large half-orc quickly glances you over and returns to his duties.

long: A skinny kid wanders around.
description: This small child sees you looking at him and quickly looks away.

long: A strong dockworker walks by moving crates.
description:
Although seemingly dull-witted, this hulking mass carries the huge crates
from the boats like it was a box of lilies.

long: A small man walks around scribbling in a notebook.
description:
The city's taxcollector walks from store to store collecting the Sultan's fee
for living in his grand city.

long: Gord the Rogue stand here.
description:
Gord wanders about trying to look innocent.  He fails miserably and makes
everyone around him watch their purses guardedly.

long: Chulainn the Knight stands here.
description:
This large man does not seem to be surprised at your approach and looks at
you quizzically.

long: Daghdha the Arch-Magi stands here.
description: This man is dressed in long brown robes and has a penetrating gaze.

long: Curley GreenLeaf stands here.
description: Curley constantly fiddles with his hair that gave him his namesake.

long: A small gray-haired man walks around spouting gospel.
description:
This sad case may have been an evangelist in another lifetime.  He is known
to stand on corners and accost passers-by with his doomsday preaching.

long: A small harmless feline searches for food.
description: You see a small starved cat.

long: A vulture circles above you.
description: As you look up at this bird, you see the only thing it wants is a corpse.

long: An old man sits here playing chess.
description: He seems intent on winning.

long: Lugh the Librarian sits behind a desk.
description: The huge hulking mass rises as someone asks him a question.

long: The wind kicks up some dust.
description: What you see before you is really a baby air elemental.

long: A strange lamia stands here waiting for her next meal.
description:
This is a creature with the upper torso of a beautiful woman, but the lower
body of a four-legged beast.  She licks her lips as she looks at you greedily.

long: A raggedy dervish stands here.
description: This man looks like he could use a lot of rest.

long: The Sultan rests here on his throne.
description: You see a large wealthy man in red robes smiling at you.

long: A lovely, veiled harem girl stands here.
description:
You see a dark skinned beauty, wearing almost transparent silks and light
blue veil.  Her loyalty to the Sultan is unwavering.

long: The Jailer sleeps here, snoring loudly.
description:
You see a pathetic soul lying here.  Probably some ex-nobleman that has
fallen out of grace with the Sultan.

long: A eunuch stands here watching over the girls.
description:
You see a large man whose only duty is to protect the harem.  He has been
castrated for the ladies' safety.

long: Nichole, the Sultan's favorite girl rests on a mound of pillows.
description:
You see the most beautiful Arabian girl that has ever meet your eyes.  Too
bad she is about to kill you.

long: Allah is here.
description: You see the all-knowing Allah.

long: The Guard for the Guild of Mages stand here.
description: This man looks like a mage/warrior, I wouldn't mess with him.

long: The Guard for the Guild of Clerics stands here.
description: This man looks like a cleric/warrior, I wouldn't mess with him.

long: The Guard for the Guild of Warriors stands here.
description: The man looks like Conan's cousin, I wouldn't mess with him.

long: The Guard for the Guild of thieves stands here.
description:
You see a thief dressed all in black, he quickly stands as you enter and
steps to bar your way.  You notice his hands resting on two sheathes.

long: A servant boy is here running errands.
description: You see a small boy running around the halls of the palace.

long: A guard stands here, protecting the innocent.
description: You see a trained fighter, ready to help those in need.

long: A guard stands here, watching the gate.
description: You see a trained fighter, ready to defend the city.

long: The Chief of the Sultan's Guard stands here.
description: You see a large man skilled in hunting and killing.

long: A mercenary stands here waiting for a job.
description: You see an assassin down on his luck looking to be freelanced out.

long: An old captain rests here carving on a stick.
description:
You see the shipwright of New Thalos, waiting to make someone a boat.  He
beams a smile at you through his beard as you walk in.

long: The blacksmith stands here pumping air into his fire.
description:
You see a large human, dripping in sweat, standing before you.  He takes a
break from his sweltering work to bid you welcome.

long: A horse stands here.
description: You see one of the fine Arabian beasts known about the land.

long: A tourist stands here looking lost.
description:
You see a small, rotund man, with a strange object around his neck and a nose
guard.  He is looking at a small map that he seems to be holding upside down.

long: A very large ray with a wicked looking tail swims here.
description: You see a large ray with sharp fangs and a barbed tail.

long: The cryohydra stands here.
description: A gray-brown reptilian creature with amber eyes stands before you.

long: the minotaur lizard stands here.
description: A huge lizard like reptile with horns like a minotaur.

long: The death dog stands here.
description: A large two-headed hound barks at you viciously.

long: The spotted lion stands here.
description: A large fierce dapple skinned lion glares at you.

long: A behir slithers on the ground.
description: You see a large snake-like reptile with more than a dozen legs.

long: A creature with three heads: lion, goat, and dragon stands here.
description:
The chimera is still a mystery, better left unexplored.  This creature has
the hindquarters of a goat, the forepaws of a lion and the body of a red dragon.

long: A couatl hovers here.
description:
A beautiful creature with the body of a serpent and feathered wings the
color of the rainbow.

long: The giant hornet hovers here.
description: It is a hornet, what else can be said?

long: The pegasus stands here, flexing its wings.
description:
A magnificent winged steed, this horse looks much like the Arabian
thoroughbreds you have seen in stables.

long: Elriva stands here mixing a love potion.
description:
You see a very healthy female dressed in black, with long flowing hair to
match her outfit.

long: Braheem stands here talking to the walls.
description: You see a powerful but slightly insane mage.

long: The high priest rests here meditating, well he WAS meditating.
description: He does NOT look real happy that you have disturbed him.

long: An Elite Royal Guard stands here smiling happily.
description:
You see one of the Royal Guards of New Thalos who seems to have undergone
some heavy training.

long: A large half-orc with a patch over one eye pours beer behind the counter.
description:
You see a really big guy here who seems to have lost an eye in one manner or
another.

long: Stitch, the leather dude reclines in his chair.
description:
You see a small hobbit with his feet kicked up on his desk waiting for some
sucker, uhm, customer to walk in his store.

long: A small elf stands here tending the garden.
description:
A young elf stands here in dirt covered overalls.  He seems to be weeding his
garden.

long: A large horse, black as night, stands here.
description:
You see the largest horse you have ever seen before.  Standing 10' at the
shoulder it breathes flame from his nostrils and leaps to attack you.

long: A large wolf like creature leaps out from the darkness.
description:
You see a half wolf, half human beast wearing a glove with long thin blades
on it.

long: You see an incredibly life-like painting of the Sultan's mother.
description: Boy is she ugly.

long: The Mayor of New Thalos stands here.
description: You see a chubby rabbit dressed in his best suit.

long: The chef stands here making dinner.
description: You see a very large human who seems to taste everything he makes.

long: You hear buzzing, and see a swarm of insects flying at you.
description:
These insects are more of an annoyance than a threat.  It is made up of
hundreds of annoying insects.

long: A black furry bat flies into your face.
description:
You hear a high pitch screech.  It is a black furry bat.  This annoying
creature usually travels in flocks, so WATCH OUT.

long: A humble shepherd is here, looking after his sheep.
description:
The shepherd is a patient old man who has spent all his days looking after
his sheep and all his nights studying the virtue of Humility.  Through the
wrinkles on his face you can see his proud dignity and begin to sense that he
was once a warrior.

long: A smiling young girl is here.
description:
The girl looks shyly at you.  Even at this young age, she has learned enough
of her culture to be humble.  She jumps rope and looks up at you expectantly.

long: A sheep peacefully eats grass.
description:
Even the sheep in New Magincia seem to exude humbleness.  The sheep has pure
white fleece.

long: Katrina the Shepherd is here, looking over the village.
description:
Katrina was one of the Warriors of Destiny.  She epitomizes the virtue of
humility.  After her great Enlightenment, she traveled back to her home and
helped rebuild Magincia.  She still is a great warrior and an able guardian of
New Magincia.

long: A rat is gnawing on a book.
description:
This giant rat is smelly and fleas jump up from its fur.  The rats have been
a great problem in the Library because they eat and shred the books.  This rat
seems to be rabid, so beware its teeth.

long: A giant spider sits on its web.
description:
This scavenger has seemed to have collected many things, including books,
scrolls, and other scraps.  Its glistening teeth drip with poison.

long: A mage stands here, reading a book.
description:
The mage, in his ever-increasing search for Honesty and Truth, has come to
the library to peruse the ancient tomes of knowledge.  He glances at you, and
returns to his study.

long: Nystul the Librarian sits at his desk, writing some scrolls.
description:
Nystul is the mentor, teacher, mage of the Lyceum.  He is a shining example
of Truth.  His head is bowed over a book, but power radiates from him.

long: Mariah walks around the stacks, busily looking for a book.
description:
Mariah is another Warrior of Destiny.  She joined the Avatar to add some
magical punch during his Enlightenment.  She seems serene in her total devotion
to the virtue of Honesty.

long: An ugly green mass sits on the ground in a puddle.
description:
The slime is an amorphous goo.  It seems pretty wimpy, but it has a lot of
friends.  As you look at it you wonder how these things reproduce.

long: The snake strikes.
description:
The green snake's tongue darts in and out tasting the air.  It senses spilled
beer and the distinctive taste of human.

long: Mr. Smithy, the talking horse, is chewing hay.
description:
This useless horse is a novelty, he can talk.  Though his talk is often
meaningless and he gives out irrelevant clues, his sleek body and his much
practiced jaw muscles can be very dangerous.

long: A bard sits here, strumming his mandolin.
description:
The bard seems happy and content to play his mandolin.  He is a seeker of
Compassion, but in his spare time he sings and dances.

long: A beggar is here with his hand out.
description:
He is more accustomed to receiving Compassion than giving it.  But help him
out guv, give him a few coins.

long: Iolo sits here with a bottle in his hand and a smile on his face.
description:
Iolo is one of the first Warriors of Destiny.  He seems to be a little bit
tipsy from the party and you wonder why he has wandered down to the cellar.
Anyway, in the spirit of the virtue Compassion that he embodies, he holds out a
bottle for you.

long: Chuckles the Jester is juggling and entertaining.
description:
Chuckles the Jester is here mumbling, 'Spam Spam.'  This annoying character is
Lord British's major entertainment.  He is laughing and telling corny jokes.
He seems to hold his dinner in his hands, and when he dances, the bells on his
hat jingle merrily.

long: A townsman is here downing drinks.
description:
This townsman is here partying and having many drinks.  Though he is also an
ardent believer in Compassion, and a responsible citizen, he knows the value of
a good party.

long: Gwenno the Bard, Iolo's happy wife, wanders around with bow in hand.
description:
You see a pretty woman with finally sculptured musculature.  She seems to
guard the party with her Infinity Bow, the best bow in the Ultima world.  Her
kindly eyes seem to emit pure Compassion, and as she wanders, she helps the
drunks up and leads them out the door.

long: A mutated ape carries a spear.
description:
This orc is a disgusting animal.  As you look, this ape-like monster
scratches its armpits.  It travels in herds and is a coward.

long: A stony troll swings his club.
description:
This huge monster is immense and powerful.  Over a chest and a head taller
then you, his meaty arms swing a club at you.

long: A blue ball of light soars over to you and winks.
description:
The Wisp is constantly blinking.  It wishes information exchange.  It looks
peaceful, but will defend itself.

long: A chanting druid walks the woods.
description:
Dressed in a hooded robe that obscures his face, the druid is softly chanting
words and traveling through the woods.  He is one that is secure in his sense of
Justice, and enlightened in the ways of judging others.  Through his communion
with nature, he has gained power.

long: A druid walks around a flame.
description:
This druid seems to be entranced by the fire.  She chants softly as she waves
her hand and stares into the flame.  She is one with the flame.  When she looks
at you, her hard eyes only judge, seeking Justice.

long: The Judge sits here.
description:
You cannot help but shiver as you see the Judge sit here silently.  His eyes
pierce into your soul, and he knows.  He knows your faults.  He knows your
virtues.  He knows if you've been bad or good....  So be good.  This ultimate
purveyor of Justice sends criminals to jail everyday, sometimes with his bare
hands.

long: Jaana the Druid is in deep meditation.
description:
You meet another Warrior of Destiny.  She helped to lead the magical force to
the Avatar.  The Avatar's mentor in Justice, she has gone to the woods to drive
life into a corner.

long: The Prisoner grips the bars with his dirty hands.
description:
The Prisoner seems to be a slimy character.  He was a thief, and Justice was
done to him.  You glimpse light shining off something in his hands.

long: The Prisoner is big and grins evilly at you.
description:
This Prisoner was convicted of one of the most heinous crimes, MURDER.  It
took many guards and druids to restrain this beast.

long: A citizen of Yew walks around.
description:
Being the second largest city in Britannia, second only to Britain itself,
this city employs and houses many people.  This citizen of the city of Justice
strolls the street, sure of his Virtue.

long: A bartender stands here in the the middle of a throng of people.
description:
A smiling face asks you what you would like to drink.  Well versed in
Compassion, he has heard and sympathized with many people who have gone to him
for advice.  His advice to you is to kick back and enjoy a drink.

long: The owner of the pub walks around, talking to her customers.
description:
The pub owner waves and smiles to you.  She asks what you want to drink and
eat.

long: The ettin scratches its heads and attacks.
description:
With its two heads, it should make sense that this monster would have double
the intelligence.  But, in fact, it has only half.

long: This little creature sneaks around and steals your food.
description:
It seems to be just a head with little hands and feet sticking out of it.
It does not seem like these things could hurt you, but your money pouch seems
much lighter.

long: The headless creature seems to be heading right for you!
description:
No one really understands how these things can sense but, as it unerringly
reaches for you, you know it does.  In any case these creatures are strong and
endurable.

long: A muscular fighter searches here.
description:
This fighter is cleaning out the dungeons.  In the peaceful time following
the Avatar's success, there are few ways to show Valor.  One of the more
dangerous is to descend into the pits of hell and clean them out.

long: Geoffrey the Fighter leads this campaign.
description:
The muscle power of the Warriors of Destiny, Geoffrey is immense.  His broad
shoulders make you look like a mouse.  He epitomizes Valor.

long: Lord Simon of the Serpent Hold stares at your form.
description:
His movements are liquid and art.  As he makes a few practice swings, you
HOPE that you are never on the receiving end of his immense sword.  This is The
Lord of Serpent Hold, courage itself solidified into a human form.

long: A treasure chest is here, overflowing with gold.
description:
The treasure chest reforms, and spits out a glob of poison.  Beware,
adventurer, of the Mimic.

long: A floating eyeball glares at you.
description:
This creature is comprised of one main eyeball and several auxiliary eyeballs
coming out of the main.  The eyeballs draw you in, making you forget who you
are....

long: A tinker is fiddling with one device or another.
description:
The tinker has huge rippling muscles and a scarred skin.  You realize that
his great Sacrifice to his craft has led to his incredible strength and
weaponskill.  This is not one you wish to fight.

long: Julia the Tinker is here, forging a sword.
description:
Julia the Tinker provided some of the muscle power to the Avatar during his
Great Quest for enlightenment.  She was a Warrior of Destiny and you see that
not much has changed since those days.  She represents Sacrifice in everything
she does.  She is the Keeper of Oral History, as well as a prominent
weaponsmith.

long: The Lady of Empath Abbey stands here.
description:
When you see her your heart almost stops as you feel the intense waves of
pure Love come from her body.  Her love for you almost knocks you down.  You
cannot hurt this one.

long: A tentacle reaches out of the sand and latches onto your leg.
description:
The Sandtrap burrows around under the sand and comes onto travellers, hidden.
No one is really sure what the Sandtrap looks like but it is a dangerous foe.

long: A dragon lies on his heap of treasure with fire billowing out of his maw.
description:
The dragon looks like every other dragon you've seen; wings, tail, fire.
Only this one doesn't have a dorky color attached to it.  And doesn't talk about
annoying C terms.

long: A paladin practices his sword strokes here.
description:
This paladin works hard to keep his Honor and the Honor of his people.
Honor does not lead his life, Honor is his life.  His shiny armor and equally
shiny sword serves to remind you that he is among Britannia's most powerful
battalion.

long: Sitting here, Dupre the Paladin consults his maps.
description:
Dupre the Paladin was constant companion of the Avatar and a Warrior of
Destiny.  He is a symbol of Honor.  He is right now trying to figure out a plan
of attack to get the dragon.

long: The reaper strikes out with its tentacles.
description:
The reaper is immobilized and attached to the ground.  Even with this
disadvantage its tentacles and magical powers more then make up for any
disadvantage.

long: The King of Gargoyles is here.
description:
Draxthanum, the Winged Gargoyle, is here to observe the odd habits of humans
and their combat tactics.  He is red with wings, very strong and his aura is
overpowering.

long: The spirit of a peaceful man floats around here.
description:
This ghost seems peaceful, even though he is chained to the earth through
some responsibility.

long: This ghost was an evil man in a past life.
description:
Even on its transparent face, you can see a grimace of evil as it swoops over
to you.

long: The skeleton walks around in tattered clothing.
description:
The skeleton has rotting bits of flesh attached to its bones.  It carries a
rusty shield and sword.  In fact the only thing completely clean on it are its
white teeth, perhaps from its nightly meals of flesh and bone.

long: The daemon unfurls his wings and swoops towards you.
description:
The most dangerous undead, and among the most dangerous of all monsters, this
beast can use all magics, is strong and hardy.  Right now he seems to be busy...
Killing you.

long: A mourner bows her head over the grave.
description:
A mourner is in tears.  She is crying over the grave of a loved one.  She is
expressing poignant Spirituality.  This gives her strength to persevere.

long: Shamino the Ranger sits here, meditating.
description:
