The last Warrior of Destiny, Shamino sits here in a yoga position.  The
Enlightened smile on his face confirms that he indeed is one with the spirit of
Spirituality.

long: The Timelord is here in an aura of power.
description:
The Hourglass that he holds in his hand actually controls the fickle powers
of time.  This being is so awe-inspiring that you feel an urge to prostrate
yourself to him.  But as all godly powers must be, he is truly and totally
neutral.

long: The Guardian, as far as you can tell, is just a big red face.
description:
First you hear a booming voice.  'You will join the Fellowship.'  He is the
latest, and some people say greatest, of the Avatar's enemies.  And now you have
the joy of meeting him.

long: Blackthorn wonders how he lost the throne.
description:
Blackthorn was more misguided rather then evil.  Though he was still a foe of
Avatar that eventually was destroyed, during this era he still is corrupt and
VERY, VERY dangerous.

long: Exodus is here, reveling in his island fortress.
description:
Exodus, the horrible progeny of Minax and Mondain, is here.  More powerful
then his parents, he is also more dangerous.  He was the last of the Triad that
the Avatar destroyed.

long: Minax is here, conjuring up the evil spirits.
description:
More powerful then her master and lover, Minax is as beautiful as she is
dangerous.  Bold enough to take on the forces of evil without the gem, she
eventually proved to be their mistress.  Without the Avatar the world would
still be under her complete power.

long: Mondain grips his evil gem and conjures magic to destroy you.
description:
Mondain, the first of the Triad of Evil, was the first foe that the man,
later to be known as the Avatar, was to face.  Mondain has killed his father to
gain the power of the dark gem that he wielded.

long: Sentri stoically stands here, protecting his Lord and castle.
description:
Sentri is a powerful man whose only job is to protect the life of Lord
British.  In seeing this done he is completely armored and wields a heavy blade.

long: Batlin says, 'Join the Fellowship.'
description:
Batlin is an evil man that goes around and corrupts the young.  You see also
that he has a full set of mantras, probably stolen from their rightful owners.
He is protected though by the power of his god.

long: The Avatar is here, chatting to Lord British.
Lord British is healing the Avatar's wounds.
description:
Lord British sits on his throne.  When you see him, you know the meaning of
true leadership.  His charisma is almost tangible.  On him you see the three
crown jewels.  These hold power both figuratively and literally.

long: The shark smells blood.
description: This fish can sense blood in the water and comes to kill you.

long: The peaceful seahorse swims here.
description:
The seahorse is an amazingly beautiful creature.  Its swimming and diving
pleases you.

long: The squid's tentacles reach for you.
description:
The squid easily is double a boat in size.  Its tentacles are huge and you
fear as it grabs for you.

long: The Armorer stands here.
description: The Armorer sells...  Armor.

long: The Weaponseller stands here.
description: The Weaponseller sells...  Weapons.

long: The Boatseller stands here.
description: The Boatseller sells...  Boats.

long: Sheila, Gatia's Assistant stands here.
description:
Sheila is a busty blonde that Gatia once had the fortune of saving from
certain death.  Ever since that day she has sworn to do everything that Gatia
says...

long: The Gemini stands here.
description: Gemini is a sign of the zodiac and is represented by the twins.

long: Pisces the fish are swimming here.
description: Pisces is represented by the two fish.

long: Aquarius the Water Carrier stands here.
description:
Aquarius seems to be made out of water.  She is carrying a large vase on her
back, it looks too much for a lady to carry but she handles it very well, almost
as if she was a man...

long: Leo the Lion stands here proudly.
description:
Leo is the 5th sign of the zodiac.  He is a fearsome monster and not one to
be messed with.  Treat him with care.

long: Taurus the Bull walks around his pen grunting.
description:
Taurus looks like a typical bull in every way except that he is ten times the
size!  Getting on his bad side would be a big mistake.

long: Aries the Ram stands here bleating.
description:
Aries is a large Merino ram.  If he had an owner he would win every
competition hand (er, hooves) down.  He is a good starsign and dislikes evil
things.

long: Sagittarius is here stringing a bow.
description:
Sagittarius belongs to an ancient race, the Centaurs.  He is the 9th sign of
the zodiac and is famous because of this.

long: Cancer the Crab squats here bubbling at the mouth.
description:
Cancer looks dangerous.  She has 5 foot claws at the end of each arm.  The
claws gleam in the half light as she clacks them through the air.

long: Bungle the Shopkeeper stands here.
description:
Bungle is widely considered a pervert, mainly after he was caught looking up
Virgos' dress at a Fancy Dress Ball two years ago.  Since then he has spent his
life in this cramped little shop.

long: Virgo is imprisoned here.
description:
Virgo is the 6th sign of the zodiac, she is imprisoned by Scorpio and will
probably end up as his next meal.

long: Capricorn rests his head here.
description: Capricorn is resting his head on a bed of moss.  He looks so relaxed.

long: A Male Goat stands here.
description:
A Male Goat stands here butting heads with friends and whacking his head into
the oak tree.

long: Scorpio, the 8th sign of the zodiac stands here.
description: Scorpio is the 8th sign of the zodiac.

long: Crannasia the Drow Assassin stands here with an evil grin upon her face.
description:
Crannasia is a very famous Drow assassin.  Her rates are high but she's the
best there is.  She has never missed a target...

long: A snail is here, nestled in the sand.
description:
The snail looks quite comfortable sitting there in the sand.  You can see
his small little eyes looking at you, almost watching you.

long: A clam is here.
description:
The clam looks dead.  It's just lying there in the sand, but looks can be
deceiving.

long: An ugly fishfly is here.
description:
Her wings are quite long and make a soft humming noise when she moves.  He
is quite ugly, and could easily scare her enemies away.

long: A small crab is crawling around in the sand.
description:
The claws of this creature are huge!  He could easily tear you apart if you
provoked him.  His eyes are small and black, almost like death.

long: A seagull is here.
description:
The bird is filthy.  His feather that were once white are now brown from the
dirt.

long: A water snake is at the waters edge.
description:
He is small and black.  He almost looks like an eel.  He appears to be
harmless, but looks can be deceiving.

long: A large mosquito is here.
description:
The creature is rather large.  You can see blood sitting in its stomach.
How revolting!

long: A beautiful parrot is here.
description:
The colors of the creature blend like paint on a canvas.  You wonder why
such a beautiful bird would be on such a small island like this.

long: An ugly little crayfish is here.
description:
Her eyes are tiny are black, they watch you very cautiously.  She may be
small, but can move quite fast.

long: A mean looking lobster is here.
description: His claws are enormous!  He could easily tear you apart if provoked.

long: A sparrow is flying around above you.
description:
She is a beautiful creature.  Her feathers are a light brown.  You see them
glistening in the sunlight.

long: The waitress is here, ready to serve you.
description:
She is a pretty little thing, slender with long brown hair.  She has the
most friendliest smile you have ever seen.

long: Herman the shopkeeper is here.
description:
He looks like a friendly gentleman.  He is balding on top, but still has
some hair on the sides.  He's a short, husky man.  One who would be good at
protecting what he owns.

long: A black widow spider is here.
description:
The spider is small, but fierce looking.  She looks to be in excellent
condition.

short: a coiled up rattlesnake is here.
long: A coiled up rattle snake is here.
description:
The snake is coiled up on the ground, looking at you, ready to attack.
Maybe you should just leave it alone.

long: A wasp is flying around you.
description:
The wasp is rather large.  You see its incredibly large stinger, waiting to
dive into your skin!

long: A scorpion is here.
description:
She is nasty little thing and would kill you without a second thought.  She
should be the least of your worries.

long: The scorpion queen is here.
description:
She looks much tougher than the average scorpion.  She has two stingers
instead of one!  Maybe you should stay away.

long: The scorpion leader is standing here.
description:
He looks at you as his stinger shakes slightly.  You suddenly feel terror
run through you.  Maybe you shouldn't have come here.

long: Earth dragon is here.
description:
The creature is quite large.  It towers over you, drooling.  You suddenly
feel like someone's lunch.

long: Purple dragon is here.
description: The dragon is purple with glowing yellow eyes.  You are frozen in terror.

long: Ice dragon is here.
description:
The creature is white and gives off a cold mist of steam.  You can see the
ice hanging off her scales.

long: A large polar bear is standing here.
description:
The bear looks cuddly, but as you look closer you can tell he has long fangs
stained with blood.

long: A cute penguin is here.
description: It looks like an average looking penguin.  You see nothing special about it.

long: A bear is standing in front of you.
description: He is mean looking.  You can hear a soft growl coming from within him.

long: A fox is here.
description:
The creature is slightly larger than normal, but looks nice enough.  You
notice a large scar down the side of its stomach.

long: John the Lumberjack is here, looking for some trees to chop down.
description:
He is six feet tall and looks quite strong, muscles bulging under his heavy,
checkered shirt.  His features are worn with hard work and his expression is one
of a peaceful man leading a simple life.

long: A small rabbit is foraging in the bushes here.
description: It is a small, furry creature with long ears and big feet.

long: A big, brown, angry-looking bear is here.
description:
The bear is a big, brown, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp
teeth.  It doesn't resemble those cute little dolls from toy shops at all.

long: A ferocious rabbit is here, glaring hungrily at you.
description:
This small, furry creature with long ears and big feet has been attacked by
the dreaded rabbit rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and innocent
rabbits into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters.

long: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.
description:
She is a graceful creature on long, slender legs, and with large, brown eyes
looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.

long: A brown fox is stalking rabbits through the underbrush here.
description: It is a large fox with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick bushy tail.

long: A large bird with a broken wing has been cornered here.
description: The bird isn't going to live much longer, by the looks of it.

long: A medium sized bobcat is stalking a bird here.
description:
The bobcat has sharp claws and teeth, and will probably eat you instead of
the bird if you give it the chance.

long: A sparrow is flapping around by the ground.
description: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.

long: A robin is hopping around looking for bugs to eat.
description: The robin looks quite intent on finding a bug or worm to eat.

long: A squirrel is here seeking refuge in its nest.
description:
It peers out of its nest at you anxiously, seeming to plead silently with you
to leave it alone.

long: A furry brown badger is curled up under a log here.
description:
The badger is slowly awakening and peering up at you from its burrow.  You
know that it won't be moving this slow for long.  Its sharp claws and teeth
catch your attention when you consider killing it.

long: A gray squirrel with a bushy tail is foraging for nuts here.
description:
This happy creature seems to pay you no heed as it goes about its search for
nuts among the leaves and twigs on the ground here.

long: A small brown-red chipmunk dashes from tree to tree here.
description:
The absolute zenith of hyperactivity, this small rodent seems to never tire
of running up, down, and around the trees in this area.  If you could ever catch
it, you imagine it would make an easy meal.

long: A large black bird flits about here, picking at bits of carrion.
description: The bird eyes you warily, but continues with its meal.

long: A grotesque vulture covered in blood and gore is here feeding madly.
description:
It sickens you to even look at this foul bird.  Bits of dried gore stick to
its beak, and unidentifiable organs hang from its talons and feathers.  It sees
you and attacks, protecting its horrible feast!

long: A young 5-point buck is drinking from the lake here.
description:
This young male deer is drinking from the edge of the lake and watching you
warily.  His antlers are not full size yet, and will no doubt be quite
impressive in a few years.

long: A fish is swimming about here.
description: The fish looks about the right size for a meal.

long: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
description: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny furball.

long: A duck is here, quacking happily.
description: The duck is quite fat.  It looks like it is enjoying life.

long: A vicious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

long: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily at you.
description:
It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.  Saliva is dripping
quickly from its long, white fangs.  It looks quite dangerous and very angry.

long: A large, gray wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
description: The large, gray wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

long: A large, black wolf is here, glaring hungrily at you.
description: The large, black wolf eyes you with interest while licking its lips.

long: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
description:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground.
Something about it makes you think that this is not a normal oak tree.  The
enormous gray trunk shivers slightly, as if sighing deeply.

long: A huge, ancient tree towers above you.
description:
Its roots are extremely big and large parts of them are above ground.
Something about it makes you think that this is not a normal oak tree.  The
enormous gray trunk emits a deep, moaning sound.

long: A huge green dragon is here, its narrow yellow eyes glowing with rage.
description:
This enormous winged serpent has dark green scales covering most of its
colossal body.  Numerous holes in its heavy wings tell of many fights as does
the nicks in the horns on its head.  It smells as disgusting as only dragons do.

long: A huge, poisonous spider is here.
description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a human crawling on all four.  It
has eight hairy legs that gives it a tremendous speed on almost any surface and
sharp poisonous fangs to paralyze or kill its prey.

long: The huge, bulky Queen spider is here.
description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface if
it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.

long: Shargugh the Forest Brownie is here, grinning broadly at you.
description:
This little fellow is only three foot tall with wild matted brown hair and
long tangled brown beard.  He wears ragged brown and green clothing and looks as
if he is having great fun.

long: The Elder druid is here.  He looks very upset about your presence in his home.
description:
The druid looks quite old.  You would think of him as venerable but yet you
know he would be a tough foe.

long: Isha the Dark Elf is here, observing you silently.
description:
She is no less than beautiful, skin as dark as the night and hair shining
like silver in the moonlight.  Her slender body is adorned with a sleeveless
shirt and a short skirt made from black scales joined with silver threads.  Her
back is covered by a large, hooded cloak as black as her skin and in her broad
silver belt hangs a long, slender sword in a silver scabbard.

long: A deer looks at you with fear in its eyes.
description: That is one nice looking deer!

long: A small rabbit nibbles at a leaf here.
description: It is a small, furry rodent with big ears.

long: A squirrel spots you and runs around a tree!
description: It is a small, brown squirrel.  Kind of like a fuzzy high-tension spring.

long: An orc hunter looks at you with hateful eyes.
description:
He looks angry, desperate, and maybe a little sick.  His green skin is
definitely mottled, and he seems to limp a little bit...

long: An orc chief growls at you!
description:
He wears a crown of oak leaves to show he is a leader.  He carries a club to
show he is a warrior.  You wonder how good he is at both.

long: An orc woman stands here, frightened of you.
description:
As you stare her down, she raises her hands slowly, as if to say, 'Don't kill
me'.

long: An orc child frantically searches for her mother.
description: She is raggedy, and seems to be covered with sores.

long: A pregnant orc woman tries to stand to flee from you.
description: She is too far gone to move very quickly.  You could kill her easily.

long: A mutant orc lies here, barely alive.
description:
Its body has been twisted beyond all hope.  It is dying, and nothing will
stop that.

long: A horribly mutated orc stands here, gibbering.
description:
It doesn't even appear to have registered your arrival...  It is just talking
to itself.  Its body is a twisted wreck of orc, man, beast, and what-not.

long: An elven wizard is here.  He looks angry.
description:
He looks at you archly as he wonders why you have invaded his domain.  No
matter...  It shouldn't be too hard for him to destroy you, no?

long: An elven child casts his fishing pole into the river.
description: He looks young and innocent.  You wonder what he is doing here.

long: A mutant... thing rushes at you!
description:
It might've been an orc, once.  Now it is a living terror, pushing everything
out of its way to get at you.

long: A mutant... thing tries to get you, but cannot move into range!
description:
It might have been an orc, once.  Now it is a living terror, pushing
everything out of its way to get at you.

long: The young spider is ballooning by you.
description:
He looks freshly hatched and sprightly.  His young fangs are just growing in
as of late.

long: Yevaud, the Usurper of Midgaard is here, grinning evilly at you.
description: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.

long: The wolf spider is here, licking its bloody fangs.
description: The wolf spider is hairy, very hairy.

long: The orc is stuck in the web and he can't get out.
description:
You notice an evil look in his eyes, but he seems quite drained of life, and
all he can do is glare at you while he's stuck in this web.

long: The queen wasp is here, thinking how tasty you look.
description: You notice a glazed look in her eyes.

long: A drone spider walks around doing its master's bidding.
description: An ordinary drone spider.

long: An ethereal spider strides here, traveling to different worlds.
description:
She winks in and out of reality.  It looks like it'd be difficult to hit her
without a magical weapon.

long: A human slave of Arachnos works here relentlessly.
description:
The slave does not mind you, but will fight like a warrior if attacked.  He
serves the spider Empress, Arachnos, though whether it is by choice or because
he was beguiled, you are not fully certain.

long: A quasit blinks in and out, grinning at you.
description:
Demoniac in nature, but more mischievous.  He twiddles his thumbs and creates
a magical treasure!

long: The bird spider snaps its powerful jaws.
description: The Bird Spider has very powerful jaws.

long: The hermit sits here and warns, 'Go back before it is too late!'
description: A dishevelled veteran warrior in disguise is what he is, but he means well.

long: The Donjonkeeper eyes you and wonders how pure your soul is.
description:
He delves deeper into you as you stare at him.  Only those free of taint will
be allowed to remain here safely.

long: The guardian is obviously not doing his job.
description: He looks like a lazy bum who sleeps half the time.

long: Arachnos the Empress of Spiders welcomes you with an evil smile.
description:
She is a very attractive spider with an ornate gown.  She tempts you into
being one of her many slaves.  She does not possess the venomous fangs of normal
spiders, but then, as you realize, she does not need them.

long: The Ki-Rin smiles good-naturedly to you.
description:
She is the last bastion of good in this realm.  Her mission is to someday
free the slaves of the Empress.  She has been trapped here for time eternal, and
now the evil power of Arachnos feeds upon her intense magical energies.  She
will never give up here fight against evil, though, and will continue her work
in whatever manner presents itself.

long: A wyrmkin with no teeth plays here.
description: It is a rather small dragon, and you almost feel sad about killing it.

long: A wyrmkin that has grown a bit stares at you inquisitively.
description:
A medium-sized dragon -- seems it hasn't killed anything yet by itself,
though there is a first time for everything...

long: Mahatma, that silly thief, is here, stealing everything.
description: This professional thief has constructed a trap to catch unwary travellers.

long: A mountain goat nibbles at a piece of grass here.
description:
This goat is acclimated to the rugged terrain of the mountains.  It looks at
you and shies away a little.

long: A cloaked and clawed demon of decay comes at you viciously!
description:
This demon has pure malevolence for anything living.  Oops!  You're living!
I guess that means you!

long: A mound of books rise up into a human shape and tries to hit you!
description: Ironically enough, the book-monster's head is War and Peace.  Hmm.

long: A bad feeling chokes your throat.
description:
It resembles a lot of other bad feelings you've had, but a lot more
tangible...  Magic?

long: Your worst nightmare coalesces in front of you and attacks!
description:
It looks like you deepest, darkest fears personified.  Wait a minute!  It IS
your deepest, darkest fears personified!

long: A guardian guards the door.  It looks at you and attacks!
description:
The guardian guards the door.  That's about all its brain can handle:
guarding.

long: A small god entrapped by the wizard looks at you with an insane expression.
description:
Four hundred years of imprisonment doesn't do much for one's disposition.
It looks ready and able to take out vengeance on anyone silly enough to enter
the pentagram that contains its power.

long: A dwarven guard is here.
description:
The guard looks very tough and mean.  He wears his beard long, and he smells
like he hasn't bathed in over a month.

long: A dwarven mining worker is here.
description: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

long: A wraith is awaiting your first move here.
description: A black, almost transparent wraith.

long: The Hide & Tooth storekeeper is standing here, waiting patiently.
description: The storekeeper is very rotund, but looks in excellent condition.

long: Granite Head, the baker, is waiting for a customer here.
description: Granite Head is covered with flour and grains.

long: A giant lizard is foraging for food along the cavern floor here.
description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to its underground habitat.
He looks very powerful.

long: A giant is wandering around the mountainside here.
description:
The giant is about 18 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks in excellent
physical condition.

long: A dwarven mineworker is here.
description: The mineworker is very tired, and very dirty, and he has bulging muscles.

long: A dwarven mine leader is here, supervising the work.
description:
The mine leader is very big and very strong, though he must be fairly bright
also, to have gotten this job.

long: The dwarven doctor is here, aiding the sick of his people.
description: He is a very skilled healer, and extremely faithful to his god.

long: A dwarven peon is awaiting help here.
description:
Incapable of doing anything himself this dwarf is utterly lost and is
awaiting orders.

long: A dwarf is here.
description: He is short and stout as their kind is famed to be.

long: A barrack guard is here, lounging around while off duty.
description: This middle aged man seems lost without something to guard.

long: A mazekeeper is here.
description: He looks VERY tough.

long: There is a giant snake here.
description:
The snake is coiled tightly and ready to strike at the first sign of trouble.
The scaly skin is a mottled brown, black, and gray that blends into the
surrounding terrain.

long: A merchant is trying to you sell you something.
description:
A merchant forces a smile and walks up to you like you are his best friend.
He immediately begins his speech on all the fine wares he could sell you...
For the right price of course.

long: This guard is protecting the outskirts of the city from attack.
description:
A veteran warrior, this guard was enlisted by the city to protect it from
attack.

long: The outpost commander is here, safe in the respect of her men.
description:
The outpost commander is a hardened, grizzled veteran with the cunning that
comes from a life of leading men in endless battle.

long: A trader tries to barter with you.
description:
He immediately starts telling you the value of every item you carry and
explains to you how he could trade you some much better equipment for a small
few or an extra item or two.

long: A hermit looks nervous with all these people around.
description:
This guy spends his life living alone in the wilderness.  It's a wonder he
can survive.

long: A patrolman is keeping an eye out for any trouble.
description:
One of the many protectors of the city, his job is to protect the outskirts
of the city and give warning in case of trouble.

long: A warden is patrolling the outskirts of the city.
description:
He looks more like he's seen his fair share of action in his time.  He looks
at you suspiciously.

long: A woodsman walks by.  He needs a shower, bad!
description:
Born and raised in the woods, he looks like more a part of the wilderness
than most animals you've seen.

long: A guard is standing watch here.
description: He looks very well trained.

long: A woodswoman is looking for a woodsman to nag.
description: She looks upset about something.

long: A messenger runs by on an errand.
description: He looks fit from running on all those errands.

long: This scoundrel is looking for some easy prey.
description: She lives off the misfortune of others.  She looks at you warily.

long: A hulking siltborn guardian pulls itself slowly from the damp stone.
description: Mud, mineral crust, and broken fragments of ancient masonry have gathered into a vaguely humanoid shape. Pale light glimmers deep within the creature's hollow face as it drags itself through the ruins, animated by whatever old power still lingers beneath Midgaard.

long: A small cave bat hangs from the stone overhead.
description: This dark-furred bat has adapted to the buried halls of the Old Delve. It is little more than a nuisance alone, but disturbed colonies can become surprisingly aggressive in the close tunnels.

long: A large delve rat watches you from beside the wall.
description: The rat is broad-bodied and scarred from life beneath the city. Damp gray fur clings to its sides, and its black eyes follow every movement with the wary hunger of a creature used to surviving on anything it can find.

long: A hairy cellar spider works at a web between the stones.
description: This hand-sized spider has spun a thick web across cracks in the ancient masonry. Its mottled legs blend into the stone until it moves, revealing a quick and territorial little predator.

long: A heavy stoneback beetle scrapes across the floor.
description: Plates of dark shell cover this oversized beetle like fitted armor. Dust and mineral flakes cling to its back, making it nearly indistinguishable from rubble until its hooked legs begin to move.

long: A pale grave grub writhes among the damp debris.
description: The bloated larva feeds on fungus, rot, and whatever else washes into the buried complex. Its translucent hide pulses around a dark digestive tract, and it curls toward warmth with unsettling persistence.

long: A blackstripe viper coils low across the stones.
description: Near-black scales cover this slender viper, broken by pale diamond markings along its head and thin green stripes down its flanks. It keeps its head low and tracks movement with patient, venomous attention.

long: A gaunt lost delver watches the passages with hollow eyes.
description: A torn gray cloak hangs from this exhausted adventurer. Old Guild trail marks have been copied onto scraps of leather tied around one wrist, but the delver's unfocused stare suggests too many days spent wandering the dark have taken their toll.

long: A malformed homunculus clings to the ruined stonework.
description: No taller than a small child, this artificial creature has green-gray skin, leathery wings, and an oversized mouth crowded with sharp teeth. Faint sigils have been burned into its flesh, evidence of some forgotten experiment carried out in the buried halls.

long: A shadow morkoth waits just beyond the edge of the light.
description: This hunched creature blends humanoid and ratlike features beneath a skin of shifting shadow. Its breathing is slow and deliberate, and faint sparks gather around its claws when it senses prey. Whatever magic shaped it still answers its instincts.

long: A copper-eyed crawler creeps along the wall.
description: Copper-colored plates cover the upper body of this strange subterranean creature, framing two luminous yellow eyes. Its lower body fades into burnt orange hide, and hooked limbs let it move across broken masonry with disturbing ease.

long: An old ember drake guards the deepest chamber of the upper Delve.
description: This scarred red-scaled drake is smaller than the great dragons of legend but still enormous within the confines of the dungeon. Heat shimmers around its jaws, and blackened claw marks score the surrounding stone. It has clearly claimed this portion of the Old Delve as its lair.

long: A drowned hag moves through the cold water with terrible grace.
description: Long limbs and slick gray-green skin mark this creature as something that has lived in darkness for far too long. Yellow eyes shine above a mouth of needlelike teeth, and strands of wet hair cling to the small horns along its skull.

long: A guardian naga keeps watch over the old passage.
description: Green-gold scales cover the naga's serpentine body, patterned with silver triangles along her back. Her golden eyes are alert rather than hostile. The ancient markings around her resting place suggest she may have guarded these halls long before Midgaard rose above them.

long: A heavy vault basilisk crawls through the ruins.
description: Eight powerful legs support a low reptilian body covered in dull brown scales. Its pale green eyes gleam beneath a ridged brow, and the stone around its claws is scored by years of territorial pacing.

long: A mindburned husk lurches toward anything that moves.
description: The vaguely humanoid creature looks as though its body was softened and remade by hostile magic. Its empty black-yellow eyes show no recognition or fear, only the automatic violence of a mind long ago burned away.

keywords: grunn two headed brute ettin cruncher jones
long: Grunn, a two-headed delve brute, blocks the passage.
description: Two scarred heads rise above Grunn's massive shoulders, arguing constantly in low growls while the body grips a crude length of timber. Layers of stitched hide and scavenged straps suggest the brute has made a home among the Old Delve's abandoned chambers.

keywords: merrik two headed runt ettin herald mouse killer
long: Merrik, a smaller two-headed brute, lurks among the ruins.
description: Merrik is undersized for an ettin, with one head noticeably weaker than the other. Rope, patched hides, and bits of scavenged metal make up the creature's poor equipment, while small bones tied at the waist serve as crude trophies.

long: The master mindflayer is here, looking at you with an evil look.
description:
It is a seven foot tall humanoid dressed in a purple cloak, and swinging a
black and purple rod above its head as if it was going to attack you any moment
now.  In the middle of its head are four tentacles with sharp points.

long: The senior mindflayer walks around here, looking for something useful.
description:
This is a horrifying monster indeed, 6'6" high.  Dressed in purple and black,
and carrying a large mace in its hand.  In the center of its head are four large
tentacles with very sharp points.

long: The junior mindflayer is here, watching you carefully from the corner.
description:
This mindflayer is six feet high.  It has a small mace in its belt, and is
dressed in purple and black cloth.  It has four small tentacles in the center of
its head.

long: An ugly wererat is here, looking at you with a strange flick in his eyes.
description:
The wererat is about four feet tall.  It looks very much like rat, except
that it is standing.

long: There is a gigantic rat here, looking at you with a hungry look.
description:
The gigantic rat is about ten feet long from head to tail and has claws the
size of your head, looking very nasty.

long: A gray dove coos softly from the branches of the willow tree.
description:
Peaceful and content, this dove sways slightly as it sings a soft, trilling
song for any to hear.  Now and again it appears to lean and breathe deeply the
scents of the nearby blossoms.

long: A disheveled boy is here, digging in the dirt.
description:
About six summers old, the young boy is covered to his elbows in dirt.  His
reddish hair stands about unkempt and his clothing is streaked with dirt.  As
you look on, he wanders around, digging holes in the carefully maintained lawn.

long: A scrawny little girl skips around, uprooting the flowers.
description:
Long of limb and tooth, the thin and gangly little girl looks to be caught
firmly in the awkward age.  Her homespun dress is simple and fairly clean.  As
you watch, she trots around the path, uprooting flowers violently from the
ground.

long: A squat groundskeeper is busy polishing the fence here.
description:
Clad in woolen homespun clothing and sturdy leather boots, the groundskeeper
is dressed for heavy work.  He is rather short and more than a bit overweight,
but intent on his job nonetheless.  His russet hair is in a bit of a disarray
and his fingers are stained with iron polish.

long: A twisted dwarf wrestles with a monstrous shovel, attempting to dig a hole here.
description:
One arm twisted by a birth defect, this ugly little dwarf has made a career
of relieving the dead of their valuables.  His face and clothes are streaked
with grave-dirt and sweat, testimony to the amount of work required to avoid
honest labor.

long: An angry young man stands screaming at a redstone grave marker.
description:
His face flushed with anger, the young man seems to be scolding a large
redstone grave marker.  His arms flail about wildly as he screams and shouts at
the unhearing tomb.

long: A distressed mother mourns her child's death.
description:
Clad in black, the woman mourns her child's death.  Her face is lined with
stress and sadness.  Tears slide slowly down her cheeks as she cries selflessly
for the loss of her poor, sweet child.

long: A groundskeeper is here, keeping busy.
description:
Clad in homespun cottons, the groundskeeper takes turns either pulling weeds
or polishing marble statues.  His face is set and he keeps his attention to his
duties, ignoring the passing mourners.

long: An old woman is here, considering the purchase of a new plot.
description:
Her face is a mapwork of wrinkles and her hair is spidersilk thin.  The old
woman looks briefly over at a couple empty plots and sinks deep into thought.
In time, she turns and moves on in search of another plot.

long: A stern man is here attempting to keep people off the empty plots.
description:
A large and brutish man, the head groundskeeper enforces his policy on
cleanliness with a stern hand.  The beauty and order of the cemetery is a
responsibility he takes very seriously.  With a loud bark, he scares a young man
off the soft grass.

long: A tawny owl is perched in the lower branches of the tree.
description:
Colored a creamy tan with dark fletchings on its wing and tail feathers, this
owl is fairly sedate and unconcerned with its surroundings.  A thin leather
thong is wrapped around one leg, apparently for carrying messages.

long: A wizened old woman uses a tall staff to prod pigeons from the crypt roof.
description:
Her face is worn and wrinkled and her hair is white and sparse.  The old
woman looks to be nearly as old as some of the pitted and weathered statues
nearby.  While you look on, she pokes at the pigeons roosting on the crypt here
with a long, ashwood staff.

long: A tall, thin man lurks about the edge of the clearing.
description:
Narrow of face and long of nose, the man is tall, nearly seven feet or so.
His clothing is the drab black most often worn by mourners, yet he hardly seems
to be here to grieve a friend or family member.  His eyes dart back and forth as
he lurks here, watching everyone.

long: A badly burned corpse haunts the place it was accidentally burned alive.
description:
The corpse is of indeterminate gender or race.  Most noticeable is that it is
moving about as no corpse was meant to do and it is covered in huge, weeping
wounds and crisp, blackened skin.  Even its armor is seared and burned.

long: The shade of the alchemist, Ghendry, glares at nothing in particular.
description:
Clearly long dead, the shade is merely a wisp of something physical, barely
discernible among the shadows.  In life, it was a man of great stature in
society and much loved by the people of the realm.  Now, however, the shade
seems more a forgotten past than legend made to live again.

long: The bones of Lord Mycea reanimate in the center of the room.
description:
Bones yellowed with age have reanimated themselves inside the molded burial
rags of the great Lord Mycea.  Rather than eyes, twin orbs of glowing greenish
light rest inside the sockets of his skull.

long: A frightening apparition floats about, examining the huge locked chests here.
description:
Given the bashed head leaking who knows what all over, this would seem to be
the ghost of the great halfling hero, Fennywen.  A bit translucent and
thoroughly dead, the ghost is having some time adjusting to its new
circumstances.

long: A mourner, dressed all in black, wanders around consumed by grief.
description:
Upset by a loved one's death and in no mood for socializing, the mourner
turns away before you can get a really good look.

long: A small doe stands here grazing.
description:
The small doe is brown with tiny white spots on its back.  A piece of hide
hangs from an old wound on its side.

long: A wild boar stands here.
description:
A wild boar has been trapped here.  It is short and round with large tusks
protruding from its mouth.  As it shifts its head around looking for the way out
its eyes shine red.

long: A giant fruit bat hangs here sleeping.
description:
A giant fruit bat is hanging here in an upside down position from a large
tree.  Its black wings are wrapped around its body like a cozy blanket.

long: A Zamba warrior stands here alert.
description:
The large warrior stands here guarding the gate.  He is well tanned with
long, black hair and cold, piercing eyes.  His clothing is strange, around his
head is a leather strap with many colorful feathers attached, he wears thick
gold bands around the upper part of both his arms and has a white cloth tied
around his waist.

long: A black kitten is lying here sleeping.
description: A black kitten looks like a cute, fuzzy ball.

long: A large man is sitting here eating.
description:
The large man has dirty white hair and food smudges on his faces and hands.
He has a large brown cloth wrapped around his waist.  His skin is sweaty and
oily, he smells horrible.

long: A young girl sits here playing.
description:
A young girl sits here playing with her doll.  Her hair is long and black,
she had big brown eyes and a very dark tan.  She wears a yellow dress tied
around the neck and waist.

long: A short woman stands here.
description:
The short woman is standing here catching her breath as she fans herself.
She is barefoot and wears only a white dress tied at one shoulder.

long: A native boy stands here.
description:
The native boy is dressed in a small cloth wrapped around his waist.  He
carries a small bow and arrow as he searches around looking for something to aim
at for target practice.

long: The barkeeper is standing here.
description:
You see a large woman standing behind the bar wearing a flowery dress.  She
smiles at you revealing several gaps where she is missing teeth.

long: A green lizard rests here in the warm sand.
description:
An iguana around six feet long is resting here.  Its skin is leathery and
bright green, strange thorn looking scales run from the top of its head down to
its tail.  The tail is extremely long and is probably more than half the length
of this strange reptile.

long: A native woman sits here.
description:
A native woman sits here preparing food for the tribe.  She is wearing a
brightly colored dress.  Her black hair is held back with a pearl hair piece.

long: A native fisherman is standing here working.
description:
The fisherman looks at you sharply as he gathers together his fishing net.
He has a dark tan and is quite muscular.  His clothing is a simple cloth wrapped
around his waist.

long: An angry monkey stands here challenging you.
description:
The large monkey stands on its bottom two feet that look just like its hands.
It stands slightly bent over a little over six feet in height.  It glares its
sharp teeth at you.

long: A thick vine is blocking the path.
description:
A vine of the Crona plant entangles everything.  The Crona has a think, dark
green base with small yellow leaves.

long: A robed figure hiding at the edge of the jungle.
description:
A man stands here dressed in dark robes hiding his appearance.  From what you
can see he is tall and thin.  The large hood of the robe drapes over his eyes
only leaving his long white beard visible.

long: A Zamba hook plant is rooted here.
description:
You see a beautiful flower gracefully standing in a little clearing to
itself.  It is quite tall with a broad flower and long, slim leaves.  The light
that glows onto this lovely flower enhancing its beauty is actually glowing from
within the flower.

long: A large rat scurries here.
description:
The large rat scurries around looking for food.  Its red beady eyes stare
about the room as it sniffs the air.  As it lifts its head you can see it has
very long front teeth on both the top and bottom of its mouth.

long: The witch doctor is hovering in the pentagram.
description:
An old man dressed in armor made of bones and teeth is inside the pentagram.
He is softly chanting strange incantations.  He sways his arms around tossing
black powder into a large pewter bowl set in the center of the pentagram.

long: A colossal falcon is perched on the edge of the cliff.
description:
The falcon stretches out its wings and screeches.  Its wing span is at least
ten feet.  Its talons look large enough to grasp large cows making the perfect
size dinner.

long: A chubby man stands here.
description:
The chubby man looks at you and smiles.  He is wearing many expensive pieces
of jewelry, and unlike the natives he is well dressed.  Something about him
doesn't look quite right.

long: A nobleman stands here.
description:
The nobleman looks wise and intellectual.  His cloths look similar to ancient
gentleman attire but new.  His hair is short and black with a touch of gray at
the temples.

long: A refined lady stands here gracefully.
description:
She stands with a grace of elegance.  Her hair pulled back and held with
pearls and strands of gold.  She wears a long, flowing, white gown.

long: A  cook is here preparing a dish for a banquet.
description:
The cook is a young woman dressed in white cloths with a small apron around
her.  Her black hair is pulled back and covered with a large scarf.

long: A cloth doll is lying here.
description: The cloth doll looks tortured from needles poked into its eyes.

long: The guard stands here in front of the door.
description: The guard is wearing silver armor.  He stares at you watching you closely.

long: A black panther crouches down ready to strike!
description:
The panther is well muscular, it looks very strong and dangerous.  Bright
green eyes shine out from under is sleek, black fur.

long: A young servant girl stands here waiting.
description:
The young girl is pretty in a plain way.  She is dressed all in white with a
cloth tied around her head to hold back her long black hair.

long: The Empress Kiona sits here, leaning over a huge bath.
description:
She gracefully leans over the tub getting ready for her bath.  She wears a
long robe about her but has removed everything else except some gold jewelry and
a elegant hair comb holding her black hair up.

long: A sea turtle is standing here.
description:
The sea turtle is around 6 feet around and has a light green shell.  As it
sits here in the sand it uses its back legs to dig into the sand.

long: A young native woman is playing at the waters edge.
description:
The beautiful girl is soaking wet.  She stops for a moment, smiles at you,
then continues running in and out of the water.

long: An old man is standing here.
description: The old man peers over his glasses at you.

long: The young man is standing here selling fruit.
description:
The young man smiles at you and holds a basket of fruit toward you to look
at.

long: A feeble old man stands here leaning on his staff.
description:
The old man stands here slightly been over using a tall staff for support.
He wears a long blue robe with gold embroidery.  He has thin, long, white, hair
growing from the top of his head to the bottom of his chin.

long: A gray wolf hunts here.
description:
The gray wolf stands as tall as a horse.  The thick fur around its neck and
back is standing up as it looks around.  Foam drips from the corner of its mouth
as it bares its teeth.

long: An elven lass stands here, humming to herself.
description:
The elven lass smiles happily as she goes on about her business, humming
quietly to herself.

long: The baker Stamnell stands here smiling.
description:
Stamnell has rosy cheeks and round belly.  His handlebar mustache has specks
of flour in it, but he doesn't seem to mind.

long: Vhispera stands here busily counting her stock.
description:
She is a middle aged elven woman with dark hair and eyes.  She is rather
plain to look at but she smiles at you warmly.

long: A small boy stands here.
description:
The small boy has a crooked smile across his dirty face.  His blonde hair
lies messily on his head and he has clothes that looks like they have seen
better days.

long: The village guard stands here, observing the area.
description:
Dressed in a gray tunic and black pants you wouldn't suspect this to be a
guard off hand, but the small patch sewn on his right arm sleeve denotes his
profession.  His eyes are darting about on constant watch for trouble.

long: The village fool stands here, making an idiot of himself.
description:
Little more than a nuisance, the fool walks around trying his best to
entertain.  His ratty clothes shed dust with every movement as he goes about his
way.

long: An elven gardner stands here, grumbling to himself.
description:
The gardner looks very grumpy, perhaps it would be a good idea to stay out of
his way.

long: A human servant stands here.
description: She looks just like you would expect a servant to look like.

long: A husky hunter stands here, bragging of his last kill.
description:
He is big and burly.  He has stains all over his clothing, perhaps it is
blood from his constant hunting.

long: The elven healer hurries about.
description:
The elven healer hurries about from house to house bandaging the sick.
Maybe she will have enough time to teach you.

long: The Grand Knight is standing here, waiting for someone to help.
description:
The Knight is standing here, smiling at you.  He is dressed all in white,
blue and silver.  He looks VERY strong, as he stands here, ready to help the
innocent.

long: There is a large rat here, poking through the foodstuffs lying around.
description:
The large rat is about two feet long from head to tail and has claws the size
of your fingers, looking very nasty.  It seems to be quite occupied with all the
chewed open foodstuffs lying about the room.

long: The Cleaver is here eyeing you hungrily in anticipation of its next meal.
description:
The Cleaver is a huge spidery chitinous creature with four large spindly
arms ending in cleaver-like talons that will surely cut you to ribbons.

long: A small fish swims by.
description:
These small fish tend to school together, in order to improve their chances
of survival against larger predators.  Their bright colors disorient the foe,
and their numbers ensure that the majority survive.

long: A large fish swims by.
description:
These large fish are more solitary than the small ones.  They have less to
fear in the sea, and thus concentrate most of their efforts on hunting smaller
fish.

long: A hungry moray eel swims by.
description:
This long, slender creature is fond of small caves and passages in the rocks
on the ocean floor.  They scavenge for food, but will sometimes attack other
creatures when hungry.

long: A Great White Shark swims by, watching you very closely...
description:
This sleek, gray creature is one of nature's most deadly predators.  They
feed on almost every creature in the sea, including you!

long: A huge ship flying a black flag sails by here.
description:
This large vessel appears to be very heavily armed.  The sailors don't
exactly seem to be friendly as they sneer at you from the deck.  A large, black
flag bearing a skull and crossbones indicates that these men are pirates.
   Pirates are not usually fond of prisoners, but sometimes exceptions are made;
If they seem too tough for you, say or just type @oSURRENDER@n at the prompt.

long: A grizzly pirate stands here, steering the boat.
description:
Long exposure to the sea air has given this man's face and hair a light
dusting of salt.  His tired eyes are focused intently on the horizon, searching
for new lands or other ships to loot.

long: The cabin boy stands here, wearily swabbing the deck.
description:
The cabin boy has dreamed of being a pirate since they plundered his village
when he was a child.  Hey, if you can't beat them, join them!

long: A pirate stands here, guarding the brig.
description:
If there is one thing you can always count on, it's pirate's greed.  This
man is paid to make sure prisoners stay in their cell, but everyone has a
price...  The going rate for a set of keys is 100 gold down here in the brig.

long: A drunken pirate sits here, taking a swig of booze.
description:
This pirate is quite enjoying his time off duty.  Right now he's so
plastered he can barely move, so he'll be stuck in that chair for a while.

long: A drunken pirate sits here, taking a swig of booze.
description:
This pirate is quite enjoying his time off duty.  Right now he's so
plastered he can barely move, so he'll be stuck in that chair for a while.

long: @o@cGlumgold the Pirate@n@y, Captain of this Vessel, stands here.@n
description:
He looks very mean!  He's missing an eye, a hand, and a leg, each replaced
some way or another.

long: @yA @o@gb@cr@ri@gg@ch@rt@cl@gy @cc@ro@gl@co@rr@ge@cd@n@y parrot is perched here.@n
description:
This parrot, Polly, comes from a far away tropical land that these
pirates have visited.  Parrots are believed to have the ability to hold a
conversation, but in reality they only repeat simple phrases that they've heard
others speak.

long: A small crab is here, scurrying about in the sand.
description:
It's a small, red, crab.  He looks quite content just sitting here on the
beach.

long: Tai Ho, a famous fisherman, sits on the side of the boat waiting for a fish to bite his line.
description:
Tai Ho is a fisherman from a far away town called Kaku, in the Toran
Republic.  He and his brother Yam Koo travel far and wide searching for good
spots to fish and good people to gamble with.

long: Yam Koo, a fisherman, stands here.
description:
Yam Koo is the brother of Tai Ho.  The two come from the town of Kaku in the
Toran Republic in search of good times and good fishing.

long: A rat is chewing on an moldy piece of bread here.
description: A rat is a small, black, greasy looking rodent with a tiny twitching nose.

long: A dusty white moth beats her wings here.
description:
No longer than the first joint of a human finger, this tiny moth flits about
looking for more curtains to chew upon.

long: A rat is wiggling beneath the covers here.
description:
The rat is a fairly large black rodent with shiny black whiskers and a foul
odor about him.

long: A small rat is here, nibbling on something.
description:
This rat is a tiny specimen considering what else is roaming about this Keep.
His eyes are shiny black and his coat is of a dark brown color.

long: A bandit is sleeping on the floor here.
description:
His skin is covered by about three layers of grime and has various scars all
over his face.  The bandits clothing is ripped and riddled with lice and food.

long: A female bandit is here, looking for something to wear.
description:
This young woman is half dressed in one of Lady Kalithorn's old dusty
dresses.  The dress has been ripped at the hem and is missing a sleeve.  The
young woman is rummaging through her closet for a better one.

long: A bat is flapping about here.
description: It looks like a flying rat!

long: A mouse is running about here, looking for a scrap of food.
description:
Small and gray this mouse looks a little on the thin side.  Its whiskers
twitch quickly and it blinks rapidly.

long: A stone guardian is fixed into the wall here.
description:
The guardian appears to be made of a chiseled marble.  A wondrous hand has
chiseled out a most imposing carving.  The guardian's stone delineated muscles
seem to quiver and its eyes almost shift.  Whomever set them here must have
something to protect...

long: Grand Duke Kalithorn is here, plotting his revenge.
description:
Clad in a long tunic and matching brown hose, Grand Duke Kalithorn is bent
over his desk scribbling and mumbling to himself about his ultimate revenge upon
the bandits who took his wife.

long: A wandering bandit is here, staring off into the distance.
description:
Unshaved, scarred and generally unappealing to look at, a bandit, grins
broadly as he stares off into the distance.

long: A dirty bandit is standing here.
description:
Looks like this fella hasn't washed in a loooong time.  His stench alone
could kill.

long: The leader of the bandits is here, writing something down.
description:
This bandit is at least somewhat clean as compared to the rest of the
riff-raff.  His hair is bound back with a leather fillip and he appears to be
writing something down in a notebook.

long: A young bandit is sneaking about here.
description:
This small, lanky bandit is hardly old enough to have hair on his face, yet
he walks with the confidence of a much older individual.  The calluses on his
hands prove that he knows his way around a sword.

long: The homba flits about.
description: Part kestrel, part bear, part wolf.  Parts is parts, and makes an ugly whole.

long: The greatest swordsman in the land is standing here with a sneer on his face.
description: This is the ultimate swordsman.

long: The Mummy of Rabscuttle wanders here, hands aloft, walking towards you.
description: All bandages, no personality.

long: A giant lizard is here.
description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to its underground habitat.
He looks very powerful.

long: General Woundwort, the dark demon of Minos, awaits to maul you to shreds.
description: He looks vaguely like a rabbit, but sure doesn't act like one.

long: Franz, Minos' henchman, is here ready to pump you up.
description:
Franz is no girlie man.  He is very muscular and looks as if he could squeeze
your head like a grapefruit.

long: Hanz is here flexing his muscles and squeezing grapefruits.
description:
Hanz is no girlie man.  He is very muscular and looks as if he could lift a
large dragon.

long: King Minos the Minotaur is ready and waiting to gore you to death.
description: He smells something awful.

long: A large dragon turtle breaks the surface churning the water into huge waves.
description: The turtle's shell is the size of a small house and looks as hard as rock.

long: You notice the face of an ugly hag in the sea weeds.
description: The sea hag is terribly frightful and has razor sharp teeth.

long: There is a merman swimming here brandishing his trident at you!
description: The merman has a powerful tail fin instead of legs.

long: A crusty looking crab is crawling around here searching for food.
description: It looks like a crab...  What more can be said?

long: A desert fox watches you carefully, trying to keep a safe distance away.
description:
This sly fox has learned to live in this wasteland and survive off it's
meager wildlife.  His tan coat blends with the sand around him, making him
almost impossible to follow as he never stays out in the open for long.

long: A small brown and black spider is hiding in the sand.
description:
You've heard stories about these small, but deadly, spiders.  They wait for a
victim to walk over them and then they attack.  Poisoning their prey with their
deadly venom.  It's been rumored that these spiders can even take down full
grown camels.

long: A camel spits at you!
description:
These beasts of burden are one of the foulest creatures in the realm.  They
reek and have a bad habit of spitting on people.  This four legged animal not
only resembles but also acts like a mule.  But they are invaluable to someone
trying to cross the desert.  They have been known to go months without water.

long: A coyote slinks away as you approach.
description:
This scavenger lives off the misfortune of those attempting to cross the
deserts.  They are known for their intelligence and cunning fighting skills.
They sometimes wander in packs and have been known to attack travellers.

long: A huge scorpion raises its tail and prepares to strike.
description:
These deadly desert dwellers are more poisonous than even the spiders found
in these parts.  They are very quick and can attack even when unprovoked.  Many
a traveller has been killed simply by almost stepping on one.

long: A hyeena cackles insanely as you pass.
description:
These small dog like creatures are known for their tempers and hunting in
packs to take down large animals.  They have an impressive set of sharp small
teeth.  They are rarely found alone and always rely on strength in numbers.

long: An old man stands here leaning on an expertly crafted bow.
description:
He stands with a casualness that radiates enough confidence to make you think
twice before approaching.  But then you look at his face and realize he means no
one any harm.  He is just here to train those seeking to learn the ways of the
Ranger.

long: A tall man stands here, casually stringing a bow.
description:
You wonder why this man is just standing out here in the middle of no where.
He seems in no hurry and you almost wonder if he is guarding something.  He is
in his middle years and has several scars from what must have been some
horrendous battles.

long: A small squirrel scampers about.
description:
A little brown squirrel scampers about busily, searching for nuts.  Finding
one, he grabs it and begins cracking it, before noticing you.  He stands stock
still and stares, waiting for you to make a move.

long: A sparrow buzzes erratically about.
description:
A small sparrow flies around randomly, collecting food and grass for it's
nest.

long: A mad wizard stands here, cackling at your presence.
description:
Red lines criss-cross in the mad wizards eyes as he glances around the room.
He dons a purple cone-shaped hat on his head, and he is dressed in ragged blue
robes.

long: A mole squints at you from the safety of its den.
description:
A mole with velvety brown fur and cute squinty eyes peers at you.  He tugs
his nose a few times, then resumes staring at the sky.

long: A lanky white rabbit hops around here.
description:
Jumping around in a blind frenzy, the rabbit takes little heed in your
appearance.  Standing about a foot high, the lanky white speedster expertly
bounds around you, eluding your grasp.

long: A wily red fox sprints around here.
description:
A wily red fox, almost 3 feet long, rushes around the path.  Spotting you, he
stops momentarily and stares at you, then continues his everlasting search for
rabbits.

long: A demonic bear with blood-red eyes snarls at you.
description:
A huge, 8 foot tall bear snarls menacingly.  His blood-red eyes seem to
pulsate eerily, and it raises a blunt claw, making ready to swipe at you.

long: A black rat scurries about.
description: A small black rat, about a foot long, scurries about the floor.

long: The queen of all rats prepares for battle.
description:
The queen of all rats, in all her hideousness.  Her jet black fur reflects no
light, and this monster is a full 3 foot long, maybe even longer.  Teeth working
in a mad frenzy, it looks ready to kill.

long: An old knight is here, ready for a last battle.
description:
An old knight is here, he must be at least 70.  As hard as it is to believe,
he still finds the strength to wield his sword and armor.  What a valiant man.

long: A small hairy gremlin hops about recklessly.
description:
A small gremlin, about 3 foot high and brandishing sharp claws bounces about.
Although he looks weak, appearances can be deceiving.

long: The King is here, shining his sword of legend.
description:
The King of Domiae seems young.  His face is youthful, with no gray hairs or
wrinkles.  He has sandy blond hair, but no beard.  His blue eyes seem to
penetrate into one's very soul.
